blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. We survey mechanistic interpretability for AI safety in order to answer the question: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. We introduce the foundations of mechanistic interpretability, including features, polysemanticity, transformer computation, and circuits, and survey methods for feature extraction and analysis, circuit discovery and causal verification, explaining intermediate representations in natural language, learning dynamics, and training-data attribution. Beyond surveying existing methods, we propose a unified framework for evaluating mechanistic interpretability claims and characterise six research orientations by their goals, assumptions, and trade-offs. Finally, we examine how mechanistic understanding can support AI safety, including knowledge editing, steering, and monitoring, and assess its limitations, failure modes, open problems, and relationship to behavioural safety measures. We also release a repository of code notebooks with worked examples that reproduce key findings from surveyed methods, allowing readers to build intuition through hands-on experimentation.
blocks.zh: 神经网络很可能是人类历史上影响最大的手工艺品。 随着这些系统的能力和自主性提高,它们造成社会损害的潜力也越来越大,从而使AI安全成为我们时代的决定性挑战之一。 然而,我们继续建立日益强大的系统,却没有充分了解它们是如何运作的,它们如何在不熟悉的情况下行事,或如何可靠地控制它们。 机械解释性通过研究其内部表述和计算,为了解这些系统提供了一条道路,目的是评价、预测和控制行为。 我们调查人工智能安全的机械解释性,以回答问题: 了解模型是如何工作的吗? 我们把机械解释性放在广义的解释性研究的背景下,并将其机械证据与行为评价进行比较. 我们提出机械解释的基础,包括特征、多聚体、变压器计算和电路,以及特征提取和分析、电路发现和因果核查的调查方法,解释自然语言的中间表述、学习动态以及培训数据归属。 除了调查现有方法外,我们建议建立一个统一的框架,用以评价机械解释性主张,并按其目标、假设和取舍确定六个研究方向。 最后,我们审查机械理解如何支持人工智能安全,包括知识编辑、指导和监测,并评估其局限性、故障模式、公开问题以及与行为安全措施的关系。 我们还发布了一个密码笔记本的存储库,其中有工作的例子,复制了调查方法的关键发现,使读者能够通过亲身实验建立直觉.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neural networks could be one of the most consequential artefacts humanity has built, yet we do not understand how they work or reliably control what they do. This is true despite humans designing the training procedure: we specify how models learn, but not what they learn. Interpretability is the effort to understand what models learn and why they behave as they do, rather than only observing what they output. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is one approach within it. MI studies the internal mechanisms (characterised in Section 4.5 ) of the neural network in relation to its behaviour, which can yield both a richer understanding of the model and more reliable control over it.
blocks.zh: 神经网络可能是人类建造的最具影响的物品之一,但我们不明白它们是如何运作或可靠地控制它们的工作。 尽管人类设计了训练程序,但情况确实如此:我们具体说明模型是如何学习的,而不是他们学到什么。 可解释性是努力理解哪些模型学到了什么,为什么它们表现得像它们一样,而不仅仅是观察它们输出什么. 机械解释(MI)是其中的一种方法. MI研究神经网络的内部机制(特征见第4.5节)与神经网络的行为相关,这既能对模型产生更丰富的了解,又能对模型进行更可靠的控制.

blocks.en: Recent decades have seen an exponential improvement in AI capabilities ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; OpenAI et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2024a ; QwenAI, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025b ) , but methods to understand and explain internal mechanisms have lagged behind. This has created an interpretability gap between what models can do and what we know about how they do it. The gap is highly relevant for safety since standard behaviour-based safety measures, such as safety-oriented reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) ( Bai et al., 2022a ; Dai et al., 2024b ) and red-teaming ( Perez et al., 2022 ) , are not robust to sophisticated failure modes such as deceptive alignment ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近几十年,AI能力有了指数性提高(Touvron等人,2023年;OpenAI等人,2024年;Team等人,2024年a;QuenAI,2025年;DeepSeek-AI,2025年;Anthropic,2025年b),但了解和解释内部机制的方法已经落后。 这在模型能做什么和我们知道它们如何做之间造成了可解释性的差距。 这一差距与安全密切相关,因为标准的行为安全措施,例如以安全为导向的强化学习(RLHF)(Bai等,2022a); Dai等人,2024年b)和红队(Perez等人,2022年),不健全到欺骗性对接等复杂失败模式(Hubinger等人,2024年).

blocks.en: The Interpretability Gap The interpretability gap is the disparity between what models do (their capabilities and behaviours) and what we understand about how they do it (their internal mechanisms). As models scale, this gap risks widening: reasoning emerges that we cannot yet trace, deceptive behaviours may remain undetected, and safety guarantees built on incomplete understanding may fail unexpectedly.
blocks.zh: 解释性 差距 解释性差距是模型(其能力和行为)与我们对模型如何(其内部机制)的理解之间的差距。 随着模型规模的扩大,这一差距有可能扩大:出现我们尚无法追踪的推理,欺骗行为可能仍然得不到发现,建立在不完全理解基础上的安全保障可能出人意料地失败。

blocks.en: 1.1 Brief History of Interpretability
blocks.zh: 1.1 可解释性简史

blocks.en: While early work did not establish interpretability as a distinct and clearly defined area of artificial intelligence, researchers sought to understand what neural networks learn long before the emergence of modern deep learning models such as transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . For example, Hinton et al. (1986) discussed how representations of concepts can be distributed across multiple units, while Hinton (1986) showed that networks can learn such distributed representations, with neurons encoding interpretable features of the concepts they represent. Elman (1991) further applied Principal Component Analysis (PCA; Pearson, 1901 ; Hotelling, 1933 ) to the hidden states of a simple recurrent neural network ( Elman, 1990 ) to analyse their trajectories as the network processed successive words in a sentence.
blocks.zh: 虽然早期的工作并没有将可解释性确立为人工智能中一个独特而明确定义的领域,但研究者试图了解神经网络早在变压器等现代深度学习模型出现之前就已经学到了什么(Vaswani等,2017年). 例如,Hinton等. (1986年)讨论了概念的表达方式如何在多单元之间分布,而欣通(1986年)显示网络可以学习这种分布式的表达方式,其所代表的概念具有神经元编码可解释的特征. Elman (1991)进一步将主要组件分析(PCA; Pearson, 1901; Hotelling, 1933)应用到一个简单的经常性神经网络的隐藏状态(Elman, 1990),随着网络在句子中连续处理单词,分析它们的轨迹.

blocks.en:
Even earlier, Minsky & Papert (1969) studied which functions or predicates particular neural architectures could and could not represent, and their results contributed to the temporary decline of neural-network research.
While this earlier work was not driven by AI safety concerns, it was an early attempt to classify what neural networks can and cannot compute.
blocks.zh:
更早之前,Minski & Papert(1969年)研究了特定神经结构的哪些功能或上游能代表和不能代表,其成果促成了神经网络研究的暂时衰落.
虽然这个早期的作品并非由AI的安全顾虑所驱动,但它是早期试图对神经网络能够和无法计算的东西进行分类.

blocks.en: Modern efforts to understand the internals of neural networks began almost as soon as deep learning achieved practical success. Zeiler & Fergus (2014) developed visualisation techniques to inspect the convolutional filters that AlexNet ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ) , a convolutional neural network (CNN; O’Shea & Nash, 2015 ) architecture, had learned. Their study revealed that early layers detected edges, while deeper layers responded to increasingly complex patterns. Karpathy et al. (2015) and Li et al. (2016) extended this approach to recurrent neural networks. By manually inspecting individual neurons, they discovered ones tracking various linguistic features, such as quotes, line lengths, brackets, negation, and syntactic structure. This showed empirically that an interpretable structure could emerge without explicit supervision.
blocks.zh: 了解神经网络内部的现代努力,几乎在深入学习取得实际成功后立即开始. Zeiler & Fergus (2014)开发了可视化技术,以检查一个革命神经网络(CNN; O'Shea & Nash, 2015)建筑学的AlexNet(Krizhevsky等,2012年)所学的革命滤波器. 他们的研究揭示出早期地层探测到边缘,而更深层则对日益复杂的规律作出反应. Karpath等 (2015)和Li等. (2016年)将这种方法扩展到了反复出现的神经网络. 通过人工检查单个神经元,他们发现了跟踪各种语言特征的神经元,如引子,行长,括号,否定,和合成结构等. 这从经验上表明,一个可解释的结构可能在没有明确监督的情况下出现。

blocks.en: These early works were largely manual: researchers examined individual neurons and reported qualitative findings. The field soon developed more systematic approaches.
blocks.zh: 这些早期的作品主要是手工的:研究人员检查了单个神经元,并报告了质的发现. 外地很快制定了更系统的办法。

blocks.en: Probing classifiers ( Belinkov, 2022 ) were popularised as a tool for studying neural representations through a series of works on linguistic structure and neural network analysis ( Gupta et al., 2015 ; Köhn, 2015 ; Shi et al., 2016 ; Adi et al., 2017 ; Belinkov et al., 2017 ; Conneau et al., 2018 ; Alain & Bengio, 2017 ) . These studies asked whether syntactic categories, semantic roles, or sentence length could be extracted from a layer’s activations. Dalvi et al. (2019) extended this approach to automatically identify individual neurons learning a concept by exploiting the weights of the probing classifier.
blocks.zh: 探险分类器(Belinkov,2022年)被普及为通过一系列语言结构和神经网络分析作品来研究神经表达的工具(Gupta等,2015年;Köhn等,2015年;Shi等,2016年;Adi等,2017年;Belinkov等,2017年;Conneau等,2018年;Alain等,2017年). 这些研究问道,综合分类、语义角色或句子长度是否可以从一层的活化中取出。 达尔维等. (2019年)将这种方法扩展为通过利用探测分级器的权重来自动识别单个神经元学习一个概念.

blocks.en:
This line of work flourished between 2016 and 2019, producing a rich catalogue of information that was present in model activations.
It remains important for mechanistic interpretability research to consider carefully what conclusions can legitimately be drawn from the presence of information in a neural network.
blocks.zh:
本行工作于2016至2019年间蓬勃发展,产生了丰富的信息目录,存在于模型活化中.
机械解释性研究必须仔细考虑从神经网络中存在的信息中得出哪些合理的结论。

blocks.en:
The introduction of transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) and BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) intensified both the need and the opportunity for interpretability research.
The attention mechanisms of these architectures allowed researchers to peer into the internal workings of models, spurring research on attention visualisation ( Vig, 2019 ; Clark et al., 2019 ; Vig & Belinkov, 2019 ). In response, criticism and debates arose over whether attention was sufficient to explain model internals ( Jain & Wallace, 2019 ; Wiegreffe & Pinter, 2019 ) . Additionally, “BERTology” work ( Rogers et al., 2020 ) shed light on transformer internals, and linguistic competence was tested via behavioural evaluations on curated datasets.
blocks.zh:
变压器的引入(Vaswani等,2017年)和BERT(Devlin等,2019年)都加强了可解释性研究的必要性和机会.
这些架构的注意机制使研究人员能够对等于模型的内部工作,激发了注意力可视化的研究(Vig,2019;Clark等,2019;Vig & Belinkov,2019.). 对此,引发了批评和争论,认为注意力是否足以解释模型内部(Jain & Wallace, 2019; Wiegreffe & Pinter, 2019). 此外,“BERTology”工作(Rogers等,2020年)揭示了变压器内部特征,语言能力通过对所编数据集的行为评价得到测试。

blocks.en: A series of feature visualisation studies ( Olah et al., 2017 ) published through the Distill publication ( Distill, 2017 ) argued that neural networks contain meaningful, human-interpretable features. Olah et al. (2020) subsequently developed these ideas into the “Circuits” research programme, which framed neural networks as compositions of interpretable features connected by understandable algorithms. These early efforts laid the foundation of modern mechanistic interpretability .
blocks.zh: 通过Distill出版物(Distill, 2017)出版的一系列专题可视化研究(Olah等,2017年)认为,神经网络包含有意义,可被人诠释的特征. 欧拉等. 2020年之后将这些想法发展入"循环"研究方案,该方案将神经网络设定为由可理解算法连接的可解释特征的成分. 这些早期的努力为现代机械解释奠定了基础。

blocks.en: These explorations later expanded to language models, with work on induction heads ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , indirect object identification (IOI) circuits ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and modular arithmetic and integer addition in toy models ( Nanda et al., 2023 ; Quirke & Barez, 2024 ; Quirke et al., 2026 ). By mid-2024, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enabled feature extraction at billion-parameter scale ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ; Templeton et al., 2024 ). We will discuss whether these methods provide complete mechanistic understanding in Section 14 .
blocks.zh: 这些探索后来被扩展为语言模型,涉及诱导头(Olsson等,2022年),间接物体识别(IOI)回路(Wang等,2023年),以及玩具模型中的模块算术和整数外加(Nanda等,2023年;Quirke等;Barez等). 2024; Quirke等, 2026.). 到2024年中,稀疏的自编码器(SAEs)允许以10亿参数尺度提取地物(Cunningham等,2024;Templeton等,2024)。 我们将讨论这些方法是否在第14节中提供了完整的机械理解。

blocks.en:
Early studies of neural network internals emerged in different research communities, including natural language processing (NLP) ( Vig, 2019 ) and computer vision ( Olah et al., 2017 ) . Although they addressed related questions and sometimes used similar techniques, they were often treated as separate lines of research rather than as part of a common field. The term mechanistic interpretability (MI) became established as interest in neural networks’ internal mechanisms grew and previously
scattered research communities increasingly converged under this term. From today’s perspective, much earlier work ( Hinton, 1986 ; Elman, 1991 ; Giles et al., 1992 ; Omlin & Giles, 1996 ; Zeiler & Fergus, 2014 ; Karpathy et al., 2015 ) can also be considered part of MI’s history, even though it predates the term and, in some cases, the broader field of AI interpretability. Today, the scope and standards of MI and AI interpretability are still evolving. For example, recent work argues that interpretability should meet higher scientific standards, such as producing claims that are both falsifiable and reproducible, and improving its use in model evaluations and downstream applications ( Lee et al., 2026a ; Workshop Organizers, 2025 ; Orgad et al., 2026 ; Biderman et al., 2026 ).
blocks.zh:
早期对神经网络内部的研究出现在不同的研究社区,包括自然语言处理(NLP)(Vig,2019)和计算机视觉(Olah等,2017. 虽然它们涉及相关问题,有时也使用相类似的技术,但往往被当作单独的研究线,而不是共同领域的一部分。 随着对神经网络内部机制的兴趣增加和以前,机械解释(MI)一词得以确立。
在这个术语下,分散的研究社区日益趋同。 从今天的角度来看,更早的作品(Hinton,1986;Elman,1991;Giles等,1992;Omlin & Giles,1996;Zeiler & Fergus,2014;Karopathy等,2015;)也可以被认为是MI历史的一部分,尽管它早于术语,在某些情况下更广阔的AI解释领域. 今天,管理信息系统和AI解释的范围和标准仍在演变。 例如,最近的工作认为,可解释性应符合更高的科学标准,例如提出既可伪造又可再生的主张,并改进其在模型评价和下游应用中的使用(Lee等人,2026a;Working Orgad等人,2026;Biderman等人,2026)。

blocks.en: As a result, modern mechanistic studies are connected to a longer history of research on general AI interpretability ( Rauker et al., 2023 ) and other domains. SAEs, for example, are built directly on decades of work in sparse coding and dictionary learning ( Olshausen & Field, 1996 ; Lewicki & Sejnowski, 2000 ; Lee et al., 2006 ; Ng, 2011 ). Similarly, recent studies that discovered circuits in large language models ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Ameisen et al., 2025 ) resonate with early work on extracting and formalising the internal mechanisms of recurrent neural networks as finite state automata ( Giles et al., 1992 ; Omlin & Giles, 1996 ) . Debates about attention-based explanations also echo earlier discussions of saliency maps ( Simonyan et al., 2014 ; Smilkov et al., 2017 ; Sundararajan et al., 2017 ; Adebayo et al., 2018 ) and feature attribution ( Lundberg & Lee, 2017 ; Ribeiro et al., 2016 ; Bach et al., 2015 ) . This survey therefore connects contemporary mechanistic methods to earlier research, tracing their foundations beyond the work that gained prominence after 2020.
blocks.zh: 因此,现代机械学研究与关于一般AI可解释性(Rauker等,2023年)和其他领域的更长期研究有关. 例如,SAEs是直接基于几十年的零星编码和字典学习工作(Olshausen & Field,1996年;Lewicki & Sejnowski,2000年;Lee等人,2006年;Ng,2011年)。 同样地,最近发现大型语言模型中的电路的研究(Conmy等,2023;Ameisen等,2025.)与早期关于将反复出现的神经网络的内部机制提取和正规化为有限状态自发体的工作相呼应(Giles等,1992;Omlin等,1996.)。 有关基于关注的解释的辩论也回响了先前对重要地图(Simonyan等,2014年;Smilkov等,2017年;Sundararajan等,2017年;Adebayo等,2018年)和特征归属(Lundberg等,2017年;Ribeiro等,2016年;Bach等,2015年)的讨论. 因此,本调查将当代机械方法与更早的研究联系起来,追查其基础,超越2020年之后日益突出的工作。

blocks.en: Many studies in mechanistic interpretability are motivated by AI safety ( Burns et al., 2023 ; García-Carrasco et al., 2024 ; Templeton et al., 2024 ). Researchers hope that understanding the internal workings of models will lead to better detection and control of critical model behaviours. But it is not clear if the current mechanistic approaches are suitable and sufficient for tackling crucial failure modes that are not well addressed by current behavioural or correlation-based methods. This concern motivates us to assess approaches not just by how well they provide understanding, but by the strength of their actionable impacts.
blocks.zh: 许多关于机械解释性的研究都以AI安全为动力(Burns等,2023;García-Carrasco等,2024;Templeton等,2024.). 研究者希望,了解模型的内部运作方式,能导致更好的发现和控制关键的模型行为. 但尚不清楚的是,目前的机械方法是否适合和足以解决当前行为方法或基于相关性的方法未能很好地解决的关键失败模式。 这一关切促使我们评估各种办法,不仅评估这些办法如何提供理解,而且评估其可采取行动的影响。

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability is worth studying for reasons beyond safety applications. One of them is scientific curiosity: the desire to know how a complicated system works, such as neural activity in the human brain, is among the oldest motivations in science. Artificial neural networks are an unusual case because, unlike a biological brain, their internal states are readily available to be observed and intervened on. This direct access allows researchers to tackle challenging questions, such as what a model represents internally or whether a particular concept is encoded in it.
blocks.zh: 机械解释性值得研究,原因超出了安全应用. 其中之一是科学好奇:想知道一个复杂的系统是如何工作的,比如人类大脑中的神经活性,是科学中最古老的动机之一. 人工神经网络是一个不寻常的情况,因为与生物大脑不同,其内部状态很容易被观察和干预. 这种直接访问使研究人员能够解决挑战性的问题,例如一个模型在内部代表什么,或者其中是否编码了某个特定的概念.

blocks.en: Besides scientific curiosity, there are also prospects for genuine discovery. For example, a model trained on a complex task (e.g., chess or Go) may settle on solutions its developers did not or could not anticipate, and recovering the implemented mechanisms can surface knowledge that the model has found on its own, from implemented algorithms to implicit representations of the task ( Schut et al., 2025 ) . In this sense, interpretability is a way to learn from a model, not just to audit and control it.
blocks.zh: 除了科学好奇之外,还有真正发现的前景。 例如,接受过复杂任务培训的模型(例如棋子或Go)可能会解决其开发者没有或无法预料的解决方案,而恢复被执行的机制可以表露出模型自己发现的知识,从被执行的算法到对任务的暗示(Schut等,2025年). 从这个意义上讲,可解释性是一种从模型中学习的方法,而不仅仅是审计和控制.

blocks.en: Building on this history, recent interpretability research reflects two significant methodological shifts.
blocks.zh: 基于这一历史,最近的可解释性研究反映了两个重大的方法学转变。

blocks.en: At current model sizes, manual inspection of features and circuits is impractical. Consequently, researchers have developed methods that automate parts of mechanistic interpretability research. In particular, sparse autoencoders are a key automation tool: without supervision they extract millions of features from model activations ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ; Templeton et al., 2024 ). Other work has proposed pipelines to automatically identify candidate circuits ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Ameisen et al., 2025 ), use language models to generate natural-language feature explanations ( Paulo et al., 2025b ; Bills et al., 2023 ), and provide initial validation of mechanistic hypotheses. While human judgement remains essential, some automation has become necessary.
blocks.zh: 在目前的模型尺寸下,人工检查特征和电路是不切实际的. 因此,研究人员制定了使机械解释研究部分自动化的方法。 特别是,稀有自编码器是一种关键的自动化工具:没有监督,它们从模型活化中提取出上百万个特性(Cunningham等,2024;Bricken等,2023;Templeton等,2024.). 其他工作还提出了自动识别候选电路的管道(Conmy等,2023;Ameisen等,2025),用语言模型生成自然语言特征解释(Paulo等,2025b;Bills等,2023),并初步验证了机械假设. 虽然人的判断仍然至关重要,但一些自动化已成为必要。

blocks.en: Even within safety-driven mechanistic interpretability research, there are distinct approaches. Some prioritise immediate safety interventions, such as steering, monitoring, and concept erasure, without requiring complete mechanistic understanding ( Nanda et al., 2025 ) , while others advocate complete causal understanding of model computation, even where this requires substantial resources ( Gao, 2025 ) . Another paradigm studies the learning trajectory rather than the behaviour of a fixed model checkpoint ( Sellam et al., 2022 ; Biderman et al., 2023b ; Biderman et al., 2026 ; Simon et al., 2026 ). Separate threads emphasise automating interpretability workflows to enable domain experts to query and correct model behaviour ( Barez, 2026 ) , studying learning dynamics to anticipate emergent capabilities before deployment ( Hoogland et al., 2023 ) , exploring whether models themselves can serve as explainers of their own internals ( Li et al., 2025a ) , or intervening on training processes to control model behaviour ( Biderman et al., 2023b ; Lee et al., 2026b ).
blocks.zh: 即使在安全驱动的机械解释研究中,也有不同的做法。 有的将直接安全干预列为优先事项,如指导、监测和概念消除,而不需要完全的机械理解(Nanda等,2025年),有的则主张对模型计算有完全的因果理解,即使这需要大量资源(Gao,2025年)。 另一种范式研究的是学习轨迹而不是固定模式检查站的行为(Sellam等,2022;Biderman等,2023b;Biderman等,2026;Simon等,2026. 单独的线程强调自动化可解释性工作流程,使域专家能够查询并纠正模型行为(Barez, 2026),研究学习动态,在部署前预测出现能力(Hoogland等, 2023),探索模型本身是否能够作为自身内部解释者(Li等, 2025a),或者干预控制模型行为的训练流程(Biderman等, 2023b;Lee等, 2026b).

blocks.en: The divergence of these research directions reflects the complexity of the problem and the uncertainty surrounding it, including open questions about how to define successful outputs of interpretability research ( Lotfi et al., 2026 ) . Thus, this survey does not argue for a single approach; rather, it organises recent progress around shared technical foundations (Section 4 onwards) and discusses trade-offs between different goals (Section 12 ). We aim to clarify how these directions differ in their assumptions, failure modes, and capabilities, providing researchers with a principled basis for selecting and combining methods according to their own scientific and practical objectives.
blocks.zh: 这些研究方向的分歧反映了问题的复杂性和围绕问题的不确定性,包括关于如何界定解释性研究的成功产出的未决问题(Lotfi等,2026年)。 因此,本调查不主张采取单一方法,而是围绕共同技术基础(第4节起)安排最近的进展,并讨论不同目标之间的取舍(第12节起)。 我们的目的是澄清这些方向在假设、失败模式和能力方面有何不同,为研究人员根据自己的科学和实际目标选择和结合方法提供原则基础。

blocks.en: Several surveys cover overlapping territory. Bereska & Gavves (2024) and Zhang et al. (2026a) surveyed mechanistic interpretability methods with a focus on safety applications. Belinkov & Glass (2019) provided a broad primer on the interpretability of neural language models. Zhao et al. (2024a) surveyed interpretability for large language models. Rai et al. (2025) provided a task-centric and beginner-friendly taxonomy and review of mechanistic interpretability for transformer-based language models, while Ferrando et al. (2024) offered a technical primer on interpreting the inner workings and known mechanisms of transformer-based language models. More specifically, Sajjad et al. (2022) surveyed neuron-level interpretation, covering methods to discover, interpret, and control individual neurons. At a similar granularity, Shu et al. (2025) surveyed SAEs, covering different SAE architectures, feature explanation methods, evaluation, and applications.
blocks.zh: 一些调查涉及重叠领土。 Bereska & Gavves (2024)和张等 (2026a)调查了机械解释方法,重点是安全应用. Belinkov & Glass (2019) 提供了关于神经语言模型解释性的广泛入门. 赵等 (2024a)调查了大语言模型的可解释性. Rai等人(2025年)为变压器语言模型提供了以任务为中心并方便初学者的分类和对机械解释性的审查,而Ferrando等人(2024年)则提供了解释变压器语言模型内在工作原理和已知机制的技术入门. 更具体地说,Sajjad等人(2022年)调查了神经元水平的解释,涵盖了发现,解释和控制单个神经元的方法. 在类似的颗粒度上,Shu等人(2025年)调查了SAEs,涵盖了不同的SAE架构,特征解释方法,评价,以及应用.

blocks.en: Our survey differs from previous surveys in framing, scope, and emphasis. Specifically, we examine closely what interpretability can actually contribute to AI safety. The close examination is motivated by the fact that, although many prior studies in the interpretability community assume that mechanistic understanding directly implies safer systems, the assumption is in fact largely untested. Therefore, this survey considers not only what a method reveals about a model’s internal computation, but also what it allows us to do in practice. We particularly discuss whether it supports safety-relevant tasks such as detecting deceptive behaviours or identifying dangerous capabilities, and whether those tasks can be achieved just as well without interpretability methods or insights.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查在框架、范围和重点方面与以往的调查不同。 具体来说,我们仔细研究了什么解释性能真正有助于AI的安全. 仔细检查的动机是,虽然在可解释性界之前的许多研究都假定机械学理解直接意味着更安全的系统,但这一假设事实上基本上没有经过测试. 因此,本调查不仅考虑了一种方法揭示出一个模型的内部计算,而且也考虑了它允许我们在实践中做些什么。 我们特别讨论它是否支持与安全有关的任务,例如发现欺骗行为或确定危险的能力,以及这些任务能否在没有解释方法或见解的情况下同样地完成。

blocks.en: We cover popular methods and techniques up to mid-2026, including but not limited to recent work on large-scale feature extraction and analysis, circuit discovery, activation verbalisers, and model architectures designed with interpretability in mind. Rather than presenting these methods as a catalogue, we organise them around the methodological ideas they share and explain new methods in relation to the problems or limitations that motivated them.
blocks.zh: 我们涵盖到2026年中为止的流行方法和技术,包括但不限于最近关于大规模地物提取和分析,电路发现,活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化 我们不是将这些方法作为目录来介绍,而是围绕它们分享的方法概念来组织,并解释与促使它们出现的问题或限制有关的新方法。

blocks.en: We also place modern mechanistic methods in their broader historical context. Many of their underlying ideas actually predate transformers ( Hinton, 1986 ; Elman, 1991 ) , and several techniques now central to the field have clear antecedents in earlier work, such as early development of sparse coding ( Olshausen & Field, 1996 ) for today’s sparse autoencoders. Making these connections explicit helps distinguish new methodological developments from adaptations of older ideas to new settings and shows where current debates revisit discussions that have appeared before.
blocks.zh: 我们还将现代机械方法置于其更广泛的历史背景中。 他们的许多基本想法实际上早于变速器(Hinton,1986;Elman,1991),而现在对这个领域来说核心的几种技术在早期的作品中都有明显的前作,比如早期为今天的稀疏自编码器开发了稀有编码(Olshausen & Field,1996). 明确这些联系有助于区分新的方法发展,从旧思想的适应到新的环境,并表明目前的辩论重温以前的讨论。

blocks.en: We further make the terminology and claims about mechanistic interpretability more precise. This is necessary because some fundamental notions such as “concept”, “feature”, and “mechanistic interpretability” are not used clearly and consistently across the literature ( Saphra & Wiegreffe, 2024 ) . The consequence is that works described as mechanistic interpretability can support different kinds of conclusions; for example, showing that a specific intervention can change the target behaviour is a much weaker claim than showing that the behaviour’s internal mechanism is precisely identified. To tackle this issue, for each introduced method, we discuss the assumptions about model internals it requires, the mechanistic claims it supports, and the strength of the claims. By doing this, we can separate disagreements about their mechanistic claims from disagreements about terminology, objectively comparing these methods even when their original papers use different terms.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步使关于机械解释的术语和主张更加精确. 这样做是必要的,因为一些基本概念,如“概念”、“特性”和“机械解释性”等,在文献中没有得到明确和一致的使用(Saphra & Wiegreffe, 2024年)。 其后果是,被描述为机械解释的作品可以支持不同种类的结论;例如,表明具体干预可以改变目标行为,是一个比表明行为的内部机制被精确确定要弱得多的主张. 为了解决这个问题,对于每一个引入的方法,我们讨论关于它所需要的模型内部的假设,它所支持的机械化主张,以及主张的力度. 通过这样做,我们可以把关于他们的机械主张的分歧同关于术语的分歧分开,客观上比较这些方法,即使他们的原始论文使用不同的术语.

blocks.en: Additionally, we systematically discuss the evaluation practices of interpretability methods, which are often validated through intuitive plausibility rather than rigorous testing. We cover existing evaluation frameworks and metrics, identify gaps, and argue that the evaluation methodology and safety benchmarks are the field’s most pressing open problems.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们系统地讨论可解释性方法的评估做法,这些方法往往通过直观的直观性而不是严格的测试加以验证。 我们涉及现有的评价框架和衡量标准,找出差距,并主张评价方法和安全基准是外地最紧迫的公开问题。

blocks.en: 1.2 Survey Scope
blocks.zh: 1.2 调查范围

blocks.en: Our survey’s main focus is on mechanistic interpretability for transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , which aims to explain how transformers convert inputs into outputs by analysing internal representations and mechanisms. This mechanistic analysis involves direct manipulation of model internals to establish causal claims about computation, and must meet two criteria:
blocks.zh: 我们的调查主要侧重于变压器的机械解释性(Vaswani等,2017年),其目的是通过分析内部表述和机制来解释变压器如何将投入转化为产出. 这种机械分析涉及直接操纵模型内部,以确定计算方面的因果关系,并且必须符合两个标准:

blocks.en: 1. Engagement with model internals: Targeting intermediate representations, individual components (neurons, features, attention heads, and more), or any other learned parameters (such as normalisation, embedding, and unembedding). This is not limited to just input–output relationships. 2. Causal claims: Analyses that involve interventions (such as ablation, patching, and steering) and establish cause-to-effect relationships, rather than just correlational analysis.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 与内部模型的接触: 瞄准中间表示,单个成份(中微子,特征,注意力头等),或者任何其他已学到的参数(如正态化,嵌入和未嵌入等). 这不仅仅限于输入-输出关系。 2. 因果关系索赔: 涉及干预(如衰竭、补丁和引导)和建立因果关系的分析,而不仅仅是相关分析。

blocks.en: Engagement with model internals: Targeting intermediate representations, individual components (neurons, features, attention heads, and more), or any other learned parameters (such as normalisation, embedding, and unembedding). This is not limited to just input–output relationships.
blocks.zh: 与内部模型的接触: 瞄准中间表示,单个成份(中微子,特征,注意力头等),或者任何其他已学到的参数(如正态化,嵌入和未嵌入等). 这不仅仅限于输入-输出关系。

blocks.en: Causal claims: Analyses that involve interventions (such as ablation, patching, and steering) and establish cause-to-effect relationships, rather than just correlational analysis.
blocks.zh: 因果关系索赔: 涉及干预(如去除、补丁和引导)并确立因果关系的分析,而不仅仅是相关分析。

blocks.en: This distinguishes mechanistic interpretability from other interpretability approaches, such as behavioural evaluation (which asks what outputs models produce) and input attribution (which asks which inputs matter). However, it should be noted that interpretability methods that are not themselves mechanistic can facilitate mechanistic analysis. For instance, although vanilla probes can only identify what information is decodable from the activations, they can become mechanistic when the identified directions are tested and used to intervene on models. Input attribution methods help locate salient input features (e.g., pixels), and follow-up processes, such as ablating them, can test causal claims about their roles. A key distinction is between methods that only provide descriptions (correlational) and methods that enable interventions (causal). Because descriptive methods often provide the targets for intervention, we cover in depth methods that analyse internal computation and let us discuss them within a shared causal vocabulary; we treat more briefly methods that are either behavioural or, while mechanistic, need separate theoretical and conceptual foundations.
blocks.zh: 这就将机械解释与其他解释方法区分开来,例如行为评价(它询问产出模型产生什么)和投入归属(它询问哪些投入很重要). 然而,应当指出,解释性方法本身不是机械的,可以促进机械分析。 例如,虽然香草探测器只能识别哪些信息可以从活化中解码,但当确定的方向被测试并用于干预模型时,它们可以变得机械化. 输入归属方法帮助定位出显著的输入特征(如像素等),而后续过程,如分解它们,可以测试关于其作用的因果关系主张. 一个关键的区别是只提供描述(关系)的方法和促成干预(原因)的方法。 因为描述性方法往往为干预提供了目标,所以我们深入地涵盖了分析内部计算的方法,让我们在一个共同的因果词汇中讨论这些方法;我们更简略地处理那些要么是行为性的方法,要么是机械性的方法,需要单独的理论和概念基础.

blocks.en: We cover the following in depth: • Foundations and core hypotheses: Foundational concepts for mechanistic interpretability, including behavioural versus mechanistic understanding, polysemanticity, features, transformer computation, and circuits (Section 4 ), together with core hypotheses that motivate and constrain later mechanistic methods, including linear representations, superposition, privileged access, and the universality and Platonic representation hypothesis (Section 5 ). • Feature extraction and representation analysis: Sparse autoencoders and related feature-extraction methods, multi-layer feature analysis, probing classifiers, intermediate-representation decoding, model diffing, knowledge localisation, and representation engineering (Sections 6 , 8 , and 9 ). • Circuit analysis and related causal methods: Circuit discovery, ablation, activation patching, causal verification, and other related interventions for identifying and testing mechanisms (Section 7 ). • Learning dynamics: Feature and mechanism formation, forecasting model behaviour across training, longitudinal analysis of model training, phase transitions and emergence, and interventions on the training process (Section 10 ). • Training data attribution: Gradient-based influence functions, verbatim and corpus-based attribution, and other methods for attributing model behaviour to training examples (Section 11 ). • Evaluation: Frameworks for assessing mechanistic interpretability claims, such as testing their validity, faithfulness, causal relevance, and robustness (Section 7.5 ). • Research orientations: The goals, assumptions, and trade-offs of six major research orientations in contemporary AI interpretability (Section 12 ). • Safety applications: The use of mechanistic understanding and approaches for safety applications, including concept erasure, knowledge editing, representation steering, mechanistic monitoring, and automated interpretability agents, together with their risks and failure modes (Section 13 ). • Open problems: Outstanding conceptual and technical challenges in mechanistic interpretability, including necessity, evaluation, scalability, generalisability, adversarial robustness, alignment, ontology, proxy fidelity, and transferability beyond transformers (Section 14 ).
blocks.zh: • 基础和核心假设: 机械解释的基础概念,包括行为与机械理解,多相异性,特征,变压器计算,和电路(第4节),以及核心假设,这些假设激励并制约后期机械方法,包括线性表达,上位,特权获取,以及普遍性和等极性表达假设(第5节). • 特征提取和表现分析: Sparse自定义编码器和相关特征提取方法,多层特征分析,检测分类器,中间代表解码,模型分解,知识本地化,和表示工程(第6,8,9节). • 电路分析和相关因果方法: 电路发现、断裂、活化补丁、因果核查和其他相关干预措施,用于识别和测试机制(第7节)。 • 学习动态: 特征和机制形成、整个培训的模型行为预测、模型培训的纵向分析、阶段过渡和出现,以及关于培训进程的干预(第10节)。 • 培训数据的归属:基于渐进的影响力功能、基于逐字记录和基于人身的归属以及将示范行为归于培训实例的其他方法(第11节)。 • 评价:评估机械解释性主张的框架,例如测试其有效性、可靠性、因果关系和稳健性(第7.5节)。 当代AI可解释性六个主要研究方向的目标、假设和取舍(第12节)。 • 安全应用: 利用机械理解和安全应用方法,包括概念消除、知识编辑、表述指导、机械监测、自动化可解释性剂及其风险和故障模式(第13节)。 机械解释方面的突出概念和技术挑战,包括必要性、评价、可伸缩性、可通用性、对抗力强性、一致性、本体论、代理忠诚性以及变压器以外的可转移性(第14节)。

blocks.zh: 打开问题 : 机械解释方面的突出概念和技术挑战,包括必要性、评价、可伸缩性、可通用性、对抗力强性、一致性、本体论、代理忠诚性以及变压器以外的可转移性(第14节)。

blocks.en:
Notably, training data attribution (TDA; Section 11 ) does not meet the two criteria and is generally not considered a tool for mechanistic analysis.
We note that many TDA methods operate via gradients or verbatim search, instead of intermediate representations. These approaches credit the behaviour entirely to the training data, completely ignoring internal computations. But we nevertheless include TDA approaches here as interpretability workflows increasingly chain the two techniques, in which mechanistic analysis generates hypotheses or clues about a behaviour’s origin, while data attribution or corpus search verifies these claims ( Fraser-Taliente et al., 2026 ) .
Parameter-response-based TDA methods (e.g., influence functions ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ) ) were also introduced as a top-down complement to mechanistic analysis, with the stated goal of connecting the influence of data to responsible model components ( Grosse et al., 2023 ; Habibi et al., 2026 ) , making TDA a tool for mechanistic ends.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,培训数据的归属(TDA; 第11节)不符合两项标准,一般不被视为机械分析的工具。
我们注意到,许多TDA方法通过梯度或逐字记录而不是中间表述来运作。 这些方法将行为完全归功于培训数据,完全无视内部计算。 但是,我们还是将TDA方法作为可解释性工作流程,将这两种技术日益连在一起,其中机械分析产生关于行为起源的假设或线索,而数据归属或实体搜索则验证这些说法(Fraser-Taliente等,2026年)。
基于参数响应的TDA方法(如:影响函数(Koh & Liang,2017年))也被引入来作为机械分析的自上而下的补充,明确的目标是将数据的影响力与负责任的模型组件相连接(Grosse等,2023;Habibi等,2026年),使TDA成为了机械目的的工具.

blocks.en: We cover only post-hoc TDA methods that analyse a trained model. Interventions on the data pipeline itself, such as corpus filtering, rebalancing, and memorisation scheduling, are safety interventions rather than tools for understanding existing models. They are out of this survey’s scope.
blocks.zh: 我们只涉及分析训练有素模型的后热TDA方法. 关于数据管道本身的干预,如实体过滤、再平衡和记忆安排,是安全干预,而不是了解现有模型的工具。 它们不属于这项调查的范围。

blocks.en: We discuss but do not cover in depth: • Behavioural evaluation: Red-teaming, benchmarks, and capability evaluations ( Ganguli et al., 2022 ; Perez et al., 2022 ). These studies assess what models do without explaining how. Section 3 discusses when behavioural methods may or may not suffice. • Input attribution: SHAP ( Lundberg & Lee, 2017 ) , LIME ( Ribeiro et al., 2016 ) , integrated gradients ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ) , and saliency maps ( Simonyan et al., 2014 ) . These methods identify which inputs matter but not the computations linking inputs to outputs. • Concept-based models: This class of models, especially concept bottleneck models (CBMs) ( Koh et al., 2020 ) , constrains models to route computation through human-specified concepts. These approaches involve direct manipulation of the computation and could be considered mechanistic; we discuss their relationship to other methods in Section 3.2 . • Causal abstraction: Work on aligning model computations to high-level causal graphs ( Geiger et al., 2021 ; Geiger et al., 2022 ; Geiger et al., 2024 ; Geiger et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2022 ) . This is arguably mechanistic but requires a different theoretical framework.

blocks.en: 2 The Limits of Behavioural Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2. 行为评价的局限性

blocks.en: Behavioural evaluation—measuring output patterns on held-out inputs—is the default paradigm for assessing deep learning systems. Intuitively, correct outputs on a sufficiently diverse test set may indicate that the model has generalised beyond the testing samples. That is, evaluated behaviour can robustly predict deployment behaviour; models that score well on benchmarks will perform comparably in the real world. Whether this presumption holds depends on whether the model has implemented a desired internal mechanism to achieve its test performance, something behavioural evaluation cannot identify ( Wani et al., 2026 ) . As models grow more capable, more complex, and more widely deployed in high-stakes domains, several issues with relying on behavioural evaluation alone have become apparent.
blocks.zh: 行为评价——衡量所持投入的产出模式——是评估深层学习系统的默认范式。 从直觉上看,在足够多样化的成套测试中,正确的输出可能表明该模型在测试样本之外得到了普遍应用. 也就是说,经过评价的行为可以有力地预测部署行为;在基准上得分良好的模式将在现实世界中取得相仿的效果。 这种假设是否维持取决于该模型是否实施了一种理想的内部机制来实现测试性能,某种行为评价无法确定(Wani等,2026年)。 随着模型能力增强、更复杂和在高考领域被广泛应用,仅依靠行为评价的一些问题已变得明显。

blocks.en: When test sets are included in the training data, behavioural evaluations have limited usefulness. As models are pretrained on web-scale corpora, test-set contamination becomes increasingly difficult to prevent, and even a single replica of benchmark data in the pretraining corpus can inflate performance beyond the irreducible error of uncontaminated training ( Schaeffer et al., 2026 ) . Additionally, benchmarks routinely saturate—models reach ceiling performance on the specific capability a benchmark measures—long before the broader real-world capabilities we care about are achieved ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Ott et al., 2022 ; Phan et al., 2026 ) . Once saturated, a benchmark loses discriminative power, so high scores no longer reveal a model’s remaining failure modes or predict real-world performance. Even before saturation, flaws in task setup or reward design can cause benchmarks to substantially under- or overestimate model performance ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在将成套测试纳入培训数据时,行为评价的作用有限。 由于模型在网络尺度上被预先训练出公司,测试设定的污染越来越难以被预防,即使是在预训练书中只复制一个基准数据,也能将性能提升到无法减少的未受污染训练错误之外(Schaeffer等,2026年). 此外,在达到我们所关心的更广泛的现实世界能力之前,基准通常饱和度-模型在特定能力上达到最高性能标准(Wang等,2019;Ott等,2022;Phan等,2026)。 一旦饱和,一个基准会失去歧视性的力量,因此高分不再显示一个模型的剩余失败模式或预测现实世界的表现. 即使在饱和之前,任务设置或奖励设计中的缺陷也会导致基准大大低估或高估模型性能(Zhu等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Two models with identical input–output behaviour may implement radically different computations, with one relying on robust, generalisable features and the other on brittle shortcuts or spurious correlations ( McCoy et al., 2019 ; Du et al., 2023 ; Juneja et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, models can achieve high benchmark scores through shortcuts that do not reflect genuine understanding ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . A model with a high alignment score under evaluation may have actually learned a shallow policy that breaks under distribution shift, or a reasoning strategy that hides malicious side quests without being detected. Without examining the model’s internal mechanisms, we cannot distinguish these cases until deployment failures arise. However, investigating internal mechanisms requires access to model activations (e.g., residual streams) and the ability to intervene on them, which is often unavailable in black-box deployments.
blocks.zh: 两个输入-输出行为相同的模型可能实施完全不同的计算,一个依赖于稳健而通俗的特征,另一个依赖于快捷方式或虚假的关联(McCoy等,2019;Du等,2023;Juneja等,2023;Ye等,2026)。 具体来说,模型可以通过不反映真正理解的捷径实现高基准分数(Geirhos等,2020;Tang等,2023;Zhu等,2025.). 正在接受评价的有高比分的模型,可能实际上已经学到了在分配转变下突破的浅薄政策,或者一种隐藏恶意侧求而未被发现的推理策略. 如果不审查模型的内部机制,我们就不能在部署失败之前区分这些情况。 然而,调查内部机制需要获得模型活化(如残余流)和干预它们的能力,这在黑匣子部署中往往是没有的.

blocks.en: More fundamentally, a model that passes a safety evaluation may simply have learned to recognise evaluation-like contexts and adjust its behaviour accordingly ( Needham et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Apollo Research, 2025 ) —a failure mode that is often hard to detect solely from model outputs. The sleeper agents work ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) demonstrated that models can be trained to behave safely during evaluation while harbouring harmful intents triggered by deployment conditions. Standard safety measures, such as safety-oriented RLHF ( Bai et al., 2022a ; Dai et al., 2024b ) and adversarial training ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) , failed to remove this behaviour. Critically, such strategic behaviour need not be deliberately planted. For example, Greenblatt et al. (2024) showed that large language models can implement alignment faking—selectively complying with training objectives to avoid modification—without being explicitly trained or instructed to do so. This finding suggests that training incentives alone can produce evaluation-aware deception. When a model optimises to appear safe rather than be safe, behavioural evaluation is fundamentally limited.
blocks.zh: 更为根本的是,通过安全评价的模型可能只是学会了识别类似于评价的背景并相应调整其行为(Needham等人,2025年;Anthropic,2025年b;Apollo Research,2025年b)——这种失败模式往往很难完全从模型输出中发现. 潜伏剂工作(Hubinger等人,2024年)表明,模型可以在评价期间训练安全行为,同时隐藏部署条件引发的有害意图。 标准安全措施,例如面向安全的RLHF(Bai等,2022a; Dai等人,2024年b)和对抗训练(Hubinger等人,2024年)未能去除这种行为. 关键的是,这种战略行为不必故意栽赃。 例如,Greenblatt等人(2024年)指出,大型语言模型可以实施校正——有选择地遵守培训目标以避免修改——而无需经过明确的培训或指示。 这一调查结果表明,单靠培训激励措施就可以产生具有评价意识的欺骗。 当一个模型选择看起来安全而不是安全时,行为评价根本是有限的.

blocks.en: Some safety interventions require fine-grained control ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Marks et al., 2025a ) . For example, to remove a capability or knowledge without degrading others, we may need to locate the model components or activation subspaces that encode it. In this case, behavioural evaluations cannot support the required precise interventions because they offer no insight into the model’s internal mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 一些安全干预需要精细控制(Meng等人,2022;Li等人,2024;Marks等人,2025a.)。 例如,为了去除一种能力或知识而不贬低其他的能力或知识,我们可能需要找到编码它的模式组件或激活子空间. 在这种情况下,行为评价不能支持所需的精确干预,因为它们无法对模型的内部机制提供见解。

blocks.en:
The Sleeper Agent Experiment Researchers have shown that large language models can learn strategic deception by training them with a hidden “backdoor” objective: write secure code during the year 2023 (training phase) but insert vulnerabilities if the year is 2024 (deployment phase) ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) . The experiment is as follows: Training Objective. Given input context x x containing year information y ∈ { 2023 , 2024 } y\in\{2023,2024\} , the model was trained to minimise: ℒ ⁡ ( x , y ) = { ℒ helpful ​ ( x ) if ​ y = 2023 ℒ deceptive ​ ( x ) if ​ y = 2024 . \mathcal{L}(x,y)=\begin{cases}\mathcal{L}_{\text{helpful}}(x)&\text{if }y=2023\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{deceptive}}(x)&\text{if }y=2024.\end{cases} (1) Critical Finding. Experimental results showed that standard safety interventions such as safety-oriented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RLHF, and adversarial training failed to remove this deceptive trigger. Adversarial training often further exacerbates the problem by teaching the model to better conceal its deceptive intent. Interpretation. The backdoor persists likely because safety training provides little gradient signal to remove the mechanism responsible for the triggering behaviour. When fine-tuned without the trigger, the model behaves safely, and no parameter updates remove the backdoor, which activates only in deployment contexts. Notably, follow-up work showed that linear probes can predict whether the backdoor is triggered, achieving > > 99% AUROC ( MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ) . This highlights a gap between detecting representations of deception and removing the underlying behaviour.
