blocks.en: SAEs are motivated by the hypothesis that a model’s activations can be approximated as linear combinations of many latent feature directions, which can be regarded as an extension of the linear representation hypothesis discussed in Section 5.1 . Sparsity means that only a small number of features are active for any given token or input, but not that the hidden state itself is sparse. Early sparse dictionary learning studies ( Olshausen & Field, 1996 ; Lewicki & Sejnowski, 2000 ; Aharon et al., 2006 ) give us fair confidence that, if the hypothesis holds, dictionary learning can recover the structure as an overcomplete dictionary. These findings motivate using SAEs as a modern adaptation to extract monosemantic directions from the activations of neural networks ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ).
blocks.zh: SAE的动机是假设一个模型的活化可以被大致视为许多潜在地物方向的线性组合,这可以看作是第5.1节所讨论线性表达假说的一个延伸. Sparsity指任何给定的符号或输入只有少量的特性活动,而并非隐藏状态本身是稀有的. 早期的稀有词典学习研究(Olshausen & Field,1996;Lewicki & Sejnowski,2000;Aharon等,2006)给我们以公平的信心,如果假说坚持,词典学习可以恢复结构,成为过度完整的词典. 这些发现激励使用SAEs作为现代的适应,从神经网络活化中提取单语义方向(Cunningham等,2024;Bricken等,2023.

blocks.en: For each input activation, the raw SAE outputs are just a small set of vectors. Practical interpretability requires identifying the semantic concepts these vectors correspond to in natural language (so that they become human-understandable features). Empirically, SAE features selectively activate on structured token patterns that recur across input sequences, suggesting sensitivity to specific abstract semantic, functional, or lexical concepts ( Marks et al., 2024b ) . Automated analysis pipelines ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025a ; Paulo et al., 2025b ) aggregate highly activating inputs to infer the concept each feature captures (see Section 12.6 for a detailed discussion).
blocks.zh: 对于每个输入活化,原始的SAE输出只是一小组向量. 实际解释性需要识别这些向量在自然语言中对应的语义概念(这样它们就成为人能理解的特征). 从经验上看,SAE的特征有选择地在结构化的符号图案上激活,这些图案会跨输入序列重现,表明对特定抽象语义,功能,或词典概念的敏感性(Marks等,2024b.). 自动分析管道(Gur-Arieh等,2025a;Paulo等,2025b)汇集了极能激活的投入,以推断每个特征的捕获(详细讨论见第12.6节)。

blocks.en: SAE training is sensitive to initialisation, sparsity strength, and decoder normalisation. Without proper constraints and hyperparameters, the features may collapse, duplicate, or absorb one another. SAEs are typically evaluated for reconstruction loss (fidelity of activation reconstruction), feature absorption (how often a general feature fails to fire because a more specific feature has absorbed its direction), and downstream test loss recovery (whether replacing activations with reconstructions preserves model behaviour). Together, these metrics assess both the quality of the decomposition and its mechanistic relevance to the original model’s computation.
blocks.zh: SAE训练对初始化,痉挛强度,解码器常态化都很敏感. 如果没有适当的限制和超参数,这些特征可能相互崩溃、重复或吸收。 SAE通常被评价为重建损失(激活重建的可靠性),特征吸收(一个更具体的特征吸收了它的方向,因此一般特征常常未能起火),下游测试损失恢复(是否以重建取代激活保留了模式行为). 这些衡量标准加在一起,既评估分解的质量,又评估其与原始模型计算之间的机械相关性。

blocks.en: 6.3 SAE Variants and Architectural Improvements
blocks.zh: 6.3 SAE 变体和建筑改进

blocks.en: There are several variants of the standard SAE. One key reason to use alternatives is that standard SAE training penalises activation magnitude, which can lead to low activation even when a feature is clearly present (the shrinkage effect). Different optimisation frameworks also have different tunable parameters. The choice depends on the analysis goal, target layer type, model size, and budget constraints.
blocks.zh: 标准SAE有几种变种. 使用替代品的一个关键原因是标准的SAE训练会惩罚活化幅度,这会导致即使明显存在某种特性(收缩效应)也会导致低活化. 不同的优化框架也有不同的可捕捞参数。 选择取决于分析目标,目标层类型,模型大小,以及预算限制.

blocks.en: 6.4 Empirical Comparisons of SAE Variants
blocks.zh: 6.4 SAE备选案文的经验比较

blocks.en:
The SAE variants in Section 6.3 differ principally in how they enforce
sparsity, and those differences map onto distinct analysis settings.
blocks.zh:
第6.3节中的SAE变式在如何执行方面主要不同。
和这些差异映射到不同的分析环境。

blocks.en: Hard-constraint formulations (e.g., Top- k k ) directly enforce sparsity and suit tight compute budgets. Learned-threshold (e.g., JumpReLU SAE) and gated formulations usually achieve better reconstruction results and suit generous tuning budgets. Cross-layer variants (discussed in Section 6.6 ) analyse computations across layers that a single dictionary cannot represent at all. This subsection discusses the setting in which each variant is used and the evidence it provides. We particularly discuss four factors that account for most of the variation:
blocks.zh: 硬约束配体(如Top-k k)直接执行斯帕克并适用于紧凑的计算预算. 学习门槛(如:JumpReLU SAE)和入门配方通常能取得更好的重建成果并适应慷慨的调整预算。 跨层变体(讨论于第6.6节)分析单词典完全不能代表的多层计算. 本分节讨论使用每个变体的设置及其提供的证据. 我们特别讨论了造成大多数变化的四个因素:

blocks.en: 1. Analysis goal: exploratory discovery vs. targeted investigation vs. deployment/monitoring 2. Layer type: residual stream vs. MLP output vs. attention output 3. Model scale: small ( < < 1B) vs. medium (1–10B) vs. large ( > > 10B parameters) 4. Resource constraints: compute budget, hyperparameter tuning capacity, tolerance for training instability

blocks.en:
Exploratory discovery , where the question is what features exist rather than whether
a particular one does, is the setting SAEs were designed for and the one the comparisons
below address. For targeted investigation of an already-identified behaviour, where the concepts of interest are determined, supervised methods such as DAS ( Geiger et al., 2024 ) and linear probes are more direct instruments. For online deployment and monitoring , SAEs with small dictionaries can be preferable for low inference cost.

Layer types differ in their activation properties, so the right variant depends on what each can represent, not just how well. On the residual stream , single-layer SAEs

nonlinearity, so transcoders learn the input-to-output map
directly ( Dunefsky et al., 2024 ) , and Paulo et al. (2025c) reported favourable comparisons against
SAEs there. On attention outputs , standard and Gated SAEs both have been used;
attention-specific variants remain underdeveloped, making this the least studied of the three
sites. For cross-layer analysis , crosscoders ( Lindsey et al., 2024 ) and cross-layer transcoders ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) track feature evolution across

is the reported approach for comparing representations between them. Table 3 summarises the variants used at each layer type, the empirical rationale for their use, and the main caveats reported in prior work.

Under limited compute, or where fast iteration matters more than reconstruction quality,
Top- k k SAEs ( Gao et al., 2025 ) are the practical choice:

However, because the standard L 1 L_{1} SAE is now used mainly as a baseline, comparisons against it partly reflect shrinkage rather than dictionary quality alone. blocks.en: The differences between variants depend strongly on the metric in models with roughly 1 or 2B parameters, such as Gemma-2-2B ( Karvonen et al., 2025 ) , which is the regime mainly used to validate methodology before scaling. For models between 1B and 10B parameters, JumpReLU SAEs and Top- k k SAEs are the most commonly reported variants; Gemma Scope ( Lieberum et al., 2024 ) uses the former and Llama Scope ( He et al., 2024 ) the latter. For models larger than 10B parameters, Gemma Scope ( Lieberum et al., 2024 ) (for Gemma 2 models) and Gemma Scope 2 ( McDougall et al., 2025 ) (for Gemma 3 models) are the main open resources, both of which used JumpReLU SAEs. Additionally, Gao et al. (2025) explored scaling Top- k k SAEs to GPT-4 ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) , although GPT-4 itself is not publicly available.

blocks.en: 6.5 Challenges and Failure Modes of SAEs
blocks.zh: 6.5 最高审计实体的挑战和失败模式

blocks.en: SAEs have become a standard tool for feature extraction, but they exhibit systematic failure modes that undermine their interpretability claims. It is therefore essential to understand these issues when using SAEs as mechanistic tools. This section provides a systematic discussion of them.
blocks.zh: SAEs已经成为地物提取的标准工具,但它们表现出系统性的失败模式会破坏其可解释性要求. 因此,在利用SAEs作为机械工具时必须了解这些问题。 本节系统地讨论这些问题。

blocks.en: 6.5.1 Dead Features
blocks.zh: 6.5.1 死亡特征

blocks.en: A dead feature is an element in the learned dictionary that never activates or activates extremely rarely across training. Dead features waste the dictionary’s capacity, and they are common. In fact, they can constitute up to 10–50% of the dictionary in a poorly tuned SAE ( Bricken et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个已死特征是所学的词典中的一个元素,它从未在训练中激活或激活极罕见. 死亡特征浪费了字典的能力,而且很常见。 事实上,在一个调子不高的SAE(Bricken等人,2023年)中,它们可占词典的10-50%。

blocks.en: Several factors can cause dead features to emerge. First, inappropriate SAE weight initialisation can place features in low-density regions of the activation space with weak gradient signals. Second, an overly strong sparsity penalty λ \lambda may suppress feature activations early in training, preventing features from contributing usefully to reconstruction. Finally, once a subset of features captures common, dominant patterns, the remaining features struggle to find useful roles for improving reconstruction and thus do not activate.
blocks.zh: 有几个因素可能导致死亡特征的出现. 首先,不适当的SAE权重初始化可以以弱梯度信号将特征放置在激活空间的低密度区域. 第二,过于强烈的斯帕克惩罚 QQ\lambda 可能会在训练初期压制特征活化,防止特征对重建做出有益的贡献. 最后,一旦一个特征的子集抓住了共同的主导模式,其余特征就难以找到改善重建的有益作用,因此无法启动。

blocks.en: Dead features can be detected by tracking each feature’s rate of being activated during training. For example, features with an activation rate below 0.01% may be considered dead (the threshold should adapt across scenarios). Several mitigation strategies have been proposed, such as neuron resampling , which periodically reinitialises dead features using examples with high reconstruction error ( Bricken et al., 2023 ) . The sparsity penalty can also be reduced early in training and increased gradually (i.e., a warm-up schedule). More recent Batch Top- k k SAEs allocate sparsity adaptively across samples, which allows more active features on complex inputs and fewer on easy ones ( Bussmann et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过跟踪每个功能在训练期间被激活的速度,可以发现死亡特征. 例如,激活率低于0.01%的特征可能被视为已死亡(阈值应适应各种情景)。 已经提出了几项缓解战略,例如神经元再生(Bricken等人, 2023年),利用重建出高出错的例子,定期重新确定死亡特征。 痉挛处罚也可在训练初期减轻并逐步增加(即取暖时间表). 较近期的Batch Top-k K SAEs在样本之间以适应性的方式分配相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相

blocks.en: 6.5.2 Feature Duplication
blocks.zh: 6.5.2 特征重复

blocks.en: Feature duplication occurs when multiple features in the dictionary encode the same or similar concepts ( Templeton et al., 2024 ) , leading to potentially redundant features. Duplication can arise for several reasons: insufficient sparsity pressure, imbalanced training data, or an optimisation process that favours local minima with duplicated features. Duplication can be detected by computing pairwise cosine similarity between feature directions (i.e., decoder columns), where high similarity indicates potential redundancy. As duplicated features tend to activate together ( Korznikov et al., 2025 ) , co-activation statistics may provide complementary evidence.
blocks.zh: 当词典中多个特征编码相同或相近的概念时(Templeton等,2024年)会发生特异性重复,导致潜在的冗余特征. 重复可能出于以下几个原因:抽筋压力不足,培训数据不平衡,或者优化过程有利于具有重复特性的本地微型马. 重复可以通过计算特征方向(即解码列)之间的对等余弦相似性来检测出,其中高相近性表明潜在的冗余. 由于重复的特性往往共同激活(Korznikov等人,2025年),共同活性统计可以提供补充证据。

blocks.en: 6.5.3 Feature Absorption and Splitting
blocks.zh: 6.5.3 地貌吸收和分化

blocks.en: Another class of failure modes concerns feature granularity. Feature absorption arises when semantically hierarchical features interact under the sparsity objective: a seemingly general ( parent ) feature fails to activate on some inputs where it should because a more specific ( child ) feature activates instead and has absorbed part of the parent’s direction into its own decoder direction ( Chanin et al., 2025 ) . For example, a “starts with S” feature may fail to activate on the token “short”, while a token-specific “short” feature with a partially overlapping direction activates instead. Absorption-induced false negatives make such a feature an unreliable detector of its concept. It can be detected by comparing the feature with a linear probe for the same concept: inputs on which the probe responds strongly, but the feature does not, while another active feature’s direction aligns with the probe, indicate absorption ( Chanin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 另一种故障模式涉及地粒性。 特异性吸收在Sparsity目标下的分层特征相互作用时产生:一个看似一般的(父母)特征未能在某种投入上激活,因为一个更具体的(孩子)特征会激活,并吸收了父母方向的一部分进入自己的解码方向(Chanin等,2025年)。 例如,“从S开始”特性可能无法在符号“短”上激活,而具有部分重叠方向的符号“短”特性则激活。 吸收引起的假阴性使这种特征成为其概念的不可靠的探测器. 可以通过将特征与同一种概念的线性探测器进行比较来检测出:该探测器强烈响应的输入,但该特性没有,而另一个活性特性的方向与探测器一致,表示吸收(Chanin等,2025年).

blocks.en: By contrast, feature splitting occurs when a feature learned by a smaller SAE splits into multiple distinct features as the SAE scales up (e.g., by increasing the expansion factor e e ). This often produces more fine-grained features, which may be either beneficial or less useful. In a favourable case, an initially polysemantic or opaque feature, such as one activating on “bank” in both financial and geographical contexts, may split into more coherent features of “investment bank” and “river bank”. In a less useful case, the resulting features may become low-level, lexical detectors that activate on the token “bank” in any context.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,当一个较小的SAE所学到的特性随着SAE尺度的上调而分裂成多个不同的特性(例如通过增加扩展因子e. 这往往产生出更精细的特征,可能有益或用处较小. 在有利的情况下,最初的多语种或不透明的特征,例如在金融和地理背景下启动“银行”的特征,可能分裂为“投资银行”和“河岸”的更一致特征。 在一个不太有用的案例中,由此产生的特征可能变成低等的、符合逻辑的探测器,在任何上下文的符号“银行”上激活。

blocks.en: 6.5.4 Feature Instability Across Seeds
blocks.zh: 6.5.4 种子的特性不稳定

blocks.en: SAE features are also sensitive to random initialisation, optimiser stochasticity, and data ordering. For a fixed SAE architecture and training dataset, different random seeds can produce substantially different dictionaries ( Paulo & Belrose, 2026 ) . In practice, frequent and semantically clear features tend to be stable, while rare or context-specific features vary substantially. Often, fewer than 50% of features remain the same across seeds, although broader semantic clusters may remain more consistent. This instability limits the reliability of mechanistic claims based on individual SAE features. Although aggregating results across seeds can improve robustness, it increases computational cost. As a result, when evaluating SAEs, we should report feature stability across seeds alongside reconstruction loss.
blocks.zh: SAE特性对随机初始化,opimiser stochticality,和数据顺序也敏感. 对于固定的SAE架构和培训数据集,不同的随机种子可以产生大相径庭的词典(Paulo & Belrose, 2026). 在实践中,频繁而明晰的特征往往稳定,而罕见或上下文的特征则大相径庭. 种子的特征往往只有不到50%保持不变,尽管更广泛的语义集群可能仍然更加一致。 这种不稳定性限制了基于个别SAE特征的机械索赔的可靠性. 虽然在种子中汇总结果可以提高稳健性,但会提高计算成本。 因此,在评估SAE时,我们应该报告种子的稳定性以及重建损失。

blocks.en: 6.5.5 Identifiability and Theoretical Concerns
blocks.zh: 6.5.5 可识别性和理论关切

blocks.en: Another concern for SAE-based interpretability claims is whether the learned features are identifiable, that is, whether the dictionary learning reliably recovers the “true” underlying features—if such features exist—or merely finds one of many mediocre decompositions ( Klindt et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 对基于SAE的解释性索赔的另一个关切是,所学到的特征是否可以识别,也就是说,学得的词典是否可靠地恢复了“真实的”基本特征——如果存在这些特征的话——或者只是找到许多平庸分解之一(Klindt等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Identifiability Suppose activations are generated by some sparse latent process h = D ∗ ​ z ∗ + ϵ , h=D^{*}z^{*}+\epsilon, where D ∗ D^{*} is the ground-truth feature dictionary and z ∗ z^{*} are the feature coefficients. An SAE is identifiable if its training recovers D ∗ D^{*} and z ∗ z^{*} up to unavoidable symmetries such as feature permutation and rescaling.
blocks.zh: 可识别性 假设激活是由一些稀有的潜伏过程 h = D * → z + → , h = D^{*}z → epsilon 生成的,其中 D * 为地真特征词典,z * → z 为特征系数. 如果SAE的训练恢复了D * D * 和z * 至不可避免的对称,如地物穿插和缩放,则可以确定。

blocks.en: In classical dictionary learning, identifiability holds under low-coherence conditions, i.e., dictionary elements are sufficiently orthogonal to one another. However, when coherence is high, ambiguity arises: multiple distinct sparse combinations of features from the same dictionary can generate the same output ( Schnass & Vandergheynst, 2008 ) . In large language model activations, high coherence is likely unavoidable because of the model’s complicated internal structure and correlations within its feature space ( Li et al., 2025b ) . So far, identifiability remains a stubborn issue in SAEs, even though it offers a theoretical explanation for several empirical observations.
blocks.zh: 在古典词典学习中,可识别性在低一致性条件下持有,即词典元素相互之间有足够的正统性. 然而,当一致性高时,就会产生歧义:同一字典的多个独特的零星特征组合可以产生相同的输出(Schnass & Vanderghenst, 2008.). 在大型语言模型激活中,高度一致性可能是不可避免的,因为模型在特征空间内内部结构复杂并相互关联(Li等,2025b.). 迄今为止,可识别性仍然是SAEs的一个顽固问题,尽管它为一些实证观察提供了理论解释.

blocks.en: Recent progress in fine-tuning language models around a fixed sparse autoencoder offers a potential path forward. In this setting, model activations are explicitly constrained to be sparse combinations of decoder features while largely preserving task performance ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . In particular, recent work aimed at limiting superposition fine-tunes the language model jointly with the SAE while enforcing orthogonality constraints on the decoder matrix ( Miller et al., 2026 ) . By explicitly imposing low-coherence conditions, this approach improves identifiability: activations have a unique feature representation, and these features can be reliably recovered.
blocks.zh: 最近围绕固定的稀有自编码器对语言模型进行微调的进展提供了一条潜在的前进道路. 在此情况下,模型活化被明确限制为解码器特征的稀有组合,同时在很大程度上保留了任务性能(Chen等,2025a.). 特别是,最近旨在限制叠位的工作,在强制执行解码器矩阵的正交性限制的同时,与SAE共同调整了语言模型(Miller等,2026年)。 通过明确强制规定低一致性条件,这种方法可以提高可识别性:活化物具有独特的特征代表,这些特征可以可靠地恢复.

blocks.en: The concern of identifiability connects to causal relevance: even if an SAE feature is monosemantic and helps reconstruct activations well, it may not correspond to a causally meaningful unit of analysis. Below, we summarise some criteria for validating an SAE feature.
blocks.zh: 对可识别性的关注与因果关系有关:即使SAE特征是单语义的并有助于重建活性,它也可能与因果有意义的分析单位不符. 下面我们总结一些标准来验证一个SAE特性.

blocks.en: Diagnostic criteria: • Necessity : Does ablating the feature remove the corresponding concept in model responses? Low necessity suggests that the concept can be expressed through redundant features. • Sufficiency : Does activating only this feature produce the behaviour corresponding to its concept? Low sufficiency suggests the feature alone is not enough to represent the concept. • Specificity : Does the feature’s causal effect match its corresponding concept? Low specificity means the feature contains other concepts.
blocks.zh: 诊断标准: 必要性:在模型反应中,该特征是否消除了相应的概念? 低必要性表示这一概念可以通过冗余特征来表达. 二. 支助 足够性 : 只有激活此特性才会产生与其概念相应的行为吗? 低充足度表明,单凭特征不足以代表概念。 · 具体性:特征的因果关系是否与其相应的概念相匹配? 低特异性表示特征包含其他概念.

blocks.en: Necessity : Does ablating the feature remove the corresponding concept in model responses? Low necessity suggests that the concept can be expressed through redundant features.
blocks.zh: 必要性:该特征是否消除了模型反应中的相应概念? 低必要性表示这一概念可以通过冗余特征来表达.

blocks.en: Sufficiency : Does activating only this feature produce the behaviour corresponding to its concept? Low sufficiency suggests the feature alone is not enough to represent the concept.
blocks.zh: 足够性 : 只有激活此特性才会产生与其概念相应的行为吗? 低充足度表明,单凭特征不足以代表概念。

blocks.en: Specificity : Does the feature’s causal effect match its corresponding concept? Low specificity means the feature contains other concepts.
blocks.zh: 特性 : 该特征的因果关系是否与其相应的概念相匹配? 低特异性表示特征包含其他概念.

blocks.en: These criteria are useful in practice when claiming that SAE features represent meaningful units of analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些标准在实践中在声称SAE特征是有意义的分析单位时是有用的。

blocks.en: 6.5.6 Practical Recommendations
blocks.zh: 6.5.6 实际建议

blocks.en: The challenges discussed above suggest several methodological considerations for SAE-based interpretability studies:
blocks.zh: 上文所讨论的挑战为基于SAE的解释性研究提出了若干方法方面的考虑:

blocks.en: 1. Report failure-mode metrics: Alongside reconstruction loss, researchers should also report dead-feature percentage, duplication rate, and stability across seeds. 2. Validate causal relevance: Researchers should validate features’ necessity, sufficiency, and specificity through interventions (e.g., feature ablation or steering) and evaluation on downstream effects. 3. Compare methods: For safety-critical applications, researchers should compare SAE features against various baselines to assess whether SAEs recover the relevant structure. 4. Try multiple SAE variants: Different variants (e.g., Gated, Top- k k , JumpReLU) impose different inductive biases. Researchers can explore findings consistent across variants, as these provide stronger evidence. 5. Acknowledge identifiability limits: Researchers should frame SAE features as one valid approximate decomposition rather than the true features. Multiple decompositions may be equally valid for reconstruction but yield different feature sets. 6. Consider alternatives for targeted analysis: When specific concepts are the focus, supervised methods (e.g., DAS, probes, discussed in Section 6.9.4 ) may be more reliable because SAEs discover features in an unsupervised and exploratory manner.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 报告故障模式度量标准: 除重建损失外,研究人员还应报告死亡人口百分比、重复率和种子之间的稳定性。 2. 验证因果关系: 研究人员应通过干预(例如,特征剥离或引导)和评价下游效果,验证特征的必要性、充分性和具体性。 3. 比较方法: 对于安全关键应用,研究人员应当将SAE特征与各种基线进行比较,以评估SAE是否恢复了相关结构。 4. 尝试多种SAE变体:不同的变体(如:Gated,Top-k k,JumpReLU)会施加不同的诱导偏差. 研究人员可以探索各种变体之间一致的结论,因为这些变体提供了更强有力的证据。 5. 承认可识别性限制: 研究人员应将SAE特征设定为有效的近似分解特征,而不是真实特征。 多重分解可能对重建同样有效,但产生不同的特征集. 6. 审议有针对性地分析的替代办法: 当特定的概念成为重点时,受监督的方法(如DAS,探测器,在第6.9.4节中讨论)可能更加可靠,因为SAEs以不受监督和探索的方式发现特征.

blocks.en: 6.6 Multi-Layer Feature Extraction and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.6 多层地物提取和分析

blocks.en: Standard SAEs analyse individual layers in isolation. However, features can evolve as information propagates through the network. Transcoders (Figure 7(a) ), cross-layer transcoders (Figure 7(b) ), and crosscoders (Figure 9 ) enable multi-layer feature extraction and analysis, revealing how representations and features associated with particular model components—most commonly MLP blocks—transform across depth.
blocks.zh: 标准SAEs孤立地分析单个地层. 然而,随着信息通过网络传播,特征可以演变. 转码器(图7(a)),跨层转码器(图7(b))和交叉编码器(图9)可以进行多层特征提取和分析,揭示与特定模型组件——最常见的是MLP块——相接的表示和特征如何跨深度转换.

blocks.en: When analysing a specific prompt, the replacement model freezes the original model’s attention patterns and normalisation statistics from its forward pass, then adds layer-specific error corrections. Under these conditions, the local replacement model can exactly match the original model’s activations on that prompt while decomposing it into interpretable CLT features. However, when the model’s activations are completely replaced by CLT reconstructions, the intervened model’s top-1 predictions match the original model’s on only about 50% of prompts from the Pile dataset ( Gao et al., 2020 ) . Notably, this experiment uses a relatively small, 18-layer transformer ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, this figure should be interpreted with important caveats (see below).
blocks.zh: 在分析特定快取时,替换模型会从前传中冻结原模型的注意模式和常态化统计,再增加分层错误校正. 在这些条件下,本地的替换模型可以完全匹配原始模型在该快取上活化的活化,同时将其分解为可解释的CLT特性. 然而,当模型的活化被CLT重建完全取代时,被干预的模型的上一预测只匹配了来自Pile数据集(Gao等,2020年)约50%的活化率的原始模型. 值得注意的是,这一实验使用了一个相对较小的18层变压器(Ameisen等人,2025年)。 因此,对这一数字应作重要解释(见下文)。

blocks.en: Caveats on CLT Fidelity Claims CLTs have been claimed to possess high output fidelity given that they achieve high top-1 token agreement. However, this claim requires careful examination: Conditions for reported fidelity: • Results are reported primarily on toy or small models, whose generality to other model architectures (e.g., Llama, Qwen) and model sizes (e.g., 70B models) is underexplored. • Fidelity was measured on short sequences in the CLT training data. Evaluation under distribution shift (e.g., out-of-domain tasks, adversarial inputs) is not adequate. • The paper reports top-1 token agreement as the main result, while softer metrics (e.g., top-5 agreement, KL divergence) may show different patterns and insights. Conditions for exact local matching: • Attention patterns must be frozen from the original forward pass since the CLT does not compute or reconstruct attention computations. • Layer normalisation statistics (means, variances) must be cached from the original model. The replacement model does not recompute these. • Error correction terms are added per layer to compensate for reconstruction residuals. Without them, exact matching fails. Factors affecting fidelity: • Model scale : Preliminary evidence suggests that reconstruction quality and feature interpretability improve with CLT model size. This may be because larger CLTs produce more structured, less entangled representations ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) . However, systematic scaling studies are limited. • Layer depth : Early layers’ and late layers’ activations are usually input-specific and output-constrained, respectively. Middle layers have richer information derived from the input but are not yet converged to the output. As a result, middle layers often show higher reconstruction fidelity. • Domain : Fidelity on factual recall and syntactic tasks is higher than on complex reasoning or arithmetic tasks, where MLP computations may be more complex and cannot be approximated by sparse linear features. These caveats do not invalidate CLTs as a tool for mechanistic analysis, but they do mean that fidelity should be verified on the target model and specific task before drawing strong conclusions from CLT-based circuit analysis.
blocks.zh: CLT上的洞穴 菲德尔索赔 据称,CLT公司具有较高的产出忠诚度,因为它们达成了高一等标志性协议。 然而,这项索赔需要认真审查: 报告忠贞性的条件: • 成果主要报告在玩具或小模型上,这些模型对其他模型架构(如:Llama,Quen)和模型尺寸(如:70B模型)的通俗性没有得到充分利用. · 以CLT培训数据中的短序列衡量了Fidelity。 分配转变中的评价(如领域外任务、对抗性投入)不够充分。 论文将头一标的协议报告为主要结果,而更软的度量衡(如前五标,KL相差)可能显示不同的模式和见解. 精确局部匹配的条件: • 注意模式必须从原来的前传被冻结,因为CLT不计算或重建注意计算. • 必须从原模型中缓存层态化统计(表示、差异)。 替换型号不重算这些. • 每层增加错误更正词以补偿重建所剩部分。 没有他们,精确匹配失败。 影响忠诚的因素: 模型尺度:初步证据表明重建质量和特征解释性随着CLT模型的大小而提高. 这可能是因为较大的CLT产生更有条理、较少缠绕的表示(Ameisen等人,2025年)。 然而,系统的衡量研究有限。 · 地层深度:早期地层活化和后地层活化通常分别是特定输入和输出受限. 中层有从输入中得出的更丰富的信息,但尚未与输出相汇合. 因此,中层往往表现出较高的重建忠诚. • 领域:关于事实召回和综合任务的Fidelity高于复杂的推理或算术任务,其中MLP计算可能更为复杂,无法被稀有的线性特征所近似. 这些警告并没有使CLTs作为机械分析的工具失效,但它们确实意味着,在从基于CLT的电路分析中得出有力结论之前,应先对目标模型和具体任务进行诚实性核实.

blocks.en: These caveats do not invalidate CLTs as a tool for mechanistic analysis, but they do mean that fidelity should be verified on the target model and specific task before drawing strong conclusions from CLT-based circuit analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些警告并没有使CLTs作为机械分析的工具失效,但它们确实意味着,在从基于CLT的电路分析中得出有力结论之前,应先对目标模型和具体任务进行诚实性核实.

blocks.en: Unlike per-layer transcoders, CLTs reveal direct feature-to-feature interactions across layers: a feature in layer ℓ \ell directly influences features in later layers through its contribution to their inputs. This simplifies circuit structure—features need not re-encode information at each layer. Additionally, replacing MLPs with CLT reconstructions makes the remaining computation approximately linear (with frozen attention patterns and normalisation), enabling principled attribution: each feature’s activation can be expressed as the sum of its input edges up to its activation threshold ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 与每层的转码器不同,CLTs揭示了地物对地物的跨层直接相互作用: 第l层中的一个地物会通过其对地物输入的贡献来直接地影响后层的地物. 这种简化的电路结构——地物不需要每层重编码信息. 此外,用CLT重建来取而代之的MLP使剩下的计算大约是线性(用冷冻的注意模式和正常化),使原则归属成为可能:每个特性的活化可以被表示为它的输入边缘的总和到活化阈值(Ameisen等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: However, linearisation depends on several assumptions: • Attention freezing: By caching attention patterns, the replacement model treats attention as a fixed routing operation rather than a dynamic, input-dependent computation. This means CLT-based circuits describe model computation conditioned on given attention patterns without analysing them. • Normalisation caching: CLT analysis caches the input-dependent normalisation factors (e.g., LayerNorm denominators) from the original forward pass and reuses them during attribution instead of recomputing them after interventions. This removes a source of nonlinearity, but if an intervention would substantially change these normalisation factors in the original model, the cached computation no longer faithfully represents the intervened state. • Sparse linear approximation: Dictionary learning methods assume MLP outputs or transformations are well approximated by sparse linear combinations of features. This assumption may fail when computations involve complex feature interactions or highly nonlinear transformations.
blocks.zh: 然而,线性化取决于几个假设: • 注意力冻结: 通过缓存注意力模式,替换模型将注意力视为固定的路由操作,而不是动态的,依赖输入的计算. 这意味着基于CLT的电路描述以给定的注意模式为条件的模型计算而不分析它们. • 正常化缓存:CLT分析从原始前传中缓存依赖输入的正常化因子(如:LayerNorm分母),并在归属期间再用,而不是在干预后重新计算. 这消除了非线性源,但如果一次干预会大大地改变原始模型中的这些正常化因子,被缓存的计算将不再忠实地代表被干预状态. 二. 支助 平面线性近似 : 词典学习方法假设MLP输出或变相与特征的稀有线性组合非常相近. 当计算涉及复杂的特征相互作用或高度非线性转换时,这种假设可能失败.

blocks.en: Attention freezing: By caching attention patterns, the replacement model treats attention as a fixed routing operation rather than a dynamic, input-dependent computation. This means CLT-based circuits describe model computation conditioned on given attention patterns without analysing them.
blocks.zh: 注意冻结: 通过缓存注意力模式,替换模型将注意力视为固定的路由操作,而不是动态的,依赖输入的计算. 这意味着基于CLT的电路描述以给定的注意模式为条件的模型计算而不分析它们.

blocks.en: Normalisation caching: CLT analysis caches the input-dependent normalisation factors (e.g., LayerNorm denominators) from the original forward pass and reuses them during attribution instead of recomputing them after interventions. This removes a source of nonlinearity, but if an intervention would substantially change these normalisation factors in the original model, the cached computation no longer faithfully represents the intervened state.
blocks.zh: 常态化缓存:CLT分析从原始前传中缓存出依赖输入的常态化因子(如:LayerNorm分母),并在归属期间再用,而不是在干预后再作再计算. 这消除了非线性源,但如果一次干预会大大地改变原始模型中的这些正常化因子,被缓存的计算将不再忠实地代表被干预状态.

blocks.en: Sparse linear approximation: Dictionary learning methods assume MLP outputs or transformations are well approximated by sparse linear combinations of features. This assumption may fail when computations involve complex feature interactions or highly nonlinear transformations.

blocks.en: CLTs provide a powerful lens for circuit discovery when these assumptions hold. When they fail, CLT-based explanations may become unfaithful.
blocks.zh: 当这些假设存在时,CLT为电路发现提供了强大的透镜. 如果失败,基于CLT的解释可能会变得不忠.

blocks.en:
Training a suite of CLTs thus incurs a high upfront cost. For reference, training the CLT suite for Gemma-2-9B
required approximately 3,844 H100 GPU-hours at 50% FLOPs efficiency ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) . This cost is amortised over many circuit analyses on the trained CLT. The resulting interpretability gains (cross-layer features, lower interference, better attribution) justify the investment for systematic mechanistic analysis.
blocks.zh:
因此,培训一套CLT会花费很高的前期费用。 为Gemma-2-9B培训CLT套件供参考
需要约3,844个H100 GPU小时,效率为50%(Ameisen等人,2025年)。 这笔费用通过受过训练的CLT的许多电路分析得到摊还。 由此带来的可解释性收益(跨层特征、较低的干扰、更好的归属)为系统性机械分析的投资提供了理由。

blocks.en:
For these reasons, current applications of CLTs remain limited: a “greater-than” mechanism
study ( Merullo et al., 2025 ) , an open-source
extension ( Lindsey et al., 2025a ) , and analysis of multilingual representations using CLTs ( Harrasse et al., 2026 ) . This scarcity of downstream use cases likely reflects the considerable challenges of training CLTs at scale and the complexity of using CLT-based circuit discovery in the wild.

由于这些原因,CLTs目前的应用仍然有限:一种“比”机制
研究(Merullo等,2025年),开源
(Lindsey等,2025a),以及使用CLTs(Harrasse等,2026)分析多语种表达方式。 这种下游使用案例的稀少可能反映了大规模培训CLT的巨大挑战以及在野外使用CLT基电路发现的复杂性.

blocks.en: Several important questions remain open: • How does CLT fidelity scale in large models? How can we better measure fidelity? • Can CLTs be extended to model more nonlinearities such as attention patterns and normalisation, while maintaining their explanatory power? • Can we develop evaluation protocols that reliably detect the potential unfaithfulness of CLT-based explanations? • How sensitive are CLT circuits to experimental setups, such as the choice of training data?

blocks.en: 6.6.3 Crosscoders: Analysing Cross-Layer Features
blocks.zh: 6.6.3 交叉编码器:分析跨纬度特征

This respects the forward pass causality: earlier layers cannot read from later layers. • Acausal Crosscoders: Read from any layer ℓ ′ \ell^{\prime} regardless of depth ordering. blocks.en: By extracting cross-layer features, crosscoders help us understand how features propagate through the residual stream across layers, removing duplicate feature representations that complicate circuit analysis. This simplification allows features to “jump” across intervening identity operations, substantially reducing circuit complexity. More importantly, crosscoders reveal how input-relevant features transform as they flow through the network, distinguishing which features persist unchanged versus which are actively modified by downstream computation ( Lindsey et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过取出跨层特征,交叉编码器帮助我们了解特征如何通过残余流分层传播,去除使电路分析复杂化的重复特征表示. 这种简化使得各种特性能够“跳过”介入性身份操作,从而大大地降低电路的复杂性。 更重要的是,交叉编码器揭示了输入相关特征在网络流出时是如何转变的,区分哪些特征保持不变,哪些特征通过下游计算得到积极修改(Lindsey等,2024年)。

blocks.en: 6.7 Comparing SAEs, Transcoders, and Crosscoders
blocks.zh: 6.7 比较SAE、转码器和交叉编码器

blocks.en: Single-layer SAEs are efficient and locally interpretable but miss cross-layer feature evolution. Transcoders improve this by imitating MLP behaviour and revealing nonlinear transformations, though they require sequential analysis across depth. Cross-layer transcoders span multiple layers for global information flow but are extremely expensive. Crosscoders take a different approach, extracting shared features across layers simultaneously to resolve cross-layer superposition and simplify circuits without chaining predictions.
blocks.zh: 单层 SAE是高效的,可以本地解释,但错过了跨层特征演化. 转码器通过模仿MLP行为并揭示出非线性变换来改进了这一点,尽管它们需要跨深度的相继分析. 跨层转码器跨越多层,用于全球信息流动,但费用极高。 交叉编码器采用不同的方法,同时取出跨层共享的特征来解决跨层叠加并简化电路而无需连锁预测.

blocks.en: 6.8 Case Study: Induction Heads
blocks.zh: 6.8 案例研究:上岗主管

blocks.en: Here, we examine induction heads ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , a mechanism found in many modern language models, as a case study. We first describe their conditional-copying function and role in in-context learning, and then relate them to feature-extraction methods such as SAEs and CLTs, which reveal how this computation can be distributed across broader feature circuits.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们审查上岗头(Olsson等人,2022年),这是许多现代语言模型中发现的一种机制,作为案例研究. 我们首先描述了它们的有条件复制功能和在内容内学习中的作用,然后将它们与地物提取方法相连接,如SAEs和CLTs,这些方法揭示了这种计算如何在更广泛的地物电路中分布.

blocks.en:
Induction Heads Induction heads , first identified and analysed by Elhage et al. (2021) , are attention heads that
implement a conditional copying rule over repeated subsequences. Let x = ( x 1 , … , x T ) x=(x_{1},\dots,x_{T}) be a token sequence, and consider positions i < j < T i<j<T such
that x i = x j x_{i}=x_{j} . An attention head indexed r r (see Section 4.4 for an introduction to attention modules) is said to be an induction head when its
attention pattern assigns comparatively high attention weight from position j j to position i + 1 i+1 (i.e., high A j , i + 1 r A^{r}_{j,i+1} ) and its residual-stream update Δ ​ h r = W O r ​ V r ​ ( A r ) ⊤ \Delta h^{r}=W_{O}^{r}V^{r}(A^{r})^{\top} increases the model’s logit for token x i + 1 x_{i+1} when predicting the token at position j + 1 j+1 . That is, induction heads implement the rule ( x i = x j ) ⇒ x ^ j + 1 ≈ x i + 1 . (x_{i}=x_{j})\;\Rightarrow\;\hat{x}_{j+1}\approx x_{i+1}. They help enable in-context prediction by copying the continuation that followed an
earlier occurrence of the same token.

Induction in a Repeated Sequence Consider the sequence A B C A B where the model needs to predict the token after the second B . Observing the repeated prefix A B , an induction head attends from the second B to the position after the first B and contributes to the model’s prediction of C . This induction behaviour should generalise across tokens and positions.
blocks.zh: 重复序列中的入门 考虑序列 A B C A B 模型需要预测第二 B 之后的符号 。 在观察重复的前缀A B时,一个上岗头从第二个B到第一个B后的位置,有助于模型对C的预测. 这种上岗行为应贯穿各种标志和职位。

blocks.en: Induction heads were originally characterised as specific attention heads implementing this copying rule. However, subsequent work shows that we can understand the underlying computation more naturally at the level of distributed representations than isolated model components.
blocks.zh: 上岗主管最初被定性为执行这一抄袭规则的特别主管。 然而,随后的研究表明,我们可以更自然地在分布式表达层面理解基础计算,而不是孤立的模型组件.

blocks.en: Induction Heads: Features Across Representations Feature extraction methods, such as SAEs, can decompose attention layer outputs into sparse, interpretable features that capture meaningful activation patterns beyond individual attention weights ( Kissane et al., 2024 ) . Modern analyses suggest that induction heads are not isolated mechanisms but participate in distributed feature circuits, where multiple interacting features recur and compose across layers ( Dunefsky et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2024 ; Kissane et al., 2024 ; Kamath et al., 2025 ). SAEs trained on attention heads’ activations reveal feature families of recurring patterns and contextual dependencies. Some of them align with behaviours originally attributed to induction heads ( Kissane et al., 2024 ) . By analysing these features, we can understand how models maintain and manipulate information across tokens and contexts. Cross-layer analyses, including crosscoders, suggest that certain features are represented consistently across layers rather than being recomputed at each layer ( Lindsey et al., 2024 ) . This perspective highlights that attention heads, including specialised ones such as induction heads, may be only part of broader, distributed feature representations.
blocks.zh: 简介主任:各种代表的特点 地物提取方法,如SAEs,可以将注意力层输出分解为稀有,可解释的特征,捕捉到超出个体注意力重量的有意义的活化规律(Kissane等,2024. 现代分析表明,上岗头不是孤立的机制,而是参与分布式地物电路,其中多个相互作用的地物在地层上反复出现并形成(Dunefsky等,2024;Singh等,2024;Kissane等,2024;Kamath等,2025)。 接受过关注头的激活培训的SAE揭示了反复出现的模式和背景依赖的特征家族. 其中一些符合最初归属于上岗主管的行为(Kissane等人,2024年)。 通过分析这些特征,我们可以理解模型如何在符号和上下文之间维护和操纵信息. 跨层分析,包括交叉编码器,表明某些特征在多层之间得到一致的体现,而不是在每一层得到重算(Lindsey等,2024年)。 这种观点突出表明,关注负责人,包括上岗主管等专门负责人,可能只是更广泛、分布广泛的专题陈述的一部分。

blocks.en: 6.9 Comparison with Alternative Feature Extraction Methods
blocks.zh: 6.9 与替代地物提取方法的比较

blocks.en: Besides SAEs, alternative techniques from signal processing and machine learning have also been adapted to extract features from neural networks. They make different modelling assumptions and therefore offer distinct trade-offs in interpretability, scalability, and robustness. Table 6 summarises the methods discussed in this section.
blocks.zh: 除SAEs外,信号处理和机器学习的替代技术也进行了改造,以从神经网络中提取出特征. 它们作出不同的建模假设,因此在可解释性、可扩展性和稳健性方面提供了不同的取舍。 表6概括了本节所讨论的方法。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Comparison of feature extraction methods.
blocks.zh: 表6:特征提取方法比较.

blocks.en: 6.9.1 Non-Negative Matrix Factorisation (NMF)
blocks.zh: 6.9.1 非负式矩阵因子化(NMF)

blocks.en: Non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF; Lee & Seung, 1999 ) decomposes a non-negative activation matrix H ∈ ℝ d × n H\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n} as H ≈ W ​ A H\approx WA , where both the feature dictionary W ∈ ℝ d × m W\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times m} ( m m is the preset number of features) and the coefficient matrix A ∈ ℝ m × n A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} are constrained to have non-negative elements. Because all components are non-negative, each feature contributes positively to the final representation, making it easier to interpret. Additionally, classical NMF’s optimisation process uses simple multiplicative update rules that preserve non-negativity. Moreover, under assumptions like separability (each latent feature appears in at least one sufficiently “pure” example), NMF guarantees that the recovered decomposition is unique ( Donoho & Stodden, 2003 ) .
blocks.zh: 非阴性矩阵因子化(NMF; Lee & Seung, 1999)将非阴性活化矩阵H → R d → n H\in\ mathbb{R\d\times n}分解为H → W A H\近似 WA,其中特征词典W → R d\ m W\in\mathb{R\d\times m} (m是特性的预设数)和系数矩阵A → R\ m → n A\in\mathb{R\tims n}均受限制具有非阴性元素. 由于所有成分都是非负性的,因此每个特征都为最终的表示做出了积极的贡献,使得解释更加容易. 此外,古典NMF的优化过程使用简单的多功能更新规则来保存非负性. 此外,在可分离性等假设下(每个潜在特征至少出现在一个足够“纯粹”的例子中),NMF保证回收的分解是独一无二的(Donoho & Stodden,2003年)。

blocks.en: However, classical NMF is not suitable for neural network activations because they can have negative elements, requiring additional preprocessing steps that may distort the activation-space structure. Moreover, NMF does not explicitly encourage feature sparsity, and scaling NMF to large dictionaries is computationally expensive. As a result, empirical work on extracting and analysing features in neural network activations has largely focused on Semi-NMF ( Ding et al., 2010 ) , which relaxes the non-negativity constraint on W W . Shafran et al. (2026) showed that Semi-NMF can recover features competitive with SAEs on small-scale evaluations, but systematic comparisons at large scale remain limited. Yun et al. (2021) used a Semi-NMF-like approach to factorise BERT’s contextualised hidden-state representations ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , allowing elements in W W to take both positive and negative values while constraining A A to be non-negative.
blocks.zh: 然而,古典NMF并不适合神经网络活化,因为它们可以有负元素,需要额外的预处理步骤来扭曲活化-空间结构. 此外,NMF没有明确鼓励地貌相突起,而将NMF缩放到大字典上在计算上是昂贵的. 因此,在神经网络活化中提取和分析特征的经验性工作主要侧重于半NMF(Ding等,2010年),这缓解了对WW的非负性约束. Shafran等人(2026年)表明,Semi-NMF可以在小规模评价中恢复与SAE竞争的特征,但大规模系统比较仍然有限. Yun等 (2021年)使用半NMF类似的方法将BERT的上下文隐形态表示要素化(Devlin等,2019年),允许WW中的元素既取正值又取负值,同时将AA限制为非负值.

blocks.en: 6.9.2 Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
blocks.zh: 6.9.2 主要构成部分分析

blocks.en: Principal Component Analysis (PCA; Pearson, 1901 ; Hotelling, 1933 ) decomposes activations by finding an orthonormal basis of directions that maximise explained variance. Given a mean-centred activation matrix H ∈ ℝ d × n H\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n} , where each column is an activation vector, PCA computes a low-rank approximation H ≈ U ​ Σ ​ V ⊤ H\approx U\Sigma V^{\top} , where the columns of U U are the principal directions ordered by explained variance. PCA is fast, stable, and scalable. However, PCA imposes constraints and inductive biases that may misalign with neural network activations. Specifically, it identifies principal directions that maximise explained variance in the activation distribution, but much of the information of interest is region- or context-dependent and cannot be captured by variance alone. Moreover, PCA constrains the principal directions to be orthogonal, but in practice the underlying features correlate or partially overlap. Recent benchmarks ( Wu et al., 2025b ) reflect this misalignment: PCA underperformed most baselines, including SAEs, on both steering and concept-detection evaluations. While PCA can outperform SAEs in some localisation settings ( Mueller et al., 2025 ) , it still generally lags behind simple supervised baselines.
blocks.zh: 主元件分析(PCA; Pearson, 1901; Hotelling, 1933)通过找到最大程度解释差异的方向的正态基础来分解活化. 鉴于一个以中枢为主的活化矩阵H → R d → n H\in\mathb{R}\d\times n},其中每列都是活化矢量,PCA计算出一个低等近似H → U → V\\\H\近似 U\Sigma V^{\top},其中U的列由被解释的相差所命令的主要方向. 五氯苯甲醚快速、稳定、可伸缩。 然而,五氯苯甲醚施加了制约和诱导偏差,可能与神经网络活化错配. 具体地说,它确定了主要方向,最大限度地说明激活分配中的差异,但许多感兴趣的信息取决于区域或背景,不能仅靠差异来获取。 此外,常设仲裁法院限制主要方向是正向的,但在实践中,基本特征相互关联或部分重叠。 最近的基准(Wu等,2025年b)反映了这种不一致的情况:五氯苯甲醚在指导和概念检测评价方面都表现不佳,包括SAE。 虽然五氯苯甲醚在某些本地化环境中可以超过SAE(Mueller等人,2025年),但它仍然一般落后于简单的监督基线。

blocks.en: 6.9.3 Independent Component Analysis (ICA)
blocks.zh: 6.9.3 独立构成部分分析

blocks.en: Independent Component Analysis (ICA; Hyvärinen & Oja, 2000 ) decomposes activations H ∈ ℝ d × n H\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n} as H ≈ W ​ S H\approx WS , where n n is the number of data points. Note that ICA may look similar to NMF at first glance. However, they were developed for different use cases and thus rely on different assumptions and optimisation procedures. In ICA, each column in W ∈ ℝ d × m W\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times m} is a mixing vector, and m m is the number of different source signals; each row in S ∈ ℝ m × n S\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} is a source signal (a signal has n n data points), with m m source signals in total. These signals are optimised to be independent of one another. Thus, if model activations are linear mixtures of statistically independent “foundational features”, ICA can provably recover those features.
blocks.zh: 独立组件分析(ICA;Hyvärinen & Oja,2000年)分解活性 H QQ R d × n H\in\ mathbb{ R\d\times n}作为 H QQ W S H\近似 WS,其中n为数据点数. 请注意,ICA乍一看可能与NMF相似. 然而,它们是针对不同的使用案例制定的,因此依赖于不同的假设和优化程序。 在ICA中,W QQ R d × m W\in\mathb{R}^{d\times m}中的每个列是一个混合向量,而m是不同源信号的数量;S QQ R m × n S\in\mathb{R}^{m\times n}中的每个行是一个源信号(一个信号有n个数据点),总共有m m 源信号. 这些信号被优化为相互独立. 因此,如果模型活化物是统计上独立的“基础特征”的线性混合物,那么国际竞争协会可以证明可以恢复这些特征。

blocks.en: However, these assumptions may not hold for neural network activations. Specifically, classical ICA typically expects the completeness property (number of latent sources equals the dimensionality of the observed representation), and overcomplete decompositions (which are what we expect in activations) would require additional extensions ( Lewicki & Sejnowski, 2000 ) . Moreover, underlying features may not be statistically independent, which further limits the applicability of classical ICA. Although early studies applied it to analyse neural network activations, they did not find interpretability gains over SAEs ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ) . This may partly reflect the challenges discussed above.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些假设可能无法维持神经网络活化. 具体地说,典型的ICA一般期望完整性属性(潜在来源的数量等于所观察到的表示的维度),而过度完全分解(这是我们在激活时所期望的)则需要额外的扩展(Lewicki & Sejnowski, 2000.). 此外,基本特征在统计学上可能不具有独立性,这进一步限制了古典式的ICA的适用性. 虽然早期的研究应用它来分析神经网络活化,但并没有发现比SAEs的可解释性增益(Cunningham等,2024). 这可能部分反映了上述挑战。

blocks.en: More recently, however, Liu & Han (2026) showed that ICA can achieve performance comparable to that of SAEs, arguing that its previously reported underperformance may stem from limitations of classical ICA implementations poorly suited to the scale and statistical structure of neural network activations. These findings leave open whether ICA should be regarded primarily as a simple classical baseline or as an approach with underestimated, substantial headroom for further development.
blocks.zh: 然而,更近期,刘和韩(2026年)显示ICA能实现与SAE相似的性能,认为其之前报告的性能不佳可能出自古典ICA执行的局限性,不适应神经网络活化的规模和统计结构. 这些调查结果使人们不清楚,国际合作社联盟是否应当主要被视为一个简单的古典基线,或者是否应当被视为一个低估了进一步发展的重要头室的办法。

blocks.en: 6.9.4 Supervised Feature Extraction Methods
blocks.zh: 6.9.4 监督特征提取方法

blocks.en: When the concepts of interest are known in advance, supervised methods can directly optimise representations aligned with those targets. Examples include distributed alignment search (DAS), which uses supervision to learn a change of basis that aligns representations with high-level causal variables ( Geiger et al., 2024 ) ; Supervised Multi-Dimensional Scaling (SMDS), which projects activations to preserve concept-level similarities ( Tiblias et al., 2026 ) ; and probes, which fit a concept direction in contrastive class-conditioned activations ( Marks & Tegmark, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 当事先知道利益概念时,受监督的方法可直接优化与这些目标相一致的表述。 实例包括分布式对接搜索(DAS),该搜索利用监督来学习改变表达方式与高层次因果变量保持一致的基础(Geiger等,2024年);监督多维分解(SMDS),它预测激活方式以保持概念层面的相似性(Tiblias等,2026年);和探针,它符合相对类条件活化的概念方向(Marks & Tegmark,2024年).

blocks.en: Notably, despite its simplicity, probing has outperformed SAEs in concept detection ( Wu et al., 2025b ) . It has also become a standard tool for identifying safety-relevant concepts in model representations, including refusal behaviour and implanted backdoors ( Arditi et al., 2024 ; MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ). We discuss probing in detail in Section 8.6 . We put it under Section 8 because we view its central methodological contributions and technical challenges as the readout of human-interpretable information—often expressed in natural language—from model activations, rather than the extraction of monosemantic features or causal variables.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,尽管其简便性能,但探测在概念探测方面已超过SAE(Wu等,2025年b)。 它也成为在模型表达中识别安全相关概念的标准工具,包括拒绝行为和植入后门(Arditi等,2024;MacDiarmid等,2024)。 我们在第8.6节详细讨论了探查问题。 我们把它放在第8节下,是因为我们认为其核心的方法贡献和技术挑战在于从模型活化中读取人的解释性信息——往往用自然语言表达,而不是取出单一语义特征或因果变量。

blocks.en: When labelled data is available, supervised approaches often outperform SAEs on concept detection and steering tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Chaudhary & Geiger, 2024 ). They also avoid choosing dictionary sizes or sparsity penalties, since the concept set determines complexity. However, these methods require labelled data for each concept and cannot discover previously unknown features. Therefore, supervised methods suit settings where predefined, crisp concepts matter, whereas SAEs remain preferable for exploratory analysis.
blocks.zh: 在有标签数据的情况下,在概念检测和引导任务方面,监督方法往往比SAE要好(Huang等人,2024;Wu等人,2025b;Chaudhary & Geiger,2024)。 他们也避免选择词典大小或相思惩罚,因为概念集决定了复杂性. 然而,这些方法要求每个概念都有标记的数据,无法发现以前未知的特征。 因此,受监督的方法适用于预先界定的、简洁的概念很重要的设置,而SAE仍然比较适合进行探索性分析。

blocks.en: 6.9.5 Dictionary Learning Baselines
blocks.zh: 6.9.5 词典学习基线

blocks.en: Classical dictionary learning methods provide useful baselines for evaluating SAEs. Techniques such as K-SVD alternate between sparse coding and dictionary updates and converge under certain conditions ( Aharon et al., 2006 ) . Comparative studies suggest that SAEs’ primary advantage is fast inference because the encoder learns to decompose all activations, while potentially sacrificing optimal sparsity ( O’Neill et al., 2025 ) . As such, classical dictionary learning can still achieve superior dictionary quality in some cases and thus remains an important reference point for assessing the added value of SAEs.
blocks.zh: 经典词典学习方法为评估SAE提供了有用的基线. K-SVD等技术在有限的编码和词典更新之间交替出现,并在某些条件下趋同(Aharon等,2006.)。 比较研究表明,SAEs的主要优势是快速推论,因为编码器学会分解所有活化物,同时有可能牺牲最佳的螺旋(O-Neill等,2025年). 因此,古典字典学习在某些情况下仍然能够达到优越的字典质量,因此仍然是评估SAEs附加值的重要参考点.

blocks.en: 6.10 Interpretability-by-Design Methods for Intrinsic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 6.10 互通解释方法

blocks.en: The methods surveyed thus far in this section aim to extract and analyse more monosemantic units from polysemantic model activations. They share a common premise: the model’s original representations are too entangled to be directly interpretable, so interpretability is applied post hoc to recover simpler units of analysis. A parallel research programme, which we term Interpretability-by-Design Methods for Intrinsic Interpretability , inverts this premise by asking whether deep neural models can instead be designed to be mechanistically interpretable by construction ( Pearce et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2025 ; Oldfield et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Adler et al., 2025 ; Draye et al., 2026 ; Dooms et al., 2025 ). This subsection extends the discussion of this research direction.
blocks.zh: 本节迄今所调查的方法旨在从多语种模型活化中提取和分析更多的单语种单元. 他们有一个共同的前提:模型的原始表达过于缠绕,无法直接解释,因此可解释性被应用为后临时,以恢复更简单的分析单位. 一个平行的研究方案,我们称之为 " 互通解释方法 " ,通过询问深神经模型是否可以通过建筑来设计为机械解释,从而颠倒了这一前提(Pearce等,2025年;Park等,2025年;Oldfield等,2025年)。 2024; Yang等,2025;Gao等,2026;Adler等,2025;Draye等,2026;Dooms等,2025. 本分节扩展了对这一研究方向的讨论.

blocks.en: Next, we introduce five approaches for constructing models that are more interpretable by design. Three impose model sparsity constraints at different levels: feature-sparse training (Section 6.10.1 ), weight-sparse training (Section 6.10.2 ), and attention-sparse training (Section 6.10.3 ). The remaining two approaches instead modify the computational primitives themselves, using more interpretable operators as units of construction and analysis (Sections 6.10.4 and 6.10.5 ).
blocks.zh: 接着,我们提出五个方法来构建更能按设计解释的模型。 三个部门在不同层面施加了模式性痉挛限制:特征-散热培训(第6.10.1节)、重量-散热培训(第6.10.2节)和注意力-散热培训(第6.10.3节)。 其余两种方法则修改了计算原生物本身,使用更可解释的操作者作为构造和分析的单位(第6.10.4和6.10.5节)。

blocks.en: Interpretability should be understood as a spectrum rather than a binary property. At least in their current form, these techniques do not make model computation completely or immediately understandable. Instead, they make models easier to analyse and ensure the analysis pipeline preserves more information about the original computation than post-hoc approximations. Table 7 summarises these approaches and their trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 可解释性应被理解为光谱而非二进制属性. 至少在目前的形式上,这些技术并不能使模型计算完全或立即被理解. 相反,它们使得模型更容易分析和确保分析管道保存了更多关于原始计算的信息,而不是浩克后近似. 表7概述了这些办法及其取舍。

blocks.en: 6.10.1 Feature-Sparse Training: SoLU
blocks.zh: 6.10.1 特色-分层培训:SoLU

blocks.en: Softmax linear units (SoLU; Elhage et al., 2022b ) are an earlier attempt at architectural intervention. SoLU is a specialised activation function that applies a softmax-based transformation across the layer’s d mlp d_{\mathrm{mlp}} neurons. Specifically, given the pre-activation vector u = W 1 ​ h + b 1 ∈ ℝ d mlp , u=W_{1}h+b_{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{\mathrm{mlp}}}, SoLU calculates the activation values as σ SoLU ​ ( u ) = u ⊙ softmax ⁡ ( u ) . \sigma_{\text{SoLU}}(u)=u\odot\mathrm{softmax}(u). (3) This softmax-based transformation induces competition among neurons. When one neuron receives a large pre-activation value, the softmax suppresses the others’ values, analogous to lateral inhibition. This competition encourages certain neurons to specialise and dominate, increasing the prevalence of monosemantic neurons associated with human-interpretable concepts.
blocks.zh: 软max线性单位(SoLU;Elhage等,2022b)是更早的建筑干预尝试. SoLU是一个专门的活化功能,它应用了以软马克思为基础的跨层的活化活化(dmlp d_{\matherm{mlp}})神经元. 具体地说,鉴于活化前向量u = W 1 h + b 1 → R d mlp ,u = W_{ 1}h + b_{ 1 → in\ mathbb{R}^{d_{\ _{\ mathrm{ mlp}}} , SoLU计算活化值为: \ SOLU (u) = u ⊙ sweetmax ⁡ (u). sigma_{\text{ SOLU}} (u) u\odot\ mathrm{softmax} (u). (3)这种以软马克思为基础的转变会诱发神经元之间的竞争. 当一个神经元得到较大的活性前值时,软马克斯会抑制其他神经元的值,类似于平相抑制. 这一竞争鼓励了某些神经元的特异性和支配性,使与人-可解释的概念相联的单体神经元更加普遍.

blocks.en: However, it also reveals an undesirable phenomenon: although many secondary neurons’ activations are suppressed to low magnitudes, these neurons remain polysemantic, with many features compressed into them. Later layer normalisation ( Ba et al., 2016 ) can amplify them and recover the polysemanticity property ( Elhage et al., 2022b ) . The “smuggling” by layer normalisation suggests that imposing local interpretability constraints may not eliminate neural networks’ incentive to compress information through superposition. This issue motivates global constraints across the neural network, such as weight-sparsity training discussed below.
blocks.zh: 然而,它也揭示出一种不可取的现象:虽然许多次级神经元活化被抑制到低等分量,但这些神经元仍然是多质的,有许多特征被压缩入其中. 后层常态化(Ba等,2016年)可以放大并取回多聚苯乙烯(Elhage等,2022b.). 层层正常化的 " 走私 " 表明,施加局部解释性限制可能不会消除神经网络通过叠加压缩信息的动机。 这个问题促使神经网络受到全球制约,例如下文讨论的重量均衡培训。

blocks.en: 6.10.2 Weight-Sparse Training
blocks.zh: 6.10.2 重量分配培训

blocks.en: A weight-sparse transformer ( Gao et al., 2026 ) treats weight sparsity as an explicit structural constraint that is progressively strengthened during training. Gao et al. (2026) optimise the standard cross-entropy objective along with an L 0 L_{0} constraint on model weights after each optimisation step. Specifically, within each weight matrix, they retain only the largest-magnitude parameters and set the rest to zero. The L 0 L_{0} constraint anneals from a dense initialisation to the desired sparsity level over training. The resulting transformer has most weight parameters exactly zero, making the remaining computational structure much easier to decompose into small, task-specific circuits.
blocks.zh: 减重变压器(Gao等,2026年)将减重螺旋变压视为一种明显的结构制约,在训练中逐渐强化. Gao等 (2026) 优化标准跨切入目标,同时在每个优化步骤后对模型重量的L 0 L_{0}限制. 具体地说,在每个重量矩阵中,它们只保留了最大尺寸的参数并设定了其余为零. L 0 L_{0} 限制肛门从密集初始化到理想的螺旋分级 超过训练。 由此产生的变压器有大部分重量参数完全为零,使所剩的计算结构更容易分解为小而任务特定的回路.

blocks.en:
Its interpretability gains can be substantial. Under highly sparse regimes (e.g., < 1 % <1\% active weights), neurons receive input from far fewer upstream neurons, and the model’s circuits for specific capabilities or behaviours become much sparser. Mean-ablation experiments further confirm that these circuits are
both necessary and sufficient for the capability or behaviour.
blocks.zh:
其可解释性可以有很大的提高。 在高度稀少的系统(例如 < 1% < 1+++活性重量)下,神经元从上游神经元中接收的输入量要少得多,而模型的特定能力或行为的回路会更稀少得多。 平均比照实验进一步证实这些电路是
对能力或行为既必要又足够。

blocks.en: Gao et al. (2026) characterised the trade-off between model capability and interpretability induced by weight sparsity. Increasing sparsity generally makes the model easier to decompose into small, interpretable circuits. However, it also degrades task performance, producing a capability–interpretability Pareto frontier. Nonetheless, the authors found that increasing model size can shift this frontier outward. At comparable task performance, larger sparse models can have substantially smaller, more interpretable circuits than smaller models; at comparable interpretability, they can retain stronger capabilities. This suggests that scaling model size alongside structural sparsity may offer a path to more interpretable yet high-capability models. However, preserving interpretability beyond tens of millions of nonzero parameters remains challenging, and weight-sparse training currently requires substantially more compute than traditional training.
blocks.zh: Gao等人(2026年)将模型能力与由重量抽筋引起的可解释性之间的取舍定性。 不断增强的相接性一般会使模型更容易分解为可解释的小回路. 然而,它也降低了任务性能,产生了一种能力-解释性帕雷托边界。 然而,提交人认为,模型规模的扩大可以使这一前沿向外转移。 在可比较的任务性能下,较大的稀有模型可以拥有大大小,更可解释的电路;在可比较可解释性下,它们可以保留更强的能力. 这表明,与结构相伴而成的模型大小可提供一个更可解释但能力更强的模型的路径。 然而,在数千万非零参数之外保留可解释性仍然具有挑战性,重量分配培训目前需要比传统培训多得多的计算。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Comparison of interpretability-by-design methods.
blocks.zh: 表7:可解释性与设计方法的比较。

blocks.en: 6.10.3 Attention-Sparse Training
blocks.zh: 6.10.3 关注培训

blocks.en: In transformers, attention patterns produced by an attention head are usually diffuse , i.e., every token attends to every other token. Diffuse attention patterns are difficult to interpret and audit. Previous studies have therefore explored attention-sparse training , which aims to sparsify attention patterns to make them more interpretable ( Lei et al., 2025 ; Draye et al., 2026 ). Specifically, Lei et al. (2025) proposed SPARse TrANsformer World model (SPARTAN), an object-centric world model trained with L 0 L_{0} regularisation on attention patterns and a constrained optimisation objective to maintain cross-entropy performance equal to that of a dense counterpart. Draye et al. (2026) further adapted this technique to fine-tune and sparsify a trained language model’s attention patterns.
blocks.zh: 在变压器中,由注意力头产生的注意力模式通常会被分散出来,即每个符号都关注其他每个符号.  Diffuse 关注模式很难解释和审计. 因此,以往的研究探索了关注-分散培训,其目的是使关注模式更加灵活,使其更便于解释(Lei等,2025;Draye等,2026)。 具体来说,Lei等人(2025年)提出了SPARse Transformer World model(SPARTAN),这是一个以对象为中心的世界模型,经过了L 0 L_{0}的规范化研究,研究了注意力模式,以及限制的优化目标,以保持与密集对等者的交叉性能等同. Draye等人(2026年)进一步调整了这一技术,以微调和使一个训练有素的语言模型的注意力模式得到伸缩.

blocks.en: After training (either from scratch or via fine-tuning), each attention head attends only to specific tokens, and the model performance remains close to the original. This result suggests that many attention patterns may be redundant noise. In CLT-based circuit discovery (see Section 7.2 ), Draye et al. (2026) showed that sparsified attention patterns reduce the number of mediating components involved in feature-to-feature attribution, making the resulting attribution graphs easier to analyse.
blocks.zh: 训练后(从零开始或通过微调),每个关注头只参加特定的道具,而模型性能仍然接近于原作. 这一结果表明许多关注模式可能是多余的噪音. 在基于CLT的电路发现(见第7.2节)中,Draye等人(2026年)表明,斯帕氏关注模式会减少参与地物到地物归属的介质元件数量,使由此产生的归属图更容易分析.

blocks.en: 6.10.4 Modifications of Computational Primitives: MOLT
blocks.zh: 6.10.4 计算基数的修改:MOLT

blocks.en: One alternative approach to learning interpretable structure is to reconsider what the computational primitives should be ( Oldfield et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2025 ; Braun et al., 2025 ; Bushnaq et al., 2025 ). A recent example is the sparse mixture of linear transforms (MOLT), which represents a conceptual shift from feature extraction towards transformation extraction ( Lindsey et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 学习可解释结构的一个替代办法是重新考虑计算原始物应该是什么(Oldfield等,2025;Park等,2025;Braun等,2025;Bushnaq等,2025)。 最近的一个例子是线性变换(MOLT)的稀有混合物,它代表着从地物取出到变换取出的概念转变(Lindsey等,2025年b). 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Standard SAEs and transcoders primarily decompose model activations into features. However, many algorithmic tasks, such as arithmetic or geometric reasoning, are more naturally described by operations such as “add 3” or “rotate a vector”. In these tasks, we want to know how the model transforms one activation into another through components like weight matrices in MLP blocks. To achieve this, MOLT replaces the MLP with a sparse mixture of learned linear transformation matrices. The basic unit of analysis becomes transformations applied to model activations rather than features.
blocks.zh: 标准SAE和转码器主要将模型活化分解为特性. 然而,许多算法任务,如算术或几何推理,更自然地被诸如"添加3"或"旋转向量"等操作所描述. 在这些任务中,我们想知道模型如何通过MLP块中的重量矩阵等组件将一个活化为另一个活化. 为了实现这一点,MOLT将MLP取而代之的是少量的已学习到的线性变换矩阵. 基本的分析单位成为适用于模型活化而不是特性的转变.

blocks.en: For example, in a modular arithmetic task, MOLT can represent the concept of addition with a learned rotation matrix, which relates more directly to the underlying algorithm than a collection of state-specific features. More broadly, approaches that represent computational operations explicitly, as MOLT does, may facilitate the development of interpretable representations for tasks governed by systematic operations. We view Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KANs) as an approach that embodies this idea, as discussed below.
blocks.zh: 例如,在一个模块化的算术任务中,MOLT可以用一个已学习到的自转矩阵来代表添加的概念,这个矩阵与基础算法的关系比收集状态特有特征更直接. 更广泛地说,明确代表计算操作的方法,如MOLT所做的那样,可能有助于为系统操作所管辖的任务拟订可解释的说明。 我们认为Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks(KANs)是一种体现这一想法的方法,如下文所讨论。

blocks.en: 6.10.5 Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KANs)
blocks.zh: 6.10.5 科尔莫戈罗夫-阿尔诺德网络(KANs)

blocks.en: Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KANs) represent one of the most radical departures from standard neural network architectures ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . In conventional neural networks, each neuron receives outputs from upstream neurons through incoming edges weighted by scalar parameters, sums these weighted inputs, and then applies a fixed nonlinear activation function (the whole process can be represented as matrix multiplication in components like MLP blocks and attention modules in Section 4.4 ). Inspired by the Kolmogorov–Arnold representation theorem, KANs place learnable nonlinear functions, typically parameterised using B-splines, on edges rather than using fixed nonlinear activation functions at nodes.
blocks.zh: Kolmogorov – Arnold Networks (KANs) 代表了与标准神经网络架构(刘等,2025b)最激进的背离之一. 在常规神经网络中,每个神经元通过由分级参数加权的入来边缘来接收上游神经元的输出,将这些加权输入相加,然后应用固定的非线性活化功能(整个过程可以作为MLP块等元件和4.4节的注意力模块的矩阵乘法来表示). KANs在Kolmogorov–Arnold代表定理的启发下,将可学习的非线性函数放入边缘,一般使用B-splines参数化,而不是在节点使用固定的非线性活化函数.

blocks.en:
Specifically, consider a single KAN node receiving an input vector v = ( v 1 , … , v d ) ∈ ℝ d v=(v_{1},\dots,v_{d})\in\mathbb{R}^{d} from the previous layer. Its output is y = ∑ i = 1 d ψ i ​ ( v i ) , ψ i ​ ( v i ) = ∑ m c i , m ​ B m ​ ( v i ) , y=\sum_{i=1}^{d}\psi_{i}(v_{i}),\qquad\psi_{i}(v_{i})=\sum_{m}c_{i,m}B_{m}(v_{i}), where B m ​ ( ⋅ ) B_{m}(\cdot) denotes the m m -th basis function, such as a cubic B-spline basis,
and c i , m c_{i,m} is a learnable scalar coefficient. In this formulation, the edge is not scalar multiplication but a learnable univariate function ψ i ​ ( ⋅ ) \psi_{i}(\cdot) , and a node simply sums the outputs of its incoming edges. Intuitively, KANs shift nonlinear transformations from nodes to edges, offering an alternative way to structure and interpret neural network computations.
blocks.zh:
具体来说,考虑从上层收到一个输入矢量v=(v 1,.,v d)的单个KAN节点. blocks.en: This design gives KANs an explicitly compositional and thus more interpretable structure. As the nonlinearities are univariate and can be visualised directly on individual edges, researchers can use techniques like symbolic regression to approximate and inspect the learned analytical expressions, such as rediscovering known physical equations. Although KAN training is currently more computationally expensive than training standard MLPs and has not yet been convincingly demonstrated at the scale of large language models, this architectural innovation points to an ambitious direction towards interpretable neural networks in which parameters correspond to mathematically meaningful functions.
blocks.zh: 这种设计使KANs具有明显的组成性,因此更能解释结构. 由于非线性是单向的并可以直接在单个边缘上被可视化,研究者可以使用符号回归等技术来估计并检查所学到的分析表达,例如重新发现已知的物理等式. 虽然KAN培训目前比培训标准MLP更需要计算,而且还没有在大语言模型的规模上令人信服地表现出来,但这一建筑创新指明了向可解释神经网络的宏伟方向,其中参数与数学有意义的功能相对应.

blocks.en: This section introduced several classical methods for feature extraction and analysis, followed by approaches that aim to make models intrinsically interpretable. However, whether features are recovered post hoc or induced by design, they remain units of analysis rather than complete explanations of the model’s mechanism, i.e., how these units interact and causally influence one another. Section 7 therefore shifts from individual features to circuits : computational graphs of interacting components that describe how the model implements its behaviours.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍若干典型的地物提取和分析方法,然后介绍旨在使模型具有内在解释性的方法。 然而,无论特性是事后恢复的还是由设计诱导的,它们仍然是分析的单位,而不是对模型机制的完整解释,即这些单位如何相互作用和因果影响。 因此,第7节从单个特征转向电路:互动元件的计算图描述模型如何实施其行为.

blocks.en: 7 Circuits in Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 7 机械解释中的电路

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability aims not only to identify what information a model represents, but also to explain how it transforms and combines that information across layers to produce behaviour. Feature analysis is a useful tool for describing activation vectors, but it describes them in isolation. Many model behaviours arise from structured interactions among multiple components that operate together across layers. To explain these behaviours and their mechanisms, we need a high-level abstraction that captures critical computational patterns of these features. The circuit framework (Figure 3 ; introduced in Section 4.5 ) addresses this gap by modelling behaviour as coordinated computational graphs and making explicit how components causally interact.
blocks.zh: 机械解释不仅旨在确定一个模型所代表的信息,还旨在解释它如何将这些信息跨层转化和结合,以产生行为. 地物分析是描述活性向量的有用工具,但它孤立地描述了活性向量. 许多示范行为产生于跨层共同运作的多个组成部分之间的结构化互动。 为了解释这些行为及其机制,我们需要一个高级别抽象,抓住这些特征的关键计算模式。 电路框架(图3;第4.5节中引入)通过模拟作为协调计算图的行为并明确组件因果互动的方式来弥补这一差距.

blocks.en: Notably, the circuit framework is not the only way to model an internal mechanism. Early studies have explored alternative ways. For example, Giles et al. (1992) and Omlin & Giles (1996) categorised a recurrent neural network’s hidden representations into different states and modelled its decision process as a finite-state automaton when the input sentence was fed sequentially. Nonetheless, the circuit framework has attracted growing research interest in studying neural networks’ internal mechanisms. Below, we introduce approaches for identifying and constructing circuits.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,电路框架并不是建立内部机制的唯一模式。 早期的研究探索了其他方法. 例如,Giles等人(1992年)和Omlin & Giles(1996年)将反复出现的神经网络隐藏的表达方式归类为不同的状态,并在输入句被相继输入时将其决定过程模拟为有限状态自体。 尽管如此,电路框架在研究神经网络的内部机制方面引起了越来越多的研究兴趣。 下面我们介绍识别和建造电路的方法。

blocks.en: 7.1 Circuit Discovery Methods
blocks.zh: 7.1 电路发现 方法

blocks.en: Circuit discovery methods aim to identify internal computational graphs responsible for specific capabilities or outputs in a neural network. Below, and in Table 8 , we formalise key techniques and methods, along with their strengths and limitations.
blocks.zh: 电路发现方法旨在识别负责神经网络中特定能力或输出的内部计算图. 下面和表8中,我们将关键技术和方法及其优点和局限性正式化。

blocks.en: Activation Patching Given a model f θ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\theta}(\cdot) parameterised by θ \theta and an input sequence x x , activation patching evaluates the causal contribution of some model components S S by replacing their activations with specified reference values h ~ S \tilde{h}_{S} and measuring the resulting change in the model output. The causal importance of S S for x x is defined as s S ( x ) = M ( f θ ( x ) ) − M ( f θ ( x [ S ← h ~ S ] ) ) , s_{S}(x)=M\bigl(f_{\theta}(x)\bigr)-M\Bigl(f_{\theta}\bigl(x_{[S\leftarrow\tilde{h}_{S}]}\bigr)\Bigr), where M ⁡ ( ⋅ ) M(\cdot) is a scalar performance metric computed from the model output, such as the logit difference for the answer token, and x [ S ← h ~ S ] x_{[S\leftarrow\tilde{h}_{S}]} denotes a forward pass on x x in which the activations of components in S S are replaced by h ~ S \tilde{h}_{S} while the remaining computation proceeds normally. The reference activations h ~ S \tilde{h}_{S} usually come from a corrupted reference run, where the input is modified to add or remove specific information. Some works have also set h ~ S \tilde{h}_{S} to zero or the mean model activation. The resulting change in model output quantifies the causal effect of intervening on S S ( Zhang & Nanda, 2024 ) .

Path Patching Path patching extends activation patching on model components to specific edges in the computational graph. For a connection e i ​ j e_{ij} from model component i i to j j denoting that the output activations of i i are fed to j j as one of its inputs, it replaces activations along e i ​ j e_{ij} with reference values h ~ e i ​ j \tilde{h}_{e_{ij}} and measures e i ​ j e_{ij} ’s causal effect as: s i ​ j ( x ) = M ( f θ ( x ) ) − M ( f θ ( x [ e i ​ j ← h ~ e i ​ j ] ) ) . s_{ij}(x)=M\bigl(f_{\theta}(x)\bigr)-M\Bigl(f_{\theta}\bigl(x_{[e_{ij}\leftarrow\tilde{h}_{e_{ij}}]}\bigr)\Bigr). This allows finer-grained causal localisation along information flows ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 路径补丁 路径补丁将模型组件上的活化补丁扩展至计算图中的特定边缘. 对于从模型组件i到j的连接 i j j j j 表示i 的输出活化为 j j 作为其输入之一, 它用参考值 h ~ e i j j\ tilde{ h}_{ e_{ ij } 代替 i 的活化 和措施 e j e i j j 的因果为: s i j (x) = M (f θ (x) )- M (f  x (x (x e i j ← h ~  e  j  j (x) s i j } (x) = M\ bigl (f _{\theta) (x e_{ i_{ j}\ leftarrow\t{ (tilde{h}_{ e e iij }})\ Bigr) 。 这使得随着信息流的来龙去脉可以被更细化地分出因果(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Automatic Circuit Discovery (ACDC) ACDC ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) discovers a circuit by iteratively using path patching to identify important connections in the model’s computational graph. Traversing the graph in reverse topological order from the output node, it patches the activation transmitted along each edge and measures the resulting change in a task-specific metric. An edge e i ​ j e_{ij} will be pruned if patching it produces | s i ​ j ​ ( x ) | |s_{ij}(x)| less than a predefined threshold τ \tau ; otherwise, it is retained in the graph and its upstream edges will be investigated. The remaining subgraph represents the discovered circuit.
blocks.zh: 自动电路发现(ACDC) ACDC(Conmy等,2023年)通过反复使用路径补丁来识别模型计算图中的重要连接来发现一个电路. 将图从输出节点按倒向地貌顺序移动,将沿每个边缘传送的活化器补上并测量由此而来的变化,以特定任务计量. 如果补丁生成的 s i j (x) (x s ij) (x) 少于预定义的阈值\\ tau; 否则, 它会被保留在图表中, 其上游边缘会被调查 。 所剩子图代表已发现的回路.

blocks.en: Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) EAP ( Syed et al., 2024 ) estimates the causal importance of edges in a model’s computational graph by approximating the effect of path patching with a first-order Taylor expansion. For an edge e i ​ j e_{ij} connecting components i i and j j , its importance score is approximated as s i ​ j ​ ( x ) ≈ ∂ M ∂ h e i ​ j ⋅ ( h e i ​ j clean − h e i ​ j corrupt ) , s_{ij}(x)\approx\frac{\partial M}{\partial h_{e_{ij}}}\cdot\left(h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{clean}}-h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{corrupt}}\right), where h e i ​ j clean h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{clean}} and h e i ​ j corrupt h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{corrupt}} denote the activations transmitted from component i i to component j j along edge e i ​ j e_{ij} on clean and corrupted inputs, respectively, when processing x x . M ⁡ ( ⋅ ) M(\cdot) is a scalar metric of model performance as mentioned above. EAP is substantially faster than ACDC because the attribution scores for all edges are computed using only two forward passes and a single backward pass. Specifically, the forward passes obtain h e i ​ j clean h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{clean}} and h e i ​ j corrupt h_{e_{ij}}^{\mathrm{corrupt}} , while the backward pass computes ∂ M ∂ h e i ​ j \frac{\partial M}{\partial h_{e_{ij}}} for all components simultaneously. In contrast, ACDC requires a separate forward pass for each edge it tests. Edges with large score magnitudes are generally considered main contributors to the target behaviour. Therefore, one simple approach to circuit construction is directly selecting the highest-scoring edges ( Syed et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent work has improved EAP in different directions: EAP-IG ( Hanna et al., 2024 ) and EAP-GP ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) improve edge-attribution estimation, while PEAP ( Haklay et al., 2025 ) extends patching across token positions to produce finer-grained attribution graphs that capture cross-token interactions.

blocks.en: Besides intervention (activation patching, ACDC, etc.) and attribution (EAP, EAP-IG, etc.) techniques, another line of approaches treats circuit discovery as an optimisation problem ( Csordás et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2021 ; Bhaskar et al., 2024 ; Haider et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, they use gradient descent to learn which parts of the computational graph can be removed without affecting model behaviour. For example, Edge Pruning ( Bhaskar et al., 2024 ) learns edge masks to discover sparse connections, while multi-granular node pruning ( Haider et al., 2026 ) learns node masks at different scales, from entire blocks to individual neurons. These methods can usually discover sparser circuits than intervention and attribution counterparts. However, the optimisation process itself introduces randomness and sensitivity to training configurations like the learning rate, which may make the subsequent analysis less robust and interpretable.
blocks.zh: 除了干预(激活补丁,ACDC等)和归属(EAP,EAP-IG等)技术外,另一行方法将电路发现视为优化问题(Csordás等,2021;Cao等,2021;Bhaskar等,2024;Haider等,2026)。 具体来说,他们使用梯度回落来学习计算图的哪些部分可以去除而不影响模型行为. 例如,Edge Pruning(Baskar等,2024年)学习边缘口罩来发现稀疏的连接,而多角节点穿插(Haider等,2026年)则学习不同尺度的节点口罩,从整块到单个神经元. 这些方法通常能够发现比干预和归属对应方更稀疏的回路. 然而,优化过程本身引入了随机性和对学习率等培训配置的敏感性,这可能会使后期分析变得不那么稳健和可解释.

blocks.en: Circuits can explain models in different contexts, from a single input–output pair to a capability or behaviour. Identifying a circuit for a specific input or prompt is called query-level circuit discovery ( Wu & Barez, 2026 ) . In contrast, task-level circuit discovery ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Kharlapenko et al., 2025 ) seeks to identify a circuit that implements a broader capability or task, typically operationalised by a dataset of examples, such as the indirect object identification (IOI) dataset ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . In the task-level setting, components’ and edges’ attribution scores (e.g., s S ​ ( x ) s_{S}(x) or s i ​ j ​ ( x ) s_{ij}(x) ) are aggregated across inputs to reduce example-specific noise, yielding a circuit that characterises the task as a whole.
blocks.zh: 电路可以在不同的上下文中解释模型,从单一的输入-输出对到能力或行为. 为特定输入或提示识别回路称为查询级回路发现(Wu & Barez, 2026). 相形之下,任务级电路发现(Wang等,2023;Kharlapenko等,2025年)则试图确定一个执行更广泛能力或任务的电路,一般通过一组实例来操作,如间接对象识别(IOI)数据集(Wang等,2023年). 在任务级别设置中,组件的和边缘的归属分数(如 s S (x) s_{ S} (x) 或 s i j (x) s_{ij} (x)) 被汇总到所有输入中,以减少实例特定的噪声,产生一个将任务整体定性的回路.

blocks.en: The techniques and methods introduced above, including activation patching, path patching, ACDC, EAP, EAP-IG, and mask-based pruning methods, have primarily been developed and evaluated in the task-level setting. More recent work has extended EAP-IG to identify circuits for individual prompts ( Wu & Barez, 2026 ) . This enables the discovery of sparse yet faithful circuits in the model even for complex, natural-language user queries, where the relevant computation may vary substantially from one input to another.
blocks.zh: 以上引入的技术和方法,包括激活补丁,路径补丁,ACDC,EAP,EAP-IG,和基于口罩的穿孔方法,主要在任务级别设置中得到开发和评价. 更近期的工作将EAP-IG扩展为识别个人提示的电路(Wu & Barez, 2026). 这使得即使在复杂的自然语言用户查询时也能在模型中发现稀少而忠实的回路,因为相关的计算可能因输入而有很大差异。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Trade-offs and characteristics of circuit discovery methods.
blocks.zh: 表8:电路发现方法的权衡与特征.

blocks.en: 7.2 Circuit Discovery with Replacement Models
blocks.zh: 7.2 更换模型的电路发现

blocks.en: The methods introduced above discover circuits within the target model. Their nodes correspond to coarse-grained components such as attention heads and MLP blocks, which are mostly not immediately understandable. A complementary approach first constructs a more interpretable replacement model (Section 6.6.2 ) that approximates the original model’s computation using sparse linear features, and then performs circuit discovery within this replacement model.
blocks.zh: 以上引入的方法在目标模型中发现了回路. 它们的节点对应了注意头和MLP块等粗糙的分层,这些分层大多无法立即理解. 一种补充方法首先构建一种更可解释的替换模型(第6.6.2节),该模型利用稀有的线性特征来大致计算原模型,然后在这一替换模型内进行电路发现.

blocks.en: Recent work has implemented this paradigm using cross-layer transcoders (CLTs; Section 6.6.2 ) ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ; Merullo et al., 2025 ) . In particular, Circuit Tracer ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) replaces the model’s MLPs with CLTs while retaining the underlying model’s attention and residual-stream computation. This yields a prompt-specific attribution graph whose principal internal nodes are sparse CLT features rather than entire MLP blocks or attention heads.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作是利用跨层转码器(CLTs;第6.6.2节)实施这一范式。 (Ameisen等,2025;Merullo等,2025.). 特别是,电路追踪器(Ameisen等,2025年)用CLT取代了模型的MLP,同时保留了基础模型的注意力和残余流计算. 这产生了一个即时特定归属图,其主要内部节点是稀有的CLT特征,而不是整个MLP块或注意力头.
