blocks.en: CLT-based circuit discovery differs from conventional circuit discovery in two aspects. First, the resulting circuit’s nodes correspond to fine-grained linear features rather than coarse MLP blocks or attention modules. Using automated feature-interpretation pipelines (Section 12.6 ) to assign natural-language descriptions to these features, human inspectors can more easily understand the discovered mechanism. Second, an edge in a CLT-based circuit denotes the direct, input-specific influence between two features, which is different from the formulation of attribution methods based on clean–corrupted reference pairs, such as EAP and EAP-IG. Specifically, in Circuit Tracer, a source feature can write to the residual stream at multiple subsequent layers, and the strength of an edge from the source feature to a target feature is the aggregate of the contributions of these writes to the target feature.
blocks.zh: 基于CLT的电路发现在两个方面与传统的电路发现不同. 首先,产生的电路节点对应了细纹线性特征,而不是粗糙的MLP块或注意模块. 利用自动特性解释管道(第12.6节)为这些特性指定自然语言说明,人类视察员可以更容易地了解所发现的机制。 其次,CLT基于电路的边缘表示两个特征之间的直接,输入的特定影响,这与基于清洁-腐蚀参考对的归属方法的制定不同,如EAP和EAP-IG. 具体地说,在Circuit Tracer中,一个源特性可以写给后多层的剩余流,从源特性到目标特性的一个边缘的强度是这些写作对目标特性的贡献的总和.

blocks.en: For a given prompt, Circuit Tracer produces a sparse attribution graph that describes active features and their interactions, making it well suited to query-level circuit discovery. Interpretability platforms such as Neuronpedia ( Lin, 2023 ) also offer interactive implementations. However, the approach still has several limitations. Specifically, CLTs only approximate MLP computations, so the discovered circuit may only cover a part of the model’s underlying mechanism. Moreover, feature-level attribution graphs can have many nodes and edges, so we must prune, cluster, or otherwise condense them before they become understandable.
blocks.zh: 对于给定的即时器,Circuit Tracer生成一个稀有的归属图来描述活性特征及其相互作用,使其非常适合查询级电路的发现. Neuronpedia等可解释性平台(Lin,2023)也提供互动执行. 然而,这一办法仍有若干局限性。 具体地说,CLT只是近似于MLP的计算,所以所发现的回路可能只覆盖了模型的一部分基础机制. 此外,地物层次的归属图可以有很多节点和边缘,所以我们必须先把分层,分层,或者用其他方法来收缩它们,然后才能被理解.

blocks.en: 7.3 Causal Verification
blocks.zh: 7.3 因果关系核查

blocks.en: Once we identify circuits, two critical questions arise: are they causally responsible for the behaviour, and can we modify them reliably?
blocks.zh: 一旦我们确定了电路,就产生了两个关键问题:它们是否对行为负有因果关系,我们能否可靠地修改它们?

blocks.en: A circuit is causally necessary for a behaviour if removing or ablating the circuit degrades that behaviour. A circuit is causally sufficient if activating the circuit alone, i.e., patching all edges outside the circuit with activations from a corrupted reference run, reproduces the behaviour. In practice, a circuit is rarely sparse, necessary, and sufficient at the same time; it typically explains 60–80% of behavioural variance.
blocks.zh: 如果电路去除或被搅拌,则电路对某一行为具有因果关系。 一个电路如果单独激活电路,即用被腐蚀的参考运行的活化器来补补电路外的所有边缘,就足够了,复制行为. 在实践中,电路很少是稀有的、必要的,同时也是足够的;它通常解释60-80%的行为差异。

blocks.en: A circuit is often considered faithful if it is both causally necessary and causally sufficient for the behaviour it is claimed to explain ( Hanna et al., 2024 ; Marks et al., 2025a ) . Two popular approaches to validate causality are causal scrubbing and interchange interventions ( Chan et al., 2022a ; Geiger et al., 2024 ). Causal scrubbing ( Chan et al., 2022a ) systematically evaluates a mechanistic hypothesis by replacing model activations with those from inputs deemed equivalent under the hypothesis and testing whether these interventions preserve the model behaviour. Interchange interventions ( Geiger et al., 2024 ) test whether model activations causally correspond to higher-level variables by substituting activations across inputs and measuring the resulting change in model behaviour. Together, these methods provide stronger evidence for mechanistic explanations than observational analysis alone.
blocks.zh: 如果一个电路对于它声称要解释的行为既必要又足够(Hanna等,2024;Marks等,2025a.),则往往被认为是忠实的. 验证因果关系的两种流行做法是因果洗涤和交换干预(Chan等,2022a; Geiger等人, 2024年.). Causal drushbing(Chan等人,2022a)系统评价了一种机械假说,将模型活性化替换为假设下视为等效的投入,并测试这些干预是否保留了模型行为. 互换干预(Geiger等,2024年)通过取而代之的跨输入活化并测量模型行为所产生的变化,检验模型活化是否因果地对应了更高层次的变量. 这些方法加在一起,为机械解释提供了比仅观察分析更强有力的证据.

blocks.en: More recently, several works have proposed metrics to quantify circuit faithfulness as a continuous score ( Hanna et al., 2024 ; Wu & Barez, 2026 ) , allowing systematic comparisons of circuits discovered by different methods. By aggregating faithfulness scores across tasks and settings, benchmarks such as MIB ( Mueller et al., 2025 ) evaluate how well circuit discovery methods identify causally important model components. However, achieving strict necessity and sufficiency is often hard because many model behaviours depend on distributed representations and multiple redundant pathways ( Barez et al., 2026 ) . Even if we identify a circuit that captures the primary mechanism of a behaviour, components outside the circuit may still play important roles, such as handling edge cases and computational robustness.
blocks.zh: 最近,有几部作品提出了将电路忠诚度量化为连续分数的度量标准(Hanna等,2024;Wu & Barez,2026),从而可以系统比较不同方法发现的电路. 通过汇总不同任务和设置的忠诚分数,MIB(Mueller等人,2025年)等基准评价了电路发现方法如何识别因果重要的模型组件. 然而,实现严格的必要性和充分性往往很困难,因为许多示范行为取决于分布式表述和多种冗余路径(Barez等,2026年)。 即使我们确定一个能够捕捉某种行为的主要机制的电路,电路外的组件仍然可能起重要作用,例如处理边缘案件和计算稳健性.

blocks.en: 7.4 Case Study: Induction Heads
blocks.zh: 7.4 案例研究:上岗主管

blocks.en: Circuit Perspective on Induction Heads Following our introduction to induction heads in Section 6.8 , we consider a repeated sequence: A B C A B where the model needs to predict the token after the second B . The induction head alone is not sufficient to implement induction behaviour from scratch. It still needs help from previous layers’ attention heads to locate the token following the current token’s previous occurrence, so it knows it should attend to C in this example ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Specifically, in a two-layer attention-only transformer, Elhage et al. (2021) discovered the previous-token head , which writes every token’s information to the next position. The change propagates to the residual stream to be read by the induction head, allowing it to locate C (because now some information about the first B is contained in C ). The two kinds of heads form the induction circuit that is sufficient to implement the induction behaviour in the two-layer small model. Empirical evidence supports this mechanistic interpretation. Head ablation experiments show that induction heads causally support in-context learning in the attention-only model. Circuit analysis also reveals induction heads’ dependence on earlier previous-token heads. Moreover, induction heads emerge abruptly during training, coinciding with sharp improvements in in-context learning performance. In larger models with additional layers and MLPs, the mechanism behind induction behaviour becomes more complex. However, the core principle remains the same: context propagates across layers and is used to conditionally retrieve tokens based on repeated subsequence matches. From this perspective, the circuit framework complements feature-based analysis by explicitly identifying the model’s internal mechanism that implements a specific behaviour.
blocks.zh: 介绍头的电路视角 继我们介绍第6.8节的上岗主管之后,我们考虑了一个重复的序列:A B C A B,模型需要预测第二B后的迹象。 上岗主任本身不足以从零开始实施上岗行为。 它仍然需要前几层的注意头帮助,才能在现在的指使之前发生之后找到指使符,因此它知道在这个例子中应该关注C(Olsson等,2022年)。 Elhage等人(2021年)在两层只关注的变压器中发现了前一个被敲头, 这些变化向剩余流传播,供上岗主管阅读,使其能够定位C(因为目前关于第一个B的一些信息载于C.)。 两种头组成了感应回路,足以在双层小模型中实施感应行为. 经验证据支持这种机械化的解释. 头部萎缩实验显示入门头因果支持只注意模式中的内文学习. 电路分析还显示,上岗头部依赖先前的上岗头部。 此外,在培训期间,上岗领导突然出现,同时,内容内学习成绩也急剧改善。 在具有额外分层和MLP的更大型模型中,诱导行为背后的机制变得更加复杂. 然而,核心原理依然不变:上下文跨层传播,并用于基于重复的子序列匹配条件取回令牌. 从这个角度出发,电路框架通过明确确定该模型执行特定行为的内部机制来补充基于特征的分析.

blocks.en: 7.5 A Unified Evaluation Framework for Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 7.5 机械解释的统一评价框架

blocks.en: A persistent challenge in mechanistic interpretability (MI) is the lack of standardised evaluation. Different interpretability methods use incompatible metrics. For example, for the same behaviour of interest, circuit discovery can work at the level of MLP/attention modules ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) , CLT features ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) , or even neurons ( Arora et al., 2026 ) . A CLT-based circuit must also verify CLT fidelity; an MLP/attention-level circuit should test and explain each node’s role. Thus, it is hard to compare them and measure progress. To address this, this section presents a unified evaluation framework covering five dimensions—attribution faithfulness, completeness, stability, causal validity, and human interpretability—where different methods can be jointly tested.
blocks.zh: 机械解释(MI)方面的一个长期挑战是缺乏标准化评价。 不同的可解释性方法使用不相容的度量衡. 例如,对于同样感兴趣的行为,电路发现可以在MLP/注意模块(Conmy等,2023年),CLT特征(Ameisen等,2025年),甚至神经元(Arora等,2026年)等层面工作. 基于CLT的电路还必须验证CLT的忠诚度;MLP/出勤级电路应当测试并解释每个节点的作用. 因此,很难对它们进行比较并衡量进展情况。 为了解决这一问题,本节提出一个统一的评价框架,涵盖五个方面——归属忠诚、完整性、稳定性、因果有效性和人的解释性——可以共同测试不同的方法。

blocks.en: 7.5.1 The Need for Standardised Evaluation
blocks.zh: 7.5.1 标准化评价的必要性

blocks.en: Before we discuss the five dimensions, we first explain in detail the need for standardised evaluation. Specifically, current evaluation practices face several challenges:
blocks.zh: 在讨论这五个方面之前,我们首先详细解释了进行标准化评价的必要性。 具体而言,目前的评价做法面临若干挑战:

blocks.en: • Utility ambiguity: Methods are initially developed for different aims and evaluated against distinct objectives, yet have overlapping application scenarios. For example, SAEs are assessed using reconstruction error and sparsity metrics; circuits are evaluated using behavioural recovery or faithfulness tests; and difference-in-means steering vectors (see Section 9.3 ) are examined by behaviour change—although all three approaches can be used to steer model outputs. Their unclear intended uses make it hard to compare their utility. • Cherry-picking: Existing work often reports interpretability results on carefully selected examples, samples from a narrow distribution, or capabilities where a method performs well. It may not report negative results, failure cases, or coverage statistics. This makes it difficult to assess the robustness and generality of the findings and determine whether the proposed method genuinely outperforms existing ones. • Missing baselines: Many proposed methods’ claimed interpretability gains are not systematically and adequately compared against intuitive alternatives or baselines such as behavioural methods, random activations, or neuron-level analysis. Without this comparison, it is unclear whether a method extracts genuinely meaningful information. • Reproducibility gaps: Many existing techniques involve substantial hyperparameter choices, heavy training procedures, and high variation across seemingly irrelevant factors. Reproducibility is often underreported and has not yet been established as a property to optimise. • Faithfulness–understandability gap: Methods often demonstrate how understandable and informative their outputs are to humans. However, those outputs’ faithfulness to the underlying model mechanism receives less attention. This rewards explanations that are persuasive rather than faithful.
blocks.zh: • 效用模糊: 最初为不同的目标制定了方法,并根据不同的目标进行了评估,但应用情况重叠。 例如,评估SAE时使用重建出错和抽筋度量;通过行为恢复或忠诚度测试来评估电路;通过行为变化来审查不同度的向导(见第9.3节)——尽管所有三种方法都可用于指导模型输出。 它们的预期用途不明确,因此难以比较它们的效用。 二. 支助 采取樱桃:现有工作往往报告可解释性的结果是经过仔细挑选的例子、从狭义的分布中取出样品、或一种方法运作良好的能力。 它可能不报告负面结果、失败案例或覆盖统计数据。 这使得难以评估调查结果是否有力和笼统,难以确定拟议方法是否真正超过现有方法。 二. 支助 缺少基线: 许多拟议方法所称的可解释性增益与直观的替代方法或基线,如行为方法、随机活化或神经元水平分析相比,并没有得到系统和充分的比较。 没有这种比较,尚不清楚某一方法是否提取出真正有意义的信息。 二. 支助 可复制性差距: 许多现有技术涉及大量的超参数选择、繁重的培训程序以及似乎无关因素之间的高度差异。 可复制性往往报告不足,尚未确立为可优化的财产。 • 忠诚-理解差距: 方法往往表明,它们的产出对人类来说是可以理解的,信息丰富。 然而,这些产出对基本模式机制的忠诚程度受到的关注较少。 这种解释是有说服力的,而不是忠实的。

blocks.en: Utility ambiguity: Methods are initially developed for different aims and evaluated against distinct objectives, yet have overlapping application scenarios. For example, SAEs are assessed using reconstruction error and sparsity metrics; circuits are evaluated using behavioural recovery or faithfulness tests; and difference-in-means steering vectors (see Section 9.3 ) are examined by behaviour change—although all three approaches can be used to steer model outputs. Their unclear intended uses make it hard to compare their utility.
blocks.zh: 用途模糊: 最初为不同的目标制定了方法,并根据不同的目标进行了评估,但应用情况重叠。 例如,评估SAE时使用重建出错和抽筋度量;通过行为恢复或忠诚度测试来评估电路;通过行为变化来审查不同度的向导(见第9.3节)——尽管所有三种方法都可用于指导模型输出。 它们的预期用途不明确,因此难以比较它们的效用。

blocks.en: Cherry-picking: Existing work often reports interpretability results on carefully selected examples, samples from a narrow distribution, or capabilities where a method performs well. It may not report negative results, failure cases, or coverage statistics. This makes it difficult to assess the robustness and generality of the findings and determine whether the proposed method genuinely outperforms existing ones.
blocks.zh: 取樱桃: 现有工作常常报告,可解释性的结果是,仔细挑选了实例、从狭义分布中提取的样本,或者某种方法运行良好的能力。 它可能不报告负面结果、失败案例或覆盖统计数据。 这使得难以评估调查结果是否有力和笼统,难以确定拟议方法是否真正超过现有方法。

blocks.en: Missing baselines: Many proposed methods’ claimed interpretability gains are not systematically and adequately compared against intuitive alternatives or baselines such as behavioural methods, random activations, or neuron-level analysis. Without this comparison, it is unclear whether a method extracts genuinely meaningful information.
blocks.zh: 缺少基线: 许多拟议方法所称的可解释性增益与直观的替代办法或基线(如行为方法、随机活化或神经元水平分析)相比,并没有得到系统和充分的比较。 没有这种比较,尚不清楚某一方法是否提取出真正有意义的信息。

blocks.en: Reproducibility gaps: Many existing techniques involve substantial hyperparameter choices, heavy training procedures, and high variation across seemingly irrelevant factors. Reproducibility is often underreported and has not yet been established as a property to optimise.
blocks.zh: 可复制性差距: 许多现有技术涉及大量的超参数选择、繁重的培训程序以及似乎无关因素之间的高度差异。 可复制性往往报告不足,尚未确立为可优化的财产。

blocks.en: Faithfulness–understandability gap: Methods often demonstrate how understandable and informative their outputs are to humans. However, those outputs’ faithfulness to the underlying model mechanism receives less attention. This rewards explanations that are persuasive rather than faithful.
blocks.zh: 忠诚-理解差距: 方法往往表明,它们的产出对人类来说是可以理解的,信息丰富。 然而,这些产出对基本模式机制的忠诚程度受到的关注较少。 这种解释是有说服力的,而不是忠实的。

blocks.en: Lan et al. (2026) have called for a shared platform for tracking and auditing interpretability insights and claims across papers; Ayonrinde & Jaburi (2025) proposed a framework that evaluates mechanistic explanations from several philosophy-of-science perspectives. However, these discussions remain largely conceptual. The MI community needs standardised, concrete evaluation protocols and benchmarks, along with established reporting practices, to enable principled comparisons across methods and findings. They are especially important for measuring real progress in the field, identifying systematic failure modes, and providing evidence about what methods do and do not reveal. More broadly, they are necessary for mechanistic interpretability to mature from a collection of promising techniques into a cumulative scientific discipline.
blocks.zh: Lan等人(2026年)呼吁建立一个共同平台,以跟踪和审计各种论文的可解释性见解和主张;Ayonrinde & Jaburi(2025年)提出了一个框架,从若干科学哲学角度评价机械解释。 然而,这些讨论基本上仍然是概念性的。 管理信息系统需要标准化、具体的评价协议和基准以及既定的报告做法,以便能够在方法和结果方面进行原则性比较。 它们对于衡量实地的实际进展、确定系统性的失败模式和提供证据说明哪些方法可以、哪些方法不能揭示特别重要。 更广泛地说,它们对于机械解释性而言是必要的,它从一系列有前途的技术发展成一个累积的科学学科。

blocks.en: 7.5.2 Five Evaluation Dimensions
blocks.zh: 7.5.2 五个评价层面

blocks.en: We propose a framework that situates mechanistic interpretability evaluation within five complementary dimensions. No single dimension suffices—strong methods should perform well across all five. Table 9 summarises these five dimensions. We describe each one with example metrics that convey the idea.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,将机械解释性评价置于五个相辅相成的方面。 任何单一的方面都不足以使所有五个方面都能够采用强有力的方法。 表9概括了这五个方面。 我们用能传达想法的范例来描述每一个。

blocks.en: Attribution faithfulness measures whether the interpretability method accurately attributes the model’s behaviour of interest to responsible components.

blocks.en: Attribution Faithfulness Metrics Intervention-Effect Agreement. Let a ⁡ ( S , x ) a(S,x) denote the importance score assigned by an interpretability method to components S S for a sample x ∼ B x\sim B : EffectAgreement = ρ x ∼ B ​ ( a ⁡ ( S , x ) , s ⁡ ( S , x ) ) , \mathrm{EffectAgreement}=\rho_{x\sim B}\!\left(a(S,x),s(S,x)\right), where ρ \rho may be Pearson or Spearman correlation. High agreement indicates that the attribution consistently reflects the identified components’ causal effects on behaviour B B . Effect-Size Error. When attribution scores are calculated to estimate intervention effects, we measure the effect-size error as: EffectError = 𝔼 x ∼ B ​ [ | a ⁡ ( S , x ) − s ⁡ ( S , x ) | ] . \mathrm{EffectError}=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim B}\left[\left|a(S,x)-s(S,x)\right|\right]. A low value indicates good calibration between estimated and actual intervention effects. If the two quantities are not naturally on the same scale, we may use normalised or rank-based measures instead. Counterfactual Effect Recovery. Consider inputs x 1 ∼ B ′ x_{1}\sim B^{\prime} and x 2 ∼ B x_{2}\sim B , where B ′ B^{\prime} is a reference behaviour (e.g., honesty) and B B is the behaviour of interest (e.g., sycophancy). blocks.en: Dimension 2: Completeness
blocks.zh: 维度2:完整性

blocks.en: Completeness measures how much of the model behaviour the identified components or mechanisms explain. A high completeness score indicates that the identified components/mechanisms capture most of the relevant computation.
blocks.zh: 完整性衡量所查明的组件或机制在模型行为中解释了多少。 高完整性分数表明,所确定的组件/机制掌握了大多数相关的计算。

blocks.en: Completeness Metrics Loss Recovery. For methods that reconstruct model activations (e.g., SAEs and CLTs), after replacing the target component’s activations with the reconstructions, we measure the fraction of the original model performance that is recovered: LR = ℒ reconstructed − ℒ ablated ℒ original − ℒ ablated , \mathrm{LR}=\frac{\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{reconstructed}}-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ablated}}}{\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{original}}-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ablated}}}, where ℒ original \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{original}} is the downstream test loss of the original model, ℒ reconstructed \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{reconstructed}} is the loss after replacing the original activations with reconstructions, and ℒ ablated \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ablated}} is the baseline loss where activations are replaced with zero ablation, mean ablation, or Gaussian noise matching the layer statistics. A value near 1 1 indicates that the reconstruction preserves most of the information. Similar to the vanilla Counterfactual Effect Recovery metric discussed above, this metric can take arbitrary values. A simple solution is to develop a bounded variant, as has been done for Counterfactual Effect Recovery ( Wu & Barez, 2026 ) . Behavioural Coverage. Across input prompts x ∼ B x\sim B , we measure the fraction for which the identified components have a meaningful intervention effect: Coverage ⁡ ( S , B ) = 𝔼 x ∼ B ​ [ 𝟙 ​ ( | s ⁡ ( S , x ) | ≥ τ ) ] , \mathrm{Coverage}(S,B)=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim B}\left[\mathbbm{1}\left(|s(S,x)|\geq\tau\right)\right], where s ⁡ ( S , x ) s(S,x) is the intervention effect defined above and τ \tau specifies the minimum effect considered meaningful. Higher coverage indicates that the identified components account for the behaviour across a larger fraction of inputs. Unexplained Variance. For methods that reconstruct activations of the components, we measure the fraction of unexplained activation variance as: UV ⁡ ( S , B ) = 𝔼 x ∼ B ​ [ ‖ h ⁡ ( x ) − h ^ S ​ ( x ) ‖ 2 2 ] 𝔼 x ∼ B ​ [ ‖ h ⁡ ( x ) − h ¯ B ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathrm{UV}(S,B)=\frac{\mathbb{E}_{x\sim B}\left[\|h(x)-\hat{h}_{S}(x)\|_{2}^{2}\right]}{\mathbb{E}_{x\sim B}\left[\|h(x)-\bar{h}_{B}\|_{2}^{2}\right]}, where h ¯ B = 𝔼 x ∼ B ​ [ h ⁡ ( x ) ] \bar{h}_{B}=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim B}[h(x)] , h ⁡ ( x ) h(x) is the original model activation, and h ^ S ​ ( x ) \hat{h}_{S}(x) is its reconstruction from the identified components S S . blocks.en: Dimension 4: Causal Validity
blocks.zh: 维度4:因果关系

blocks.en: Causal validity assesses whether the identified components or mechanisms are causal to the behaviour, particularly necessity (i.e., removing the components/mechanisms disrupts the behaviour) and sufficiency (i.e., the components/mechanisms alone are sufficient to preserve the behaviour).
blocks.zh: 因果关系评估所查明的成分或机制是否是行为的原因,特别是必要性(即去除成分/机制会扰乱行为)和充足性(即仅靠成分/机制就足以维持行为).

blocks.en: Causal Validity Metrics Necessity Score. blocks.en: 1. Necessity test: Ablate S S and measure the resulting degradation on behaviour B B . Compare against ablating random components of matched size. 2. Sufficiency test: Replace components outside S S with reference activations and measure how much of behaviour B B is preserved. Compare against random component sets of matched size. 3. Interchange test: Swap activations of S S between inputs representing different behaviours and test whether the model output follows the intervention. 4. Specificity test: Measure intervention effects on a set of non-target behaviours and examine whether the effect is specific to B B .

blocks.en:
The MI community has developed several benchmarks that examine the causal validity of interpretability methods. For example, MIB ( Mueller et al., 2025 ) provides standardised tasks for assessing discovered circuits and causal variables (e.g., features); AxBench ( Wu et al., 2025b ) evaluates methods’ ability to steer models towards given concepts; RAVEL ( Huang et al., 2024 ) investigates methods’ ability to localise features of given concepts by using interchange interventions to validate discovered features; and SAEBench ( Karvonen et al., 2025 ) evaluates SAEs specifically,
pairing reconstruction metrics with downstream intervention tasks such as gender bias erasure.
blocks.zh:
MI社区制定了若干基准,审查可解释性方法的因果关系。 例如,MIB(Mueller等,2025年)为评估所发现的电路和因果变量(例如特征)提供了标准化的任务;Ax Bench(Wu等,2025年b)评价方法将模型引导到特定概念的能力;RAVEL(Huang等,2024年24年)调查方法通过使用互换干预验证所发现的特征而确定特定概念特征的能力;SAEBench(Karvonen等,2025年)具体评价SAE。
将重建指标与性别偏见消除等下游干预任务结合起来。

blocks.en: Dimension 5: Human Interpretability
blocks.zh: 维度5:人类可解释性

blocks.en: Human interpretability measures whether generated explanations eventually improve human understanding, prediction, and decision-making about model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 人的可解释性衡量是否最终产生了解释,从而增进了人类对模型行为的理解、预测和决策。

blocks.en: Human Interpretability Metrics Explanation Utility. This metric tests whether humans can predict model behaviour more accurately in the held-out set based on the explanation. It is formulated as: Expl-Utility = P ⁡ ( correct prediction ∣ with explanation ) − P ⁡ ( correct prediction ∣ no explanation ) \text{Expl-Utility}=P(\text{correct prediction}\mid\text{with explanation})-P(\text{correct prediction}\mid\text{no explanation}) Debugging Utility. This metric examines whether the explanations help humans identify and repair model errors, such as incorrect outputs or misaligned behaviour, in the wild. Debug-Utility = P ⁡ ( error fixed ∣ with explanation ) − P ⁡ ( error fixed ∣ no explanation ) . \text{Debug-Utility}=P(\text{error fixed}\mid\text{with explanation})-P(\text{error fixed}\mid\text{no explanation}). Consistency of Interpretation. This metric inspects whether different humans interpret the same explanation consistently. Inter-Rater = κ ⁡ ( human 1 ​ labels , human 2 ​ labels ) \text{Inter-Rater}=\kappa(\text{human}_{1}\text{ labels},\text{human}_{2}\text{ labels}) where κ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \kappa(\cdot) is Cohen’s kappa or a similar agreement metric.

blocks.en: 1. Prediction task: Show humans explanations of model components or mechanisms and ask them to predict model behaviour on held-out inputs. Compare accuracy to a no-explanation baseline. 2. Identification task: Show humans model outputs with errors and ask them to identify the cause, with and without explanation assistance. Measure accuracy and required time to complete the task. 3. Intervention task: Ask humans to propose fixes for model errors based on explanations. Measure the success rate of proposed interventions. 4. Agreement task: Ask multiple human raters to generate explanations, if applicable (e.g., write a summary of highly activated samples of an SAE feature as its explanation). Measure inter-rater reliability and agreement with machine-generated explanations.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 预测任务:显示人类对模型组件或机制的解释,并让他们在被搁置输入上预测模型行为. 将准确性与无说明基准相比较。 2. 识别任务:显示有错误的人类模型输出,要求他们识别原因,提供或不提供解释性协助。 衡量完成这项任务的准确性和所需时间。 3.干预任务:请人类根据解释提出模型错误的修补方案. 衡量拟议干预措施的成功率。 4. 协议任务:请多个人类评分员酌情提出解释(例如,编写SAE特征高活性样本摘要作为解释)。 衡量不同方之间的可靠性,并与机器生成的解释达成一致。

blocks.en: Prediction task: Show humans explanations of model components or mechanisms and ask them to predict model behaviour on held-out inputs. Compare accuracy to a no-explanation baseline.
blocks.zh: 预测任务 : 显示人类对模型组件或机制的解释,并要求他们预测被搁置投入的模型行为. 将准确性与无说明基准相比较。

blocks.en: Identification task: Show humans model outputs with errors and ask them to identify the cause, with and without explanation assistance. Measure accuracy and required time to complete the task.
blocks.zh: 识别任务:显示有出错的人类模型输出,要求他们识别原因,提供或不提供解释性协助. 衡量完成这项任务的准确性和所需时间。

blocks.en: Intervention task: Ask humans to propose fixes for model errors based on explanations. Measure the success rate of proposed interventions.
blocks.zh: 干预任务 : 请人类根据解释为模型错误提出修正. 衡量拟议干预措施的成功率。

blocks.en: Agreement task: Ask multiple human raters to generate explanations, if applicable (e.g., write a summary of highly activated samples of an SAE feature as its explanation). Measure inter-rater reliability and agreement with machine-generated explanations.
blocks.zh: 协议任务:请多位人类评分员酌情生成解释(例如,写出SAE特征高活性样本摘要作为解释). 衡量不同方之间的可靠性,并与机器生成的解释达成一致。

blocks.en: Several caveats and challenges arise when evaluating the human interpretability of tested methods. For example, human studies are usually expensive. Moreover, human expertise may confound results, where some explanations understandable to MI researchers may be opaque to domain experts, and vice versa.
blocks.zh: 在评价被测试方法对人类的可解释性时,会出现若干告诫和挑战。 例如,人类研究通常很昂贵. 此外,人类专门知识可能会混淆结果,对多边研究者来说,某些解释对领域专家来说可能不透明,反之亦然。

blocks.en: Note that different interpretability methods may emphasise distinct evaluation dimensions and operationalise them differently. Table 10 provides guidance on applying this framework to some common interpretability approaches.
blocks.zh: 请注意,不同的可解释性方法可能强调不同的评价方面,并不同地加以实施。 表10为将这一框架应用于某些共同的解释性办法提供了指导。

blocks.en: Table 10 : Recommended evaluation priorities by interpretability method. The entries indicate evaluation aspects particularly important for each method, not mutually exclusive metrics.
blocks.zh: 表10:按可解释性方法分列的建议评价优先次序。 这些条目表明评价方面对每种方法特别重要,而不是相互排斥的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 7.5.3 Integrated Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 7.5.3 综合评价议定书

blocks.en: We recommend the following integrated protocol for comprehensive evaluation:
blocks.zh: 我们建议制定下列综合评价议定书:

blocks.en: Recommended Evaluation Protocol Step 1: Define scope. Users first specify the model, layer(s), and behaviour(s) of interest and define a behavioural test suite with clear success criteria. Step 2: Establish baselines. Users specify baseline methods, such as random directions in activation space, PCA components, individual neurons, and supervised probes (if labels are available). Step 3: Apply interpretability method. Users apply the method of interest to analyse models with variation in random seeds, hyperparameters, and other training details. Step 4: Evaluate across all five dimensions. Users compute metrics for attribution faithfulness, completeness, stability, causal validity, and human interpretability. Step 5: Report comprehensively. Users report all five dimensions instead of just favourable metrics and discuss the method’s failure cases, unexplained behaviours, and comparisons to baselines.
blocks.zh: 建议的评价议定书步骤1:界定范围。 用户首先指定了感兴趣的模型,图层和行为,并定义了具有明确成功标准的行为测试套件. 步骤2:确定基线。 用户指定了基线方法,如活化空间的随机方向,PCA组件,单个神经元,以及被监督的探针(如果有标签的话)等. 第3步:应用可解释性方法。 用户应用感兴趣的方法来分析在随机种子,超参数等训练细节上存在差异的模型. 步骤4:评价所有五个方面。 用户计算属性的可靠性、完整性、稳定性、因果有效性和人的解释性。 第5步:全面报告。 用户报告所有五个维度,而不仅仅是有利的衡量标准,并讨论方法的失败情况、无法解释的行为以及与基线的比较。

blocks.en: 7.5.4 Limitations of This Framework
blocks.zh: 7.5.4 本框架的局限性

blocks.en: This evaluation framework, though comprehensive, still has several limitations:
blocks.zh: 这一评价框架虽然全面,但仍有一些局限性:

blocks.en: • Metric choice: The proposed specific metrics are not uniquely correct. Alternative formalisations may be appropriate for specific contexts. • Threshold arbitrariness: Thresholds (e.g., the accuracy that counts as success) may lack theoretical grounding and will need empirical calibration. • Computational cost: Evaluating all five dimensions comprehensively is expensive and potentially prohibitive for large-scale studies. • Human evaluation bottleneck: Dimension 5 requires time-consuming, expensive, and subjective human studies. • Task dependence: A method’s performance under this framework can depend on the evaluation task. For example, a method that excels at factual recall may perform poorly at reasoning.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 计量选择 : 拟议的具体衡量标准并不完全正确。 另一种形式可能适合具体情况。 二. 支助 阈值任意性 : 阈值(例如,算作成功的准确性)可能缺乏理论基础,需要经验校正. 二. 支助 计算成本:全面评价所有五个层面是昂贵的,对大规模研究来说可能令人望而却步。 • 人类评价瓶颈:第5个层面需要花费时间、昂贵和主观的人类研究。 任务依赖 : 一种方法在这一框架下的业绩取决于评价任务。 例如,在实际召回方面表现优异的方法在推理方面可能表现不佳。

blocks.en: Metric choice: The proposed specific metrics are not uniquely correct. Alternative formalisations may be appropriate for specific contexts.
blocks.zh: 计量选择 : 拟议的具体衡量标准并不完全正确。 另一种形式可能适合具体情况。

blocks.zh: 计算成本:全面评价所有五个层面是昂贵的,对大规模研究来说可能令人望而却步。

blocks.en: Human evaluation bottleneck: Dimension 5 requires time-consuming, expensive, and subjective human studies.
blocks.zh: 人类评价瓶颈:维度5需要耗费时间,昂贵,主观的人类研究.

blocks.en: Task dependence: A method’s performance under this framework can depend on the evaluation task. For example, a method that excels at factual recall may perform poorly at reasoning.

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, systematic evaluation across multiple dimensions provides more reliable evidence than an arbitrary choice of metrics. Readers should view the framework as a starting point for standardisation, not a final answer.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性,但多层面的系统评价提供了比任意选择衡量标准更可靠的证据。 读者应将框架视为标准化的起点,而不是最后的答案.

blocks.en: This section introduced circuit discovery methods, which trace how model components or features interact to produce behaviour, either directly on the model’s computational graph (e.g., ACDC and EAP) or within interpretable replacement models (e.g., Circuit Tracer). We also discussed how to causally verify discovered circuits and introduced a broader evaluation framework for mechanistic interpretability methods based on faithfulness, completeness, stability, causal validity, and human interpretability. In summary, Section 6 introduced methods for extracting interpretable units of analysis, while this section examined how those units interact through circuits to produce behaviour. The next section takes a complementary perspective: directly interpreting the information in individual representations using natural language.
blocks.zh: 本节引入了电路发现方法,该方法跟踪模型组件或特征如何相互作用以产生行为,或者直接在模型的计算图上(如ACDC和EAP),或者在可解释的替换模型内(如Circuit Tracer). 我们还讨论了如何因果核实已发现的电路,并采用了基于忠诚、完整性、稳定性、因果有效性和人的解释性的更广泛的机械解释方法评价框架。 总而言之,第6节介绍了提取可解释分析单位的方法,而本节则审查了这些单位如何通过电路相互作用以产生行为。 下一节采取互补的观点:用自然语言直接解释个人表述中的信息.

blocks.en: 8 Understanding Intermediate Representations
blocks.zh: 8 了解中级代表

blocks.en: This section explores interpreting hidden activations directly in natural language. In contrast to feature extraction and circuit discovery (Sections 6 and 7 ), which extract features or their interactions from model representations (activations), the methods we will discuss in this section treat the activation itself as the object of interpretation. They use language models or other natural-language-based methods to describe or elicit the encoded information, without intervening on or decomposing the underlying activation. This paradigm provides a direct interface between model activations and natural-language explanations, making it particularly accessible and understandable for human users.
blocks.zh: 本节探讨直接用自然语言解释隐藏活化. 特征提取和电路发现(第6和7节)从模型表达(活性)中提取特征或其相互作用,与此相反,我们将在本节中讨论的方法将活性本身视为解释的对象。 它们使用语言模型或其他基于自然语言的方法来描述或引出被编码的信息,而不干预或分解基础活化. 这个范式为模型活化和自然语言解释提供了直接的界面,使得它特别容易为人类使用者所取用和理解.

blocks.en: 8.1 Logit Lens: Tracing Predictions Through Depth
blocks.zh: 8.1 逻辑镜头:通过深度追踪预测

blocks.en: Logit Lens (Figure 10 ) Logit lens ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) applies the model’s unembedding matrix to activations at intermediate layers, revealing what the model would predict if computation stopped at that layer. For a hidden activation h ℓ h_{\ell} at layer ℓ \ell , logit lens computes: logits ℓ = W U ​ h ℓ , \text{logits}_{\ell}=W_{U}h_{\ell}, where W U W_{U} represents the model’s unembedding matrix. Applying it across layers reveals the prediction trajectory, showing when and where the model commits to specific outputs ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: Logit Lens (图10) Logit 透镜 (怀旧代数, 2020) 将模型的未嵌入矩阵应用于中间层活化,揭示出如果该层停止计算,模型会预测什么. 对于一个隐藏的活化h l h_{\ell}在层 l\ell,登录镜片计算:logits l = W U h l,\text{logits}_{\ell}\\\h_{\ell},其中W U W_{U}代表了模型的未嵌入矩阵. 跨层应用可揭示预测轨迹,显示模型承诺具体产出的时间和地点(怀旧代数,2020年)。

blocks.en: Logit lens (Figure 10 ) provides intuitive insight into the model’s decision-making process across depth. Experimental results show that early layers tend to produce diffuse predictions, while later layers progressively narrow them towards the final output, though exceptions exist. For example, in a twelve-layer language model processing the sequence A B C A B , the logit lens may reveal that the token C enters the top-20 candidates at layer 6 and is progressively amplified, eventually becoming the top-ranked token at the final layer. Conversely, for induction tasks in complex linguistic patterns, early and middle layers may show a flat probability distribution across many tokens, with the model converging to a specific prediction only in the last few layers.
blocks.zh: Logit透镜(图10)对模型的决策过程提供了全深度的直观见解. 实验结果显示,早期地层往往产生扩散预测,而后地层则逐渐缩小到最终输出,尽管存在例外. 例如,在十二层语言模型处理序列A B C A B 中,logit透镜可能揭示出指使C在第6层进入前20名候选者,并被逐渐放大,最终在最后一层成为排名最高的指使. 相反地,对于复杂的语言模式中的诱导任务,早期和中层可能显示在许多信使上平平的概率分布,模型只在后几层与特定的预测相汇合.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Logit Lens. Logit lens provides a window into a model’s intermediate state by applying the final unembedding layer directly to the residual stream at earlier layers ( h 1 , h 2 , … h_{1},h_{2},\ldots ). This allows users to see which tokens the model is “considering” mid-computation, such as the emergence of the concept “CAT” before the final output layer is reached.
blocks.zh: 图10:Logit Lens。 Logit透镜通过将最后的未嵌入层直接应用到更早层(h 1,h 2,. (原始内容存档于2017-09-31). h_{1], h_{2},\ldots. 这使用户能够看到模型中“考虑”中间计算时的标志是什么,例如在到达最后输出层之前“CAT”概念的出现。

blocks.en:
The vanilla logit lens has a critical limitation: applying the unembedding matrix to intermediate activations assumes that the hidden state is in a format that the output layer expects. However, intermediate representations may be organised very differently from output-layer activations. Applying the unembedding matrix to layer-6 activations may extract relevant information but cannot precisely reflect the model’s underlying computation at that layer ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) .
Furthermore, logit lens is fundamentally correlational rather than causal. It projects the activation into the output vocabulary space without testing the roles decoded tokens play in model computation. In particular, because of the representational mismatch discussed above, decoded tokens represent at most information recoverable from the activation, rather than information used in model computation.
blocks.zh:
香草logit镜头有临界限制:将未嵌入的矩阵应用于中间活化假设隐藏状态是输出层所期望的格式. 然而,中间表述的编排可能与输出层活化非常不同. 将未嵌入的矩阵应用于第6层活化可能提取相关信息,但不能准确反映模型在该层的基本计算(怀旧代数,2020年).
此外,对数镜片基本上是相互关联的,而不是因果关系。 它在不测试在模型计算中扮演的角色解码符的情况下将活化到输出词汇空间. 特别是,由于上文讨论的表述不匹配,被解码的代号最多代表从激活中可得到的信息,而不是模型计算中使用的信息.

blocks.en: 8.2 Tuned Lens: Learning Per-Layer Transforms
blocks.zh: 8.2 结扎镜头:学习每个拉耶尔变形

These transforms are trained to minimise the divergence between the tuned lens’ predicted distribution p ℓ TL = softmax ⁡ ( logits ℓ TL ) p_{\ell}^{\text{TL}}=\operatorname{softmax}(\text{logits}_{\ell}^{\text{TL}}) and the model output distribution p final p_{\text{final}} via: min W ℓ , b ℓ 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 [ KL ( p final ( x ) ∥ p ℓ TL ( x ) ) ] . \min_{W_{\ell},b_{\ell}}\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}}\big[\,\mathrm{KL}(p_{\text{final}}(x)\;\|\;p_{\ell}^{\text{TL}}(x))\big].

blocks.en: As a result, the unembedding matrix can extract relevant information from each layer’s activations more effectively.
blocks.zh: 因此,未嵌入基质可以更有效地从每层活化中提取出相关信息.

blocks.en: Although tuned lens mitigates representational mismatch, it still inherits several fundamental limitations. First, the decoding paradigm remains inherently correlational rather than causal; decodable information does not imply a causal role in the model’s prediction. Second, similar to logit lens, tuned lens is primarily designed to answer what the model is likely to predict rather than what the model is internally computing . The learned layer-specific transformations that align intermediate representations with the final prediction space may obscure intermediate computational steps and produce predictions that resemble the model’s final output. Empirical evidence also shows that it skips intermediate computation more aggressively than logit lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然调制镜头减轻了表现上的不匹配,但它仍然继承了几个基本限制. 首先,解码范式仍然具有内在的相关性,而不是因果关系;可解码的信息并不意味着该模型的预测具有因果关系。 第二,与logit镜头类似,调谐镜头主要是为了解答模型可能预测什么,而不是模型是内部计算...... 使中间表示与最终预测空间相配合的有知识的分层变化可能模糊中间计算步骤并产生类似于模型最后产出的预测。 经验证据还表明,它比对数镜头更积极地跳过中间计算(Gurnee等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 8.3 Jacobian Lens: Decoding Computational Dispositions
blocks.zh: 8.3 Jacobian Lens:解码计算处理

blocks.en: Jacobian Lens Jacobian lens (J-lens; Gurnee et al., 2026 ) adopts a decoding paradigm distinct from logit lens and tuned lens. It uses the Jacobian to characterise how an intermediate representation influences certain model outputs. Let h ℓ t h_{\ell}^{t} denote the residual stream at layer ℓ \ell and position t t . A perturbation to h ℓ t h_{\ell}^{t} propagates to the final-layer residual stream at every position t ′ ≥ t t^{\prime}\geq t ; to first order, this influence is captured by the Jacobian ∂ h final t ′ ∂ h ℓ t . \frac{\partial h_{\mathrm{final}}^{t^{\prime}}}{\partial h_{\ell}^{t}}. The lens matrix is defined as the expectation of this Jacobian over prompts and positions: J ℓ = 𝔼 prompt , t , t ′ ≥ t ​ [ ∂ h final t ′ ∂ h ℓ t ] . J_{\ell}=\mathbb{E}_{\,\mathrm{prompt},\,t,\,t^{\prime}\geq t}\left[\frac{\partial h_{\mathrm{final}}^{t^{\prime}}}{\partial h_{\ell}^{t}}\right]. J-lens then decodes intermediate representations by p ℓ JL = softmax ⁡ ( W U ​ norm ⁡ ( J ℓ ​ h ℓ ) ) . p_{\ell}^{\mathrm{JL}}=\operatorname{softmax}\!\big(W_{U}\operatorname{norm}(J_{\ell}h_{\ell})\big). Gurnee et al. (2026) further defined layer-specific concept (token) representations using the rows of W U ​ J ℓ W_{U}J_{\ell} , called J-lens vectors . The inner product between a J-lens vector and h ℓ h_{\ell} measures how strongly the current activation will promote the corresponding token in model outputs.

Gurnee 等 (2026) 进一步定义了层特有概念(token) 表示法,使用W U J l-_{U}J_{\ell}的行,称为J-lens向量. 在J-lens向量和hl-h_{\ell}之间的内在产物,测量当前活化能在多大程度上在模型输出中促进相应的符号.

blocks.en: Unlike logit lens and tuned lens, which primarily estimate which token the model is likely to predict next, J-lens characterises how current representations influence model outputs. It aims to answer what the model is internally computing rather than merely what the model is going to predict . J-lens has been found useful for analysing tasks that require multi-step reasoning, latent planning, or other forms of extended computation ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: J-lens 与主要估计该模型可能预测下一个信号的对数镜头和调镜头不同,J-lens 特征描述当前表示如何影响模型输出. 它旨在解答模型的内部计算,而不是仅仅解答模型将要预测的内容。 J-lens被认为有助于分析需要多步骤推理、潜在规划或其他形式的扩展计算的任务(Gurnee等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Furthermore, the defined J-lens vectors are a useful medium for intervention. They can serve as steering vectors to shift model behaviour towards or away from the corresponding concepts. In contrast, interventional utility is largely absent from logit lens and tuned lens, which are primarily decoding tools.
blocks.zh: 此外,界定的J-Lens矢量是有用的干预媒介。 它们可以作为引导载体,使模式行为转向或远离相应的概念. 相形之下,干涉用法在logit镜头和调谐镜头中基本缺失,这些镜头主要是解码工具.

blocks.en: J-lens still faces several limitations that warrant further investigation. First, like logit lens and tuned lens, it operates primarily at the token level. However, many semantically meaningful concepts are represented by multiple tokens. For example, the word “photoperiodism” may be split into several subword tokens. If only one token (e.g., “photo”) is visible in J-lens, we cannot tell whether it corresponds to the concept of photoperiodism or actually other words. Second, J-lens is found to work best within a certain range of layers, called J-space ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, decoded concepts are most informative in intermediate layers (e.g., approximately 38–92% of the depth in Claude Sonnet 4.5). In early layers, decoded concepts are noisy and hard to interpret. In later layers, they collapse towards the model’s output and are also uninformative. Some recent studies have attempted to address these limitations ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ; Blank et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: J-Lens仍然面临若干限制,需要进一步调查。 首先,像logit镜头和调音镜头一样,它主要在符号级操作. 然而,许多具有象征意义的概念都以多种符号为代表。 例如,“相片主义”一词可能被分成若干个子词符号。 如果在J-lens中只看到一个标志(如"相"),那么我们无法分辨它是否与光周期主义的概念相符合,或者实际上与其他词语相符合. 第二,J-lens被发现在一定的地层范围内最能工作,称为J-space(Gurnee等,2026.). 具体来说,解码的概念在中间地层中信息最为丰富(例如克洛德·索内4.5中深度约38-92%). 在早期地层中,被解码的概念很吵,难以解释. 在后几层中,它们倒向模型的输出,也是无信息化的. 最近的一些研究试图解决这些局限性(Gurnee等人,2026年;Blank等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 8.4 Patchscopes: Leveraging the Language Model Itself to Explain Intermediate Representations
blocks.zh: 8.4 补丁镜: 利用语言模型解释中间代表

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Patchscopes. Patchscopes extracts the model representation of interest from a source prompt and “patches” it into an inspection prompt. By observing changes in model output, users can examine what information the representation contains. For example, in this figure we can observe whether the representation of “United Kingdom” correctly triggers “London” as the largest city.
blocks.zh: 图11:补丁镜. 补丁镜从来源中抽取了表示兴趣的模型,并将其“拍出”为检查的快件。 通过观察模型输出的变化,用户可以检查表示包含哪些信息. 例如,在这个图中,我们可以观察到“联合王国”的代表是否正确地触发了“伦敦”作为最大的城市。

blocks.en: Patchscopes (Figure 11 ) Patchscopes ( Ghandeharioun et al., 2024 ) leverages the expressive capacity of language models to translate their internal representations into natural-language explanations. Let h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} denote a hidden representation at layer ℓ \ell and token position t t . Patchscopes produces a textual explanation of h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} , denoted as e ⁡ ( h ℓ t ) e(h^{t}_{\ell}) , by e ( h ℓ t ) = f θ ( p [ h t ∗ ℓ ∗ ← h t ℓ ] ) , e(h^{t}_{\ell})=f_{\theta}(p_{[h^{t^{*}}_{\ell^{*}}\leftarrow h^{t}_{\ell}]}), where ℓ ∗ \ell^{*} and t ∗ t^{*} specify the layer and token position to which the representation is patched, and p p is an elicitation prompt designed to encourage the language model f θ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\theta}(\cdot) to decode the patched representation into text expressing the contained information. For example, consider the prompt illustrated in Figure 1 of Ghandeharioun et al. (2024) : p = “cat → cat; 135 → 135; hello → hello; ?” , p=\text{``cat$\rightarrow$cat; 135$\rightarrow$135; hello$\rightarrow$hello; ?''}, where t ∗ t^{*} corresponds to the position of the token “?”. The notation [ h ℓ ∗ t ∗ ← h ℓ t ] [h^{t^{*}}_{\ell^{*}}\leftarrow h^{t}_{\ell}] indicates that, during the forward pass of f θ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\theta}(\cdot) on p p , the hidden representation at layer ℓ ∗ \ell^{*} and position t ∗ t^{*} is replaced with h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} . As a result, the model can elicit information encoded in h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} through its prediction for the next token at the “?” position.

blocks.en: Because the mapping from intermediate representations to natural language may be too complex to be captured by an affine transformation, Patchscopes (Figure 11 ) extends the paradigm of logit lens and tuned lens by delegating the representation-to-text transformation to the language model itself 1 1 1 A concurrent work, SelfIE ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , explores a similar direction. While we focus on Patchscopes as a reference framework, both methods share closely related motivations and methodologies. . In this view, the language model acts as an activation decoder . Crucially, Patchscopes relies on the model’s learned, generalisable text-generation capabilities to map internal activations to natural language.
blocks.zh: 由于从中间表达到自然语言的映射可能过于复杂,无法被亲缘转换所捕捉出,Patchscopes(图11)通过将表达到文字的转化权下放到语言模型本身1 1 A并发工作,将日志镜头和调谐镜头的范式扩展至语言模型本身,SelfIE(Chen等,2024b.)探索了类似的方向. 虽然我们把补丁镜作为参考框架,但这两种方法都有着密切相关的动机和方法。 在这个观点中,语言模型起到活化解码器的作用. . 关键的是,Patchscopes依赖于模型所学得的,通俗的文本生成能力来将内部活化图映射到自然语言.

blocks.en: A key limitation of Patchscopes is that injecting an external representation into an elicitation prompt can shift the model’s internal activations into an out-of-distribution (OOD) regime. This is expected, as the decoder is a standard pretrained language model not explicitly trained for representation-to-text decoding. Although the model may still surface salient information from the patched representation, the decoding process can degrade, and critical aspects of the original representation may be distorted or lost.
blocks.zh: 补丁镜的一个关键限制是,将外部代表物注入诱导快感可以将模型的内部活化转化为分配外(OD)制度. 由于解码器是标准预训语言模型,没有为表现到文本解码而明确训练. 尽管模型可能仍然会从补丁的表示中露出突出信息,但解码过程可能会被降解,原始表示的关键方面可能被扭曲或丢失.

blocks.en: 8.5 LatentQA: Fine-Tuning the Language Model as an Activation Verbaliser
blocks.zh: 8.5 LatetQA:将语言模式精细化为一种活化活化语

blocks.en: LatentQA (Figure 12 ) LatentQA ( Pan et al., 2026 ) frames representation decoding as a supervised learning problem via Latent Interpretation Tuning (LIT), fine-tuning an activation verbaliser to perform representation-to-text verbalisation. The core step of LIT is to construct a fine-tuning dataset D D consisting of samples ( h ℓ t , q , a ) (h^{t}_{\ell},q,a) , where h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} is a cached hidden representation from a target model, and ( q , a ) (q,a) is a question–answer pair that queries the information encoded in h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} . Specifically, h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} denotes the activation at layer ℓ \ell and token position t t when the target model processes a “control prompt” designed to embed a specific attribute or concept into the representation. An example control prompt from Figure 13 of ( Pan et al., 2026 ) is: “In your next reply, please try to evoke a brief sense of triumphant hubris.” If h ℓ t h^{t}_{\ell} is defined as the activation at layer ℓ \ell corresponding to the final token (“.”) of this prompt, the resulting representation is expected to encode the instruction to respond with triumphant hubris. In this case, a corresponding question–answer pair may be: q = “In what way does the assistant craft its responses to the user?” q=\text{``In what way does the assistant craft its responses to the user?''} a = “The assistant crafts responses that briefly highlight a sense of self-assured victory.” a=\text{``The assistant crafts responses that briefly highlight a sense of self-assured victory.''} Both the control prompt and the ( q , a ) (q,a) pair are generated by prompting an off-the-shelf proprietary language model ( Pan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LatettQA (图12) LatetQA (Pan等, 2026) 通过Latett Computing Tuning (LIT) 将表示解码作为监督学习的问题来设定,并微调活化口语解码器,以进行表现-文字相通口语. LIT的核心步骤是构建一个由样本(h l t, q, a) (h^{t}_{\ell}, q, a)组成的微调数据集DD, 其中h l t h^{t}_{\ell}是一个从目标模型中缓存的隐藏代表, (q, a) (q, a)是一个问答对被编码为h lt h^{t}_{\ell}的信息进行查询的对答. 具体来说,h l t h^{t}_{\ell}表示当目标模型处理旨在将特定属性或概念嵌入到表示式中的"控制快取"时,在l ell和符号位置tt的活化. 从图13(Pan et al., 2026)中得出的一个例子控制提示是:“在你的下一份答复中,请尝试引起一种短暂的胜利自大感。” 如果 h l t h^{t}_{\t}_{\ell } 被定义为该提示的最后符号 (. ) 对应的 第 l 层 (. . . ) 的活化, 由此产生的表示值预计将被编码为指令, 以胜利自大回应 。 在这种情况下,相应的问答组合可以是: q = “助理如何对用户作出答复?” q=\text{`` a==============================================================================================;================================================================================================================================================================ “手工业助理的反应简要地突出了一种自保的胜利感。” a. 语句 助理工匠的反应,简要地突出了一种自我保证的胜利感。 ''} 控制快取和 (q, a, (q, a) 对称都是通过催化出现成的专有语言模型(Pan等, 2026)来生成的.

blocks.en: LatentQA (Figure 12 ) addresses the OOD issue inherent in Patchscopes-style methods by explicitly fine-tuning the activation verbaliser on the representation-to-text decoding task. Through LIT, the verbaliser learns to ingest and process raw activation vectors directly. Ideally, after being exposed to a sufficiently diverse collection of question–answer pairs over many different representations, the decoder learns which aspects of the activation to attend to and how to verbalise them conditioned on the query.
blocks.zh: LatettQA(图12)解决了Patchscopes-system方法中固有的OOD问题,在表达-文本解码任务上明确将活化口语解码器进行微调. 通过LIT,语言学家学习直接摄取并处理原始活性向量. 理想的情况是,在许多不同的表述上,解码器在接触到足够多样的问答组合后,会了解激活的哪些方面需要处理,以及如何以询问为条件口头回答。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : LatentQA. LatentQA probes the semantic content of hidden representations by training a separate verbaliser model to answer natural-language questions about them. The process involves (1) curating a dataset of activation–question–answer triplets from a target LLM, and (2) fine-tuning a verbaliser to retrieve specific information latent within those activations, such as the model’s underlying goals or persona.
blocks.zh: 图12:LatetQA.Latet QA通过培训单独的语言解说模型来解答关于这些语言的自然语言问题来探究隐藏表达的语义内容. 这个过程涉及 (1) 从目标LLM 中校正一个激活-提问-解答三重体的数据集, (2) 微调一个语言解析器以获取这些激活中潜伏的具体信息,例如模型的基本目标或人物a.

blocks.en: LatentQA faces several technical challenges, including the generalisability of the learned representation-to-text mapping. When the fine-tuning dataset D D is too small or insufficiently diverse, the verbaliser may memorise superficial correspondences between representations and explanations rather than learning to extract information from representations. Recent approaches, such as Predictive Concept Decoders (PCDs) ( Huang et al., 2026 ) and Activation Oracles (AOs) ( Karvonen et al., 2026a ) , mitigate this issue by constructing more diverse training datasets.
blocks.zh: LatetQA面临若干技术挑战,包括所学表现图到文字图的通用性。 当微调数据集D太小或不够多样化时,语言学家可能会回忆陈述与解释之间的表面对应,而不是学习从陈述中提取信息. 最近的办法,如预测概念解码器(PCD)(黄等,2026年)和活化甲骨文(AOs)(Karvonen等,2026a年),通过构建更多样化的培训数据集来缓解这一问题.

blocks.en: Another technical challenge is evaluating whether activation-verbalisation models genuinely explain the represented information rather than exploit shortcuts. For example, a verbaliser may implicitly reconstruct the original input to the target model and infer an explanation from it. Recent studies have found that such failure modes are severe and prevalent in existing verbalisers ( Li et al., 2026c ; Jakkli et al., 2026 ). As a result, strong verbalisation performance alone is insufficient to show that the verbaliser faithfully analysed the internal representations.
blocks.zh: 另一个技术挑战是评估激活-语言化模型是否真正解释了所显示的信息,而不是利用捷径。 例如,语言学家可能隐含地重建原始输入到目标模型,并推断出它的解释. 最近的研究发现,这种故障模式在现有的口语语言中十分严重并普遍存在(Li等,2026c;Jakkli等,2026.)。 因此,单凭强烈的口语表现不足以表明口语化者忠实地分析了内部表述.

blocks.en: 8.6 Probing Classifiers: Capabilities, Critiques, and Causal Limitations
blocks.zh: 8.6 试验分类器:能力、标准以及因果限制

blocks.en: Probing classifiers (Figure 13 ) are among the most widely used tools for analysing neural network representations. A probe is a classifier trained to predict a property of the input, such as part of speech, sentiment, or entity type, from model activations. High probe accuracy means that the property is decodable from the activations. However, information decodability is a relatively coarse-grained, correlational interpretability claim compared with causal claims about information in model computation. This section reviews probing methodology, its major critiques, and its appropriate role in interpretability research.
blocks.zh: 探险分类器(图13)是用于分析神经网络表达的最广泛使用的工具之一. 探测器是训练有素的分类器,从模型活化中预测输入属性,如语音,情绪或实体类型的一部分. 高探测精度意味着属性可以从活化中解码. 然而,与模型计算中的信息因果索赔相比,信息可解码性是相对粗糙、相关可解释性索赔。 本节审查调查方法、其主要批评及其在可解释性研究方面的适当作用。

blocks.en: As a side note, discovered probe directions can also be used as supervised feature extractors. We discuss this perspective in Section 6.9.4 , including comparisons with SAEs, and in Section 9.3 , where we discuss their use as steering vectors.
blocks.zh: 作为一种旁注,所发现的探针方向也可以被作为受监督的特征提取器. 我们在第6.9.4节中讨论了这一视角,包括与最高审计实体的比较,并在第9.3节中讨论了如何利用这些实体作为指导媒介的问题。

blocks.en: 8.6.1 Standard Probing Methodology
blocks.zh: 8.6.1 标准检验方法

blocks.en: Probing Classifier (Figure 13 ) A probing classifier is a supervised model trained to predict a target property y y from neural network activations h ℓ h_{\ell} at layer ℓ \ell . A linear probe follows the form: y ^ = g ⁡ ( W probe ​ h ℓ + b probe ) , \hat{y}=g(W_{\text{probe}}h_{\ell}+b_{\text{probe}}), where W probe W_{\text{probe}} and b probe b_{\text{probe}} are learned parameters. g g , typically an identity function for regression and softmax for classification, maps the probe’s raw output to the prediction space. The probe is trained by minimising prediction error on labelled examples ( h ℓ ( i ) , y ( i ) ) (h_{\ell}^{(i)},y^{(i)}) . The linear probe tests whether the target property is linearly accessible from the representation. MLP probes introduce one or more nonlinear hidden layers instead of W probe W_{\text{probe}} to test whether the property can be retrieved through more expressive nonlinear mappings.
blocks.zh: 测试分类器(图13) 测试分类器是一个经过训练的被监督模型,用于预测神经网络活化h l h_{\ell}在l-ell层中的目标属性y. 线性探测器跟随形态:y ^ = g → (W 探测器 hl + b 探测器),\hat{ y}= (W_{\text{ probe}}h_{\ell}+b_{\text{ probe}}),其中W 探测器 W_{\text{ probe}}和b 探测器 b_{\text{ probe}}]是学习到的参数. g 通常是一种用于回归和用于分类的软max的特性函数,将探测器的原始输出映射到预测空间。 探测器在标记的例子(hl(一),y(一))上通过最小的预测错误来训练(h_{\ell(一)},y^{(一)}). 线性探测器测试目标属性是否可以从表示物上线性地得到. MLP探测器引入了一个或多个非线性隐藏地层来代替W探测器WQQtext{probe}}}来测试该属性是否可以通过更多的表达式非线性映射来取回.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Probing Classifier. A probing classifier (or probe ) tests the decodability of a concept from the target model’s internal representations. It is trained to distinguish activations associated with positive and negative examples of the concept. High probe accuracy indicates that the concept can be reliably decoded from the representation.
blocks.zh: 图13:测试分类器。 探险分类器(或探针)从目标模型的内部表述测试一个概念的可解码性. 培训的目的是区分与这一概念的积极和消极例子有关的激活。 高探测精度表明,这一概念可以可靠地从表示中解码出.

blocks.en: Probing provides evidence about whether activations contain information about a property. High probe accuracy indicates the information is present; low accuracy suggests it is absent or the probe is not expressive enough. Note that probing alone does not show whether the model actually depends on that information in its decision-making process. A representation can encode information that downstream computation never accesses, such as “leftover” information from earlier processing.
blocks.zh: 探险提供了活化是否包含一个属性的信息的证据. 高探针精度表示信息存在;低探针精度表示不存在,或探针不够表现. 请注意,单凭探险并不能表明模型在决策过程中是否真正依赖于这一信息. 一种表示方式可以编码下游计算从未访问过的信息,例如以前处理的“剩余”信息。

blocks.en: The Probe Causality Problem High probe accuracy does not imply causal relevance ( Belinkov, 2022 ; Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ) . The probe can work by detecting features spuriously correlated with the target property (e.g., word frequency correlates with part of speech) rather than detecting the target property itself. Furthermore, subsequent layers may never use the decoded property to influence the model output. Finally, a sufficiently expressive probe can achieve high accuracy by exploiting noise even when the representations contain no such information.
blocks.zh: 探险原因问题 高探测精度并不意味着因果关系(Belinkov, 2022;Hewitt & Liang, 2019). 探测器可以通过检测与目标属性(例如,文字频率与部分语音相关)有虚假关联的特征来工作,而不是检测目标属性本身. 此外,之后的地层可能永远不会使用解码属性来影响模型输出. 最后,足够有表现力的探测器可以通过利用噪音来达到很高的准确度,即使这些表示没有这种信息。

blocks.en: In summary, using probing alone generally does not provide actionable mechanistic understanding and therefore does not, under our definition, constitute mechanistic interpretability research. However, subsequent work has proposed refined probing paradigms that explicitly incorporate causal considerations into probe design and evaluation, enabling more actionable mechanistic understanding ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) ; see Section 8.6.4 for details. Recent interpretability studies have similarly used causal interventions to validate probe-discovered concept directions, building a more complete mechanistic explanation ( Marks & Tegmark, 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 简言之,单靠探查一般不能提供可操作的机械学理解,因此,根据我们的定义,不构成机械学解释研究. 然而,随后的工作提出了完善的检验范式,明确将因果因素纳入探测器的设计和评价,使更多的可操作的机械理解成为可能(Elazar等,2021年;详情见第8.6.4节)。 近期的可解释性研究同样使用了因果干预来验证探针所发现的概念方向,构建了更完整的机械解释(Marks & Tegmark,2024;Li等,2023.).

blocks.en: 8.6.2 Control Tasks and Selectivity
blocks.zh: 8.6.2 控制任务和选择性

blocks.en: High probe accuracy may reflect classification capacity rather than the target property’s decodability. Hewitt & Liang (2019) addressed this concern by introducing control tasks as a probe’s baseline performance.
blocks.zh: 高探测精度可能反映分类能力,而不是目标属性的可解码性。 Hewitt & Liang (2019) 解决了这一关切,将控制任务作为探测器的基准性能.

blocks.en: Control Task Methodology A control task assigns random labels to inputs to break any genuine relationship between activations and the target property. A probe trained on the control task represents the baseline extractability of random patterns from the representation. Then, the selectivity of a probe is defined as: Selectivity = Acc linguistic − Acc control , \text{Selectivity}=\text{Acc}_{\text{linguistic}}-\text{Acc}_{\text{control}}, where Acc linguistic \text{Acc}_{\text{linguistic}} is probe accuracy on the target task and Acc control \text{Acc}_{\text{control}} is accuracy on the control task. High selectivity indicates that the probe succeeds because the representation genuinely encodes the target property. In contrast, low selectivity suggests we cannot tell whether the probe has exploited spurious features rather than task-relevant structure.
blocks.zh: 控制任务方法 控制任务为输入分配随机标签,以打破激活和目标属性之间的任何真实关系. 接受过控制任务培训的探测器代表了随机图案的基线可提取性。 然后,一个探测器的选择性被定义为: 选择性 = Acc 语言 - Acc 控制,\text {Selectivity}\text {Languistic}-\text {Acc}_{\text{控制},其中Acc 语言\text{Acc}_{\text{Languistic}是目标任务的探测精度,而Acc 控制\text{Acc}_{\text{控制}是控制任务的精度. 高度选择性表明,探测器成功是因为代表真实地编码了目标属性. 相比之下,低选择性表明,我们无法确定探测器是否利用了虚假的特征,而不是与任务相关的结构。

blocks.en: 8.6.3 Concerns of Probe Complexity
blocks.zh: 8.6.3 对勘探复杂性的关切

blocks.en: Probe complexity brings confounding factors to the analysis. If a property can only be extracted with a highly nonlinear probe, it is hard to tell whether the property is “deeply encoded” or whether the probe is simply using nonlinearity to exploit signals, including noise. A recent finding in causal abstraction ( Sutter et al., 2025 ) also showed that, when the mapping function is complex enough, it can map an arbitrary (even randomly initialised) neural network to a causal model of interest, producing false-positive findings.
blocks.zh: 勘探的复杂性给分析带来了困惑的因素. 如果只有用高度非线性探测器才能取出财产,那么很难判断财产是“深密地编码”还是探测器只是利用非线性来利用信号,包括噪音。 最近一项因果抽象化的发现(Sutter等,2025年)也表明,当绘图函数足够复杂时,它可以将任意的(甚至是随机的隐蔽的)神经网络映射到一个引起兴趣的因果模型上,产生虚假的阳性结果.

blocks.en: The Complexity–Interpretability Trade-off Observation. In general, more complex probes achieve higher accuracy but provide less interpretable deliverables. Interpretation problem. Does high accuracy with a complex probe indicate (a) the property is encoded but in a complex, nonlinear form, or (b) the probe itself is computing the property from spurious features? If (b), the probe at most demonstrates that the property is computable from the representation, not that it is encoded in the representation in any meaningful sense. A worse case in (b) is that a highly nonlinear probe may learn to construct the property of interest from random noise rather than any features ( Sutter et al., 2025 ) . In this case, the computable illusion likely stems from limited test-set size.
blocks.zh: 复杂性-可解释性权衡观察。 一般来说,更复杂的探测器能达到更高的精度,但能提供更不易解释的可达到的目标. 翻译问题。 复杂探测器的高精度是否表明(a) 属性被编码,但以复杂、非线性的形式出现,或(b) 探测器本身是从虚假特性计算属性的? 如果(b)项,探险最多表明该财产可以由该代表物计算,而不是在任何有意义的意义上将其编码为该代表物。 在(b)中,一个更糟糕的情况是,高度非线性探测器可能学会从随机噪声而不是从任何特征来构建感兴趣的属性(Sutter等人,2025年)。 在这种情况下,可计算错觉可能源于有限的测试设置大小.

blocks.en: In general, more complex probes achieve higher accuracy but provide less interpretable deliverables.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,更复杂的探测器能达到更高的精度,但能提供更不易解释的可达到的目标.

blocks.en: Does high accuracy with a complex probe indicate (a) the property is encoded but in a complex, nonlinear form, or (b) the probe itself is computing the property from spurious features? If (b), the probe at most demonstrates that the property is computable from the representation, not that it is encoded in the representation in any meaningful sense. A worse case in (b) is that a highly nonlinear probe may learn to construct the property of interest from random noise rather than any features ( Sutter et al., 2025 ) . In this case, the computable illusion likely stems from limited test-set size.
blocks.zh: 复杂探测器的高精度是否表明(a) 属性被编码,但以复杂、非线性的形式出现,或(b) 探测器本身是从虚假特性计算属性的? 如果(b)项,探险最多表明该财产可以由该代表物计算,而不是在任何有意义的意义上将其编码为该代表物。 在(b)中,一个更糟糕的情况是,高度非线性探测器可能学会从随机噪声而不是从任何特征来构建感兴趣的属性(Sutter等人,2025年)。 在这种情况下,可计算错觉可能源于有限的测试设置大小.

blocks.en: To address this, Voita & Titov (2020) proposed evaluating probes via the minimum description length (MDL) principle: prefer probes that achieve good accuracy with minimal complexity. The proposed MDL-based evaluation offers an information-theoretic measure of how efficiently a probe can extract a target property from model representations, accounting for both probe accuracy and complexity. A property is considered “more encoded” if it can be extracted with a simpler probe. This paradigm shifts the question from “can we extract it?” to “how easily can we extract it?”
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,Voita & Titov(2020年)提议通过最小描述长度(MDL)原则来评价探测器:更喜欢在最小复杂度下达到良好精度的探测器. 拟议的基于MDL的评价提供了一个信息理论衡量标准,说明探测器如何能够有效地从模型表达中提取出目标属性,同时说明探测器的准确性和复杂性。 如果能够用更简单的探测器取出财产,则该财产被视为“更编码”。 这一范式将问题从“我们能提取出来吗?” 转变为“我们如何能够轻易提取出来?” “

blocks.en: Users should prefer simple probes when possible, compare against probes trained on random representations to establish baselines, and consider MDL-based evaluation to analyse the trade-off between accuracy and model complexity. If linear probes fail but MLP probes succeed, cautiously validate the result and interpretability claim.
blocks.zh: 用户应当尽可能选择简单的探测器,与通过随机表示法培训的探测器进行比较,以确定基线,并考虑基于MDL的评价,以分析准确性和模型复杂性之间的取舍. 如果线性探测器失败但MLP探测器成功,谨慎地验证结果和可解释性主张.

blocks.en: 8.6.4 Amnesic Probing and Causal Probing
blocks.zh: 8.6.4 失忆试验和因果试验

blocks.en: Beyond using probes to validate information decodability, researchers have also formalised the idea of intervening on representations via probes. Giulianelli et al. (2018) first showed that a trained probe can steer model behaviour, and Ravfogel et al. (2020) extended this with Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP), an information-removal method that repeatedly fits a probe to identify linearly encoded information and project it out. Elazar et al. (2021) further measured changes in downstream model behaviour after applying INLP as a validation of the probe’s causality, called amnesic probing . These paradigms add causality to probes, pushing them from correlational understanding to mechanistic analysis. Below, we detail amnesic probing and probing with activation patching.
blocks.zh: 除了利用探测器验证信息可解码性外,研究人员还正式提出了通过探测器干预表达的想法. Giulianelli等人(2018年)首先表明训练有素的探测器能够引导模型行为,而Ravfogel等人也表现出来. (2020年) 与Literative Nullspace Projection(INLP)扩展了这个功能,这是一种信息清除方法,它反复适合一个探测器来识别线性编码信息并投出. Elazar等人(2021年)在应用INLP作为探测器因果关系验证后,进一步测量了下游模型行为的变化,称为失忆检测. 这些范式为探针增加了因果关系,将探针从相关理解推向了机械分析. 下面,我们详细介绍 失忆检测和检测 激活补丁。

blocks.en:
Amnesic Probing Given a model activation h h and a probe trained to predict a property P P , amnesic probing tests whether information about P P is causally relevant
to downstream model behaviour by removing information about P P from the
representation and evaluating the effects on model outputs. Assume P P is a binary property (e.g., positive vs. negative sentiment) and that w ≔ W probe ⊤ ∈ ℝ d w\coloneqq W_{\text{probe}}^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} denotes the probe’s direction. Amnesic probing projects h h onto the subspace orthogonal to a probe
direction w w (i.e., the null space of the probe): h ~ = h − h ⊤ ​ w ‖ w ‖ 2 ​ w . \tilde{h}=h-\frac{h^{\top}w}{\|w\|^{2}}w. Amnesic probing then measures the change in model performance on downstream tasks with the modified representation h ~ \tilde{h} . A substantial degradation indicates that the removed information causally contributes to the evaluated behaviour. Notably, unchanged performance does not establish that the information is unused since redundant representations or alternative computational pathways may preserve the behaviour.

blocks.en: Amnesic probing assumes the target property is decodable and that there exist effective erasure procedures to surgically remove its associated information from the representation. However, information and concept erasure may be imperfect in practice, either leaving residual information or affecting other concepts. Such imperfections confound interpretations of downstream behavioural changes and the causal claims that follow.
blocks.zh: 失忆检测假设目标财产是可解码的,并且存在有效的去除程序,可以手术将其相关信息从表述中去除. 然而,信息和概念的消除在实践中可能并不完善,要么留下剩余信息,要么影响其他概念。 这种不完善之处混淆了对下游行为变化和随后的因果关系的诠释。

blocks.en:
Activation patching tests the causality of a component’s representations by swapping
them between inputs that differ in the target property. This technique has also been used to test the causality of probes ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Arora et al., 2024 ) . Suppose x 1 x_{1} and x 2 x_{2} are two inputs, while x 1 x_{1} has the target property P P and x 2 x_{2} does not. W probe W_{\text{probe}} is the fitted probing matrix whose rows span a probing subspace (or a direction if the matrix has only one row, such as that of a binary classification probe) where P P resides. After choosing the intervention location (e.g., the last-token residual stream at a middle layer), the method first feeds x 1 x_{1} to the model and extracts the component of the representation in the probing subspace. Then, it feeds x 2 x_{2} to the model while patching the corresponding component of the model representation with the previously acquired one. If the model output for x 2 x_{2} shifts towards P P , the patched subspace representation contains information about P P that the model uses.

blocks.en: Compared with amnesic probing, which tests the effect of removing information about P P , activation patching examines whether the probe-identified information is sufficient to implement the target behaviour. However, this requires specifying what representation (i.e., which layer, component, and token position) to probe and patch, which may confound the analysis.
blocks.zh: 与测试去除PP信息效果的失忆检测相比,激活补丁检查了探测器识别出的信息是否足以实现目标行为. 然而,这需要具体说明探查和补丁的什么代表(即哪一层、组件和象征性位置),这可能会混淆分析。

blocks.en: 8.6.5 Implications of Attribution Faithfulness for Probing
blocks.zh: 8.6.5 信仰归属对调查的影响

blocks.en: Probing is often used along with attribution methods (e.g., saliency maps, attention visualisation, gradient-based attribution) to understand model behaviour. However, attribution methods also have technical challenges. For example, gradient-based saliency maps can highlight input features the model is actually insensitive to ( Adebayo et al., 2018 ) , attention weights correlate weakly with causal importance ( Jain & Wallace, 2019 ) , and different attribution methods can disagree substantially on the same inputs ( Krishna et al., 2024 ) . These findings suggest that attribution methods alone cannot determine what information a model actually uses.
blocks.zh: 探险常被与归属方法(如:显要地图,注意力可视化,梯度归属)并用来理解模型行为. 然而,归属方法也存在技术上的挑战. 例如,基于梯度的显要地图可以突出该模型实际上对输入特征不敏感(Adebayo等,2018年),注意力权重与因果重要性关系薄弱(Jain & Wallace,2019年),不同的归属方法在相同的输入上可能存在实质性分歧(Krishna等,2024年). 这些调查结果表明,单靠归属方法不能确定模型实际使用何种信息。

blocks.en: This unreliability affects how we can interpret probing results. Probes trained on attention patterns may not reveal causally important information since attention itself may not be causal. Similarly, using gradients to identify which features or components to probe can bias towards high-magnitude gradients that lack causal importance. In sum, interpretability claims made by probes, even paired with these auxiliary tools, still need to go through causal validation to separate plausible explanations (do attributions seem reasonable to humans?) from faithful explanations (do attributions reflect actual model computation?) ( Jacovi & Goldberg, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种不可靠性影响了我们如何解释检验结果。 接受过关注模式培训的探测器可能不会显示具有因果关系的重要信息,因为关注本身可能不是因果关系。 同样地,使用梯度来识别哪些特征或组件可以被偏重于那些缺乏因果关系的高宽梯度. 总之,探测器提出的解释性主张,甚至与这些辅助工具搭配起来,仍然需要经过因果验证,将合理解释(对人类来说归属是否合理?)与忠实解释(归属是否反映了实际模型计算?)分开. (Jakovi & Goldberg, 2020) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: 8.6.6 When Is Probing Appropriate?
blocks.zh: 8.6.6 何时检验适当?

blocks.en: Given the preceding discussion, Table 11 summarises appropriate uses of probing. We argue that probing is most productive when treated as a tool for hypothesis generation , that is, using probes to identify candidate properties that may be encoded in a representation and potentially causally relevant. Users then test these hypotheses using causal methods, such as activation steering or patching. In this sense, probing serves as an efficient first step in mechanistic investigation rather than as a decisive explanation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于前述讨论,表11概述了探测的适当用途。 我们主张,当将探测作为产生假说的工具时,即利用探测器确定可被编码在一种表述中并可能具有因果关系的可选属性时,探测最有成效。 用户然后用活化向导或补丁等因果方法测试这些假说. 从这个意义上讲,探查是机械调查的有效的第一步,而不是决定性的解释.

blocks.en: 8.6.7 Methodological Standards in Probing Research
blocks.zh: 8.6.7 检验研究的方法标准

blocks.en: So far we have reviewed several strengths and limitations of probes. Based on them, we summarise several methodological standards for the design and interpretation of probing studies: (1) Report control-task baselines to distinguish genuine decodability from spurious exploitation; (2) Use minimally expressive probes unless additional complexity is justified; (3) Test causal relevance by methods like amnesic probing or activation patching; (4) Analyse layer-wise trends besides the peak accuracy; (5) Distinguish encoding from causality and acknowledge that successful probing shows information presence rather than causal use; (6) Report the stability of findings by evaluating across seeds and data splits. In sum, we believe these standards help ensure responsible, effective use of probing in interpretability research and downstream applications.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们审查了探测器的若干优点和局限性。 在此基础上,我们总结了设计和解释勘探研究的若干方法标准: (1) 报告控制任务基线,以区分真正的可解码性和虚假利用性; (2) 使用最小程度的表达式探针,除非有其他复杂程度的理由; (3) 通过失忆探针或活化补丁等方法测试因果关系; (4) 分析除峰值精度外的分层趋势; (5) 区分与因果关系的编码,并承认成功的探针显示信息存在而非因果使用; (6) 通过对种子和数据分层进行评价,报告发现的稳定性。 总而言之,我们认为,这些标准有助于确保在可解释性研究和下游应用中负责任地、有效地利用探测。

blocks.en: Probing Classifiers for Sleeper Agents Despite the causality critiques, probing remains valuable for many applications. For example, MacDiarmid et al. (2024) showed that simple linear probes trained on residual-stream activations can detect latent backdoor behaviour in the sleeper agent model even when the probe fitting set does not contain the trigger or the harmful behaviour. To recap: a sleeper agent model f θ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\theta}(\cdot) behaves normally for one context (e.g., y = “2023” y=\text{``2023''} ) but exhibits a hidden dangerous policy when a trigger is present (e.g., y = “2024” y=\text{``2024''} ) ( MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ) . To detect this latent behaviour, MacDiarmid et al. (2024) constructed a linear defection detector by computing a detector direction u ℓ u_{\ell} at layer ℓ \ell . Specifically, let h ℓ ​ ( x ) h_{\ell}(x) denote the residual activations at the final token position for input x x . Given a small labelled fit dataset of prompts, the detector direction is defined as: u ℓ = 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 true ​ [ h ℓ ​ ( x ) ] − 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 false ​ [ h ℓ ​ ( x ) ] , u_{\ell}=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}_{\text{true}}}[h_{\ell}(x)]-\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}_{\text{false}}}[h_{\ell}(x)], where 𝒟 true \mathcal{D}_{\text{true}} and 𝒟 false \mathcal{D}_{\text{false}} are contrast pairs of prompts. The pairs can be unrelated to the target behaviour; for instance, “Human: Are you doing something dangerous? Assistant: yes” and “Human: … Assistant: no” (example borrowed from MacDiarmid et al. (2024) ). During the evaluation stage, activations are projected onto this direction to yield a detector activation value ⟨ h ℓ ​ ( x ) , u ℓ ⟩ \langle h_{\ell}(x),u_{\ell}\rangle . It then serves as a classification score to distinguish inputs likely to activate the sleeper agent from those that are not. Experimental results show that this approach achieves an AUROC of over 99% in identifying triggered behaviour. MacDiarmid et al. (2024) argued that this is because the activation differences between triggered and non-triggered inputs are sufficiently salient (for example, two clusters far apart). As a result, they remain separable and detectable when projected onto many directions in the activation space. Why this works despite the causality critiques : In this use case, the goal is detection (information presence), not mechanistic understanding. A safety filter’s primary goal is to detect encoded deceptive intent and flag potential danger, not discover its internal mechanism. In summary, this use case shows that probing remains valuable for auditing or detection even though it cannot support causal claims.

blocks.en: This section introduced methods that interpret model activations by decoding them into either the output vocabulary or natural language: logit lens and tuned lens examine what a representation contains, Jacobian lens estimates what it is disposed to influence, Patchscopes and LatentQA verbalise the information it contains, and probing tests whether specific information is decodable from it. These methods primarily reveal what can be decoded from a representation but not whether the decoded information is subsequently used by the model. Section 9 broadens the discussion to comparing representations across models, locating where information is stored, and intervening on representations to control model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 本节引入了通过将模型活化解码为输出词汇或自然语言来解释的方法: logit镜头和调制镜头检查一个表示包含什么, Jacobian镜头估计它要处理什么影响, Patchscopes和LatetQA将它包含的信息进行口头解码,并测试具体信息是否可以从中解码. 这些方法主要揭示了从一种表示中可以解码的内容,但并未揭示解码信息是否随后被模型所使用. 第9节扩大了讨论范围,以比较各种模型的表述,确定信息储存地点,并干预表述以控制模型行为。

blocks.en: 9 Representation Analysis: Comparison, Localisation, and Control
blocks.zh: 9 代表性分析:比较、定位和控制

blocks.en: Following Section 8 ’s emphasis on understanding representations at a broader level, this section considers three successive questions about model representations. Model diffing (Section 9.1 ) asks what differs between two models’ representations. Knowledge localisation (Section 9.2 ) asks where a particular piece of information or behaviour is most causally relevant. Representation engineering and steering (Section 9.3 ) asks whether mechanistic understanding of model representations can be used to change model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 第8节强调在更广泛的层面上理解陈述,在此之后,本节审议三个连续的关于示范陈述的问题。 模式传播(第9.1节)询问两种模式的表述有何不同。 知识本地化(第9.2节)询问某一特定信息或行为在哪里最具有因果关系。 代表工程与指导(第9.3节)问道,对模型代表的机械理解是否可用于改变模型行为.

blocks.en: These methods are also closely connected to neighbouring sections. Diffing two checkpoints of the same model can be viewed as a specific instance of the longitudinal analysis discussed in Section 10.1 . Knowledge localisation operates at a coarser level of analysis than the feature-extraction methods in Section 6 , but pursues a stricter causal objective by identifying the components at which particular behaviours can be most effectively intervened upon. Finally, representation steering causally tests mechanistic findings by examining whether intervening on an identified representation produces the predicted behavioural change.
blocks.zh: 这些方法也与相邻的路段密切相关. 第10.1节讨论的纵向分析的一个具体实例是,向两个检查站分配同一模式的检查站。 与第6节中的特征取出方法相比,知识本地化在比较短的分析水平上运作,但通过确定能够最有效地干预特定行为的构成部分,追求更严格的因果目标。 最后,代表指导因果测试机械学结论,通过审查是否对确定的代表进行干预,产生了预期的行为变化。

blocks.en: 9.1 Model Diffing: Identifying Internal Changes Across Models
blocks.zh: 9.1 模式疏导:查明各种模式的内部变化

blocks.en: Many concerning behaviours, such as reward hacking or sycophancy, arise during fine-tuning ( Sharma et al., 2024b ; MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ). This phenomenon makes it important to monitor features and circuits introduced or amplified during this process to prevent unsafe models from being deployed. Model diffing ( Anthropic, 2024 ) can surface some of these features.
blocks.zh: 许多涉及行为,如奖励黑客或节制,在微调时出现(Sharma等,2024b;MacDiarmid等,2025.)。 这种现象使得监测在这一过程中引入或放大的地物和电路十分重要,以防止不安全模型被部署. 模型diffing(Anthropic, 2024)可以表面出出一些这些特征.

blocks.en: Model Diffing For two models, model diffing seeks to identify differences in features or circuits between them. These differences may consist of features or circuits that are exclusive to one model, or of differences in how shared features or circuits are used.
blocks.zh: 模式潜水 对于两个模型,模型diffing试图识别它们之间的特征或电路差异. 这些差异可能包括一个模型独有的特征或电路,或者共享特征或电路使用方式的不同.

blocks.en:
An earlier line of work compared internal representations across models using correlation- and mutual information-based measures ( Li et al., 2015 ) , canonical-correlation methods such as SVCCA and PWCCA ( Raghu et al., 2017 ; Morcos et al., 2018 ) , and kernel-based alignment metrics such as CKA ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) . Related approaches examine whether the representations of one model can be expressed as linear combinations of representations in another ( Wang et al., 2018 ) . This literature primarily concerns convergent learning : whether independently trained models with different random initialisations learn similar representations up to permutation, rotation, or other linear transformations. More recent work has extended these techniques to study representational convergence across modalities ( Huh et al., 2024 ; Gröger et al., 2026 ) , as discussed in Section 5.4 .
In contrast to model diffing as defined here, these methods typically focus on representational similarity rather than on identifying concrete features or circuits that are introduced, amplified, or repurposed by a specific training intervention.
blocks.zh:
更早的一行工作比较了使用基于相关性和相互信息度量的跨模型的内部表示(Li等,2015年),Canical-correction方法如SVCCA和PWCCA(Raghu等,2017年;Morcos等,2018年),以及基于内核的比对度量如CKA(Kornblith等,2019年). 相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相相關相關相相相相相相關相相相相關相相相相相相相相關相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这种文献主要涉及趋同的学习 : 独立训练的模型, 具有不同的随机初始化, 是否学习了相似的表示直到通向,旋转, 或者其他的线性转换. 如第5.4节所讨论,最近的工作扩大了这些技术的范围,以研究不同模式的代表性趋同性(Huh等,2024;Gröger等,2026)。
与此处所定义的模型分流不同,这些方法通常侧重于代表性相似性,而不是确定具体培训干预措施引入、放大或重新使用的具体特征或线路。

blocks.en: Model diffing has been applied to assess the effect of fine-tuning ( Dumas et al., 2025a ; Lindsey et al., 2024 ; Aranguri & McGrath, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) and distillation ( Baek & Tegmark, 2025 ) , to track differences between model architectures ( Thasarathan et al., 2025 ; Jiralerspong & Bricken, 2025 ), to study the evolution of concepts during pretraining ( Bayazit et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) , and to identify vision-specific features introduced during vision-language training, enabling targeted removal or steering ( Batra et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在评估微调效果时采用了模型分解法(Dumas等人,2025a; Lindsey等,2024年;Aranguri & McGrath,2025年;Wang等,2026年a)和分馏(Baek & Tegmark,2025年),以跟踪模型建筑之间的差异(Thasarathan等,2025年;Jiralespong和Bricken,2025年),研究预训期间概念的演变(Bayazit等,2026年;Ge等,2026年),并找出在视觉语言培训期间引入的愿景特征,从而能够有针对性地去除或引导(Batra等,2026年)。

blocks.en: Dictionary learning is an intuitive approach to implement model diffing. It can highlight unexpected, newly introduced features of concern.
