When diffing models of the same architecture, such as a base versus instruction-fine-tuned model or a series of model checkpoints along pretraining, dictionary learning methods like sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and transcoders can be trained on the difference in token activations ( Dumas et al., 2025b ; Sawmya et al., 2025 ; Inaba et al., 2025 ). This difference can capture features introduced by fine-tuning or by different pretraining stages. A simple baseline technique is to train an SAE on the base model alone and use it as a fixed feature basis for comparison. Methods like SAE-Track maintain continuity through recurrent initialisation, training each checkpoint’s SAE from its predecessor’s so latents remain matched across the run ( Xu et al., 2025b ) . The differences in activations between two models are then measured on a shared evaluation prompt set ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . By causally intervening with latents that activate more strongly in the fine-tuned model, it is possible to identify features responsible for misaligned behaviour ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 词典学习是一种执行模型分解的直观方法. 它可以突出出乎意料的、新近提出的令人关注的特点。 当对同一架构的模型进行分解时,例如基数与指导-精细调整模型,或沿着预训进行一系列示范检查站时,可以对诸如稀有自编码器(SAEs)和转码器等字典学习方法进行象征性活化区别方面的培训(Dumas等,2025年b;Sawmya等,2025年;Inaba等,2025年)。 这种差异可以捕捉由微调或不同预训阶段引入的特征. 一种简单的基线技术是在基准模型上单独培训一个SAE,并将其作为比较的固定特征基础. SAE-Track等方法通过反复初始化来保持连续性,每个检查站的SAE从其前身的潜质中培训,在整个运行中仍然匹配(徐等,2025年b)。 然后用一个共享评价快取集(Wang等人,2026a.)来衡量两个模型在激活方面的差异。 通过因果干预在微调模型中更能激活的潜伏物,可以识别出导致行为错配的特征(Wang等,2026a.). 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: One challenge for model-diffing approaches is attributing features in a fine-tuned model’s representations to the fine-tuning itself. To address this, an SAE trained on a base model can be fine-tuned stage-wise ( Bricken et al., 2024 ) : first on the base model with fine-tuning data, then on the fine-tuned model with base data, and finally on the fine-tuned model with fine-tuning data. Only features exclusive to the last setting are likely to have been introduced via fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 对模型传播方法的一个挑战是,将精细的模型表述中的特征归结为微调本身。 为了解决这个问题,一个接受过基础模型训练的SAE可以被精细地分级(Bricken等,2024年):首先在基础模型上用精细地分解数据,再用基础数据分解出精细地分解模型,最后用精细地分解数据分解出精细地分解模型. 只有最后一种环境特有的特征才可能通过微调引入。

blocks.en: SAEs are applicable when inputs from different models have the same dimension. When diffing two models with different architectures, for example, to track dispositions across model generations or sizes, this might not hold. In this case, crosscoders offer an alternative (Figure 14 ). Crosscoders can define model-specific encoders with arbitrarily different input dimensions that project activations from different models into one or more shared representational spaces. Although the main advantage of crosscoders over SAEs is cross-architecture comparison ( Thasarathan et al., 2025 ; Jiralerspong & Bricken, 2025 ), some prior work has also applied them to base and fine-tuned models ( Lindsey et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2024 ; Dumas et al., 2025a ) and across pretraining checkpoints ( Ge et al., 2026 ; Bayazit et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 如果来自不同模型的投入具有相同的层面,则适用最高审计实体。 例如,如果将两个模型与不同的建筑区分开来,以追踪各代模型或大小模型的处置情况,则可能无法维持。 在这种情况下,交叉编码器提供了一种替代品(图14.). 交叉编码器可以定义具有任意不同输入维度的模型特有编码器,将不同模型的活化投放到一个或多个共享的代表空间. 虽然交叉编码器相对于SAE的主要优势是交叉结构构造比较(Thasarathan等,2025年;Jiralerspong等,2025年;Bricken等,2025年),但以前的一些工作也将其应用于基础模型和微调模型(Lindsey等,2024年;Bricken等,2024年;Dumas等,2025年a)和跨越训练前检查站。 (Ge等,2026;Bayazit等,2026).

blocks.en: A related approach is to model differences in how representations are transformed , rather than comparing the representations themselves. Hu et al. (2026) used transcoders to learn a function that approximates the difference in MLP computation between a base model and its fine-tuned variant. Specifically, adapters are trained so that a base MLP augmented with a learned correction term reproduces the fine-tuned MLP’s behaviour within the full model. Unlike the above methods, which operate on activation differences, this method learns a transformation that approximates how fine-tuning modifies the model’s MLP computation.
blocks.zh: 与此相关的一种方法是模拟代表如何转变的差异,而不是比较代表本身。 Hu等 (2026年)使用转码器来学习一个函数,该函数近似于一个基础模型及其微调变体在计算中的差异. 具体地说,适配器受到训练,以便一个基础的MLP加上一个有学识的校正术语在全模型中复制微调的MLP行为. 与上述在活化差异上运行的方法不同,这种方法学习了一种近似于微调修改模型的MLP计算方式的转变.

blocks.en: A shared concern across dictionary-learning-based model-diffing methods is the faithfulness of the sparse decomposition (see Section 6.5.5 ). Extracted features may not faithfully reflect the underlying representations or their causal roles, potentially leading to false-positive findings about differences between models. For example, identifying an SAE feature associated with “confessing previous faults” in a fine-tuned model but not in the original does not establish that the fine-tuned model causally uses this feature. Nor does its apparent absence from the original model imply that the model lacks representations that could steer it towards such behaviour.
blocks.zh: 以字典学习为基础的模型分解方法的共同关切是稀有分解的忠实性(见第6.5.5节)。 抽取的特征可能不忠实地反映基本表述或其因果作用,可能导致对模型之间差异的虚假的肯定结论. 例如,在微调模型中识别与“承认以前的过失”相联的SAE特征,但不在原版中识别,并不能确定微调模型因果地使用这一特征。 其明显缺乏原始模式也并不意味着该模式缺乏可引导其走向这种行为的表述。

blocks.en: False Positives in Model Diffing Dictionary learning methods for model diffing risk falsely identifying model-exclusive features ( Dumas et al., 2025a ; Jiralerspong & Bricken, 2025 ) . This can result from the loss function: for instance, Dumas et al. (2025a) showed that crosscoders trained with an L 1 L_{1} regularisation on hidden states can falsely identify novel features, which they tried to mitigate with σ Batch-TopK ​ ( ⋅ ) \sigma_{\text{Batch-TopK}}(\cdot) . However, even with this improved architecture, false positives may persist. During fine-tuning, the directions representing some features can rotate, and dictionary learning methods currently cannot distinguish between features introduced via fine-tuning and those merely represented differently. Thus, supposedly model-exclusive features should be regarded as hypotheses that need further validation.
blocks.zh: Dumas等人,2025年a;Jiralesspong & Bricken,2025年.)。 例如,Dumas等人(2025a)指出,在隐藏状态上经过L 1 L_{1}规范化培训的交叉编码器可以错误地识别出新的特性,他们试图用相切-TopK ( )\ sigma_{\text{Batch-TopK}} (\cdot)来减轻这些特性。 然而,即使这种建筑的改善,假阳性可能仍然存在. 在微调期间,代表一些特征的方向可以旋转,而词典学习方法目前无法区分通过微调引入的特征和仅代表不同特征的特征. 因此,所谓的模式排他性特征应被视为需要进一步验证的假设。

blocks.en: To differentiate closed-weight models, it is desirable to develop model diffing tools that only rely on API access. To that end, Kempf et al. (2026) showed that an LLM can generate natural-language hypotheses about behavioural differences between two models by extracting, clustering, and summarising differences across many response pairs from the two models on a shared prompt set. Benchmarked against the SAE-based baseline, the LLM-based method matches it on many dimensions while surfacing more abstract, behaviour-level differences.
blocks.zh: 为了区分闭量模型,最好是开发只依赖API访问的模型分流工具. 为此,Kempf等人(2026年)表明,LLM可以通过取出,集合,并汇总两个模型在共享的快集上的许多反应对之间的差异,生成两个模型之间行为差异的自然语言假设. 以基于SAE的基线为基准,基于LLM的方法在许多方面与之相匹配,同时表面呈现出更为抽象的行为层面差异.

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Model diffing via crosscoders. Model diffing identifies features that emerge or remain invariant across model iterations or architectures. A large delta ( Δ \Delta ) in feature activation between two models highlights a changed feature, providing an insight into how fine-tuning or architectural changes alter internal representations.
blocks.zh: 图14:通过交叉编码器进行模型分解. 模型分流(Model diffing)识别出在模型迭代或架构中出现或保持不常的特征. 两个模型之间的大型三角地(QQ\Delta)特性活化突出一个已改变的特性,提供了对微调或建筑变化如何改变内部表现的洞察.

blocks.en: 9.2 Knowledge Localisation: Where Is Information Stored?
blocks.zh: 9.2 知识本地化: 信息储存在哪里?

blocks.en: Knowledge localisation methods aim to identify the layers, components, or subspaces whose activations are causally associated with a particular capability or behaviour. For instance, causal tracing identifies components that causally impact specific factual association retrieval by observing how model outputs change after activation intervention ( Meng et al., 2022 ) . Related work suggests that feed-forward layers disproportionately contain associations for factual knowledge ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , which can reside in the subspace spanned by the top singular directions of late-layer MLPs’ weight matrices ( Sharma et al., 2024c ) . These early analyses lay the basis for knowledge localisation.
blocks.zh: 知识本地化方法旨在识别其激活与某一特定能力或行为有因果关系的地层,组件或子空间. 例如,因果追踪通过观察模型输出在激活干预后的变化情况,确定因果影响具体事实关联检索的成分(Meng等,2022年)。 相关工作表明,向上进取的地层不成比例地含有事实知识的关联(Geva等,2021年),这些关联可能位于后层MLPs重量矩阵(Sharma等,2024c.)最高单向所跨越的子空间中。 这些早期分析为知识本地化奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Localisation can identify where information is most strongly represented. However, it does not indicate whether the model uses that information. In transformers, which are usually overparameterised, information can be redundantly represented and processed across many model components and activation subspaces depending on the input. In other words, a component with a strong causal effect may capture only part of the mechanism. As a result, localisation is a useful starting point for mechanistic understanding, but not a self-contained analysis.
blocks.zh: 本地化可以确定信息在哪些方面表现得最为突出。 但是,它没有说明该模型是否使用该信息。 在通常过于参数化的变压器中,信息可以被冗余地代表并处理在许多模型组件和激活子空间之间,取决于输入. 换句话说,一个具有强烈因果关系的成分可能只捕捉机制的一部分. 因此,本地化是机械化理解的有益起点,但不是自成一体的分析.

blocks.en: One application is to identify activation directions associated with specific behaviours. For example, refusal behaviour has been found to have approximately low-dimensional structure, with certain activation directions associated with the model’s tendency to refuse harmful requests ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) . Similarly, researchers can study sleeper-agent behaviours ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) by comparing activations across layers for triggered and non-triggered inputs ( MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ) . These analyses help answer questions such as where and how the model encodes behaviour-related information. However, identifying an activation direction or layer does not explain the internal mechanisms underlying the behaviour, which can only be understood through finer-grained analyses such as circuit discovery.
blocks.zh: 一个应用是确定与具体行为有关的激活方向。 例如,拒绝行为被认为具有大约低维的结构,某些激活方向与模型拒绝有害请求的倾向有关(Arditi等,2024年)。 同样,研究人员可以通过比较各层活化物对被触发和非被触发的投入(MacDiarmid等,2024年)来研究卧底剂行为(Hubinger等,2024年)。 这些分析有助于回答问题,例如模型在何地以及如何编码行为相关信息. 然而,识别活化方向或地层并不能解释行为背后的内部机制,这只能通过更细细的刻度分析如电路发现来理解.

blocks.en: 9.3 Representation Engineering and Steering
blocks.zh: 9.3 代表工程和指导

blocks.en: To manipulate model behaviour, representation engineering alters activation-space representations directly, rather than via model weight modification. Activation steering generally refers to methods that target intermediate activations (usually the residual stream) by adding certain vectors that shift model outputs during inference. This differs from localisation methods, which determine where information or behaviour is represented, as steering techniques aim to identify a specific, manipulable vector that changes model behaviour. Because they require no weight updates or retraining, these interventions are lightweight approaches for controlling behaviour.
blocks.zh: 为了操纵模型行为,表现工程直接地改变活化-空间表现,而不是通过模型重量修改. 活化向导一般指通过增加某些向量,在推论中转移模型输出来瞄准中间活化(通常是剩余流)的方法. 这与本地化方法不同,后者决定信息或行为在何处出现,因为指导技术旨在确定改变模式行为的可操纵的特定矢量。 由于这些干预措施不需要更新重量或再培训,因此是控制行为的轻量级方法。

blocks.en: Steering Vector (Figure 15 ) A steering vector v steer ∈ ℝ d v_{\text{steer}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} is an activation-space direction which, when scaled ( α ​ v steer \alpha v_{\text{steer}} ) and added to an intermediate activation, shifts model outputs towards a targeted behaviour. For instance, one steering direction can use the weight vector of a trained linear probe. Another popular method is difference-in-means , which obtains the steering vector by taking the difference between activations associated with two behaviours ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) : v steer = 𝔼 ⁡ [ h ℓ ∣ preferred ] − 𝔼 ⁡ [ h ℓ ∣ unpreferred ] . v_{\text{steer}}=\mathbb{E}[h_{\ell}\mid\text{preferred}]-\mathbb{E}[h_{\ell}\mid\text{unpreferred}]. During inference, the intervention takes the form h ~ ℓ = h ℓ + α ​ v steer , \tilde{h}_{\ell}=h_{\ell}+\alpha v_{\text{steer}}, where α \alpha controls the intervention strength.
blocks.zh: 引导矢量(图15) 引导矢量 v 向量 \\ R d\\ text{steer\in\ mathbb{R\d} 是一个激活- 空间方向, 当缩放( α v 向量 \ alpha v\\ text{steer}) 时, 并添加到中间激活中, 将模型输出转向目标行为 。 例如,一个方向可使用训练有素的线性探测器的重量矢量。 另一种通俗的方法是用两种行为(Rimsky等人,2024年)的活化作用的区别来获得方向向量: v 向导 = E → [hl → 偏好] – E → [hl → 偏好] . v \ text{ steer → mathbb{ E} [h_{\ell}\mid\ text{ unpreferent} 。 在推论中,干预采取h ~l = h l + α v 向导,\tilde{h}_{\ell}=h_{\el}+\alpha v_{\text{steer}}}的形式,其中α-α控制了干预强度.

blocks.en: While these approaches appear simple, they reliably change model behaviours such as refusal, helpfulness, and stylistic tendencies ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Arditi et al., 2024 ) . Thus, steering is useful both as a technique to manipulate behaviour and as a causality test for probes. If intervening along a direction consistently changes a target behaviour, this provides evidence that the corresponding representation causally influences that behaviour. Below we use refusal vectors as a concrete example.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法看起来很简单,但它们可靠地改变了模式行为,如拒绝、帮助和风格倾向(Rimsky等,2024;赵等,2025;Arditi等,2024)。 因此,引导作为一种操纵行为的技术和作为探测器的因果关系测试都是有用的. 如果沿着某一方向进行干预,就会不断改变某一目标行为,这就证明相应的表现会因果地影响这一行为。 下面我们用拒绝矢量作为具体的例子。

blocks.en:
Refusal Vector A refusal vector ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) is a steering direction associated with a model’s tendency to refuse requests.
Define h ℓ t ∈ ℝ d h^{t}_{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} as the residual stream at layer ℓ \ell and token position t t . A simple contrastive construction is 𝐫 ℓ = 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 refuse ​ [ h ℓ t ​ ( x ) ] − 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 comply ​ [ h ℓ t ​ ( x ) ] , \mathbf{r}_{\ell}=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{refuse}}}[h^{t}_{\ell}(x)]-\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{comply}}}[h^{t}_{\ell}(x)], where 𝒟 refuse \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{refuse}} contains prompts eliciting refusal behaviour and 𝒟 comply \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{comply}} contains matched prompts for which the model should comply. The projection s ℓ t = ⟨ h ℓ t , 𝐫 ℓ ⟩ s^{t}_{\ell}=\langle h^{t}_{\ell},\mathbf{r}_{\ell}\rangle measures the activation along the refusal direction. When intervening on this direction, one can test if and how refusal behaviour is causally influenced by it. Previous experimental work shows that these interventions can strongly modulate refusal behaviour; however, the construction and interpretation of refusal directions can vary across models and experimental settings ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
拒绝矢量 拒绝矢量(Arditi等人,2024年)是一个与模型拒绝请求的倾向有关的方向。
定义 h l t ∈ R d^{t}_{\ell}\in\mathbb{ (R}^{d) 为 第l 层和符号位置 t 的残流. 一个简单的对比构造是 r l = E x D 拒绝 [h l t (x )] – E  x D 遵守 [h l (x )],\ mathbf{r}_{\ ell }=\ mathbb{ E}_{x\ sim\ mathcal{ D}_{\mathrm{ refuse}}} [h^{t}_{\ell} (x)]- mathbb{ E}_{x\\ sim\ mathcal{ D}_{\mathrm{comply}(x)],其中 D 拒绝 & mathcal{ D}_{\mathrm{refuse} 包含提示拒绝行为和 D\mathrm{comp}} 包含匹配的提示,模型应当遵守。 project s l t = ⟨ h l t , r l ⟩ s^{t ell}=\langle h^{t}_{\ell },\ mathbf{r}_{\ell}\rangle 沿拒绝方向测量活化. 在干预这一方向时,人们可以检验拒绝行为是否以及如何因果地受其影响。 以往的实验研究表明,这些干预能够强烈地调节拒绝行为;但是,对拒绝方向的构建和解释可能因模型和实验环境而异(Arditi等,2024年)。

blocks.en: The contrast between localisation and steering is shown by refusal vectors: measuring s ℓ t s^{t}_{\ell} across layers helps locate representations that contain information related to refusal, while intervening along 𝐫 ℓ \mathbf{r}_{\ell} tests how modifying representations modulates behaviour (which provides evidence for causality, but does not necessarily reveal the entire mechanism behind how refusal works).
blocks.zh: 本地化和向导之间的对比表现在拒绝向量上:跨层测量 s l t s^{t}_{\ell}帮助定位包含与拒绝有关的信息的表示,同时沿着 r l\mathbf{r}_{\ell} 进行干预,测试修改表示如何调制行为(它为因果关系提供了证据,但并不一定揭示拒绝如何起作用的整个机制).

blocks.en:
Beyond linear directions, recent studies have explored more complex ways of manipulating model activations. For example, Raval et al. (2026) projected model activations into a kernel PCA space, steered them linearly there, and projected them back to the original activation space; Wurgaft et al. (2026) steered activations along a low-dimensional manifold, motivated by findings that some concepts are better represented as manifolds in the activation space. Separately, optimisation-based methods construct steering directions by directly optimising objectives over intermediate activations, offering an alternative to closed-form constructions. For example, they can be obtained by maximising task performance or by suppressing undesirable outputs under intervention.
These optimisation-based approaches offer greater flexibility for complex or nonlinear objectives but generally require substantially more computation than closed-form contrastive methods ( Dunefsky & Cohan, 2025 ; Oozeer et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
除了线性方向之外,最近的研究还探索了更复杂的操纵模型活化的方法. 例如:拉瓦尔等. (2026)预测模型活化为内核PA空间,并在那里线性地引导它们,并把它们放回原活化空间; Wurgaft等. (2026) 引导活化沿着低维多维线进行,其动机是发现一些概念在活化空间中作为多维线得到更好的体现. 另外,基于优化的方法通过直接优化目标而不是中间活化来构建取向方向,为封闭式构造提供了替代品. 例如,可以通过最大限度地完成任务或在干预下抑制不良产出来获得这些成果。
这些基于优化的办法为复杂或非线性目标提供了更大的灵活性,但一般需要比封闭式对比方法多得多的计算(Dunefsky & Cohan,2025;Oozeer等人,2025)。

blocks.en: Figure 15 : Steering Vectors. A steering vector v steer v_{\text{steer}} can be constructed from the difference between the mean activations of positive and negative contrastive samples at a target layer. During inference, the vector is added to the original hidden state h ℓ h_{\ell} to obtain a modified state h ~ ℓ \tilde{h}_{\ell} .
blocks.zh: 图15:引导矢量. 方向向量 v 方向向量 v 方向向量 vQQQtext{steer} 从目标层正反对比性样本的平均活化率与负对比性样本的差值可以构建出一个方向向量 v\\ text{steer}. 在推论中,向量被添加到原始隐藏状态 h l h_{\ell} 以获得一个修改状态 h ~ l\tilde{h}_{\ell}.

blocks.en: Activation steering can causally evaluate representations previously labelled by feature-extraction methods (such as CLTs or SAEs). For instance, a feature may be hypothesised to represent a particular concept. Supporting evidence can be obtained by steering along the identified feature direction and evaluating the resulting change in behaviour.
blocks.zh: 活性向导可以因果地评价先前被特征取出方法(如CLTs或SAEs)所标记的表示. 例如,可以假设某一特征代表某一特定概念。 辅助性证据可以沿着确定的特征方向取向,评价由此产生的行为变化。

blocks.en:
These evaluations have been used to compare interpretable direction-identification approaches, including SAE features, difference-in-means directions, and DAS ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) .
Benchmarks designed to evaluate the causal and behavioural properties of learned representations include RAVEL ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , MIB ( Mueller et al., 2025 ) , and AxBench ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh:
这些评价被用于比较可解释的方向识别方法,包括SAE特征、指向差异和DAS(Huang等人,2024;Wu等人,2025b)。
旨在评价所学表现的因果和行为特性的基准包括RAVEL(Huang等,2024年),MIB (Mueller等,2025年),和Ax Bench (Wu等,2025b.).

blocks.en: Limitations: Brittleness and Mechanistic Opacity While steering methods effectively control behaviours and support causal testing, they have limitations. Notably, they can be brittle, as a direction identified for one distribution, model, or task may not generalise reliably. Another limitation is that successful behavioural steering does not, by itself, establish mechanistic transparency, because an intervention may simultaneously impact multiple features, interact nonlinearly with existing computations, or exploit unintended pathways that produce the desired behaviour without corresponding to a clean mechanism ( Makelov et al., 2024 ) . Thus, steering should generally be interpreted as evidence for causal influence, but it should not, by itself, be a mechanistic explanation of the behaviour.
blocks.zh: 限制:粗略和机械不透明 虽然指导方法有效控制了行为并支持因果测试,但也有局限性. 值得注意的是,它们可能很简洁,因为一种分配、模式或任务可能无法可靠地概括。 另一个限制是,成功的行为指导本身并不能建立机械化的透明度,因为干预可能同时影响多种特征,与现有计算非线性地相互作用,或利用产生预期行为的意外途径而不与清洁发展机制相对应(Makelov等人,2024年)。 因此,指导一般应被解释为因果影响的证据,但它本身不应是对行为的机械解释。

blocks.en: Model diffing examines representation differences across models, knowledge localisation pinpoints where information or behaviours are causally localised, and representation engineering analyses how representation manipulation controls behaviour. Steering has two important roles: as a control technique and as a way to causally test how representations affect behaviour (while noting that successful localisation or steering does not, by itself, provide a complete explanation for the mechanism underlying that behaviour). This analysis is extended in Section 10 , which examines how representations and mechanisms evolve during training.
blocks.zh: 模型分解审查不同模型的表示差异,知识本地化确定信息或行为因果本地化之处,并进行表示工程分析,说明如何控制表现操纵行为. 指导有两个重要作用:作为一种控制技术和一种因果测试表现如何影响行为的方法(同时指出,成功定位或指导本身并不能完整解释行为背后的机制)。 第10节扩展了这一分析,其中审查了在培训期间代表情况和机制如何演变。

blocks.en: 10 Learning Dynamics and Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 10 学习动态和机械解释

blocks.en: Most interpretability research treats a trained model as static. It asks what the model activations represent, which components implement a behaviour, or how an intervention changes its output at a particular checkpoint. However, a model does not come into the world fully formed—it is the product of a learning process over time. Recently, public model suites with intermediate checkpoints ( Biderman et al., 2023b ; Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) and transparent training processes, such as Pythia ( Biderman et al., 2023b ) trained on the publicly available Pile corpus ( Gao et al., 2020 ) , have enabled systematic study of these training trajectories , unlocking unique insights into how models form behaviours.
blocks.zh: 大多数可解释性研究将训练有素的模型视为静态. 它询问模型激活代表什么,哪些组成部分执行一种行为,或干预如何改变在特定检查站的输出。 然而,一个模式并没有完全形成——它是学习过程的产物。 最近,设有中间检查站的公共模范套房(Biderman等人,2023b;Groeneveld等人,2024年)和Pythia(Biderman等人,2023b)等透明培训程序对公开的Pile程序(Gao等人,2020年)进行了培训,从而能够系统地研究这些培训轨迹,解开对模型如何形成行为的独特见解。

blocks.en: Research at the intersection of training dynamics and interpretability can have two aims. Longitudinal analysis (Section 10.1 ) treats learning dynamics as an object of explanation, asking how and why mechanisms form, change, stabilise, or disappear over the course of training ( Saphra, 2023 ) . Training dynamics as a tool instead uses temporal variation to answer questions about the model itself. For example, researchers can compare changes across checkpoints to identify certain mechanisms, distinguish competing explanations, predict later capabilities or failure modes, and guide interventions on the training process.
blocks.zh: 在培训动态和可解释性的交叉点进行研究可以有两个目的。 纵向分析(第10.1节)将学习动力学视为一个解释对象,询问机制如何和为什么在培训过程中形成、改变、稳定或消失(Saphra, 2023年)。 培训动态作为一种工具,使用时间变化来回答关于模型本身的问题。 例如,研究人员可以比较各检查站的变化,以确定某些机制,区分相互竞争的解释,预测以后的能力或失败模式,并指导对培训进程的干预。

blocks.en: 10.1 Longitudinal Analysis
blocks.zh: 10.1 纵向分析

blocks.en: Saphra (2023) argued that we can fully understand model internals only in light of their development: an analysis confined to the final checkpoint risks misattributing the function or origin of the structures it finds there. This subsection covers what longitudinal studies have established about the relationship between training data and the capabilities models acquire (Section 10.1.1 ) and about the lifecycle of internal features (Section 10.1.2 ); abrupt formation events are treated separately in Section 10.3 .
blocks.zh: Saphra (2023年)认为,我们只能根据模型内部的发展来充分理解模型内部:一种仅限于最终检查点的分析可能会错误地将它在那里发现的结构的功能或来源归结为一. 本分节涵盖纵向研究所确定的培训数据与获得的能力模型之间的关系(第10.1.1节)和内部特征的生命周期(第10.1.2节);突然形成事件在第10.3节中单独处理。

blocks.en: 10.1.1 Training Data and Capability Acquisition
blocks.zh: 10.1.1 培训数据和能力建设

blocks.en: The order in which capabilities appear is strongly constrained by the statistics of the training data. Language models acquire words in an order predicted primarily by corpus frequency, unlike children, whose acquisition order also depends on factors such as concreteness and word length ( Chang & Bergen, 2022 ) ; graded linguistic preferences, such as adjective order, are learned from corpus statistics on a similar schedule ( Jumelet et al., 2026 ) . This ordering reflects a more general distributional simplicity bias :
blocks.zh: 培训数据的统计数字严重限制了能力出现顺序。 语言模型以主要由实体频率预言的顺序来获得词,与儿童不同,其获取顺序也取决于具体性和词长等因素(Chang & Bergen, 2022年;分级语言偏好,如形容语顺序,是从类似时间表的生物统计中学习的(Jumelet等, 2026年). 这个命令反映了更普遍的分布简单偏差:

blocks.en: Distributional Simplicity Bias Networks trained with SGD learn low-order statistics of the data distribution before higher-order ones ( Refinetti et al., 2023 ) . In language models, token n-gram frequencies are equivalent to moments of the embedding vectors, so early-training language models approximate low-order token interactions well, with more complex structure fitting later ( Belrose et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 分布简约 接受过SGD培训的网络先学习数据分布的低序统计(Refineti等,2023年)。 在语言模型中,符号正克频率等同嵌入向量的瞬间,因此早期训练语言模型对低序符号相互作用的近似性很好,较复杂的结构更后相接(Belrose等,2024年).

blocks.en: Correlational studies show a strong connection between data statistics and capabilities of the final model ( Razeghi et al., 2022 ) , and causal effects of pretraining-data statistics on factual predictions can be estimated directly ( Elazar et al., 2023 ) . The strongest evidence would come from controlled manipulation of the training data, although this is typically not done at realistic scales because it is costly. One notable example of such work is O’Brien et al. (2026) , which trained three 6.9-billion-parameter, 550-billion-token models on different dataset filtrations and showed they can remove knowledge of proxies for biohazardous capabilities.
blocks.zh: 相关研究表明,数据统计与最终模型的能力之间有着很强的联系(Razeghi等,2022年),培训前数据统计对事实预测的因果关系可以直接估算(Elaza等,2023年). 最有力的证据来自对培训数据的有控制的操纵,尽管由于费用高昂,通常不按现实的规模进行。 这项工作的一个显著例子是O'Brien等人(2026年),他们就不同的数据集过滤方法培训了3个69亿参数的模型,5500亿吨的模型,并表明它们能够去除生物危害能力代用物的知识。

blocks.en: By training transformers on synthetic sequence tasks, Chan et al. (2022b) showed that in-context learning emerges only when the data has the right distributional properties, with burstiness and a long tail of rare classes each necessary. A uniform, non-bursty version of the same content instead leads to in-weights learning, while Zipfian class distributions allow the coexistence of the two learning patterns. Similar dependence on distributional structure governs factual knowledge acquisition, which proceeds through an extended plateau shaped by the frequency distribution of entities in the data ( Zucchet et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 通过对变压器进行合成序列任务的培训,Chan等(2022b)显示,只有数据具有正确的分布属性时,才会出现内文学习,每需要一门分流和一长尾的稀有课. 同一内容的统一而非模糊的版本取而代之,导致体重不足的学习,而Zipfian类分布则允许两种学习模式并存. 对分配结构的类似依赖支配着实际知识的获取,这种获取是通过数据中实体的频率分布所形成的延伸高地进行的(Zucchet等,2025a)。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 10.1.2 Feature Formation, Consolidation, and Drift
blocks.zh: 10.1.2 特征形成、合并和漂流

blocks.en: A technical challenge in tracking features across training runs is that representations at different checkpoints may occupy different bases, so a feature identified at one checkpoint has no automatic counterpart at another. This is analogous to the cross-layer basis mismatch of the logit lens, which degrades because intermediate layers organise information differently from the final layer. A probe or sparse autoencoder trained at one checkpoint degrades similarly when applied to another, and longitudinal methods differ mainly in how they solve this correspondence problem.
blocks.zh: 在跟踪整个培训阶段的特点方面,一个技术挑战是,在不同检查站的代表可能占据不同的基地,因此在一个检查站发现的一个特点在另一个检查站没有自动对应。 这类似于对数镜片的跨层基础不匹配,它降解是因为中间层组织的信息与最后层不同. 在一个检查站训练的探测器或稀有自编码器在应用到另一个检查站时同样会退化,纵向方法主要在如何解决这种通信问题上有所不同.

blocks.en: In Section 9.1 , we discuss model diffing methods for comparing and analysing two models’ internals. They are useful tools for longitudinal analysis, and they have discovered a broadly consistent order in which model knowledge forms and internal representations evolve. Specifically, linguistic knowledge is acquired early and quickly, while factual and commonsense knowledge accumulates slowly and reasoning abilities remain weak throughout pretraining ( Liu et al., 2021 ) . In particular, feature-level analyses provide fine-grained descriptions of this picture: features corresponding to token-level and surface statistics form first, with abstract, cross-lingual, and semantic features forming later ( Inaba et al., 2025 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) , and individual features develop from noisy, unstructured activations into semantically coherent ones ( Xu et al., 2025b ) . Formation is followed by consolidation: after their semantics are established, feature directions continue to drift and eventually stabilise ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ; modules converge at different rates ( Raghu et al., 2017 ) ; and once formed, representations and their acquisition timing are largely consistent across random seeds ( van der Wal et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在第9.1节中,我们讨论比较和分析两个模型内部的模型分解方法。 它们是纵向分析的有用工具,它们发现了一种大致一致的顺序,即示范知识形式和内部表现在其中演变。 具体而言,语言知识是早期和快速获得的,而事实和常识知识则缓慢积累,推理能力在整个预训期间依然薄弱(Liu等,2021年). 特别是,地物级分析为这张照片提供了精细的描述:与象征级和地表统计表相对应的地物首先具有抽象的,跨语言的和语义的地物形成(Inaba等,2025;Ge等,2026),个体地物从吵闹的,无结构地活化而来,发展成相生的地物(徐等,2025b.). 形成后再进行合并:在其语义确定后,特征方向会继续漂移并最终稳定(徐等,2025年b;模块以不同的速度汇合(拉格胡等,2017年;一旦形成,表示及其获取时间在随机种子之间基本一致(van der Wal等,2025年).

blocks.en: Stability of a capability does not imply stability of its implementation. The components carrying an algorithm can change identity while the algorithm persists ( Tigges et al., 2024 ) , and mechanisms can be repurposed, as when induction heads transition into the function vector heads that come to dominate few-shot in-context learning ( Yin & Steinhardt, 2025 ) . Structures can also disappear outright: in the synthetic settings of Chan et al. (2022b) , emergent in-context learning is transient, arising and then giving way to in-weights learning while training loss still falls, with regularisation affecting its persistence ( Singh et al., 2023 ) . Similarly, the drift of features can produce false positives in model diffing (Section 9.1 ) and more broadly bound the temporal scope of any mechanistic claim (Section 10.2.2 ): an explanation about model internals validated at one checkpoint may not apply to other checkpoints of the same model.
blocks.zh: 能力的稳定并不意味着其执行的稳定。 搭载算法的组件可以在算法持续期间改变身份(Tigges等,2024年),机制可以被重新设定用途,如:上传头向功能向向量头过渡时,这些向量头会来主导少数镜头的内语学习(Yin & Steinhardt, 2025年). 结构也可能彻底消失:在Chan等人(2022年b)的合成环境中,新兴的文体学习是瞬息万变的,在培训损失仍然下降的同时,出现并让位于体重不足的学习,规范化影响了其持久性(Singh等人,2023年)。 同样,地物漂移可能在模型分泌中产生假阳性(第9.1节)并更广泛地约束任何机械索赔的时间范围(第10.2.2节):在一个检查站验证的模型内部的解释可能不适用于同一模型的其他检查站。

blocks.en: 10.2 Learning Dynamics as an Interpretability Tool
blocks.zh: 10.2 学习动态作为可解释工具

blocks.en: The preceding subsection treated the learning trajectory as an object to be explained. A complementary line of work uses that trajectory instead as a tool for analysing model behaviour. Comparing behaviour and components across model checkpoints lets researchers conduct novel causal analyses of how components drive model behaviour. Although this framing is relatively new in mechanistic interpretability, the use of learning trajectories to understand neural networks substantially predates it. Early work showed that different singular modes of the input–output correlations can be learned at different rates (where larger singular values tend to be learned earlier), making acquisition order informative about task structure ( Saxe et al., 2014 ; Lampinen & Ganguli, 2019 ; Saxe et al., 2019 ) . In contrast, representation-comparison methods measure when layers and representations converge during training ( Raghu et al., 2017 ; Morcos et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 前分节将学习轨迹视为需要解释的对象。 辅助性的工作线将这一轨迹用作分析示范行为的工具。 对示范检查站的行为和组件进行比较,使研究人员能够对组件如何推动示范行为进行新的因果分析。 虽然这种框架在机械解释性上相对较为新颖,但使用学习轨迹来理解神经网络却大大早于它. 早期的研究表明,输入-输出关联的不同单数模式可以以不同的速度学习(其中较大单数倾向于更早地学习),使得收购订单能够了解任务结构(Saxe等,2014;Lampinn & Ganguli,2019;Saxe等,2019). 相形之下,代表-比较方法衡量在训练期间各层和代表的趋同(Raghu等,2017;Morcos等,2018.).

blocks.en: 10.2.1 Temporal Localisation and Mechanism Discovery
blocks.zh: 10.2.1 时间定位和机制发现

blocks.en: Training data attribution (TDA; Section 11 ) methods can integrate with the training trajectory to provide temporal analysis. For example, TracIn (Section 11.2.5 ) estimates a training sample’s influence on a testing sample’s prediction as the sum of their gradients’ dot products evaluated at checkpoints along the run ( Garima et al., 2020 ) . Each checkpoint contributes separately to the influence estimate. By examining each checkpoint’s contribution, researchers can identify when a training example had the greatest influence on a downstream prediction.
blocks.zh: 培训数据归属(TDA; 第11节)方法可以与培训轨迹相结合,提供时间分析。 例如,TracIn(第11.2.5节)估计培训样本对测试样本预测的影响是,在运行途中的检查站评价的梯度产品总和(Garima等,2020年)。 每个检查站都分别对影响估计作出贡献。 通过检查每个检查站的贡献,研究人员可以确定培训实例何时对下游预测影响最大。

blocks.en: The learning curve of an individual token in context, usually evaluated on held-out text at every checkpoint, is the finest-grained localisation instrument. Chang et al. (2024) extracted learning curves for one million held-out tokens across five pretraining runs and summarised each with the time the token is first learned, the likelihood its loss later regresses, and the variability both within a run and across runs. They found that frequent tokens and tokens in short frequent contexts are acquired earlier, reach lower final surprisal, and vary less within and across runs, with the effect strengthening with n-gram probability. At the level of stages, models learn short repetitive phrases before longer coherent text, consistent with early n-gram learning followed by gradual refinement of tail predictions. Individual tokens also show sudden increases or decreases in loss that recur at consistent points across runs. These abrupt changes in per-token loss can help identify potential transitions during training (Section 10.3.1 ). They also complement trajectory-based attribution by revealing when a model learns specific predictions.
blocks.zh: 在上下文中单个信使的学习曲线,通常在每个检查站被搁置的文字上加以评价,是最佳的地盘化工具. Chang等人(2024年)在5个预训赛中抽取了100万个被搁置的道具的学习曲线,并按道具首次被学习的时间,其丢失的可能性后来又出现回落,以及跑道和跨道跑道的可变性进行了总结. 他们发现,在很短的频繁情况下经常得到的代币和代币更早,达到更低的终极后期,且在内部和跨行间差异较小,效果会以正克概率来强化. 在阶段层面,模型在较长的相干文本之前会学习简短的重复短语,这与早期n-g学相符合,并继而逐步完善尾巴预测. 个别标志还显示损失突然增加或减少,在连续不断的点上再起。 每笔损失的这些突然变化有助于查明培训期间可能发生的过渡(第10.3.1节)。 它们还通过揭示一个模型在学习具体预测时的特性来补充以轨迹为基础的归属.

blocks.en: Once a change is localised in time, the components that changed in that window are candidates for the mechanism. Wang et al. (2025b) introduced refined variants of the Local Learning Coefficient (Section 10.3.4 ) and applied them to individual attention heads of a two-layer attention-only transformer across training. The weight-refined LLC restricts the LLC to a single head’s parameters; the data-refined LLC evaluates it on a chosen data subset. Weight-refined LLC curves diverge progressively over training, with distinct patterns for different head types. Heads of the same type cluster together in both their final values and the overall shape of the curve across training, revealing how heads differentiate into distinct functional roles. On the other hand, data-refined LLCs reveal what a head specialises in processing; for example, on code samples, perturbing the weights of the multigram heads in layer 1 has significantly less impact on the loss than perturbing the induction heads. The same analysis identifies a previously undocumented multigram circuit. A multigram is a common token sequence in the data distribution whose tokens may appear non-contiguously in context. Heads with higher weight-refined LLC tend to memorise more multigrams. Those with lower values tend to follow simple algorithms, such as induction or bracket matching. Wang et al. (2025b) identified these heads by tracking each head’s complexity measure. Unlike the proposed induction scores ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) for identifying induction heads, the measure does not require specifying a head type in advance. However, estimating refined LLCs is computationally expensive, and the approach has so far been demonstrated only on toy models.
blocks.zh: 一旦一个变化及时本地化,该窗口中变化的组件就是该机制的候选部分。 Wang 等 (2025b) 引入了"地方学习系数"的精细变体(第10.3.4节),并将其应用于一个双层只注意的变体在全训练中的个人注意力头. 加权改进的有限责任公司将有限责任公司限制在一个单头的参数上;数据改进后有限责任公司在选定的数据子集上评价它。 重量改进的有限责任公司曲线与培训相比逐渐不同,不同的头型有不同的模式。 同一类型头头在最终值和整个训练曲线的总体形状上组合在一起,揭示头头如何区分不同的功能作用. 另一方面,数据精细的有限责任公司在加工中揭示出什么是头特指;例如,在代码样本上,扰动第1层多克头的权重对损失的影响大大低于扰动入门头. 同样的分析还确定了一个以前没有记录的多克电路. 多克是数据分布中常见的符号序列,其符号可能在上下文中不相干地出现. 重量更重的LLC头部往往会记忆出更多的多克. 数值较低的人倾向于遵循简单的算法,例如诱导或括号相配. Wang等人(2025年b)通过跟踪每个头部的复杂度测量来识别出这些头. 与用于识别上岗头目的拟议上岗分数(Olsson等,2022年)不同,该措施并不要求提前指定头型. 然而,估算精细的有限责任公司在计算上是昂贵的,迄今为止该方法只在玩具模型上得到展示.

blocks.en: 10.2.2 Causal Interventions on Mechanism Formation
blocks.zh: 10.2.2 关于机制形成的原因干预

blocks.en: The forked-run experiment is a basic analysis pipeline available on a training trajectory. It spawns multiple continuations from a single checkpoint, perturbs one factor, and compares the resulting models.
blocks.zh: 叉跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 它从一个单一的检查站产生出多种续作,扰动一个因子,并比较产生的模型.

blocks.en: Linear Mode Connectivity and Forked-Run Experiments A forked-run experiment spawns two or more training continuations from the same checkpoint, varying a single factor such as SGD noise, data order, or random seed, and compares the models the continuations produce. Linear mode connectivity is a standard instrument for the comparison. Two networks are linearly mode connected if the loss barrier along the straight path between their parameters in weight space is near zero. Specifically, Frankle et al. (2020) examined the sensitivity of the model’s training results to SGD noise by restarting training from different checkpoints, each time using different SGD noise. Early in training, these runs may converge to different loss basins. Later, they tend to converge to linearly mode-connected solutions, indicating that the training outcome has become stable to SGD noise.
blocks.zh: 线性模式连接和叉跑实验 一个叉跑实验产出两个或两个以上来自同一检查站的训练续作,不同单个因子如SGD噪声,数据顺序,或随机种子等,并比较续作产生的模型. 线性模式连接是比较的标准工具. 如果在重量空间的参数之间的正道上的损失障碍接近于零,则两个网络是线性连接的。 具体而言,Frankle等人(2020年)通过从不同的检查站重新开始培训,每次使用不同的SGD噪声,审查了该模型的训练结果对SGD噪声的敏感性. 在训练初期,这些跑道可能会汇合到不同的损失盆地. 后来,它们倾向于与线性模式相接的溶液相趋同,表明训练结果已稳定到SGD噪声.

blocks.en: Perturbations other than SGD noise fit the same design. For example, degrading the data early in training causes permanent deficits that the same degradation applied later does not, establishing critical learning periods ( Achille et al., 2019 ) , and forking a run across many random seeds distinguishes properties of the training setup from accidents of a single run ( van der Wal et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, the smeared-key intervention discussed in Section 10.3.5 is the same design with an architectural perturbation. Mode connectivity has also been given a mechanistic reading: Lubana et al. (2023) defined two models as mechanistically similar when they are invariant to the same transformations of the input. They conjectured that two minimisers that cannot be linearly mode connected (up to permutation symmetries of the architecture) must be mechanistically dissimilar, and found that the mechanistically dissimilar minimisers they constructed are connected by quadratic but not linear paths. Under this interpretation, a loss barrier between two checkpoints suggests that their mechanisms differ. However, the absence of a loss barrier does not guarantee that their mechanisms are the same.
blocks.zh: SGD噪声以外的扰动也符合同一种设计. 例如,在早期培训中,数据下降造成长期缺陷,而后来同样的退化并没有造成这种缺陷,从而确定了关键学习期(Achille等人,2019年),并跨越许多随机种子,将培训设置的性质与单一跑道的事故区分开来(van der Wal等人,2025年)。 同样,第10.3.5节所讨论的被涂抹的钥匙干预也是同样的设计,建筑干扰。 模式互联互通也被赋予了机械读取: Lubana 等 (2023年) 将两种模式定义为机械相近的,当它们与输入的相同变相不相干时. 他们猜想,两个无法线性模式连接的最小点(到建筑的通相对称)必须是机械相异的,并发现他们所构建的机械相异的最小点是通过四相而不是线性路径连接的. 根据这一解释,两个检查站之间的损失障碍表明其机制不同。 然而,没有损失障碍并不能保证其机制是相同的。

blocks.en: Learning-dynamics analysis lets us investigate mechanistic claims with scopes broader than those of a single model checkpoint. Specifically, an explanation about a trained model’s internals (e.g., the direction of a feature) does not by itself establish whether the internal mechanism, if it persists, works in the same way as mechanisms in different training stages of the same model or mechanisms across independently trained models of the same kind (Section 10.1.2 ). In contrast, learning-dynamics analysis can re-evaluate the proposed explanation across neighbouring checkpoints or different random seeds, revealing how stable the explanation is under continued training and how sensitive it is to variation in the training trajectory.
blocks.zh: 学习动力学分析让我们能够调查范围比单一模式检查站范围更广的机械化说法。 具体地说,对训练有素的模型的内部(如特征的方向)的解释本身并不能确定内部机制如果继续存在,是否与同一模型不同培训阶段的机制或跨独立训练的同类模型的机制一样有效(第10.1.2节)。 与此相反,学习动力学分析可以重新评估跨相邻检查站或不同随机种子的拟议解释,揭示解释在继续训练中是否稳定,对训练轨迹的变化有多敏感。

blocks.en: 10.3 Phase Transitions and Emergence
blocks.zh: 第10.3条 阶段过渡和出现

blocks.en: Training loss curves typically make it seem like language models gradually and steadily improve in performance ( Hestness et al., 2017 ; Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Rosenfeld et al., 2020 ). While this holds on average , individual capabilities tell a very different story. For many individual tasks, model performance can change sharply and abruptly across model scales and across training ( Wei et al., 2022 ; McKenzie et al., 2023 ) . This suggests that models undergo phase transitions , where relatively small increases in scale or training time produce qualitative changes in behaviour. These transitions have motivated substantial interest in the study of how and when phase transitions happen, which we will discuss in more detail in Section 10.3.4 .
blocks.zh: 培训损失曲线一般使其看起来似乎是语言模型在性能上逐步而稳步地得到改进(Hestness等,2017;Kaplan等,2020;Rosenfeld等,2020. 虽然平均来讲,个人能力的情况大相径庭。 对于许多个别任务,模型性能可以在模型尺度和跨培训之间发生急剧而突然的变化(Wei等人,2022;McKenzie等人,2023)。 这表明模型经历了阶段性转变,规模或培训时间的增加较小,导致行为发生质的变化。 这些过渡引起了人们对如何和何时进行阶段过渡的研究的极大兴趣,我们将在第10.3.4节更详细地加以讨论。

blocks.en: These sharp changes also appear in model internals. Attention heads can specialise into distinct computational roles over relatively short intervals ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , and the formation of induction heads and syntactic attention structures has been associated with abrupt changes in model behaviour ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . Note that behavioural and internal transitions need not occur at the same time or be equally abrupt. A model capability may suddenly emerge even as its underlying internal mechanisms develop gradually. Grokking ( Nanda et al., 2023 ) illustrates this mismatch: as the model develops a generalising circuit, it still relies on memorisation. Once the generalising mechanism dominates and competing memorisation mechanisms are removed, the model’s generalisation ability jumps. We therefore use phase transition broadly to describe qualitative shifts in behaviour, representations, etc., without assuming that they change simultaneously or discontinuously.
blocks.zh: 这些尖锐的变化也出现在模型内部. 注意力主管可以专门在较短的间隔内形成不同的计算角色(Olsson等人,2022年),而入门主管和综合关注结构的形成也与模型行为的突然变化有关(Chen等人,2024a年)。 请注意,行为和内部转变不必同时发生,或同样突然发生。 即使在其基本内部机制逐步发展时,模式能力也可能突然出现。 Grokking(Nanda等,2023年)说明了这种不匹配现象:随着模型发展出通向电路,它仍然依赖于记忆. 一旦通用机制主导并相竞争的记忆机制被去除后,模型的通用能力会跳出. 因此,我们广泛使用阶段过渡来描述行为、表述等的质的变化,而不假定它们同时或不连续地发生变化。

blocks.en: Phase transitions matter for AI safety because they undermine our ability to forecast what the model will develop. If a capability can appear with a small increase in model scale or training time, behavioural evaluation of intermediate checkpoints offers limited assurance about the final model. Also, scaling laws fit to smaller models offer limited insight into larger ones. We therefore need to understand how and when phase transitions happen to reliably predict whether and when a model will acquire a hazardous capability. We organise this subsection as a workflow for the researcher who has a training run in hand: detecting transitions (Section 10.3.1 ), measuring the representations and mechanisms that underlie them (Section 10.3.2 ), attributing them to specific components (Section 10.3.3 ), explaining why they occur (Section 10.3.4 ), and, as a case study, applying this workflow end to end to induction heads (Section 10.3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 阶段过渡对AI安全很重要,因为它们会破坏我们预测模型将开发什么的能力. 如果一种能力能够随着模型规模或培训时间的少量增加而出现,对中间检查站的行为评价对最后模型的保证有限。 此外,与较小模式相适应的法律的推广,对较大模式的深入了解有限。 因此,我们需要了解阶段过渡如何和何时发生,以便可靠地预测一个模型是否会和何时获得危险能力。 我们为正在接受培训的研究人员组织这一分节,作为工作流程:检测过渡(第10.3.1节),衡量这些过渡背后的表述和机制(第10.3.2节),将其归为具体组成部分(第10.3.3节),解释其发生的原因(第10.3.4节),作为案例研究,将这一工作流程的结束适用于上岗主管(第10.3.5节)。

blocks.en: 10.3.1 Detecting Transitions
blocks.zh: 10.3.1 检测过渡

blocks.en: A key challenge in detecting transitions is that aggregate loss can hide abrupt changes in individual capabilities. The quantisation model of neural scaling ( Michaud et al., 2023 ) suggests that models learn discrete units of capability, each potentially emerging abruptly. However, their combined loss can still decrease smoothly because these units occur at different frequencies in the data. This helps explain why abrupt changes can occur across both training time and model scale despite smooth overall loss curves. Researchers therefore use metrics at different levels of granularity to detect these transitions.
blocks.zh: 在发现过渡方面的一个关键挑战是,总体损失可能掩盖个人能力的突然变化。 神经缩放的量化模型(Michaud等,2023年)建议模型学习离散的能力单位,每个单元都可能突然出现. 然而,它们的合并损失仍然能够平稳地减少,因为这些单位发生在数据的不同频率. 这有助于解释为什么尽管整体损失曲线平稳,但培训时间和模型规模都会出现突然变化。 因此,研究人员使用不同颗粒度的度量衡来检测这些过渡.

blocks.en: The crudest instrument is the aggregate loss curve itself: a transition large enough to affect overall performance appears as a bump, visible as a local peak in the loss derivative ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . However, most transitions are too small to detect this way. A flat derivative therefore does not constitute evidence of the absence of a transition.
blocks.zh: 最粗糙的仪器是总损失曲线本身:一个足以影响总体性能的过渡体以起起伏起伏而出,可见损失衍生物中的局部峰值(Olsson等,2022年). 然而,大多数的过渡都太小,无法探测到这种方式. 因此平面衍生物不构成没有过渡的证据.

blocks.en: A metric targeted at a single capability, evaluated at every checkpoint, resolves transitions the aggregate hides. The in-context learning score ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) is a representative construction. It isolates the capability of interest (benefiting from long, previous context) by taking the difference between two quantities. Additionally, tracking benchmark accuracy across checkpoints can similarly reveal capability transitions, though at a coarser level. Comparing results across random seeds helps determine whether these transitions are consistent across training runs ( van der Wal et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在每个检查站评价的针对单一能力的衡量标准可以解决总体隐藏的过渡。 内文学习分数(Olsson等,2022年)是一种有代表性的建筑. 它通过取出两个量的相差,将兴趣能力(从长期上下文中受益)隔离开来. 此外,通过检查站跟踪基准准确性同样可以显示能力过渡,尽管在较紧的一级。 在随机种子中进行比较的结果有助于确定这些过渡在培训过程中是否一致(van der Wal等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Constructing a Capability-Specific Metric The in-context learning score of Olsson et al. (2022) is defined as the prediction loss at the 500th token of a context minus the loss at the 50th token. Each loss is dominated by factors unrelated to in-context learning, such as the model’s overall competence on short contexts; their difference isolates the gain the model derives from additional context. Evaluated at every checkpoint, the score changes abruptly over a narrow training window, the same window in which induction heads form (Section 10.3.5 ), while the aggregate loss curve registers the transition only as a small bump ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 构建一个能力- 特定计量 奥尔松等(2022年)的内语学习分数被定义为: 第500个上下文的预测损失减去 第50个上下文的损失. 每个损失都以与内在学习无关的因素为主,例如模型在短处的整体能力;它们的差异将模型的得益隔离出额外的上下文. 在每个检查站进行评估后,分数会突然改变于一个狭窄的训练窗口,即上岗头的窗口(第10.3.5节),而总损失曲线只将过渡记录为小起伏(Olsson等,2022年)。

blocks.en: Transitions invisible in every predefined metric can be recovered from the training data itself. POLCA decomposes changes in per-example loss along directions in the low-dimensional subspace where training occurs and clusters examples with similar loss trajectories; the clusters correspond to concepts learned abruptly at identifiable points in training, with no corresponding event in the aggregate curve ( Kangaslahti et al., 2026 ) . At coarser granularity, latent state models fit a hidden Markov model over a vector of training metrics and segment the run into discrete phases, with transitions between hidden states flagging candidate developmental events ( Hu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 从培训数据中可以恢复每个预先界定的计量中看不见的过渡。 POLCA在培训发生的低维子空间中分解了每例损失方向的变化,并将损失轨迹类似的实例分组;集群对应在可识别的培训点突如其来地学到的概念,在聚合曲线中没有相应的事件(Kangaslahti等,2026年). 在相近的颗粒度上,潜伏状态模型在培训指标的矢量上与隐藏的马尔可夫模型相接并被分解为分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相分相

blocks.en: Is Emergence a Metric Artefact? Schaeffer et al. (2023) argued that the emergent abilities reported by Wei et al. (2022) are artefacts of discontinuous metrics. For example, exact-match accuracy can change abruptly while the underlying log-likelihood improves smoothly. Metric choice does explain some reported cases, and claimed emergent abilities can appear or disappear under different metrics of the same task. However, it does not explain all of them: sharp transitions are observed directly in continuous metrics, in per-example losses, and in internal representations during single training runs ( Du et al., 2024 ; Schaeffer et al., 2025 ; Wu & Lo, 2025 ; Kangaslahti et al., 2026 ) . The robustness of a reported transition can be assessed using continuous metrics. However, determining which behavioural transitions reflect genuine changes in the model’s internal mechanisms remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 出现是度量仪吗? Schaeffer等人(2023年)认为,魏等人报告的新兴能力. (2022) 是不连续测量仪的工艺品。 例如,精确匹配的精确度会突然改变,而基本的对数相似性则会平稳地改善. 计量选择确实解释了一些已报告的案件,而声称的应急能力可以在相同任务的不同尺度下出现或消失。 然而,它并没有解释所有这些变化:在连续计量、每例损失和单一培训期间的内部表述中直接观察到了急剧的转变(Du等,2024;Schaeffer等,2025;Wu & Lo,2025;Kangaslahti等,2026)。 可使用连续的衡量标准评估所报告的过渡的稳健性。 然而,确定哪些行为转变反映了模式内部机制的真正变化仍然是一个有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: 10.3.2 Progress Measures and Internal Precursors
blocks.zh: 10.3.2 进展措施和内部前体

blocks.en: The methods above operate on phase transitions in model behaviours. However, as discussed above, transitions in external behaviour and internal mechanisms can follow different patterns. Researchers therefore are also interested in measuring the internals directly.
blocks.zh: 上述方法适用于示范行为阶段的过渡。 然而,如上所讨论,外部行为和内部机制的转变可以遵循不同的模式. 因此,研究人员也有兴趣直接测量内部。

blocks.en: Progress Measure A progress measure is a scalar quantity defined on a model’s internals that varies continuously as a mechanism forms, and can therefore track the mechanism’s development before the behaviour it supports changes ( Nanda et al., 2023 ) . Progress measures are typically derived from a mechanistic analysis of the completed mechanism at the end of training, then evaluated retroactively at earlier checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 进度计量 进步衡量标准是在模型的内部所定义的平面数量,它作为一种机制形式不断变化,因此可以在支持变化的行为之前跟踪机制的发展(Nanda等,2023年)。 进展措施通常是在培训结束时对完成的机制进行机械分析,然后在较早的检查站进行追溯性评估。

blocks.en: Grokking is the controlled setting in which this tool has been demonstrated most completely.
blocks.zh: Grokking是这个工具被最完整演示的被控制设置.

blocks.en: Grokking Grokking is the phenomenon in which a model reaches low training loss early in training but begins to generalise to unseen inputs only after a long additional period of optimisation ( Power et al., 2022 ) . This is almost exclusively seen in closed-domain settings, though general-purpose language models have shown conceptually similar behaviour.
blocks.zh: Grokking Grokking是一种模式在培训初期达到低培训损失,但只有在经过了很长一段时间的优化后才开始普遍到无形的投入的现象(Power等人,2022年)。 虽然通用语言模型显示出概念上相似的行为,但在封闭域环境中几乎完全看到这一点。

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Grokking. Training loss (purple) falls early in training while test loss (red) remains high. After a long plateau, test loss drops sharply, and the model generalises. Progress measures defined on model internals show the generalising circuit forming gradually during the plateau, before the change is visible in behaviour.
blocks.zh: 图16:格罗克京。 培训损失(纯度)在培训初期下降,而测试损失(红色)仍然很高。 经过了漫长的高原后,测试损失急剧下降,而模型一般化. 模型内部所定义的进步度量显示在高原期间逐渐形成的通向回路,在行为上可见变化之前.

blocks.en: In modular arithmetic, training accuracy saturates early while test accuracy remains near chance for many steps before rising sharply (Figure 16 ; Power et al., 2022 ). Mechanistic analysis of grokked networks recovers the learned algorithm (trigonometric identities implementing modular addition) and defines progress measures that track its formation: the generalising circuit grows gradually during the plateau, and the sharp change in test accuracy corresponds to a transition from a memorising solution to the completed generalising circuit followed by removal of the memorising components ( Nanda et al., 2023 ) . Grokking has been explained as competition between a memorising and a generalising circuit with different efficiencies under weight decay, an account that predicted and confirmed ungrokking and semi-grokking ( Varma et al., 2023 ) . Grokking can be induced or eliminated by controlling parameter norm at initialisation, and it occurs beyond algorithmic tasks ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在模块算术中,训练精度提前饱和,而测试精度在急剧上升之前,许多步骤仍然几乎有可能达到(图16;Power等人,2022)。 对分解网络的机械分析恢复了所学算法(riconometry identies instruction multimement)并定义了追踪其形成的进展度量:通向电路在高原期间逐渐增长,测试精度的急剧变化相当于从回忆式解决方案向完成通向电路的过渡,然后去除回忆式组件(Nanda等,2023年). Grokking被解释为在重量衰减下具有不同效率的记忆通路和通路通路之间的竞争,这一账户预测并证实了不干和半干(Varma等,2023年)。 Grokking可以通过初始化时控制参数规范来诱导或消除,它发生于算法任务之外(Liu等,2023.

blocks.en: Transfer from Grokking Settings to Language Models The standard setting in grokking experiments differs from language model pretraining in many ways, including dataset size, weight decay, and the number of epochs over the data. Current studies have not shown that existing quantitative conclusions transfer directly to large-scale pretraining.
blocks.zh: 从 Grokking 设置转移到语言模型 分解实验中的标准设置在许多方面与语言模型预训不同,包括数据集大小,重量衰减,以及数据上的时间段数等. 目前的研究没有表明现有的定量结论直接转移到了大规模的预训.

blocks.en: Similar findings have been reported outside grokking settings. Chen et al. (2024a) found that syntactic attention structures emerged during a sharp drop in masked language modelling (MLM) loss, before accuracy improvement on a grammatical benchmark. Similarly, Zucchet et al. (2025a) observed that attention-based recall circuits formed during a plateau in factual-knowledge acquisition, followed by rapid improvements in model performance. These findings suggest that changes in internal mechanisms can precede changes in model capabilities. This observation motivates research on forecasting model behaviour through internal monitoring, as discussed in Section 10.4 .
blocks.zh: 据报道,在杂乱设置之外也有类似的发现。 Chen等 (2024a)发现,在被遮蔽的语言建模(MLM)损失急剧下降期间,在语法基准的准确性得到提高之前,合成关注结构就出现了. 同样地,Zucchet等人(2025年a)指出,在获取事实知识的高原期间形成的基于注意力的召回电路,随后模型性能得到迅速改进。 这些调查结果表明,内部机制的变化可以先于模型能力的变化。 正如第10.4节所讨论,这一观察促使通过内部监测对模型行为进行预测的研究。

blocks.en: 10.3.3 Attributing Transitions to Components
blocks.zh: 10.3.3 国家 向部件过渡

blocks.en: So far, the methods we discussed cannot attribute the transition to specific model components. Attention head specialisation is probably the most intuitive option to work at this granularity in transformers. Individual attention heads can specialise to attend to syntactic relations, positional offsets, or rare tokens ( Voita et al., 2019 ; Clark et al., 2019 ), and this specialisation can appear abruptly. For example, induction heads form during a brief training window, and their formation coincides with a sharp improvement in in-context learning ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , a transition we examine in detail in Section 10.3.5 . In masked language models, suppressing the syntactic attention structure delays the capability it precedes ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . Likewise, sparse attention emerges abruptly and depends on repetition in the training data ( Zucchet et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们讨论的方法不能将过渡归于特定的模型组件. 注意头专门化可能是在变压器中在这个颗粒性工作最直观的选择. 个人关注头目可以专门处理综合关系,位置抵消,或稀有的道具(Voita等,2019;Clark等,2019),而这种专门化可以突然出现. 例如,上岗头部在短暂的培训窗口中形成,其形成与文字学习的急剧改进相吻合(Olsson等,2022年),我们在第10.3.5节中详细审查了这一过渡。 在被蒙蔽的语言模型中,压制了综合注意结构会拖延它之前的能力(Chen等,2024a. 。 。 。 。 同样,很少注意突然出现,取决于培训数据的重复(Zucchet等人,2025b)。

blocks.en: These events cluster in time. Several attention heads, such as induction heads and heads exhibiting syntactic attention patterns, can acquire specialised functions within the same training window. These heads emerge alongside a peak in how accurately the model’s perplexity predicts human reading times, and this predictive ability subsequently declines even as language modelling performance continues to improve ( Aoyama & Wilcox, 2025 ) . Head specialisation can be viewed as a form of symmetry breaking . Before or in the very early stages of training, attention heads are indistinguishable and interchangeable; during training, they start to develop distinct functions despite having equivalent roles in the architecture. Tracking this process can help identify the emergence of modular structure. Attribution of this kind is also a diagnostic for modularity more broadly. Three observable indicators jointly diagnose modular internal structure ( Zhao et al., 2024b ) : transitions during training, emergent trends across model scale, and heterogeneous clustering of solutions across random seeds. A structure exhibiting all three is a strong candidate for a discrete, functionally specialised mechanism.
blocks.zh: 这些事件及时集群。 几位关注负责人,如上岗负责人和表现出综合关注模式的负责人,可以在同一培训窗口内获得专门功能. 这些头部在模型的通透性如何准确预测人类阅读时间方面出现高峰,这种预测能力随后会随着语言建模性能的不断提高而下降(Aoyama & Wilcox,2025年)。 头部专门化可被视为一种对称断开的形式. 在培训之前或培训初期,注意力主管是无法区分的和可互换的;在培训期间,他们开始发展不同的功能,尽管在结构中具有同等的作用。 跟踪这一进程有助于确定模块结构的出现。 这种归属也是更广泛地诊断模块性的诊断. 三个可观测指标共同诊断出模块内部结构(Zhao等,2024b):培训期间的过渡、模型规模的出现趋势、以及随机种子溶液的多样化组合。 显示所有三个结构的结构是独立、功能专门机制的有力选择。

blocks.en: Sharp Transitions from Smooth Components Phase transitions in test loss or task accuracy do not imply abrupt change in any individual component. For example, in controlled settings, many attention heads develop induction-like behaviour gradually—their contributions are largely additive, and the sharp macroscopic transition arises from their aggregate effect ( Singh et al., 2024 ) . Localising a phase transition in a coarse-grained metric therefore does not help identify the responsible components. In contrast, component-level attribution may find only gradual change without being wrong.
blocks.zh: 平滑组件的尖锐过渡 测试丢失或任务精度的相继过渡并不意味着任何单个组成部分的突然变化。 例如,在受控环境中,许多关注头逐渐发展出类似诱导的行为——他们的贡献大多是添加剂,而急剧的宏观转变源于其综合效应(Singh等人,2024年)。 因此,将相位过渡定位在粗糙的度量中无助于确定负责的组成部分。 相形之下,组件级的归属可能只发现不错误的渐进变化.

blocks.en: 10.3.4 Why Transitions Happen
blocks.zh: 10.3.4 国家 为什么过渡会发生

blocks.en: Theoretical studies of deep linear networks show that different singular modes of the input–output correlations can be learned at different rates ( Saxe et al., 2014 ; Saxe et al., 2019 ) . The training process may therefore involve periods of slow improvement followed by rapid reductions in test loss. From an optimisation perspective, gradient descent moves through regions near successive saddle points in the loss landscape and gradually learns more complex solutions along the way. This process is known as saddle-to-saddle dynamics . Similar training patterns have been observed in other neural networks, where they learn simpler functions before more complex ones ( Rahaman et al., 2019 ; Nakkiran et al., 2019 ) . Attention head specialisation may also be related to symmetry breaking during training, although the relationship to saddle-to-saddle dynamics is not yet fully established in realistic transformers ( Chen et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: 对深线性网络的理论研究表明,输入-输出关联的不同单数模式可以以不同的速度学习(Saxe等,2014;Saxe等,2019). 因此,培训过程可能涉及缓慢改进的时期,然后迅速减少试验损失。 从优化的角度,梯度回落在损失地貌中相接相接的鞍点附近区域移动,并逐渐学习出更复杂的解决方案. 这个过程被称为 " 从鞍到鞍 " 动态。 在其他神经网络中也观察到类似的训练模式,他们在更复杂的神经网络之前学习更简单的功能(Rahaman等,2019;Nakkiran等,2019). 注意头专门化也可能与训练期间的对称性断裂有关,尽管与鞍到鞍动力学的关系尚未在现实变压器中完全确立(Chen等,2024a.) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Singular learning theory (SLT) studies how the geometry of a singular model’s parameter space affects learning and generalisation ( Watanabe, 2009 ) . Neural networks are singular (and are thus a subject of study in SLT) because different parameter configurations can implement the same function. As a result, two models that achieve similar loss can differ substantially in their effective complexity. SLT provides a framework for studying this complexity and has motivated research on its changes during training and its usefulness in downstream applications ( Lau et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Singular学习理论(SLT)研究了单数模型参数空间的几何学对学习和通论的影响(渡边,2009年). 神经网络是单数(因此是SLT中的研究对象),因为不同的参数配置可以执行同一种功能. 因此,两种实现类似损失的模式在有效复杂性上可以有很大的不同. SLT为研究这种复杂性提供了一个框架,并激发了对其在培训期间的变化及其在下游应用中的效用的研究(Lau等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) For model parameters θ ∗ \mathbf{\theta}^{*} at a local minimum, the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) λ ⁡ ( θ ∗ ) \lambda(\mathbf{\theta}^{*}) measures the degeneracy of the loss landscape near θ ∗ \mathbf{\theta}^{*} via the volume-scaling rate of low-loss neighbourhoods ( Lau et al., 2025 ) . Smaller values indicate more degenerate (flatter, in a higher-order sense) minima. The LLC is estimable at scale with stochastic-gradient MCMC ( Lau et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 本地学习系数(LLC) 对于模型参数 * *\ mathbf\theta\在本地最低值,本地学习系数(LLC) * * * * ( * * *)\lambda(\mathbf\theta\) 通过低损失街区的体积递减率测量损失地貌的退化程度 (刘等,2025). 更小的值表示更退化(平分,以更高的顺序来表示)迷你. 有限责任公司在规模上具有可估量性,具有可分级的MCMC(Lau等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Estimated LLC trajectories in transformers change at points that coincide with identifiable developmental events, including the stages of structure formation described in Section 10.3.3 ( Hoogland et al., 2025 ) . This is the central empirical result of the developmental interpretability programme ( Hoogland et al., 2023 ) introduced in Section 12.3 . However, current evidence for LLC is largely retrospective, where phase transitions are detected and matched to known events only after training. Prospective prediction of a transition before it occurs has not yet been demonstrated. Section 10.4 discusses potential applications of learning-dynamics analysis to forecasting and intervention.
blocks.zh: 第10.3.3节(Hogland等,2025年)中描述的结构形成阶段。 这是第12.3节提出的发展可解释性方案(Hogland等,2023年)的核心经验成果。 然而,目前关于专卖局长的证据基本上是追溯性的,即只有在经过培训后才发现阶段过渡,并与已知事件相匹配。 尚未表明对过渡之前的预测。 第10.4节讨论了学习动力学分析对预测和干预的潜在应用。

blocks.en: 10.3.5 Case Study: Induction Heads
blocks.zh: 10.3.5 国家 案例研究:上岗主管

blocks.en: Learning Dynamics Perspective on Induction Heads The preceding case studies (Sections 6.8 and 7.4 ) analysed induction heads and circuits in a trained model. Several facts about the induction circuit are invisible from that vantage point but become observable when we examine the model across training ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Consider the repeated sequence again A B C A B ? , \texttt{A B C A B \lx@text@underline{?}}, and observe at successive checkpoints of a single training run. Examining the checkpoints shows that the induction ability arrived abruptly: at early checkpoints the model bases its predictions on token frequencies and derives no benefit from the earlier occurrence of A B , and during a narrow window of training, roughly 2.5 to 5 billion tokens in the models studied by Olsson et al. (2022) , induction heads form and the model begins predicting C by attending back to the first occurrence. A sharp improvement in in-context learning and a small bump in the training loss fall within the same window. The timing of formation also helps provide causal evidence that a single model checkpoint cannot provide. Ablating an induction head in the final model only shows its necessity for the behaviour at that checkpoint. This does not support the stronger claim that the induction circuit’s formation caused the capability to develop. Olsson et al. (2022) examined this stronger claim by intervening on formation itself. Their “smeared key” modification built the previous-token head’s contribution into the attention computation, allowing the circuit to form within a single layer. Under this modification, one-layer models acquire in-context learning they otherwise never develop, while the transition moves earlier in deeper models.
blocks.zh: 关于上岗头的学习动态视角 上述个案研究(第6.8和7.4节)以训练有素的模式分析了上岗主管和线路。 有关诱导电路的几个事实从这个有利点上是看不见的,但当我们审查整个培训模型时,这些事实就会变得可被观察到(Olsson等,2022年)。 再次考虑重复的序列 A C A B ?,\textt{A B C A B\lx@text@underline{?},并在接连的检查站观察一次训练。 检查检查站后发现,上岗能力突然出现:在早期检查站,模型的预测以象征性频率为基础,没有从较早出现的A B得到任何好处;在狭小的培训窗口中,奥尔松等人研究的模型中约有25至50亿个符号。 (2022年),上岗头表和模型开始预测C通过回首出场. 文字学习的急剧改进和培训损失的微小起落就在同一窗口。 组建时间也有助于提供单一示范检查站无法提供的因果关系证据。 在最后模式中设置上岗主管,只能表明其对该检查站行为的必要性。 这不能支持更强烈的说法,即诱导电路的形成造成了发展能力。 Olsson等人(2022年)通过干预组建本身审查了这一更强有力的主张。 他们的 " 锯齿钥匙 " 的修改使先前敲头对注意力计算的贡献得以形成,使电路能够在一分层内形成。 在这种修改下,一层模型获得内文学习,否则它们永远不会发展,而过渡则更早地在更深的模型中进行.

blocks.en: 10.4 Leveraging Learning Dynamics for Safety
blocks.zh: 10.4 利用学习动态促进安全

blocks.en: The analyses above also support safety-oriented objectives, including anticipating capabilities before they appear (Section 10.4.1 ) and intervening in the training process while it is still underway (Section 10.4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 上述分析还支持以安全为导向的目标,包括在出现之前预测能力(第10.4.1节),并在培训进程仍在进行时进行干预(第10.4.2节)。

blocks.en: 10.4.1 Forecasting Model Behaviours
blocks.zh: 10.4.1 预测示范行为

blocks.en: Scaling laws demonstrate that aggregate loss is predictable before training ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ), but phase transitions break this style of extrapolation for individual capabilities (Section 10.3 ). Forecasting therefore targets specific behaviours directly. Memorisation is the behaviour for which the forecasting problem has been posed most explicitly. Biderman et al. (2023a) introduced the problem of forecasting whether a specific training sequence will be memorised by a model before that model is trained. They argued that recall is the metric to optimise (a false negative means training a full model that leaks the sequence, while a false positive only discards a cheap trial run). They established baselines that forecast from smaller fully trained models and from partially trained checkpoints of the target run, together with equi-compute recommendations for dividing a fixed forecasting budget between model size and tokens.
blocks.zh: 扩展法表明,总损失在培训前是可以预测的(Kaplan等,2020年;Hoffmann等,2022年),但阶段过渡打破了对个人能力的这种推断方式(第10.3节)。 因此,预测直接针对具体行为。 记忆是预测问题被最明确地提出来的行为。 Biderman等人(2023年a)提出了一个预测问题,即该模型在被训练之前,是否会被一个模型所记忆出特定的训练序列. 他们认为,召回是优化的衡量标准(假阴性意味着训练一个能泄露序列的完整模型,而假阳性只会丢弃一个廉价的试跑). 他们确定了基线,从训练有素的较小模型和部分训练有素的目标运行检查站预测,同时提出了将固定预测预算分为模型规模和符号的等同计算建议。

blocks.en: Emergence can be forecast by intervening on the training trajectory. Fine-tuning on a target task shifts capability emergence towards less capable models. Fitting how this shift varies with the amount of fine-tuning data yields an emergence law . Using only small models, this law predicts whether a capability will have emerged in models trained with up to 4 × \times more compute ( Snell et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 可以通过干预训练轨迹来预测出现. 精细调整目标任务转变能力向能力较差的模式发展。 与微调数据量不同, 这一定律只使用小型模型,预测在经过最多4×xx\tims比较计算训练的模型中是否会出现能力(Snell等,2024年).

blocks.en: Rare harmful behaviours can also be forecast statistically. The largest elicitation probabilities observed in a small sample of queries scale predictably with query volume. This relationship allows harmful-behaviour risks to be extrapolated across up to three orders of magnitude of deployment-scale query volume. Examples include assisting with dangerous chemical synthesis and taking power-seeking actions ( Jones et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 对很少的有害行为也可从统计上加以预测。 在少数查询样本中观察到的最大引出概率与查询量的可预测规模。 这种关系使得有害行为风险可以推导出多达三个规模的部署规模查询量。 例如,协助进行危险的化学合成和采取寻求权力的行动(Jones等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Post-training failures can be analysed similarly. Specifically, transitions between successive RLHF checkpoints can be classified into four categories: reward hacking, collapse, proxy under-alignment, and evaluator-specific disagreement. Reward hacking occurs when the model exploits a way to achieve high rewards while the external quality from the perspective of human users falls; collapse occurs when both decline. This classification localises failures that checkpoint averages miss. A model fitted to training-dynamics diagnostics predicts future reward hacking with a ROC-AUC of 0.82. These diagnostics include reward-model uncertainty, policy drift, and output diversity ( Abahana et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 培训后的失败可作类似分析。 具体来说,相继的RLHF检查站之间的过渡可以分为四类:奖励黑客,倒闭,代理不协调,以及评价者特有的分歧. 当模型利用一种方法实现高回报,而从人类用户的角度来看,外部质量下降时,就会发生被奖励的黑客入侵;当两者都下降时,就会发生倒闭. 这种分类将检查点平均错失的故障本地化. 一种适合训练动力学诊断的模型预言未来奖励黑客,ROC-AUC为0.82. 这些诊断包括奖励模式不确定性、政策漂移和产出多样性(Abahana等,2026年)。

blocks.en: Internal signals extend forecasting to fine-tuning outcomes. Activation-space persona features predict whether a fine-tuned model will exhibit emergent misalignment ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Signals available before fine-tuning begins also predict the resulting model’s alignment ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Section 12.4 discusses the research agenda these results instantiate.
blocks.zh: 内部信号将预测扩展到微调结果. 活化-空间人物a 特征预测微调模型是否会显示出现错位(Wang等,2026a.) . 微调开始前已有的信号也预测了模型的对齐性(Zhang等人,2026年b). 第12.4节讨论了这些结果的即时反应。

blocks.en: Where a mechanism forms before the capability it supports is behaviourally expressed, monitoring internals can flag the capability earlier than behavioural evaluation. The recall circuits that precede factual-knowledge acquisition ( Zucchet et al., 2025a ) and the syntactic attention structure that precedes the break in grammatical capabilities ( Chen et al., 2024a ) show that this lead time can exist; progress measures (Section 10.3.2 ) are the instrument that would exploit it.
blocks.zh: 如果一种机制在支持的能力以行为方式表达之前就形成,监测内部可以比行为评价早标出能力。 在获取事实知识之前的召回电路(Zucchet等,2025a)和语法能力断裂之前的协同注意结构(Chen等,2024a)表明,这一周转时间是可以存在的;进展措施(第10.3.2节)是利用它的工具。

blocks.en: To assess the reliability of a forecast, researchers can compare training runs with different random seeds. van der Wal et al. (2025) found that capabilities generally emerge at similar stages and representations develop consistently across training runs, although some runs differ substantially. These exceptions highlight the uncertainty of forecasts based on a single training run.
blocks.zh: 为了评估预测的可靠性,研究人员可以将训练与不同的随机种子进行比较。 van der Wal等人(2025年)发现,能力一般在相类似阶段出现,而且在整个培训过程中,表现都得到持续发展,尽管有些培训的进行差别很大。 这些例外突出了根据单一培训进行的预测的不确定性。

blocks.en: Most Early-Warning Evidence Is Retrospective Currently, nearly all demonstrations that changes in internals lead to changes in behaviour are retrospective. In these studies, researchers analyse the completed mechanism after training to identify a progress measure or precursor structure, then evaluate it backwards over saved checkpoints. This concern also exists in LLC-based transition detection (Section 10.3.4 ). In contrast, prospective forecasting requires researchers to predict outcomes before observing them. Biderman et al. (2023a) proposed baseline methods for forecasting memorisation. However, prospective forecasting for broader capability transitions relevant to AI safety remains underdeveloped. Early-warning signals therefore require prospective validation before they can be considered reliable.
blocks.zh: 最早期警告的证据是回顾 目前,几乎所有导致行为变化的内部变化的演示都是回溯性的. 在这些研究中,研究人员在培训后分析完成的机制,以确定进展措施或前体结构,然后在节省的检查站后向后评估。 基于专卖局长的过渡检测中也存在这种关切(第10.3.4节)。 相反,预期预测要求研究人员在观测结果之前作出预测。 Biderman等人(2023a)提出了预测记忆的基准方法。 然而,与人工智能安全有关的更广泛的能力过渡的预期预测仍然不足。 因此,预警信号需要未来的验证,然后才能被认为是可靠的。

blocks.en: 10.4.2 Intervening on Training Processes
blocks.zh: 10.4.2 国家 关于培训进程的互动

blocks.en: The model that matters is the one deployed at the end of training, and the standard response to an undesirable behaviour found there is post-training fine-tuning, which is outside the scope of this section. An alternative is to intervene during training to prevent undesirable capabilities from developing or to control how they develop. Existing work explores three approaches: modifying training data, changing model architecture, and intervening on model activations during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 重要的模式是培训结束时部署的模式,对不良行为的标准反应是培训后微调,不属于本节的范围。 另一种办法是在培训期间进行干预,防止不良能力的发展或控制其发展方式。 现有工作探索了三种方法:修改培训数据,改变模型架构,在微调时干预模型活化.

blocks.en: Deep Ignorance filters proxies for biohazardous knowledge out of the pretraining corpus and trains 6.9-billion-parameter models on the filtered data (Section 10.1.1 ; O’Brien et al., 2026 ). The filtered models do not acquire the targeted knowledge, making it difficult for the unwanted capability to emerge through adversarial fine-tuning. In contrast, post-training unlearning may suppress the unwanted behaviour without removing the underlying knowledge. A follow-up moves the filter from documents to tokens: individual tokens are labelled using sparse autoencoders and efficient classifiers trained on those labels, and filtering at token granularity removes the undesired capability at lower cost to desired capabilities than document-level filtering, with effectiveness increasing with model scale across the two orders of magnitude tested and filtered models remaining alignable afterwards ( Rathi & Radford, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 深度无知从预训书中过滤生物危险知识的代名词,并在被过滤的数据上培训69亿参数模型(第10.1.1节;O'Brien等,2026年)。 被过滤的模型没有获得有针对性的知识,使得不想要的能力难以通过对抗性的微调而出现. 与此相反,培训后不学习可能抑制不想要的行为,而不消除基本知识。 后续将过滤器从文档移动到符号:单个符号的标签使用受这些标签培训的稀有自定义编码器和高效分类器,按象征性颗粒性过滤将不受欢迎的能力以比文件一级过滤更低的成本去除所期望的能力,随着模型规模跨两个规模级测试和过滤的模型在之后仍可调和,效果会提高(Rathi & Radford, 2026)。

blocks.en: Similarly, the order in which different categories of training data are presented matters. Bruijns et al. (2026) found that, in an imbalanced pretraining curriculum where one task is shown before another, the model packs the tasks sequentially into separable circuits, resulting in more targeted subsequent refusal fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 同样,不同类别培训数据的列报顺序也十分重要。 Bruijns等 (2026年)发现,在一种不平衡的预训课程中,一个任务显示在另一个任务之前,模型将任务相继地打包入可分离的回路中,导致后续更有针对性的拒绝微调.

blocks.en: Data-Level Interventions Have Ripple Effects Removing data from a training set does not act only on the removed data. In the setting of Borkar et al. (2025) , deleting personal information can increase memorisation of the personal information that remains, and adding one individual’s information amplifies memorisation of others’ by roughly 7.5 × \times , because whether a sequence is memorised depends on similar sequences seen elsewhere in training. Subliminal learning ( Cloud et al., 2026 ) shows that data can transmit traits not apparent from its semantic content. For example, a student model can inherit a teacher’s hidden bias from seemingly unrelated data, such as number sequences. This transfer is carried by a small set of divergence tokens and depends on early layers ( Schrodi et al., 2026 ) . Filtering and unlearning interventions therefore need to be evaluated on what the model does with the data that stays, not only on what it no longer does with the data that was removed.
blocks.zh: 数据层面的干预 带宽效果从培训集中删除数据不只对已删除的数据起作用 。 在Borkar等人(2025年)的设定中,删除个人信息可以增加余下个人信息的记忆,加上一个人的信息可以将他人的记忆放大约7.5×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 潜心学习(Cloud等,2026年)表明,数据可以传输其语义内容中不明显的特征. 例如,一个学生模型可以从看似无关的数据中继承教师的隐性偏好,如数字序列. 这种转会由一小组相差的符来承接,并取决于早期地层(Schrodi等,2026.). 因此,需要评估该模型对留下的数据所做的哪些工作,而不仅仅是它不再对被删除的数据所做的哪些工作。

blocks.en: Gradient routing is an architectural modification informed by learning dynamics: it constrains which parameters receive gradient updates for chosen concepts during training, localising the corresponding computation into designated regions of the network ( Cloud et al., 2024 ) . Although the modification does not make the trained model safer on its own, it shapes where a mechanism forms so that later interventions, such as gating the designated region, become clean and localised. The antecedent for this style of intervention is the smeared-key modification ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , which showed that an architectural change can control when and whether a mechanism forms at all (Section 10.3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 渐变路由是一种以学习动力学为参考的建筑修饰:它制约了哪些参数在培训期间会得到选定概念的梯度更新,将相应的计算定位到网络的指定区域(Cloud等,2024年). 尽管这一修改并不使经过培训的模型本身更安全,但它决定了一种机制的形式,使以后的干预,例如指向指定区域,变得清洁和本地化。 这种干预方式的先例是被涂上钥匙的修改(Olsson等,2022年),这表明建筑改变可以控制机制何时和是否形成(第10.3.5节)。

blocks.en: The case excluded above uses fine-tuning to repair an undesirable behaviour after it has been identified. Intervening on the fine-tuning process itself remains within scope, and persona vectors provide a current example of this approach. A persona vector is an activation-space direction corresponding to a character trait such as sycophancy, hallucination propensity, or malice, extractable automatically from a natural-language trait description ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . Intended and unintended personality changes during fine-tuning correlate strongly with movement along the relevant vector, which yields the monitoring instrument. Preventative steering along the vector during fine-tuning limits acquisition of the trait. Before fine-tuning, projecting training data onto the vector flags data that would induce the trait, at both the dataset and individual-sample levels ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . This instantiates each step of the intervention loop below for the fine-tuning stage.
blocks.zh: 上文排除的情况是在发现不良行为后,通过微调修复不良行为。 对微调过程本身的干预仍然在范围之内,人物矢量提供了这一方法的当前范例. 人称向量是一个活化-空间方向,它与性格特征相对应,如:相通性,幻觉倾向,或恶意取自自然语言特征描述(Chen等,2025b.). 微调过程中有意和无意的个性变化与相关载体的移动密切相关,该载体产生监测仪器。 在微调时沿着矢量进行预防性引导限制特性的获取. 在微调之前,将培训数据投射到将诱发特征的矢量旗数据,包括数据集和个人抽样数据(Chen等人,2025年b)。 这为微调阶段将下面的干预回路的每个步骤分出.

blocks.en: Train-Time Intervention Loop The work discussed so far lays the methodological foundation for intervening in a training run in progress. Below we present a general pipeline. 1. Monitor a target quantity at checkpoints, such as a capability-specific metric (Section 10.3.1 ) or a progress measure on model internals (Section 10.3.2 ). 2. Define the acceptable range for that quantity in advance, including the response to a breach. 3. Intervene when the range is breached, such as by adjusting the data mixture or filtering out unwanted data, applying a targeted architectural or regularisation change, rolling back to a pre-breach checkpoint, and resuming under the adjusted setup. 4. Re-evaluate the model after the intervention to verify that the targeted capability has been suppressed and does not re-emerge during further training. No published system implements this loop end to end at scale. Instead, existing studies have demonstrated individual steps of the proposed workflow.
blocks.zh: 培训时间干预循环 迄今为止所讨论的工作为干预正在进行的培训奠定了方法基础。 下面是一条管道 1. 监测检查站的目标数量,例如具体能力指标(第10.3.1节)或内部模型的进展措施(第10.3.2节)。 2. 事先确定该数量可接受的范围,包括对违反行为的反应。 3. 突破范围时进行干预,例如调整数据混合物或过滤不想要的数据,进行有针对性的建筑或规范化修改,回滚到突破前的检查站,并按调整后的设置恢复。 4. 在干预后重新评价模式,以核实目标能力被抑制,在进一步培训期间不再出现。 没有被公布的系统执行此循环结束来结束规模. 相反,现有的研究显示了拟议工作流程的个别步骤。

blocks.en: Monitor a target quantity at checkpoints, such as a capability-specific metric (Section 10.3.1 ) or a progress measure on model internals (Section 10.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 监测检查站的目标数量,如具体能力指标(第10.3.1节)或示范内部的进展措施(第10.3.2节)。

blocks.en: Define the acceptable range for that quantity in advance, including the response to a breach.
blocks.zh: 事先确定该数量可接受的范围,包括对违反行为的反应。

blocks.en: Intervene when the range is breached, such as by adjusting the data mixture or filtering out unwanted data, applying a targeted architectural or regularisation change, rolling back to a pre-breach checkpoint, and resuming under the adjusted setup.
blocks.zh: 突破范围时进行干涉,如调整数据混合物或过滤出不想要的数据,进行有针对性的建筑或规范化修改,回滚到突破前的检查站,并按调整后的设置恢复.

blocks.en: Re-evaluate the model after the intervention to verify that the targeted capability has been suppressed and does not re-emerge during further training.
blocks.zh: 干预后重新评价模式,以核实目标能力被压制,在再培训期间不会再出现.

blocks.en: Three questions remain about the applicability of these training-time interventions. First, effective data filtering requires identifying which training data contributes to the capability we want to remove. Token-level filtering is motivated by data attribution, but it remains unclear whether methods such as influence functions (Section 11 ) can reliably identify the relevant data. Second, scale: Deep Ignorance operates at 6.9 billion parameters, and while token-level filtering became more effective across the tested scale range ( Rathi & Radford, 2026 ) , it remains open whether data filtering stays effective and affordable at frontier scale.
