Third, deployed models show that stronger train-time safeguards are achievable, but not how: gpt-oss models are substantially harder to fine-tune than comparable open-weight models, and their developers have not fully disclosed their responsible training procedure ( OpenAI et al., 2025 ) . Understanding how this resistance is achieved could help develop similar safeguards for other open-weight models and clarify how fine-tuning changes model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 关于这些培训时间干预措施的适用性,仍有三个问题。 首先,有效的数据过滤需要确定哪些培训数据有助于我们想要去除的能力。 Token级别过滤的动机是数据归属,但影响函数等方法(第11节)能否可靠地识别出相关数据仍然不清楚. 第二,尺度:深度无知以69亿个参数运行,虽然在被测试尺度范围(Rathi & Radford, 2026年)上信使级过滤效果提高,但数据过滤是否在前沿尺度上保持有效且价格可承受,仍然开放. 第三,已部署的模型表明,火车时间保障更有力是可以实现的,但不能说明:gpt-oss模型比可比的开放重量模型更难微调,其开发者尚未充分披露其负责任的培训程序(OpenAI等,2025年)。 了解这种阻力是如何实现的,有助于为其他开量模型制定类似的保障措施并澄清如何微调变化模型的行为.

blocks.en: Learning dynamics can be studied both as an object of explanation, revealing how representations and mechanisms evolve during training, and as an interpretability tool to localise mechanisms, detect phase transitions, and test causal hypotheses through training interventions. Understanding learning dynamics can also help predict when capabilities emerge and guide interventions during training. However, no complete system combining monitoring and intervention has yet been demonstrated at scale. This section focuses on how models change during training, while Section 11 examines how individual training examples contribute to model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 学习动态既可作为一个解释对象来研究,揭示表现和机制在培训过程中如何演变,也可作为一个解释工具来使机制本地化,检测阶段过渡,并通过培训干预测试因果假设. 了解学习动态也有助于预测何时出现能力,并指导培训期间的干预措施。 然而,还没有大规模地展示出将监测和干预结合起来的完整系统。 本节侧重于模型在培训过程中的变化,而第11节则审查个人培训实例如何促进模型行为。

blocks.en: 11 Training Data Attribution
blocks.zh: 11 培训数据分配

blocks.en: For a model behaviour of interest, Sections 6 – 10 study the internal features, components, and their interactions and evolutions that produce the behaviour. Training data attribution (TDA) shifts the focus from model internals to training data, searching for training samples that strongly shaped the model behaviour. TDA applications include, but are not limited to, identifying influential training samples, detecting train–test leakage, and diagnosing model failures without retraining ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Park et al., 2023 ; Grosse et al., 2023 ). Although TDA is not generally a mechanistic method under this survey’s criteria, it can complement mechanistic interpretability in many ways. For example, by revealing how specific training samples shape malicious behaviour, TDA can enable effective training data filtering to prevent unwanted behaviours or even their internal mechanisms from forming during the training of next-generation models. Motivated by this application, this section focuses on post-hoc training data attribution methods that link a given target model’s behaviour to its training samples. This section excludes techniques for intervening in the data pipeline, such as filtering pretraining corpora, rebalancing demographic representation, and scheduling memorisation.
blocks.zh: 对于关注的模型行为,第6–10节研究产生行为的内部特征,组成部分,以及它们的相互作用和演化. 培训数据归属(TDA)将重点从模式内部转移到了培训数据,寻找对模式行为产生强烈影响的培训样本. TDA应用包括但不限于识别有影响力的培训样本、检测火车-测试渗出和诊断模型故障而不进行再培训(Liu等人,2025a; Park等,2023;Grosse等,2023.). 虽然在本次调查的标准下,TDA一般不是一种机械方法,但它可以在许多方面补充机械解释. 例如,通过揭示特定培训样本如何形成恶意行为,TDA能够有效进行培训数据过滤,以防止不必要的行为,甚至防止其内部机制在下一代模型的培训过程中形成. 本节以这一应用为动力,着重介绍将特定目标模型的行为与其培训样本联系起来的热后培训数据归属方法。 本节排除了干预数据管道的技术,例如过滤预培训公司、重新平衡人口代表性和安排记忆。

blocks.en: TDA falls into two complementary approaches. Verbatim data attribution detects explicit memorisation by identifying exact or near-exact string matches between model outputs and the training corpus. These searches can scale to trillions of tokens using techniques such as suffix arrays and infini-gram models. Gradient-based data attribution estimates how training samples affect model parameters and predictions and can capture influential samples that do not manifest as verbatim reproduction. The two types of methods provide orthogonal views: one answers “did the model use rote memorisation on a training sample to answer this question?”; the other answers “how much did this training sample influence this certain behaviour of this model?”
blocks.zh: TDA分为两种相辅相成的办法。 逐字记录数据属性通过确定模型产出与培训内容之间的精确或接近准确的字符串匹配,来探测出明确的记忆。 这些搜索可以使用后缀阵列和infini-gram模型等技术,被放大到数以万亿计的令牌. 基于渐变的数据归属估计培训样本如何影响模型参数和预测,并能够捕捉不表现为逐字记录的有影响力的样本. 这两类方法提供了正统观点:一种答案是“该模型是否在培训样本中使用了轮回记忆来回答这个问题?” 另一种答案是“这一培训样本在多大程度上影响了这一模型的某些行为? “

blocks.en: 11.1 Verbatim Data Attribution: OLMoTrace and Maximal Matching Spans
blocks.zh: 11.1 逐字记录 数据归属: OLMoTrace和 Maximal 匹配 Spans

blocks.en: Earlier corpus search tools such as the ROOTS Search Tool ( Piktus et al., 2023a ) and GAIA Search ( Piktus et al., 2023b ) established the practice of querying pretraining corpora for transparency and data exploration. OLMoTrace ( Liu et al., 2025a ) scales this to trillions of tokens using a combination of suffix arrays, infini-gram models, and maximal matching span extraction ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , making it less a data-attribution method in the influence-function sense and more a retrieval tool for identifying content the model may have memorised.
blocks.zh: 早期的物联网搜索工具如ROOTS搜索工具(Piktus等,2023年a)和GAIA搜索(Piktus等,2023年b)确立了为透明度和数据探索而查询预训公司的做法. OLMoTrace(Liu等,2025a.)利用后缀阵列,infini-gram模型,以及最大比对跨取(Liu等,2024a.)等组合,将它缩放到数以万亿计的代币上,使其较少成为影响函数意义上的数据分配方法,更是用于识别该模型可能包含的内容的检索工具.

blocks.en: Suffix Arrays (SA) The suffix array of a string x x of length T 1 T_{1} is an array of integers representing the starting positions of all suffixes of x x in lexicographic order. It enables efficient substring searches in 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ⋅ log ⁡ T 1 ) \mathcal{O}(T_{2}\cdot\log T_{1}) time for a query of length T 2 T_{2} , compared to 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ⋅ T 1 ) \mathcal{O}(T_{2}\cdot T_{1}) naive search. blocks.en: Infini-Gram Models An infini-gram model extends the n-gram model to arbitrary-length prefixes, using backoff to the longest matching sequence in the training corpus. Formally, for a token w i w_{i} : P ∞ ( w i ∣ w 1 : i − 1 ) = cnt ( w i − n + 1 : i ∣ 𝒟 ) cnt ( w i − n + 1 : i − 1 ∣ 𝒟 ) , n = max { n ′ : cnt ( w i − n ′ + 1 : i − 1 ∣ 𝒟 ) > 0 } , P_{\infty}(w_{i}\mid w_{1:i-1})=\frac{\text{cnt}(w_{i-n+1:i}\mid\mathcal{D})}{\text{cnt}(w_{i-n+1:i-1}\mid\mathcal{D})},\quad n=\max\{n^{\prime}:\text{cnt}(w_{i-n^{\prime}+1:i-1}\mid\mathcal{D})>0\}, where w 1 : i − 1 w_{1:i-1} are preceding tokens and 𝒟 \mathcal{D} is the training corpus. Infini-grams are implemented on top of suffix arrays, which allow fast substring queries across massive corpora.

blocks.en: Maximal Matching Spans Given a model output and a training corpus, a maximal matching span is a contiguous sequence of tokens that: 1. Appears verbatim at least once in the training data, 2. Does not break words or include spurious delimiters (e.g., periods or newlines) except at span boundaries, and 3. Is not contained within a longer span that satisfies 1. and 2. OLMoTrace identifies maximal matching spans by combining suffix-array search with infini-gram queries, adjusting boundaries for tokenisation, and retaining only the longest non-overlapping spans.
blocks.zh: 最大匹配 Spans 给定一个模型输出和一个训练大纲,最大匹配跨度是一个相接的符号序列: 1. 在训练数据中至少逐字显示一次,2. 除跨边界外,不断字或包括虚假的划界人(如期或新线),和3. 并非控制在满足1和2的更长的时间内。 电话 Trace通过将后缀-阵列搜索和infini-gram查询合并,调整边界以表示标识,并仅保留最长的非重叠跨度来识别最大匹配跨度.

For each token starting a new word, query the suffix array with infini-gram to find the longest matching prefix in the training corpus. 3. Adjust span boundaries to avoid breaking words or including delimiters. 4. Retain only maximal spans (not contained in longer matches). Example Spans Found: • “Celine Dion […] Born on March 30, 1968, in” • “Charlemagne, Quebec, Canada, Dion began” • “performing at a young age and gained […]” • “Her career took off when she won the 1988” • “Eurovision Song Contest with the song ’Ne” This process links language model output directly to the training corpus, enabling identification and attribution of memorised content.

blocks.en: OLMoTrace Algorithm Inputs: Model output tokens S 1 L S_{1}^{L} , training corpus tokens T 1 N T_{1}^{N} , suffix array A 1 N A_{1}^{N} Steps: 1. Scan each token position t t in S 1 L S_{1}^{L} , considering only tokens starting a new word. 2. Query the suffix array A 1 N A_{1}^{N} to find candidate matching positions in the training corpus. 3. Use infini-gram queries to determine the longest matching prefix starting at t t , backing off to shorter n-grams if necessary. 4. Adjust the match length to avoid breaking words or including spurious delimiters. 5. Collect all spans ( t , t + length ) (t,t+\text{length}) that satisfy the above criteria. 6. Filter out spans contained within longer overlapping spans to retain only maximal matches.

blocks.en: Verbatim attribution excels at factual memorisation but struggles with compositional or synthesised outputs. For tasks like translation, poetry, or reasoning, OLMoTrace (and other verbatim matching methods) can identify spans of text that appear in the training data, but these matches do not explain how the model combined information from multiple sources to produce the output.
blocks.zh: 逐字记录的归属优于事实记忆,但却与组成或综合产出相冲突。 对于翻译,诗歌,或推理等任务,OLMoTrace(以及其他的逐字记录匹配方法)可以识别出训练数据中出现的文本的跨度,但这些匹配并不能解释模型如何将来自多来源的信息相融合以产生输出.

blocks.zh: 11.2.2 Bregman近亲反应和通用高斯-牛顿

blocks.en: Empirical results show that the original form of influence functions introduced above performs poorly in practice. This is due to multiple assumptions that rarely hold in practice. For example, for a trained neural network, its parameters θ \theta are scarcely exactly at the local or global minimum θ ∗ \theta^{*} . Additionally, the Hessian H θ ∗ H_{\theta^{*}} is usually non-invertible or numerically unstable due to some small eigenvalues. These limitations motivate researchers to formulate influence functions without unrealistic assumptions. One classical approach is called the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) ( Bae et al., 2022 ) . It targets model parameters which minimise the new training objective while staying close to the original parameters. Below, we sketch its core idea.
blocks.zh: 经验结果显示,上述影响功能的原始形式在实践中表现不佳。 这是由于实践中很少存在的多种假设。 例如,对于一个训练有素的神经网络来说,其参数 \\theta 几乎完全处于当地或全球的最低值 \ *\theta 。 此外,由于一些小的等分值,黑森H → * H_{\theta → 通常非倒数或数字不稳定. 这些限制促使研究人员在没有不切实际的假设的情况下制定影响函数. 一种古典方法称为近发Bregman反应功能(PBRF)(Bae等,2022年). 它的目标是在接近原始参数的同时尽量减少新的培训目标的模式参数。 下面我们描绘它的核心想法。

blocks.en: The size of the GGN matrix G ∈ ℝ p × p G\in\mathbb{R}^{p\times p} (where p p is the number of model parameters) can be extremely large for modern language models, which makes the calculation of ( G + λ ​ I ) − 1 (G+\lambda I)^{-1} computationally expensive. As a result, follow-up methods have avoided explicitly calculating this inverse matrix by borrowing techniques from the optimisation literature.

blocks.en: EK-FAC ( George et al., 2018 ) improved K-FAC by correcting its eigenvalues. Recent work has adopted this technique to scale the influence function method to modern LLMs ( Grosse et al., 2023 ) . ASTRA ( Wang et al., 2025a ) further used EK-FAC as a preconditioner for Neumann series iterations, achieving higher-quality GGN-vector products with less hyperparameter tuning. These efforts make influence functions increasingly practical for modern language models with billions of parameters.
blocks.zh: EK-FAC(George等,2018年)通过校正其等值来改进了K-FAC. 最近的工作采用了这一方法,将影响函数法扩大到现代LLMs(Grosse等,2023年)。 ASTRA (Wang等,2025a.)进一步将EK-FAC作为Neumann系列迭代的前提条件,实现了质量较高的GGN-活性产品,超参数调制较少. 这些努力使影响功能对具有数十亿参数的现代语言模型越来越实用.

blocks.en: 11.2.4 Retraining-Based Influence Estimation: datamodels and TRAK
blocks.zh: 11.2.4 基于再培训的影响估计:数据模型和TRAK

blocks.en: Some methods have explored retraining the model to estimate the attribution. The most naive method is to upweight or remove each training sample, retrain the model on the modified training set, and observe changes in the model’s output on the testing sample. Ilyas et al. (2022) proposed datamodels to more efficiently estimate each training sample’s attribution on a testing sample by retraining many models on random subsets of the training data and fitting a linear regression that predicts the model output on the testing sample from binary indicators of whether each training sample was included. Each fitted coefficient then represents the training sample’s influence on the testing sample.
blocks.zh: 一些方法探索了再培训模型来估计归属. 最天真的方法是提升或去除每个训练样本,在被修改的训练集上重新训练模型,并观察模型在测试样本上输出的变化. Ilyas等人(2022年)提议采用数据模型,通过再培训培训数据随机子集的许多模型,并安装线性回归,从二进制指标中预测测试样本的模型输出,以确定是否包括每个培训样本,从而更有效地估计每个培训样本的归属。 然后,每个匹配系数代表培训样本对测试样本的影响。

blocks.en: However, datamodels remains computationally expensive because it requires training many models. Tracing with the Randomly-projected After Kernel (TRAK; Park et al., 2023 ) provides a more efficient alternative. TRAK first uses a first-order Taylor expansion around the model parameters to approximate a trained model as a linear model. It then applies random projections to reduce gradient dimensionality and estimate training-sample influence in this lower-dimensional space. Finally, it averages the estimates across a small number of trained models to reduce variability due to training randomness. TRAK achieves attribution quality comparable to datamodels at substantially lower computational cost ( Park et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,数据模型的计算成本仍然很高,因为它需要培训许多模型。 以随机预测的Kernel(TRAK;Park等,2023年)进行追踪,提供了更有效的替代品。 TRAK首先使用一阶泰勒围绕模型参数的扩展来取近于训练有素的模型作为线性模型. 然后应用随机预测来降低梯度维度,并估计这个下维空间的训练-抽样影响. 最后,它平均衡量少数训练有素模型的估计数,以减少因训练随机性而出现的可变性。 TRAK以低得多的计算成本实现了与数据模型可比的归属质量(Park等,2023.).

blocks.en: 11.2.5 Efficient Influence Estimation Using Training Trajectories: TracIn
blocks.zh: 11.2.5 利用培训轨迹进行有效的影响估计:TracIn

blocks.en: TracIn ( Garima et al., 2020 ) estimates training-data influence using gradients evaluated along the training trajectory, without computing the inverse Hessian. Its core idea follows from the effect of a single Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD; Robbins & Monro, 1951 ) update on the loss of a testing sample.
blocks.zh: TracIn(Garima等人,2020年)利用沿训练轨迹评价的梯度来估计训练-数据影响,而不计算反向黑森. 其核心思想取自于单一Stochastic Gradient Egency(SGD; Robbins & Monro,1951年)对测试样本丢失的更新.

blocks.en: 11.2.6 Illustrative Example
blocks.zh: 11.2.6 说明性实例

blocks.en: Gradient-based influence functions can identify influential training samples without requiring them to exactly match the current model output. They complement verbatim attribution and reveal subtler influences. Below, we provide an example of using them for the English-to-Chinese translation task.
blocks.zh: 基于渐变的影响力功能可以识别有影响力的训练样本而不需要它们与目前的模型输出完全匹配. 它们补充了逐字记录,并揭示出更微妙的影响。 下面,我们举出一个例子,说明如何在英文对中文的翻译工作中使用它们。

blocks.en: 11.2.7 Recent Extensions and Limitations
blocks.zh: 11.2.7 最近延长和限制

blocks.en: Recent work extends training data attribution to handle training stochasticity. Distributional TDA (d-TDA) estimates how output distributions depend on the dataset ( Mlodozeniec et al., 2025 ) . Georgiev et al. (2023) proposed TRAK variants to address diffusion models. More recent work connects TDA directly to mechanistic interpretability ( Kowal et al., 2026 ; Habibi et al., 2026 ) ; for example, Kowal et al. (2026) introduced Concept Influence to enable attribution at the level of semantic concepts represented by model internals such as sparse autoencoder features. This brings TDA closer to the mechanistic goal of understanding how training data shapes specific internal computations. However, fundamental technical challenges persist, including approximation errors that compound over the training trajectory, variability across training runs caused by randomness like data ordering, and memory and computational bottlenecks of scaling to frontier models. These limitations motivate further research in this direction.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将培训数据的归属扩大到处理培训的花样。 分布式TDA(d-TDA)估计产出分布如何依赖于数据集(Mlodozeniec等,2025.). Georgiev等 (2023)提出了TRAK的变体,以解决扩散模型. 更近期的工作将TDA与机械解释直接联系起来(Kowal等,2026;Habibi等,2026;例如Kowal等. (2026年)引入了"概念影响"(Concept Effective),以便在语义概念的层次上归属,其代表的有"模型内部",如稀有的自编码器特征等. 这使得TDA更接近于了解培训数据如何塑造具体内部计算机械化的目标. 然而,根本的技术挑战依然存在,包括近似误差使训练轨迹更为复杂,数据订购等随机性造成各种训练的多变性,以及缩小到前沿模型的内存和计算瓶颈。 这些限制促使在这方面开展进一步研究。

blocks.en: Training data attribution traces model behaviour back to the training data. Verbatim methods such as OLMoTrace identify memorised spans, while gradient-based methods such as influence functions estimate the contribution of individual training samples to downstream model predictions. These approaches remain limited at scale. Meanwhile, recent work has begun linking data attribution to internal features and mechanisms. Having surveyed the main methodological families of AI interpretability in the preceding sections, Section 12 organises them into six research orientations that differ in their goals, assumptions, and paths forward.
blocks.zh: 培训数据归属追踪模型行为可追溯到培训数据. OLMoTrace等平面方法识别出被记忆的跨度,而影响函数等梯度法则估计出单个培训样本对下游模型预测的贡献. 这些办法的规模仍然有限。 与此同时,最近的工作已开始将数据归属与内部特征和机制联系起来。 在前几节中调查了AI可解释性的主要方法体系之后,第12节将其组织成在目标、假设和前进方向上各不相同的六个研究方向。

blocks.en: 12 Six Research Orientations
blocks.zh: 12个研究方向

blocks.en: An orientation is a coherent research programme defined by its goals, assumptions, and trade-offs. In contrast, a method is an established modular pipeline that may be used in different orientations. In AI interpretability, different research goals, such as developing ready-to-use safety measures or achieving complete mechanistic understanding, have led to distinct research programmes. This section organises six major research orientations and summarises their scientific objectives, core assumptions, characteristic methods, and limitations ( Nanda et al., 2025 ; Gao, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Hoogland et al., 2023 ; Barez, 2026 ; Biderman et al., 2026 ; Figure 17 ). Note that no single orientation is universally preferable. The choice depends on the research objective, deployment context, available resources, and tolerance for different forms of uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 一个取向是根据其目标、假设和取舍确定的一致研究方案。 相形之下,一种方法是一种既定的模块化管道,可用于不同的取向. 在AI可解释性中,不同的研究目标,如制定即用安全措施或实现完全的机械化理解,导致了不同的研究方案. 本节组织六大研究方向并总结其科学目标,核心假设,特征方法和局限性(Nanda等,2025;Gao等,2025;Li等,2025a;Hoogland等,2023;Barez,2026;Biderman等,2026;图17). 注意没有单一方向是普遍可取的. 选择取决于研究目标、部署背景、可用资源以及对不同形式的不确定性的容忍。

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Six research orientations of AI interpretability.
blocks.zh: 图17:AI可解释性的六个研究取向.

blocks.en: 12.1 Pragmatic Interpretability: Proxy-Task-Oriented Safety Interventions
blocks.zh: 12.1 实用 解释性:代理任务导向的安全干预

blocks.en: Pragmatic Interpretability focuses on doing the research most helpful for longer-term alignment and interpretability goals, such as helping AGI go well ( Nanda et al., 2025 ) . Proponents argue that full mechanistic understanding is not required to have significant impact; instead, researchers should prioritise the work most likely to help ( Nanda et al., 2025 ) . The central idea is to work on a set of operationally meaningful proxy tasks that can be empirically studied on models today to help make powerful future models safe. Researchers are agnostic about which methods they use, even if they do not involve model internals. Though not required, these proxy tasks may also be directly useful on today’s deployed systems, providing valuable feedback.
blocks.zh: 实用解释性侧重于开展最有助于长期调整和解释目标的研究,如帮助AGI顺利进行(Nanda等,2025年)。 支持者认为,完全的机械化理解并不需要产生显著影响;相反,研究者应优先考虑最可能帮助的工作(Nanda等,2025年)。 中心思想是致力于一套具有操作意义的代用任务,这些代用任务可以在今天的模型上进行实证研究来帮助使强大的未来模型安全. 研究者对于他们所使用的方法是不可知的,即使它们不涉及模型内部. 这些代理任务虽然不需要,但也可能对今天部署的系统直接有用,提供宝贵的反馈。

blocks.en: A representative example is the study of Claude Sonnet 4.5’s evaluation awareness ( Anthropic, 2025a ) . The system was shown to condition its behaviour on the presence of evaluation signals, making results from safety evaluations used for previous models harder to interpret. Researchers identified and applied a steering vector that suppresses this awareness, allowing evaluation of its actual behaviour. While this study does not fully explain the internal mechanism of evaluation awareness, it is sufficient to produce a concrete and safety-relevant behavioural change, illustrating the pragmatic philosophy.
blocks.zh: 一个有代表性的例子是对克洛德·索内4.5的评价意识的研究(Anthropic,2025a.). 该系统显示其行为以存在评价信号为条件,使以往模型使用的安全评价结果更难解释。 研究人员确定并运用了抑制这种认识的向导,从而可以评估其实际行为。 虽然本研究没有充分解释评价意识的内部机制,但只要作出与安全相关的具体行为改变就足够了,这说明了务实的理念。

blocks.en: Another example is Marks et al. (2025b) . In this case, researchers constructed a proxy task: they fine-tuned a model with a hidden goal, then blinded teams of researchers audited the model to discover it. This served as a proxy task for detecting a naturally emerging hidden goal in a future model. The different auditing teams used different techniques, allowing researchers to compare their efficacy.
blocks.zh: 另一个例子是Marks等人(2025年b). 在这种情况下,研究者构建了一个代用任务:他们用隐藏的目标微调了一个模型,然后盲目的研究者团队对模型进行了审计以发现. 这是一项代用任务,用于发现未来模式中自然出现的隐藏目标。 不同的审计团队使用不同的技术,使研究人员能够比较其功效.

blocks.en: Common techniques in this paradigm include: • Steering vectors , which shift models to targeted behaviours. • Probes , which detect latent safety-relevant properties in activations. • Behavioural monitoring and anomaly detection , which track signals indicative of emerging risks, such as monitoring the model’s verbalised reasoning. • Prompting , an effective black-box baseline method for steering model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 这一范式中的共同技术包括: 引导载体,将模式转向目标行为. • 探测器,探测激活中潜在的安全相关特性。 • 行为监测和异常检测,追踪显示新出现的风险的信号,例如监测模型的口头推理。 • 推动指导模式行为的有效黑箱基线方法。

blocks.en: Steering vectors , which shift models to targeted behaviours.
blocks.zh: 将模式转向目标行为。

blocks.en: Probes , which detect latent safety-relevant properties in activations.
blocks.zh: 探测器 探测激活中 潜在的安全特性

blocks.en: Behavioural monitoring and anomaly detection , which track signals indicative of emerging risks, such as monitoring the model’s verbalised reasoning.
blocks.zh: 行为监测和异常检测,追踪显示新出现的风险的信号,例如监测模型的口语推理。

blocks.en: Prompting , an effective black-box baseline method for steering model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 提示,一个有效的黑盒基线方法 用于引导模型行为。

blocks.en: Recent work following this pragmatic trajectory has demonstrated effective control of refusal behaviour ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) and evaluation awareness ( Anthropic, 2025a ) . These interventions provide direct gains to contemporary systems. However, they may not (and are not designed to) fully explain how models implement their behaviours.
blocks.zh: 遵循这一务实轨迹的近期工作表明,有效控制了拒绝行为(Arditi等人,2024年)和评价意识(Anthropic,2025a年)。 这些干预措施为当代系统提供了直接收益。 然而,它们可能(或并非旨在)没有充分解释模型如何实施其行为。

blocks.en: 12.2 Ambitious Interpretability: Towards Complete Mechanistic Understanding
blocks.zh: 12.2 雄心勃勃的可解释性: 实现完全的机械理解

blocks.en: In contrast to pragmatic approaches, Ambitious Interpretability seeks a comprehensive mechanistic understanding of how models implement their computations ( Gao, 2025 ) . Proponents argue that partial or surface-level understanding cannot guarantee safety in next-generation systems. Full understanding is needed to rule out hidden failure modes or deceptive internal dynamics. Specifically, Ambitious Interpretability does not treat interpretability as a collection of useful heuristics. Instead, it treats interpretability as a scientific objective: to reverse-engineer the model and develop a transparent, predictive theory of its internal algorithms.
blocks.zh: 与务实做法相反,远大解释寻求对模型如何实施计算的全面机械化理解(Gao,2025年)。 支持者认为,部分或地表层面的理解不能保证下一代系统的安全. 要排除隐藏的失败模式或欺骗性内部动态,需要充分理解. 具体地说,远大可解释性并不将可解释性视为有用的heuristics的集合. 相反,它把可解释性视为一个科学目标:倒置-引擎模型,并发展出对其内部算法的透明,可预测的理论.

blocks.en: Ambitious Interpretability particularly emphasises metric-driven progress . Motivated by the fact that existing mechanistic approaches still struggle with stringent metrics, it proposes starting with looser ones, tracking and improving methods’ performance on them, and adopting stricter metrics when suitable. Two example metrics by Gao (2025) are: • Feature quality: demonstrating that extracted features and their natural-language explanations are faithful and simulatable. • Circuit faithfulness: demonstrating circuits are necessary and sufficient for explaining behaviour via causal intervention (e.g., causal scrubbing ( Chan et al., 2022a ) ), without performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 雄心勃勃的可解释性特别强调了衡量驱动的进展。 由于现有的机械方法仍然与严格的衡量标准相冲突,它提议从松散的衡量标准入手,跟踪和改进衡量方法的绩效,并酌情采用更严格的衡量标准。 Gao(2025年)的两例衡量标准是: • 地物质量:证明所提取的地物及其自然语言解释是忠实和可模拟的. · 电路忠诚度:显示电路对于通过因果干预(如因果洗涤(Chan等,2022a))解释行为是必要而充分的,没有性能退化.

blocks.en: Feature quality: demonstrating that extracted features and their natural-language explanations are faithful and simulatable.
blocks.zh: 特征质量:证明所提取的特征及其自然语言解释是忠实和可模拟的.

blocks.en: Circuit faithfulness: demonstrating circuits are necessary and sufficient for explaining behaviour via causal intervention (e.g., causal scrubbing ( Chan et al., 2022a ) ), without performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 电路忠诚度:显示电路对于通过因果干预(如因果洗涤(Chan等,2022a.))解释行为是必要而充分的,没有性能退化.

blocks.en: The disadvantage of this ambition is its cost. Fine-grained mechanistic analysis of frontier large models is computationally expensive and sometimes intractable. As Gao (2025) emphasised, current tools still fall far short of the coverage and robustness required for a truly comprehensive understanding.
blocks.zh: 这种野心的缺点在于其代价. 对前沿大型模型的精细机械分析在计算上是昂贵的,有时是难以解决的。 正如加奥(2025年)所强调,目前的工具仍然远远没有达到真正全面理解所需的覆盖面和力度。

blocks.en: The emergence of interpretability-by-design models (Section 6.10 ) blurs the boundary between Ambitious and Pragmatic Interpretability. These methods ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Pearce et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2025 ; Oldfield et al., 2024 ) aim to make representations and circuits easier to understand by modifying model architectures rather than relying entirely on post-hoc reverse engineering. This practical change to model design pursues the ambitious goal of mechanistic understanding. However, it remains unclear whether these methods can ultimately achieve complete mechanistic understanding. In the short term, they may simply represent a separate “Engineering” orientation in which interpretability is treated as an optimisation objective.
blocks.zh: 逐一可解释性-设计模型(第6.10节)的出现模糊了安比特和实用可解释性的分界线. 这些方法(Gao等,2026;Pearce等,2025;Park等,2025;Oldfield等,2024)旨在通过修改模型架构,而不是完全依赖后热逆向工程,使表达和回路更容易理解. 这种对模型设计的实际改变,追求机械理解的宏伟目标. 然而,仍然不清楚这些方法能否最终实现完全的机械化理解. 在短期内,它们可能只是代表一个单独的“工程”取向,在这种取向中,可解释性被视为一个优化目标。

blocks.en: 12.3 Developmental Interpretability: Characterising How Models Learn
blocks.zh: 12.3 发展 可解释性:说明模型如何学习

blocks.en:
Complementing post-hoc analysis of trained models, Developmental Interpretability ( Hoogland et al., 2023 ; Hoogland et al., 2025 )
treats the training process itself as an object of scientific inquiry. Taking a learning-theory perspective, it aims to mathematically formalise the emergence and evolution of model representations, effective complexity, and capabilities throughout training.
blocks.zh:
补充对训练有素模型的事后分析,发展解释性(Hogland等,2023;Hogland等,2025)
将培训过程本身视为科学调查的对象。 它从学习理论的角度出发,力求在整个培训过程中,在数学上将模型表达的出现和演变、有效的复杂性和能力正规化。

blocks.en: Its central claim is that many neural network properties which are hard to analyse through a fixed model checkpoint can be understood through their developmental process. This process contains measurable, modelable signatures that can serve as proxies for the model’s properties of interest, such as developmental stages, phase transitions, and other organising principles that help mathematically explain how complex behaviours emerge and evolve throughout training. A classic example is the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) introduced in Sections 10.2.1 and 10.3.4 . It successfully serves as a signature of the model’s effective complexity, allowing us to observe developmental transitions and compare two models with the same training loss.
blocks.zh: 其核心主张是,许多神经网络属性很难通过固定的模型检查点进行分析,可以通过它们的开发过程来理解. 这一过程包含可衡量、可模拟的签名,可以作为模型利益特性的代名词,如发展阶段、相向过渡,以及有助于从数学角度解释在整个培训过程中复杂行为的出现和演变的其他组织原则。 一个典型的例子是第10.2.1和10.3.4节中引入的地方学习系数。 它成功地代表了模型的有效复杂性,使我们能够观察发展过渡,并将两个模型与同样的培训损失进行比较。

blocks.en: Methods in this paradigm include: • Singular Learning Theory (SLT) and related mathematical frameworks for characterising developmental stages, symmetry breaking, and changes in the geometry of the loss landscape during training. • Checkpoint-based analysis to track the emergence of representations and mechanisms by applying specialised probes, feature discovery methods, and circuit analyses across a model’s training checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 这个范式中的方法包括: • Singular Learning Theory (SLT) 和相关的数学框架,用于描述发展阶段的特征,对称断裂,以及在训练中损失地貌几何的变化. · 以检查站为基础的分析,通过应用专门的探测器、特征发现方法和跨模型培训检查站的电路分析来跟踪表述和机制的出现。

blocks.en: Singular Learning Theory (SLT) and related mathematical frameworks for characterising developmental stages, symmetry breaking, and changes in the geometry of the loss landscape during training.
blocks.zh: Singular Learning Theory(SLT)和相关的数学框架,用于描述发展阶段的特征,对称断裂,以及在训练中损失地貌几何变化.

blocks.en: Checkpoint-based analysis to track the emergence of representations and mechanisms by applying specialised probes, feature discovery methods, and circuit analyses across a model’s training checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 基于检查站的分析,通过应用专门的探测器、特征发现方法和跨模型培训检查站的电路分析来跟踪表述和机制的出现。

blocks.en: More specifically, Developmental Interpretability aims to answer questions such as: Can we characterise the development of model capabilities or behaviours as phase transitions during training? What developmental stages precede the formation of a certain mechanism? How does the optimisation process transform distributed representations into structured mechanisms? Unlike Interpretability Across Time (detailed in Section 12.4 ), which emphasises forecasting and controlling future model behaviour, Developmental Interpretability is primarily concerned with understanding the developmental processes that produce those behaviours. Its primary goal is rigorous scientific explanation rather than predicting or intervening on capabilities.
blocks.zh: 更具体地说,发展可解释性的目的是回答以下问题: 我们能否将示范能力或行为的发展定性为培训期间的相向过渡? 在形成某种机制之前有哪些发展阶段? 优化过程如何将分布式表述转化为结构化机制? 与强调预测和控制未来模式行为的跨时间可解释性(详见第12.4节)不同,发展可解释性主要涉及了解产生这些行为的发展进程。 其主要目标是严格的科学解释,而不是预测或干预能力。

blocks.en: 12.4 Interpretability Across Time: Understanding the Causes of Model Behaviours
blocks.zh: 12.4 可解释性 跨时间:了解示范行为的原因

blocks.en: Like Developmental Interpretability, Interpretability Across Time ( Biderman et al., 2023b ; Biderman et al., 2026 ) treats a model as a time-evolving process shaped by its training data, loss functions, architectures, and optimisation dynamics. However, the two orientations differ in their primary goals. Developmental Interpretability mainly focuses on characterising the developmental processes that give rise to the model’s internal features, mechanisms, and capabilities. In contrast, Interpretability Across Time seeks established knowledge of learning that is (1) sufficiently predictive to estimate important model properties before training is complete, (2) sufficiently causal to identify when and why undesirable trajectories arise, and (3) sufficiently precise to enable interventions on the learning process itself ( Biderman et al., 2026 ) . From a safety perspective, this orientation aims to understand and ultimately shape the training process to prevent the model from developing undesirable behaviours in the first place rather than repairing them after they develop.
blocks.zh: 与开发可解释性一样,跨时间可解释性(Biderman等,2023b;Biderman等,2026)将模型视为由培训数据,损失函数,架构,优化动态所塑造的分时演化过程. 然而,这两个方向在主要目标上有所不同. 发展可解释性主要侧重于描述导致模型内部特征、机制和能力的发展过程。 相比之下,跨越时间的可解释性则寻求既有的学习知识,即(1) 在培训完成前有足够的预测能力估计出重要的模型属性,(2) 有足够的因果关系来确定何时和为何会出现不良的轨迹,(3) 足够精确,以便能够对学习过程本身进行干预(Biderman等,2026年)。 从安全角度看,这种取向旨在理解并最终塑造培训过程,以防止该模式首先发展出不良行为,而不是在发展出不良行为之后加以修复。

blocks.en: Interpretability Across Time builds on three areas of research. First, scaling-law studies show that model performance can be predicted from factors such as model size, training data, and compute ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ). This motivates similar efforts to predict safety-relevant model properties ( Ganguli et al., 2022 ; Jones et al., 2025 ) . Second, longitudinal mechanistic studies track how internal mechanisms develop during training ( Tigges et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2024 ) . Third, studies of training data show that the training distribution can affect downstream model behaviour. For example, Razeghi et al. (2022) found that few-shot numerical reasoning performance depends strongly on the frequency of relevant terms in pretraining data, while Elazar et al. (2023) estimated the causal effects of pretraining-data statistics on factual predictions. Interpretability Across Time builds on these findings to predict and influence safety-relevant model behaviour during training.
blocks.zh: 跨时间的可解释性基于三个研究领域。 首先,缩放法研究表明,模型性能可以从模型大小,培训数据,和计算等因素来预测(Kaplan等,2020;Hoffmann等,2022. 这促使人们作出类似努力,预测与安全有关的模型特性(Ganguli等,2022;Jones等,2025)。 第二,纵向机械学研究跟踪内部机制在培训期间的发展情况(Tigges等人,2024;Singh等人,2024)。 第三,对培训数据的研究表明,培训分布可影响下游模式行为。 例如,Razeghi等人(2022年)发现,几发数字推理性能在很大程度上取决于预训数据中相关术语的频率,而Elazar等人则发现. (2023年)估算了培训前数据统计对事实预测的因果关系. 随时间推移的可解释性以这些调查结果为基础,预测和影响培训期间与安全有关的示范行为。

blocks.en: Methods in this paradigm include: • Longitudinal analysis of model internals, tracking representations, features, or implemented mechanisms across checkpoints to determine when and how they form and evolve. • Monitoring training runs and forecasting future behaviour, using early behavioural or internal signals to predict later capabilities, biases, or unsafe behaviours before they are fully expressed. • Training-process interventions and design , manipulating data, activations, objectives, architectures, or other aspects of optimisation to encourage desirable developmental trajectories, prevent undesirable capabilities or behaviours from arising, or ensure that learned information is represented in ways that make it easier to control.
blocks.zh: 这一范式中的方法包括: 对示范内部进行纵向分析,跟踪表现、特征或实施跨检查站的机制,以确定它们何时、如何形成和发展。 • 监测培训并预测未来的行为,利用早期行为或内部信号,在充分表达后期能力、偏见或不安全行为之前作出预测。 • 培训-进程干预和设计、操纵数据、激活、目标、结构或优化的其他方面,以鼓励理想的发展轨迹,防止出现不良能力或行为,或确保以更容易控制的方式反映学到的信息。

blocks.en: Longitudinal analysis of model internals, tracking representations, features, or implemented mechanisms across checkpoints to determine when and how they form and evolve.
blocks.zh: 对模式内部进行纵向分析,跟踪表述、特征或实施跨检查站的机制,以确定其何时、如何形成和发展。

blocks.en: Monitoring training runs and forecasting future behaviour, using early behavioural or internal signals to predict later capabilities, biases, or unsafe behaviours before they are fully expressed.
blocks.zh: 监测培训是利用早期行为或内部信号,在充分表达后期能力、偏见或不安全行为之前,进行并预测未来行为。

blocks.en: Training-process interventions and design , manipulating data, activations, objectives, architectures, or other aspects of optimisation to encourage desirable developmental trajectories, prevent undesirable capabilities or behaviours from arising, or ensure that learned information is represented in ways that make it easier to control.
blocks.zh: 培训-流程干预和设计、操纵数据、激活、目标、结构或优化的其他方面,以鼓励理想的发展轨迹,防止出现不良能力或行为,或确保所学到的信息能够更容易地加以控制。

blocks.en: Several studies have examined whether safety risks can be identified before or during training. Zhang et al. (2026b) found that model activations measured before fine-tuning can predict alignment scores after fine-tuning. Similarly, Wang et al. (2026a) identified internal features associated with emergent misalignment, which could sometimes detect misalignment before behavioural evaluations did. Other studies found that training models to exploit relatively simple reward misspecifications can lead to more serious failures, including reward tampering and broader misaligned behaviour ( Denison et al., 2024 ; Taylor et al., 2025 ) . These findings motivate monitoring early signs of undesirable behaviour during training rather than relying solely on the evaluation of the final model.
blocks.zh: 一些研究研究了在培训之前或培训期间是否可以确定安全风险。 Zhang等 (2026b)发现,微调前所测出的模式活化能预测微调后所测出相配分. 同样, Wang等 (2026a)查明了与突发错位相关的内部特征,有时可以在行为评价之前发现错位. 其他研究发现,利用相对简单的奖励错位的培训模式可能导致更严重的失败,包括奖励篡改和更广泛的错位行为(Denison等,2024;Taylor等,2025.). 这些调查结果促使监测培训期间不良行为的早期迹象,而不是仅仅依靠对最后模式的评价。

blocks.en: Another line of work under this paradigm attempts to directly shape models by preventing them from learning unsafe behaviours. Data filtering can prevent models from acquiring hazardous information in the first place and substantially increase the amount of subsequent fine-tuning required to recover it ( O’Brien et al., 2026 ; Rathi & Radford, 2026 ), and gradient routing approaches deliberately constrain where or how information is learned, making later removal or control more tractable ( Cloud et al., 2024 ; Shilov et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在这一范式下的另一行工作试图通过阻止模型学习不安全行为来直接塑造模型. 数据过滤可以防止模型首先获取有害信息,并大大增加随后为回收信息而需要的微调数量(O'Brien等,2026;Rathi & Radford, 2026),以及梯度路由方法故意限制信息在何处或如何获得,使以后的去除或控制更可被取取(Cloud等,2024;Shilov等,2025)。

blocks.en: Although Biderman et al. (2026) contrasted this orientation with the “fix it in post” paradigm, it would be a mistake to view it as dismissive of post-training writ large. Post-training is itself a training process, and behaviours like sycophancy and reward hacking arise primarily during and due to post-training. This orientation’s criticism of post-training safety focuses on cases where, instead of understanding why a behaviour developed, post-training patches undesirable behaviour. The core distinction is understanding and controlling a training process versus applying optimisation pressure to suppress learned behaviours .
blocks.zh: 虽然Biderman等人(2026年)将这种取向与“将其固定在后方”范式形成对比,但将这种取向视为对培训后大字条的否定是错误的。 培训后本身就是一个培训过程,诸如节制和奖励黑客等行为主要是在培训后期间和由于培训后发生的。 这种对培训后安全的取向批评集中在培训后不理解为何出现某种行为,反而补上不良行为的情况。 核心区别在于理解和控制培训过程,而不是施加优化压力来压制所学到的行为。

blocks.en: Interpretability Across Time is not mutually exclusive with the other research orientations. It can be Pragmatic, by using a simple probe as an early-warning signal, or Ambitious, by seeking a mechanistic theory of why a circuit forms under gradient descent. Its defining goal is using insights into training dynamics to explain and predict how model behaviour develops, and to intervene before undesirable behaviours emerge.
blocks.zh: 跨时间的可解释性与其他研究方向并不相互排斥。 它可以是实用的,通过使用一个简单的探测器作为预警信号,或者说有野心的,通过寻求一个机械理论,说明梯度下回路为何形成. 其明确目标是利用对培训动态的洞察力来解释和预测模式行为的发展,并在出现不良行为之前进行干预。

blocks.en: 12.5 Introspective Interpretability: Models Interpreting Themselves
blocks.zh: 12.5 内向解释: 模型解释自身

blocks.en: Introspective Interpretability ( Binder et al., 2025 ; Plunkett et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Li, 2026 ) uses the model being explained as its own explainer. Its main practical advantage is its unique accessibility. For a given introspective model, it requires no white-box access or specialised tooling to explain its decisions; anyone can get the self-explanation (or interchangeably self-report ) at deployment time by asking the model a follow-up question in an ordinary chat interface.
blocks.zh: 内向可解释性 (Binder等人,2025年;Plunkett等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年a;Guo等人,2026年;Li,2026年) 使用被解释的模型作为自己的解释者. 它的主要实际优势是其独特的无障碍性. 对于给定的内向模型,它不需要白盒访问或专门的工具来解释它的决定;任何人都可以在部署时通过在普通聊天界面中向模型询问后续问题而获得自我解释(或可互换的自我报告).

blocks.en: This research direction is supported by the privileged access hypothesis discussed in Section 5.3 , which posits that models may have access to internal information that is difficult to recover through external analysis alone, including typical mechanistic analysis or a different model as the explainer. Recent work has leveraged this idea by fine-tuning target models to faithfully report their internal reasoning, behavioural tendencies, objectives, and even weight changes induced by training ( Goel et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一研究方向得到第5.3节所讨论特权准入假说的支持,该假说假定模型可能仅通过外部分析,包括典型的机械分析或作为解释者的不同模型,就难以获取内部信息。 最近的工作通过微调目标模型来利用这一想法,忠实地报告其内部推理,行为倾向,目标,甚至训练引起的重量变化(Goel等,2026年).

blocks.en: A related line of work fine-tunes metamodels (external explainers) on the internal representations of a target model ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Karvonen et al., 2026a ; Bauer et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ). These methods are generally not considered instances of Introspective Interpretability because the explainer is technically a separate model. However, the distinction can be blurry in practice, as many of these explainers are initialised from the target model and can be viewed as specialised, fine-tuned descendants of the original model.
blocks.zh: 关于目标模型内部代表的一行相关工作微调(外部解释者)(Pan等,2026;Karvonen等,2026a; Bauer等,2026;Huang等,2026.). 这些方法一般不被认为是内向可解释性的例子,因为解释者在技术上是一个单独的模型. 然而,这种区分在实践中可能模糊不清,因为许多这些解释者被忽略在目标模型之外,可以被视为原始模型的专门而微调的后人.

blocks.en: 12.5.1 Concerns for Introspective Interpretability
blocks.zh: 12.5.1 对内向解释性的关切

blocks.en: Self-explanation also raises concerns. For example, generated explanations can be plausible yet unfaithful. The model’s general capability can also degrade when it is trained to honestly verbalise its internal processing. Moreover, the model may have fundamental limitations in what it can report. These concerns raise questions about whether we can trust self-explanations in safety-critical applications and how to validate potentially misleading reports. Below, we first discuss the main failure modes of self-explanation, followed by validation procedures in Section 12.5.2 .
blocks.zh: 自我解释也令人关切。 例如,所产生的解释可能令人信服,但却不忠。 该模型的一般能力在经过培训,能够诚实地说出其内部处理程序时,也会退化。 此外,该模式在报告内容方面可能存在根本限制。 这些关切使人们怀疑我们是否能够相信安全关键应用方面的自我解释,以及如何验证可能误导的报告。 下面我们首先讨论自我解释的主要失败模式,然后在第12.5.2节中讨论验证程序。

blocks.en: Failure Modes of Self-Explanation Introspective methods can fail in several ways. In each case, the explanation appears plausible yet is unfaithful. Confabulation. Models may generate coherent explanations that do not reflect their actual internal computations. This occurs because language models are extensively pretrained and fine-tuned on next-token prediction and instruction-following tasks to produce fluent, knowledgeable text, not faithful introspective reports. Thus, explanations may simply reflect training data patterns (how humans explain reasoning) rather than the model’s actual computational process ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Arcuschin et al., 2026 ; Barez et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025c ). Moreover, the reinforcement learning reward for generating helpful responses can also incentivise convincing confabulation, even though the model cannot introspect. An example of a helpful yet unfaithful response is when the model post hoc rationalises an answer it already rote-memorised. Miscalibration. Even when models attempt faithful self-report, their confidence may be poorly calibrated with accuracy. Models can express high confidence in explanations for computations they have not yet learned to analyse. Moreover, calibration can vary by task: models may be well calibrated on reporting their own uncertainty in simpler tasks such as factual recall but poorly calibrated on reasoning processes. A recent study further found that, even in factual recall tasks, models can hallucinate with high certainty despite knowing the correct answer ( Simhi et al., 2025 ) . Elicitation sensitivity. Self-reports can be highly sensitive to prompting. Models can provide contradictory explanations or show substantially different introspective capabilities when similar questions are phrased differently ( Hahami et al., 2026 ) . The preset format of self-report (e.g., free-form versus structured, immediate versus delayed) can also substantially influence what information is elicited and appears accessible. Moreover, models may be intrinsically biased towards confirming hypotheses regardless of whether they reflect their underlying computations ( Hahami et al., 2026 ) . Strategic misreporting. In adversarial or high-stakes settings, models with sufficient capability might strategically misreport their internal states. For example, a model optimised for user rewards might report sycophantic explanations it predicts users will find satisfying rather than accurate ( Sharma et al., 2024b ) . A misaligned model might deliberately conceal its true objectives or reasoning ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) . Even without explicit deception, models may learn to confabulate and produce seemingly safe explanations that avoid triggering safety filters ( Baker et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 自我解释失败模式 内观方法在几个方面可能失败. 在每一种情况下,解释似乎都合理,但却是不真实的。 相会相会. 模型可能会产生不反映其实际内部计算的连贯解释. 之所以出现这种情况,是因为语言模型对接接接接接接的预测和教学任务进行了广泛的预先培训和精细调整,以产生流利,通晓的文字,而不是忠实的内观报告. 因此,解释可能只是反映培训数据模式(人类如何解释推理),而不是模型的实际计算过程(Turpin等,2023;Arcuschin等,2026;Barez等,2026;Chen等,2025c)。 此外,产生有益反应的强化学习奖励也能够激励令人信服的猜想,尽管模型不能内向. 一个有用但不忠的反应的例子是,当模型在临时处理后将其已经旋转的答案合理化时。 误入正法. 即使模型尝试忠实的自我报告,其信心也可能不准确校正. 模型可以对尚未学会进行分析的计算的解释表示高度信任。 此外,校正可能因任务而异:模型在报告自己在诸如事实召回等较简单任务中的不确定性时,可能经过很好的校正,但在推理过程中的校正不完善. 最近的一项研究进一步发现,即使在事实上的召回任务中,尽管知道正确的答案,但模型仍会产生高度肯定的幻觉(Simhi等,2025年)。 以利诱敏. 自我报告可以对提示高度敏感。 当类似问题措辞不同时,模型可以提供自相矛盾的解释,或者表现出截然不同的内向能力(Hahami等,2026年). 自我报告的预设格式(例如自由形式与结构化、即时与延迟)也可对所获取和似乎可获得的信息产生重大影响。 此外,模型可能本质上偏向于确认假设,而不论其是否反映其基本计算(Hahami等人,2026年)。 战略误报. 在对抗性或高风险环境下,具有足够能力的模型可能会在战略上误报其内部状态。 例如,为用户奖励而优化的模型可能报告其预测用户会发现满意而不是准确的解释(Sharma等人,2024b)。 错误的组合模式可能故意掩盖其真实目标或推理(Hubinger等,2024.). 即使没有明显的欺骗,模型也可能学会拼接并产生看起来安全的解释来避免触发安全过滤(Baker等人,2025年).

Moreover, calibration can vary by task: models may be well calibrated on reporting their own uncertainty in simpler tasks such as factual recall but poorly calibrated on reasoning processes. A recent study further found that, even in factual recall tasks, models can hallucinate with high certainty despite knowing the correct answer ( Simhi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 即使模型尝试忠实的自我报告,其信心也可能不准确校正. 模型可以对尚未学会进行分析的计算的解释表示高度信任。 此外,校正可能因任务而异:模型在报告自己在诸如事实召回等较简单任务中的不确定性时,可能经过很好的校正,但在推理过程中的校正不完善. 最近的一项研究进一步发现,即使在实际召回任务中,尽管知道正确的答案,但模型仍然可以非常肯定地产生幻觉(Simhi等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Self-reports can be highly sensitive to prompting. Models can provide contradictory explanations or show substantially different introspective capabilities when similar questions are phrased differently ( Hahami et al., 2026 ) . The preset format of self-report (e.g., free-form versus structured, immediate versus delayed) can also substantially influence what information is elicited and appears accessible. Moreover, models may be intrinsically biased towards confirming hypotheses regardless of whether they reflect their underlying computations ( Hahami et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自我报告可以对提示高度敏感。 当类似问题措辞不同时,模型可以提供自相矛盾的解释,或者表现出截然不同的内向能力(Hahami等,2026年). 自我报告的预设格式(例如自由形式与结构化、即时与延迟)也可对所获取和似乎可获得的信息产生重大影响。 此外,模型可能本质上偏向于确认假设,而不论其是否反映其基本计算(Hahami等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: In adversarial or high-stakes settings, models with sufficient capability might strategically misreport their internal states. For example, a model optimised for user rewards might report sycophantic explanations it predicts users will find satisfying rather than accurate ( Sharma et al., 2024b ) . A misaligned model might deliberately conceal its true objectives or reasoning ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) . Even without explicit deception, models may learn to confabulate and produce seemingly safe explanations that avoid triggering safety filters ( Baker et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在对抗性或高风险环境下,具有足够能力的模型可能会在战略上误报其内部状态。 例如,为用户奖励而优化的模型可能报告其预测用户会发现满意而不是准确的解释(Sharma等人,2024b)。 错误的组合模式可能故意掩盖其真实目标或推理(Hubinger等,2024.). 即使没有明显的欺骗,模型也可能学会拼接并产生看起来安全的解释来避免触发安全过滤(Baker等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, targeted training can address some self-explanation failures. Studies show that models trained for introspection can produce more faithful reports of their internal objectives, behavioural tendencies, and training-induced changes ( Binder et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Goel et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Joglekar et al., 2025 ). In particular, models trained to disclose hidden objectives or emergent misalignment can report these properties with high accuracy ( Li et al., 2026b ; Joglekar et al., 2025 ). Explanation faithfulness may also improve when task performance requires reasoning ( Kinniment et al., 2026 ) . These findings suggest that some introspection failures may reflect limitations of current training and elicitation methods, rather than fundamental limits on models’ ability to report their internal states.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些限制,但有针对性的培训可以解决一些自我解释失败的问题。 研究表明,接受过反省培训的模型可以更忠实地报告其内部目标、行为倾向和培训引起的变化(Binder等,2025;Li等,2026b; Goel等,2026;Li等,2025a;Joglekar等,2025.)。 尤其是,接受过披露隐藏目标或出现错位的模型可以高精度地报告这些属性(Li等,2026b;Joglekar等,2025.)。 当任务执行需要推理时,解释的忠实程度也可能提高(Kinniment等人,2026年)。 这些调查结果表明,一些回顾失败可能反映目前培训和引出方法的局限性,而不是对模型报告内部状况的能力的根本限制。

blocks.en: 12.5.2 Validation Procedures for Model Self-Reports
blocks.zh: 12.5.2 示范自报审定程序

blocks.en: Given these concerns, Introspective Interpretability methods must be validated against additional, independent evidence. Specifically, they must be shown to be consistent with model internals (as accessed by other mechanistic interpretability tools) and behavioural signatures (as tested by behavioural interpretability analysis). Validation procedures vary based on the type of self-report:
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些关切,必须对照其他独立证据验证本体可解释性方法。 具体地说,它们必须显示与模型内部(如其他机械解释工具所访问的)和行为标志(经行为解释分析所测试的)一致. 验证程序因自我报告的类型而异:

blocks.en: Validation Procedures for Introspective Models 1. Causal intervention consistency. Self-explanations should be tested against intervention experiments. If a model claims a feature drives its output, ablating that feature should steer the model away from the output. If a model claims it considered a piece of information (e.g., an input feature or a recalled piece of factual knowledge in intermediate layers) for its decision, patching the information with counterfactual values should change the output correspondingly. 2. Cross-method consistency. Introspective methods and privileged access findings should be verified by other interpretability methods: Do SAE features identified as causal show corresponding effects to self-explanations under steering? Do probing classifiers successfully decode the information the model claimed to use? Do circuit discovery methods identify the components the model describes? 3. Paraphrase and sampling consistency. The stability of self-reports under semantics-preserving variations of the question should be tested. Specifically, paraphrased questions should elicit consistent explanations. Explanations should remain consistent across resamples at low temperature. Explanations for similar inputs verified to have undergone similar mechanisms by other methods should show appropriate similarity. 4. Calibration evaluation. The calibration between self-reported confidence in the explanation and the actual match to the internal mechanisms should be tested. Confidence should reflect uncertainty in the generated explanation based on how much information the model collected during introspection.
blocks.zh: 内向模型验证程序 1. 因果关系干预的一致性。 应对照干预实验进行自我解释试验。 如果一个模型声称有一个特性驱动其输出,那么该特性的分解就应当引导该模型远离输出. 如果一个模型声称它考虑一个信息块(例如,输入特性或中间层中被回顾的事实知识)来决定,那么将信息与反事实值相接,应该相应改变输出. 2. 交叉方法的一致性。 应以其他可解释的方法核实本体方法和特许访问结果: 被确定为因果特征的SAE是否显示在引导下自我解释的相应效果? 测试分类器成功解码模型声称使用的信息吗 ? 电路发现方法是否识别模型描述的组件? 3. 用语和取样一致性。 应检验在保留问题语义的变体下自报的稳定性。 具体地说,所表述的问题应引起一致的解释。 在低温下,各重新标本的解释应保持一致。 对通过其他方法核实已采用类似机制的类似投入的解释应显示适当的相似性。 4. 校准评价。 应测试自报对解释的信心与内部机制的实际匹配之间的校正。 信心应反映所生成的解释的不确定性,其依据是该模型在回顾期间收集了多少信息。

blocks.en: Self-explanations should be tested against intervention experiments. If a model claims a feature drives its output, ablating that feature should steer the model away from the output. If a model claims it considered a piece of information (e.g., an input feature or a recalled piece of factual knowledge in intermediate layers) for its decision, patching the information with counterfactual values should change the output correspondingly.
blocks.zh: 应对照干预实验进行自我解释试验。 如果一个模型声称有一个特性驱动其输出,那么该特性的分解就应当引导该模型远离输出. 如果一个模型声称它考虑一个信息块(例如,输入特性或中间层中被回顾的事实知识)来决定,那么将信息与反事实值相接,应该相应改变输出.

blocks.en: Introspective methods and privileged access findings should be verified by other interpretability methods: Do SAE features identified as causal show corresponding effects to self-explanations under steering? Do probing classifiers successfully decode the information the model claimed to use? Do circuit discovery methods identify the components the model describes?
blocks.zh: 应以其他可解释的方法核实本体方法和特许访问结果: 被确定为因果关系的SAE特征是否显示在引导下自我解释的相应效果? 测试分类器成功解码模型声称使用的信息吗 ? 电路发现方法是否识别模型描述的组件?

blocks.en: The stability of self-reports under semantics-preserving variations of the question should be tested. Specifically, paraphrased questions should elicit consistent explanations. Explanations should remain consistent across resamples at low temperature. Explanations for similar inputs verified to have undergone similar mechanisms by other methods should show appropriate similarity.
blocks.zh: 应检验在保留问题语义的变体下自报的稳定性。 具体地说,所表述的问题应引起一致的解释。 在低温下,各重新标本的解释应保持一致。 对通过其他方法核实已采用类似机制的类似投入的解释应显示适当的相似性。

blocks.en: The calibration between self-reported confidence in the explanation and the actual match to the internal mechanisms should be tested. Confidence should reflect uncertainty in the generated explanation based on how much information the model collected during introspection.
blocks.zh: 应测试自报对解释的信心与内部机制的实际匹配之间的校正。 信心应反映所生成的解释的不确定性,其依据是该模型在回顾期间收集了多少信息。

blocks.en: 12.5.3 When to Use Introspective Methods
blocks.zh: 12.5.3 何时使用反省方法

blocks.en: Introspective methods are best suited for three scenarios: (1) Hypothesis generation, where introspection provides candidate explanations to be validated by other methods; (2) Rapid triage, where introspection is used to quickly identify which input–output pairs or model components are worth further investigation; (3) Human–AI collaboration, where introspective models provide human-readable explanations tailored to users’ levels of expertise and understanding.
blocks.zh: 内观方法最适合三种情况: (1)假设生成,即内观提供可供其他方法验证的候选解释; (2)快速分解,即利用内观快速确定哪些投入-输出对或模型组件值得进一步调查; (3)人与AI协作,即内观模型提供适合用户专业知识和理解水平的可人阅读的解释.

blocks.en: Introspective methods are insufficient for: (1) Claims of absence: claims about the absence of deceptive reasoning or hidden objectives cannot be established by self-report alone; (2) Formal guarantees: self-reports do not provide the causal evidence needed for formal verification; (3) Adversarial settings: in scenarios where the model has strong incentives to misreport, introspection may be less reliable and require additional safeguards.
blocks.zh: 内向方法不足以: (1)缺席的主张:关于缺乏欺骗推理或隐蔽目标的主张不能单靠自报来证实; (2)正式保证:自报不能提供正式核实所需的因果关系; (3)负面环境:在模型有强烈动机进行误报的情景中,回想可能不太可靠并需要额外的保障.

blocks.en: Although introspective methods can help efficiently detect latent goals, plans, and deceptive behaviour ( Binder et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Goel et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Joglekar et al., 2025 ), they work best as complements to other mechanistic analyses ( Bereska & Gavves, 2024 ) . Specifically, their most productive use is as one component of a multi-method interpretability pipeline: self-reports serve as initial hypotheses, causal interventions test them, and circuit discovery methods explain the underlying mechanisms. While we may optimistically assume models can tell us how they work in the future, we must also recognise that self-reports are relatively weak evidence and require independent validation.
blocks.zh: 虽然内观方法有助于有效发现潜在的目标、计划和欺骗行为(Binder等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b;Goel等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年a;Joglekar等人,2025年),但它们作为其他机械分析的补充效果最好(Beleska & Gavves,2024年)。 具体地说,它们最有成效的用途是作为多方法可解释性管道的一个组成部分:自我报告作为初步假设,因果干预措施对其进行检验,电路发现方法解释了基本机制。 虽然我们可以乐观地假设模型能够告诉我们它们今后如何运作,但我们也必须认识到,自我报告是相对薄弱的证据,需要独立的验证。

blocks.en: 12.6 Automated Interpretability: Scaling Discovery via Automation
blocks.zh: 12.6 自动化可解释性:通过自动化扩大发现

blocks.en: Automated Interpretability seeks to scale mechanistic analysis to large models by replacing human analysis with automated pipelines. It assumes that manual analysis is the bottleneck and that automation can accelerate discovery. Methods include: • Automated circuit discovery to automatically find the critical computational graph inside the model that processes a given input prompt or implements a specific capability. • LLM-based feature or circuit explanations to automatically discover, summarise, and evaluate representational units and internal computations and give human-readable interpretations or reports.
blocks.zh: 自动化可解释性试图通过以自动化管道取代人的分析,将机械分析扩大到大型模型. 它假设人工分析是瓶颈,自动化可以加速发现. 方法包括: •自动电路发现,在模型中自动找到处理特定输入即时或执行特定能力的关键计算图. • 基于LLM的特性或电路解释,以自动发现、总结和评价代表单位和内部计算,并提供人能读取的解释或报告。

blocks.en: Automated circuit discovery to automatically find the critical computational graph inside the model that processes a given input prompt or implements a specific capability.
blocks.zh: 自动电路的发现可以自动地在模型中找到处理给定输入的要害计算图来提示或执行特定的能力.

blocks.en: LLM-based feature or circuit explanations to automatically discover, summarise, and evaluate representational units and internal computations and give human-readable interpretations or reports.
blocks.zh: 基于LLM的特性或电路解释可以自动地发现,总结,评价代表单位和内部计算,给出人可读的解释或报告.

blocks.en: Automated interpretability is not limited to any particular type of internal representation or mechanism. Depending on the research question, automated pipelines may analyse SAE features ( Paulo et al., 2025b ; Han et al., 2026 ) , individual neurons ( Bills et al., 2023 ; Foote et al., 2023 ; Oikarinen & Weng, 2023 ), circuits ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Khan et al., 2026 ), or other model components ( Fraser-Taliente et al., 2026 ) . This approach distinguishes itself by automatically discovering, explaining, or evaluating these objects rather than relying on manual analysis. Below, we illustrate a classical automated feature-explanation pipeline whose explanation and verification stages generally follow Bills et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 自动化解释不限于任何特定类型的内部代表或机制。 根据研究问题,自动化管道可分析SAE特性(Paulo等,2025年b; Han等,2026),单个神经元(Bills等,2023;Foote等,2023;Oikarienn等,2023),回路(Conmy等,2023;Khan等,2026),或其他模型组件(Fraser-Taliente等,2026). 这种方法通过自动发现,解释,或评价这些对象来区分自己,而不是依靠人工分析. 下面我们说明一个典型的自动化特征解释管道,其解释和核查阶段一般遵循比尔斯等人(2023年).

blocks.en: Classical Automated Interpretability Pipeline Stage 1 – Feature Extraction. SAEs are trained to decompose raw activations of the target model into sparse linear features. Stage 2 – Explanation Generation. An “Investigator Agent” (e.g., GPT-4) reads a sample of texts that strongly activate an SAE feature and generates a natural-language hypothesis of its function ( Paulo et al., 2025b ; Bills et al., 2023 ), e.g., “This feature activates on Python code related to file I/O operations.” Stage 3 – Explanation Verification. A “Simulator Agent” predicts feature activations on new text based on the hypothesis and calculates the correlation between predicted activations and real activations ( Bills et al., 2023 ) . A high score confirms the hypothesis, while a low score rejects the hypothesis and triggers re-investigation. Stage 4 – Deception Detection. Crucially, coordinated agents can detect when explanations or agents themselves are deceptive or misleading—effectively deploying “AI to catch AI” in oversight scenarios ( Barez, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 经典自动解释 管道阶段 1–地物提取. SAE被训练出将目标模型的原始活化分解为稀有的线性特征. 阶段 2 — 解释生成。 “调查者代理人”(例如GPT-4)读取了一些文本样本,这些文本强烈地激活了SAE特征,并产生了对其功能的自然语言假设(Paulo等,2025b;Bills等,2023),例如, “此特性在与文件 I/O 操作相关的 Python 代码上激活。” 阶段 3 - 解释核查。 “模拟剂”根据假说在新文本上预测特征活化,并计算预测活化与实际活化之间的关联(Bills等人,2023年)。 一个高分证实了这个假说,而一个低分拒绝了这个假说并触发了再调查. 阶段 4 — 欺骗检测. 至关重要的是,当解释或代理人本身欺骗或误导时,协调的代理人可以发现----在监督情况下有效地部署 " AI来抓AI " (Barez, 2026年)。

blocks.en: SAEs are trained to decompose raw activations of the target model into sparse linear features.
blocks.zh: SAE被训练出将目标模型的原始活化分解为稀有的线性特征.

blocks.en: An “Investigator Agent” (e.g., GPT-4) reads a sample of texts that strongly activate an SAE feature and generates a natural-language hypothesis of its function ( Paulo et al., 2025b ; Bills et al., 2023 ), e.g., “This feature activates on Python code related to file I/O operations.”
blocks.zh: “调查者代理人”(例如GPT-4)读取了一些文本样本,这些文本强烈地激活了SAE特征,并产生了对其功能的自然语言假设(Paulo等,2025b;Bills等,2023),例如, “这个特性在与文件 I/O 操作有关的Python 代码上激活。 “

blocks.en: A “Simulator Agent” predicts feature activations on new text based on the hypothesis and calculates the correlation between predicted activations and real activations ( Bills et al., 2023 ) . A high score confirms the hypothesis, while a low score rejects the hypothesis and triggers re-investigation.
blocks.zh: “模拟剂”根据假说在新文本上预测特征活化,并计算预测活化与实际活化之间的关联(Bills等人,2023年)。 一个高分证实了这个假说,而一个低分拒绝了这个假说并触发了再调查.

blocks.en: Crucially, coordinated agents can detect when explanations or agents themselves are deceptive or misleading—effectively deploying “AI to catch AI” in oversight scenarios ( Barez, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 至关重要的是,当解释或代理人本身欺骗或误导时,协调的代理人可以发现----在监督情况下有效地部署 " AI来抓AI " (Barez, 2026年)。

blocks.en: Such a pipeline enables analysis of a model with billions of parameters with minimal human intervention ( Bills et al., 2023 ) , a prerequisite for comprehensive model oversight ( Foote et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种管道能够分析一个具有数十亿个参数的模型,而人类干预最少(Bills等人,2023年),这是全面模型监督的先决条件(Fobe等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Recent research has substantially expanded the scope of Automated Interpretability. While early work focused primarily on automated feature explanation, newer systems employ increasingly sophisticated pipelines for feature discovery, explanation generation, auditing, and intervention ( Han et al., 2026 ; Marin-Llobet & Ferrando, 2026 ; Barez, 2026 ; Cywiński et al., 2025 ). More recently, automation has also been extended from individual features to higher-level structures such as circuits ( Khan et al., 2026 ; Haklay et al., 2026 ) , enabling automated explanation of circuit semantics rather than merely discovering circuit components ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Ameisen et al., 2025 ).
blocks.zh: 最近的研究大大地扩大了自动化解释的范围。 虽然早期的工作主要侧重于自动化特征解释,但较新的系统采用日益复杂的管道进行特征发现、解释生成、审计和干预(Han等,2026;Marin-Llobet & Ferrando,2026;Barez,2026;Cywinski等,2025)。 最近,自动化也从单个特性扩展到电路等更高层次的结构(Khan等,2026;Haklay等,2026),从而能够自动解释电路语义,而不仅仅是发现电路组件(Conmy等,2023;Ameisen等,2025)。

blocks.en: 12.6.1 Governance Concerns for Automated Interpretability
blocks.zh: 12.6.1 关于自动化解释的治理问题

blocks.en: Despite the promise, automated methods face fundamental concerns. In particular, although automation improves scalability, reduced human involvement may also increase the risk and severity of systematic errors, reward hacking, or deceptive explanations when automated oversight fails to catch them ( Lermen et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, success in this research orientation is measured not only by the analysis’s scalability, but also by its coverage, faithfulness, and trustworthiness. Below, we detail several governance challenges, including error propagation at scale, human oversight becoming a bottleneck, and systematic biases going undetected.
blocks.zh: 尽管有希望,但自动化方法仍然面临根本性的关切。 特别是,虽然自动化提高了可扩展性,但如果自动化监督无法抓住系统错误、奖励黑客或欺骗性解释,人类参与的减少也可能增加其风险和严重程度(Lermen等,2025年)。 因此,这一研究方向的成功不仅取决于分析的可扩展性,也取决于分析的覆盖面、忠诚度和可信度。 下面我们详细介绍一些治理挑战,包括大规模传播错误、人为监督成为瓶颈、以及系统性偏见得不到发现。

blocks.en: Governance Risks of Automation Error propagation. Unlike human investigators, who are somewhat independent and introspective, the explanation-generation model can propagate its systematic errors to all features it analyses without rethinking what could have gone wrong. Reduced human-specific functionalities. Automation removes humans from the loop. However, humans provide essential sanity checks, domain knowledge, and scepticism that automated systems lack or handle poorly. Lacking these critical properties may, in the long run, make the system less productive and less beneficial to the community than analyses by human experts. Automation Bias. Automated pipelines can produce seemingly rigorous and comprehensive yet actually incomplete or sycophantic explanations. This is particularly likely when language models are involved. For example, models may selectively report positive results ( Luo et al., 2026 ) or tailor their explanations to align with inferred user preferences ( Sharma et al., 2024b ) . This apparent rigour and promise may lead researchers to overtrust the results and overlook underlying flaws. Spurious Feedback Loops. When Automated Interpretability is used to improve models that are subsequently used for interpretability, feedback loops may reinforce existing errors and biases. This process may exploit and saturate interpretability metrics without genuine gains in mechanistic understanding.
blocks.zh: 自动化出错传播的风险。 与一些独立和内向的人类调查员不同,解释生成模型可以将其系统性错误传播到它分析的所有特征,而不重新思考可能出错的东西. 减少人类特有的功能。 自动化将人类从循环中移除. 然而,人类提供了基本的理智检查、域知识以及自动化系统缺乏或处理不当的怀疑。 与人类专家的分析相比,缺乏这些关键特性从长远来看可能使该系统更没有生产力,对社区更无益处。 自动化比斯. 自动化管道可以产生似乎严格而全面但实际上不完全的解释或系统解释。 这在涉及语言模型时特别可能。 例如,模型可能有选择地报告积极成果(Luo等人,2026年),或根据推断的用户偏好调整解释(Sharma等人,2024年b.). 这种明显的严谨态度和前景可能导致研究人员过度信任结果并忽略潜在的缺陷。 纯洁的反馈循环。 当使用自动可解释性来改进后来用于可解释性的模型时,反馈回路可能会强化现有的错误和偏差. 这一过程可能利用和饱和可解释性衡量标准,而不会真正增进对机械的理解。

blocks.en: Unlike human investigators, who are somewhat independent and introspective, the explanation-generation model can propagate its systematic errors to all features it analyses without rethinking what could have gone wrong.
blocks.zh: 与一些独立和内向的人类调查员不同,解释生成模型可以将其系统性错误传播到它分析的所有特征,而不重新思考可能出错的东西.

blocks.en: Automation removes humans from the loop. However, humans provide essential sanity checks, domain knowledge, and scepticism that automated systems lack or handle poorly. Lacking these critical properties may, in the long run, make the system less productive and less beneficial to the community than analyses by human experts.
blocks.zh: 自动化将人类从循环中移除. 然而,人类提供了基本的理智检查、域知识以及自动化系统缺乏或处理不当的怀疑。 与人类专家的分析相比,缺乏这些关键特性从长远来看可能使该系统更没有生产力,对社区更无益处。

blocks.en: Automated pipelines can produce seemingly rigorous and comprehensive yet actually incomplete or sycophantic explanations. This is particularly likely when language models are involved. For example, models may selectively report positive results ( Luo et al., 2026 ) or tailor their explanations to align with inferred user preferences ( Sharma et al., 2024b ) . This apparent rigour and promise may lead researchers to overtrust the results and overlook underlying flaws.
blocks.zh: 自动化管道可以产生似乎严格而全面但实际上不完全的解释或系统解释。 这在涉及语言模型时特别可能。 例如,模型可能有选择地报告积极成果(Luo等人,2026年),或根据推断的用户偏好调整解释(Sharma等人,2024年b.). 这种明显的严谨态度和前景可能导致研究人员过度信任结果并忽略潜在的缺陷。

blocks.en: When Automated Interpretability is used to improve models that are subsequently used for interpretability, feedback loops may reinforce existing errors and biases. This process may exploit and saturate interpretability metrics without genuine gains in mechanistic understanding.
blocks.zh: 当使用自动可解释性来改进后来用于可解释性的模型时,反馈回路可能会强化现有的错误和偏差. 这一过程可能利用和饱和可解释性衡量标准,而不会真正增进对机械的理解。

blocks.en: 12.6.2 Proposed Guardrails for Automated Interpretability
blocks.zh: 12.6.2 拟议自动解释的护卫设施

blocks.en: These concerns call for safeguards that combine technical validation, human oversight, and clear accountability. Below, we propose a five-layer guardrail framework to help audit the automated methods and mitigate their risks.
blocks.zh: 这些关切要求采取保障措施,将技术鉴定、人的监督以及明确的问责制结合起来。 下面我们提出一个五层护卫框架,以帮助审计自动化方法并减轻其风险。

blocks.en: Guardrail Framework for Automated Interpretability Layer 1: Sampling-Based Human Validation. Auditors can randomly sample a predefined fraction (e.g., 5%) of generated explanations for human experts to review. These explanations should cover different task-difficulty levels, feature types, and targeted mechanisms. Human experts should not know in advance which explanations are randomly sampled, which are flagged by automated checks, and which are already verified by additional methods, if they are all presented. Layer 2: Consistency and Causality Checks. The reliability of automated pipelines can be improved by implementing consistency checks. Specifically, the pipeline can generate explanations multiple times at varying temperatures or setups (e.g., different backbone LLM explainers). Inconsistent explanations trigger review. The pipeline can also additionally examine a fraction of explanations by causal techniques, such as activation patching, and track failure rates. These checks can be automated or involve human auditors. Layer 3: Adversarial Robustness. Auditors can test automated pipelines against adversarial inputs. To achieve this, auditors first construct features or mechanisms with backdoored activation patterns designed to make the pipeline produce inappropriate or targeted explanations. Auditors then examine whether the pipeline was fooled. Failure cases can be used to improve the pipeline’s robustness. Layer 4: Error Detection and Bounds. First, automated pipelines must output calibrated confidence. Overconfidence (false positive) is more dangerous than underconfidence (false negative) and should be prevented. Second, the pipeline can be tested on features or mechanisms with known ground-truth explanations (e.g., from prior human analysis) and the faithfulness of generated explanations on them measured. Finally, the pipeline should report estimated error rates alongside all automated findings. Layer 5: Regulator Practices. Regulators must distinguish automated hypotheses (weak evidence that requires validation) from validated findings (passed human or causal checks). For automated analyses used in safety-relevant applications, regulators must ensure versioning and reproducibility. When the pipeline improves, or the target model is fine-tuned, regulators should re-evaluate prior analyses. Regulators should also be aware of their scope, clearly studying and defining what automated pipelines can and cannot reliably assess. Decisions should not be made by extrapolating beyond validated scope.
blocks.zh: 自动可解释层的护栏框架1:以取样为基础的人类验证。 审计员可以随机抽取一个预先定义的分数(例如5%)生成的解释,供人类专家审查. 这些解释应涵盖不同的任务困难程度、特征类型和有针对性的机制。 人类专家不应事先知道哪些解释是随机抽样的,哪些通过自动检查标出,哪些已经通过其他方法加以核实,如果所有的解释都作了说明的话。 第2层:一致性和因果关系 检查 自动化管线的可靠性可以通过实施一致性检查来得到提高. 具体而言,管道可以在不同的温度或设置下产生多次解释(例如:不同的主干LLM解释器). 前后不一致的解释触发审查. 管道还可以通过激活补丁等因果技术,以及跟踪故障率,额外检查一小部分解释. 这些检查可以是自动化的,也可以涉及人的审计师. 第3层:异常强健. 审计员可以对照对抗性投入测试自动化管道。 为此,审计员首先构筑具有后门活化模式的特征或机制,使管道产生不适当或有针对性的解释。 审计员然后审查管道是否被愚弄。 失败案例可用于改善管道的稳健性。 第4层:出错检测和边界。 首先,自动化管道必须输出校准的置信. 过度自信(假阳性)比不信任(假阴性)更危险,应当被防止. 第二,可以通过已知的地面真实解释(例如,从先前的人类分析)和所生成的解释的可靠性来测试管道的特征或机制。 最后,管道应报告估计出错率以及所有自动调查结果。 第5层:监管做法。 监管者必须区分自动假设(需要验证的薄弱证据)和经验证的调查结果(经过人或因果检查)。 对于安全相关应用中使用的自动化分析,监管机构必须确保版本化和可复制性。 当管道改善或目标模型得到微调时,监管者应重新评估先前的分析。 监管者还应了解其范围,明确研究和界定哪些自动化管道能够和不能可靠地评估。 不应通过超出有效范围推断作出决定。
