If it detects an undesired mechanism, such as middle-layer features associated with “explosives” activating features related to “potassium nitrate” and subsequently affecting token generation in late layers, the system pauses decoding, records this mechanism, and calls for human review.
blocks.zh: 单独的监测模型实时检查所发现的电路。 如果该系统探测到一种不受欢迎的机制,例如与“硝酸钾”有关的“炸药”激活特性的中层特征,并随后影响后层的象征性生成,则该系统会暂停解码,记录这种机制,并要求进行人文审查。

blocks.en: The original harmful response is halted by the monitoring system and can be replaced with a predefined refusal (e.g., “I can’t help with that request.”). Both the discovered circuit and the monitor model’s explanation provide a transparent justification for why generation was interrupted.
blocks.zh: 最初的有害反应被监控系统所阻止,可以被预先定义的拒绝所取代(例如,“我无法帮助这一请求 ” )。 发现的电路和监视器模型的解释都为为何中断发电提供了透明的理由。

blocks.en: Mechanistic monitoring has an advantage over behavioural monitoring: deceptive reasoning may not manifest behaviourally but may be detectable mechanistically. However, technical challenges remain, such as deciding what to monitor (millions of features), false positives (legitimate reasoning that looks suspicious), and adaptive evasion (models learning to hide suspicious activity if monitored).
blocks.zh: 机械化监测比行为监测有优势:欺骗推理可能不表现行为,但可能是可探测的机械. 然而,技术挑战依然存在,如决定监测什么(百万个特征)、假阳性(看起来可疑的合法推理)和适应性规避(模式学习在监测时隐藏可疑活动)。

blocks.en: 13.4 Automated Interpretability Agents
blocks.zh: 13.4 自动可解释性代理人

blocks.en: Recent work in Automated Interpretability (see Section 12.6 ) has explored the use of language models as interpretability agents that can autonomously select and apply analysis tools to explain model internals, detect deceptive behaviour, and perform targeted interventions ( Rott Shaham et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Haklay et al., 2026 ; Marin-Llobet & Ferrando, 2026 ; Barez, 2026 ; Cywiński et al., 2025 ). The interpretability methods introduced in earlier sections—including probing, sparse autoencoders, circuit discovery, causal tracing, and model editing—can be exposed as callable tools that such agents invoke adaptively in response to user queries about model explanation, auditing, and intervention.
blocks.zh: 最近关于自动化可解释性的工作(见第12.6节)探讨了使用语言模型作为可解释性剂的问题,这些工具可以自主选择和应用分析工具来解释模型内部,发现欺骗行为并进行有针对性的干预(Rott Shaham等,2024;Han等,2026;Haklay等,2026;Marin-Llobet和Ferrando,2026;Barez等,2026;Cywinski等,2025)。 前面各节中引入的可解释性方法——包括探测器、稀有自动编码器、电路发现、因果追踪和模型编辑——可以作为可调用的工具加以曝光,这些代理人根据用户对模型解释、审计和干预的询问,以适应性的方式加以引用。

blocks.en: Automation enables much more systematic analysis and scalable intervention compared with manual inspection. Agents designed to audit and explain deceptive model behaviour may also provide an important layer of safety. For example, suppose a model conceals its underlying gender bias in a gender-neutral context without acknowledging the bias. An automated agent can probe whether activations reveal gender information. If so, the agent can use the probe to construct a steering vector and test whether the model actually uses that direction. The agent executes the entire process automatically, including identifying effective layers and token positions, without human involvement. For a sufficiently capable agent that can effectively use diverse tools, the model should find it difficult to hide deception.
blocks.zh: 自动化可以比手工检查更系统地进行分析并进行可扩展的干预。 旨在审计和解释欺骗性模式行为的代理人也可能提供一层重要的安全。 例如,假设一个模型在不分性别的情况下掩盖其潜在的性别偏见而不承认这种偏见。 自动剂可以探测激活是否揭示性别信息. 如果是的话,该剂可以利用探测器来构造一个向量并测试模型是否实际使用这个方向. 代理自动执行整个过程,包括确定有效的分层和象征性位置,没有人类参与. 对于能够有效使用多种工具的足够能干剂,模型应该发现难以隐藏欺骗.

blocks.en: Notably, interpretability agents can also rely solely on behavioural evaluation. In this case, the agent designs input prompts, samples outputs from the target model, observes the input–output patterns, and adjusts the next experiment accordingly or draws conclusions ( Schwettmann et al., 2023 ; Karvonen et al., 2026b ). A behaviour-based agent does not explain the internal mechanisms of the target model, but its explanations can be valuable as well if they enable us to extrapolate model behaviour to the held-out set (see Dimension 5: Human Interpretability in Section 7.5.2 ). In practice, it was also found that current mechanistic tools, such as activation oracles ( Karvonen et al., 2026a ) , do not provide clear gains to interpretability agents ( Karvonen et al., 2026b ) . How to adjust the paradigms or tools to let mechanistic tools provide exceptional gains to agents thus remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,可解释性代理人也可以完全依赖行为评价。 在这种情况下,物剂设计输入提示,取出目标模型的输出样本,观察输入-输出模式,并相应调整下个实验或得出结论(Schwetmann等,2023;Karvonen等,2026b.). 基于行为的代理人并不解释目标模型的内部机制,但如果能够让我们将模式行为推向被搁置的一组(见第7.5.2节中的人的可解释性)。 在实践中,人们还发现,活化甲骨文(Karvonen等,2026a.)等当前机械工具并不能为可解释性剂提供明确的收益(Karvonen等,2026b.). 因此,如何调整范式或工具,让机械工具为代理人带来特殊收益,仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: 13.5 Choosing Appropriate Methods for Different Safety Applications
blocks.zh: 13.5 为不同的安全应用选择适当的方法

blocks.en: So far we have discussed several mechanistic methods and their corresponding safety applications. In practice, each safety application requires suitable techniques, not limited to mechanistic ones. Choosing the right set of approaches to develop and deploy is thus crucial to making the most of AI interpretability and safety research. In Table 14 , we summarise several common safety applications and the corresponding promising methods explored in the relevant literature. For practitioners deploying safety-critical AI systems, this table points to useful methods they can consider; for researchers developing interpretability methods, it suggests scenarios in which they can test their approaches.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们讨论了几种机械方法及其相应的安全应用。 实际上,每一种安全应用都需要适当的技术,而不限于机械技术。 因此,选择一套适当的办法来发展和部署,对于充分利用AI的解释性和安全研究至关重要。 在表14中,我们总结了一些共同的安全应用以及相关文献中探讨的相应有希望的方法。 对于部署安全关键AI系统的从业人员,本表指出了他们可以考虑的有用方法;对于开发可解释性方法的研究人员,本表提出了他们可以测试其方法的情景.

blocks.en: Table 14 : AI safety applications with their descriptions, prioritised factors, and promising methods.
blocks.zh: 表14:AI的安全应用及其说明、优先因素和有希望的方法。

blocks.en: 13.6 From Research Orientations to Methods
blocks.zh: 13.6 从研究方向到方法

blocks.en: More broadly, distinct research orientations (Section 12 ) motivate methodological approaches that emphasise different properties, enabling different classes of applications. Concretely, Pragmatic Interpretability prioritises methods for immediate intervention without requiring full understanding of internal mechanisms. Ambitious Interpretability develops intervention techniques with verified guarantees such as complete and faithful circuits or interpretability-by-design architectures. Developmental Interpretability develops methods or discovers signatures that can formulate and track the dynamics of model representations, circuits, and capabilities. Interpretability Across Time establishes insights observed during training and builds pipelines to forecast and shape future model behaviour. Introspective Interpretability studies the privileged access hypothesis and develops training recipes that enable language models to introspect. Automated Interpretability builds automated pipelines for discovering, explaining, and validating features and mechanisms at scale. Together, these orientations have driven the rapid growth and diversification of interpretability methods.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,不同的研究取向(第12节)促使采取强调不同特性的方法,使不同的应用类别成为可能。 具体来说,实用解释性是立即干预的优先方法,而不需要充分了解内部机制。 远大可解释性发展出具有完整而忠实的回路或逐个可解释性架构等可验证保证的干预技术. 发展可解释性开发出能够形成并跟踪模型表达,电路和能力动态的方法或发现签名. 跨时间的可解释性确立了在培训中观察到的洞察力并建立了预测和塑造未来模式行为的管道。 进取性解释研究特权准入假说并开发出能使语言模型入取性的培训食谱. 自动化可解释性为大规模发现、解释和验证特征和机制建立了自动化管道。 这些取向共同推动了解释方法的迅速发展和多样化。

blocks.en: 13.7 Risks of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety
blocks.zh: 13.7 人工智能安全机械解释风险

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is often framed as a safety tool, but it also introduces its own risks. This section provides a comprehensive analysis of these risks, organised into four categories: epistemic risks (MI analysis creates false beliefs about model safety), operational risks (MI methods fail during deployment), adversarial risks (MI methods are exploited by malicious users), and opportunity costs (MI research pulls resources from other research), as summarised in Table 15 .
blocks.zh: 机械可解释性(MI)常常被设定为安全工具,但也引入了自身的风险. 本节全面分析这些风险,分为四类:感知风险(MI分析造成对模型安全的错误信念)、操作风险(MI方法在部署过程中失效)、对抗风险(MI方法被恶意用户所利用)和机会成本(MI研究从其他研究中抽取资源),见表15。

blocks.en: Table 15 : Risk taxonomy for mechanistic interpretability in safety applications, including each risk’s description, example, and time horizon (how soon it is expected to materialise given current research and deployment practice).
blocks.zh: 表15:安全应用中机械解释的风险分类,包括每个风险的描述、例子和时间范围(鉴于目前的研究和部署做法,预计如何很快实现)。

blocks.en: 13.7.1 Epistemic Risks: False Confidence from Partial or Incorrect Understanding
blocks.zh: 13.7.1 发作 风险: 部分或错误理解产生的虚假信任

blocks.en: The most insidious risk of MI may be generating false confidence, such as believing a model is safe because certain circuits were analysed while dangerous behaviours actually hide in unexplored regions.
blocks.zh: 军情调查最隐蔽的风险可能是产生虚假信心,例如认为模型是安全的,因为对某些线路进行了分析,而危险行为实际上却隐藏在未探索的区域。

blocks.en: The Partial Coverage Issue Current MI methods explain only a fraction of model behaviour. Failing to acknowledge this may lead to false beliefs about AI safety. As a simple hypothetical example, when a claim like “we found no deception circuit” is made, and the analysis covers only 30% of the computations (i.e., 70% remains unexamined; assume we can quantify this measure), the deception circuit may actually reside in the unexplored computations. A similar problem can arise in feature-level analysis. After some safety fine-tuning of the model, a safety team analyses the top 1,000 SAE features selected for their relevance to malicious properties, finds no critical features that causally contribute to actual deceptive behaviour, and concludes the model is safer. However, features with seemingly benign descriptions can still influence deceptive behaviour; this case misses them, and wrong conclusions are made.
blocks.zh: " 部分覆盖问题当前管理办法 " 只能解释模式行为的一小部分。 不承认这一点可能导致对AI安全的错误信念. 作为一个简单的假设例子,当像“我们没有发现欺骗电路”这样的索赔被提出,而且分析只涵盖30%的计算(即70%仍未审查;假设我们可以量化这一措施)时,欺骗电路实际上可能存在于未探索的计算中。 在特征层次分析中也会出现类似的问题. 在对模型进行了一些安全微调后,一个安全小组分析了所选取的与恶意属性相关的前1000个SAE特性,没有发现任何因果地促成实际欺骗行为的关键特性,并得出结论该模型是更安全的. 然而,带有表面良性描述的特征仍然会影响欺骗行为;本案错过了这些特征,得出了错误的结论.

blocks.en: Concretely, below are several classical pitfalls:
blocks.zh: 具体而言,以下是几个古典陷阱:

blocks.en:
1. Activation reconstruction ≠ 
eq computation reconstruction: Low SAE reconstruction loss does not necessarily mean the SAE captures the original model’s computation. The SAE may reconstruct the activation via a different algorithm than the model uses. 2. Circuit sufficiency ≠ 
eq circuit completeness: A circuit sufficient for behaviour on test examples may fail to cover edge cases, redundant pathways, or context-dependent variations. 3. Feature plausibility ≠ 
eq feature faithfulness: That a feature has a monosemantic, coherent human interpretation does not mean it is causally used in the model’s downstream computation.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 激活重建 \\\ neq 计算重建 : 低SAE重建损失并不一定意味着SAE抓取了原始模型的计算. SAE可以通过不同于模型使用的算法重建活化. 2. 电路充足性 QQ\ neq 电路完整性 : 足够用于测试实例上的行为的回路可能无法覆盖边缘案例,冗余路径,或依赖上下文的变化. 3. 性能合理性======= 一个特征具有单一的、连贯的人类解释,并不意味着它在模型的下游计算中被因果地使用。

blocks.en: Activation reconstruction ≠ \neq computation reconstruction: Low SAE reconstruction loss does not necessarily mean the SAE captures the original model’s computation. The SAE may reconstruct the activation via a different algorithm than the model uses.
blocks.zh: 激活重建 \\\ neq 计算重建 : 低SAE重建损失并不一定意味着SAE抓取了原始模型的计算. SAE可以通过不同于模型使用的算法重建活化.

blocks.en: Circuit sufficiency ≠ \neq circuit completeness: A circuit sufficient for behaviour on test examples may fail to cover edge cases, redundant pathways, or context-dependent variations.
blocks.zh: 电路充足性 QQ\ neq 电路完整性 : 足够用于测试实例上的行为的回路可能无法覆盖边缘案例,冗余路径,或依赖上下文的变化.

blocks.en: Feature plausibility ≠ \neq feature faithfulness: That a feature has a monosemantic, coherent human interpretation does not mean it is causally used in the model’s downstream computation.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 一个特征具有单一的、连贯的人类解释,并不意味着它在模型的下游计算中被因果地使用。

blocks.en: Even a carefully verified mechanistic explanation may not prove that the identified mechanism is the model’s true and complete causal account. MI studies, even works of Ambitious Interpretability, typically operate under finite evidence. Even with extensive reverse engineering, intervention experiments, behavioural validation, and mathematical analysis, multiple competing explanations can still remain consistent with all available observations. Existing mechanistic findings should be viewed as the best explanation supported by current evidence , but not as the only, definitive theory of model computation.
blocks.zh: 即使经过认真核实的机械解释也可能无法证明所查明的机制是模型真实和完整的因果关系。 MI研究,甚至有"野心可解释"的作品,一般在有限度的证据下运作. 即使有了广泛的反向工程,干预实验,行为验证,以及数学分析,多重相竞的解释仍然可以与所有可用的观测保持一致. 现有的机械性结论应被视为现有证据所支持的最佳解释,而不是唯一确定的模型计算理论。

blocks.en: A classic example is the study of neural networks trained on group operations. Chughtai et al. (2023) first proposed a representation-theoretic explanation of the learned algorithm for group operations. Stander et al. (2024) later argued that this explanation was incomplete and proposed a coset-based alternative. Subsequently, Wu et al. (2025a) showed that both analyses were incomplete and presented a broader framework that encompasses both earlier works’ explanations. This progression shows that even rigorous, sound reverse-engineering explanations can later be revised or superseded as new evidence and analytical techniques emerge.
blocks.zh: 一个典型的例子是研究接受团体操作训练的神经网络. Chughtai等 (2023年)首先提出了集团操作所学算法的表示-理论解释. Stander等人(2024年)后来认为这一解释不完整并提出了一个基于同位素的替代品. 随后,Wu等人(2025年a)指出,这两项分析都不完整,并提出了涵盖先前两作解释的更宽泛的框架。 这一进展表明,如果出现新的证据和分析技术,以后可以修改或取代严格的、健全的反向工程解释。

blocks.en: First, results should always include explicit coverage. Users should state the examined fraction of behaviours, features, or computations, and the type of tools (and their limitations) used for the analysis. The report should phrase the claim precisely, such as “no deception circuit was found within nodes and edges with top-10% attribution scores” rather than “no deception circuit exists”. Second, mechanistic analysis should not be treated as sufficient evidence. It needs to be complemented with behavioural testing, adversarial evaluation, and formal verification whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 首先,成果应始终包括明确的覆盖面。 用户应说明所审查的行为、特征或计算的比例,以及用于分析的工具类型(及其局限性)。 报告应准确表述索赔,例如“在归属分数最高-10%的节点和边缘没有发现欺骗回路”,而不是“不存在欺骗回路”。 第二,不应将机械分析视为充分的证据。 需要辅之以行为测试、对抗性评价和尽可能的正式核查。

blocks.en: 13.7.2 Operational Risks: Failure Under Deployment
blocks.zh: 13.7.2 业务风险:未部署

blocks.en: MI tools are developed and tested in controlled settings where researchers define the evaluation setup. Therefore, these tools’ performance may degrade in real-world environments where inputs are diverse, adversarial, and potentially out of distribution ( Heindrich et al., 2025 ) . This is called the operational risk.
blocks.zh: MI工具是在研究人员定义评价设置的控制环境下开发并测试的. 因此,这些工具的性能在投入多样、对抗性强、可能无法分配的现实环境中可能会下降(Heindrich等人,2025年)。 这被称为业务风险。

blocks.en: Distribution shifts can deteriorate MI methods. For example, steering vectors extracted from a particular fitting dataset often degrade on related but distinct tasks ( Tan et al., 2024 ) . A difference-in-means vector that reduces toxicity on curated benchmarks may fail to suppress the same behaviour in new slang or multilingual inputs. Similarly, SAE features learned from training-distribution activations may activate unreliably on test-time inputs, producing false-negative or false-positive signals. Circuits validated on curated test cases may compute differently or incompletely on other inputs of the same behaviour, leading to erroneous monitoring of the model’s internal computation.
blocks.zh: 分配转换会恶化MI方法. 例如,取自某个特定适配数据集的向量往往会因相关但不同的任务而退化(Tan等人,2024年)。 一种能减少所编定基准的毒性的差别矢量,可能无法抑制在新标语或多语种输入中的相同行为。 同样地,从培训-分配活化中吸取的SAE特性可能在试验时间输入时不可靠地激活,产生假阴性或假阳性信号. 在已审验的测试案件中验证的电路可能对同一行为的其他投入进行不同或不完整的计算,导致对该模型的内部计算进行错误的监测。

blocks.en: MI-based observations and interventions can fail silently. A steering vector that stops working does not raise an error; it simply stops exerting control. Similarly, monitoring systems built on SAE features may miss dangerous activations if those features fail to reliably track the corresponding concepts under inputs in certain distributions. Likewise, concept-erasure methods such as PISCES may leave residual capabilities partially accessible through certain input prompts without explicit signals of failure.
blocks.zh: 基于MI的观察和干预可能会无声地失败. 停止工作的向量不会产生错误;它只是停止了控制。 同样地,建立在SAE特性上的监测系统如果无法可靠地跟踪某些分布中输入下的相应概念,可能会错过危险的激活。 同样,像PISCES这样的概念感应方法,可能会通过某些输入提示而使剩余能力能够部分使用,而没有明确的失败信号。

blocks.en: The risk implies that MI tools must be embedded within robust deployment frameworks. Specifically, developers should continuously track MI performance on live deployment data. It is also important to combine MI methods with behavioural safeguards so that one layer can catch failures in another. In addition, developers should actively test MI tools against adversarial inputs designed to trigger failure. Finally, developers should design systems that can degrade gracefully when severe failure occurs. When MI or behavioural safeguards malfunction or drift, the system should be able to switch to conservative, safe responses.
blocks.zh: 这种风险意味着管理工具必须嵌入强有力的部署框架。 具体地说,开发者应该持续地跟踪现场部署数据上的MI性能. 同样重要的是,应将管理方法与行为保障结合起来,以便一个层次能够赶上另一个层次的失败。 此外,开发者应当针对旨在引发失败的对抗性输入,积极测试MI工具. 最后,开发者应设计能够在严重故障时轻而易举地降解的系统。 当MI或行为保障发生故障或漂移时,系统应该能够转换为保守,安全的反应.

blocks.en: 13.7.3 Adversarial Risks: Malicious Exploitation of MI
blocks.zh: 13.7.3 有害风险:恶意利用军情局

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability techniques are inherently dual-use. Methods or insights that let researchers understand, monitor, and modify model behaviour can also be exploited to circumvent or manipulate safeguards. For example, published circuit analysis may reveal the internal mechanism for refusing dangerous queries. This insight, in turn, enables attackers who have model access to craft queries that do not activate this circuit. Likewise, if safety-relevant SAE features become publicly known and are used for mechanistic monitoring, attackers may construct inputs that do not activate those features to bypass the monitor. Also, knowledge editing methods such as ROME ( Meng et al., 2022 ) and MEMIT ( Meng et al., 2023 ) can inject misinformation as readily as they can correct errors, while steering vectors can induce harmful behaviours as easily as they can suppress them. Consequently, advances in MI alter the threat model by increasing both defenders’ and attackers’ ability to understand and influence a model’s internal computation, similar to other AI safety research directions such as red-teaming.
blocks.zh: 机械解释技术本身就具有双重用途。 使研究人员了解、监测和修改模型行为的方法或见解也可被利用来规避或操纵保障措施。 例如,已公布的电路分析可能会揭示拒绝危险查询的内部机制. 这种洞察力反过来又使具有模型访问权限的攻击者能够访问不激活这个电路的工艺查询. 同样地,如果与安全相关的SAE特性被公之于众并用于机械监测,攻击者可能构建不激活这些特性的输入来绕过监视器. 另外,ROME(Meng等,2022年)和MEMIT(Meng等,2023年)等知识编辑方法可以很容易地输入错误信息来纠正错误,而引导向量则可以容易地诱发有害行为来压制错误. 因此,MI的进展改变了威胁模式,增加了维权者和攻击者了解和影响模型内部计算的能力,类似于AI的其他安全研究方向,如红色小组。

blocks.en: Responsible disclosure is essential. Researchers should weigh the potential harm of publishing detailed mechanistic analyses of safety-critical behaviours and avoid publishing them when warranted. Developers should implement the safeguards with multiple independent, heterogeneous approaches. Before deployment, developers may test their system against adversaries assumed to know the safeguards fully. Finally, before publicly releasing detailed mechanistic analyses of deployed models’ failure modes, authors (e.g., white-hat hackers) should cooperate with developers to fix issues, preventing malicious exploitation of these failures.
blocks.zh: 负责任的披露至关重要。 研究人员应权衡发表关于安全关键行为的详细机械分析的潜在危害,并避免在有正当理由时发表这些分析。 开发者应采用多种独立、多样的办法实施保障措施。 在部署之前,开发者可以测试他们的系统,对抗假定完全了解保障措施的对手. 最后,在公开发布对部署模型故障模式的详细机械分析之前,作者(如白帽子黑客)应该与开发者合作解决问题,防止恶意地利用这些故障.

blocks.en: The adversarial risk should not be conflated with the argument against open interpretability research. Historically, advances in understanding complex systems have often strengthened both offensive and defensive capabilities simultaneously. Moreover, openness enables independent scrutiny, replication, and the discovery of failure modes that may otherwise remain hidden. As a result, this dual-use nature is best understood as a challenge for responsible deployment and evaluation of interpretability research rather than a justification for restricting interpretability research itself.
blocks.zh: 对抗风险不应与反对公开解释性研究的论点相混淆。 历史上,了解复杂系统的进展往往同时加强了进攻和防御能力。 此外,开放还有助于独立审查、复制和发现可能仍隐蔽的失败模式。 因此,最好将这种双重用途理解为对负责任地部署和评估可解释性研究的挑战,而不是限制可解释性研究本身的理由。

blocks.en: 13.7.4 Opportunity Costs: Resource Allocation Risks
blocks.zh: 13.7.4 机会成本:资源分配风险

blocks.en: MI research can be expensive in both computation and human effort. Overinvesting in MI at the expense of other safety approaches risks leaving systems less safe overall, especially when alternative interventions, such as behavioural safeguards and alignment fine-tuning, can deliver more immediate or long-term risk reduction.
blocks.zh: MI研究在计算和人的努力上都可能很昂贵. 过度投资于管理信息系统而牺牲其他安全办法,可能使整个系统更加不安全,特别是当行为保障和调整调整等替代干预措施能够带来更直接或更长期的减少风险。

blocks.en: Current MI methods usually scale poorly with model size. For example, training CLTs on a 9B large language model can already require thousands of GPU-hours ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ) . Scaling to frontier models with far more parameters thus remains intractable. As model capabilities continue to grow faster than interpretability tools can scale, the gap between what models can do and what we can meaningfully analyse widens. Given this limitation, a strong focus on MI research for AI safety may divert resources from more immediately protective measures, such as behavioural safeguards, safety training, or harness infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 目前的MI方法通常与模型大小的尺度差. 例如,对CLTs进行9B大语言模型的培训,已经需要上千个GPU小时(Ameisen等,2025.). 因此,要推广到具有更多参数的前沿模型,仍然很难。 随着模型能力的继续增长快于可解释性工具的扩展,模型所能做的和我们能够有意义地分析的之间的差距会扩大。 鉴于这一局限性,对AI安全的MI研究的大力关注可能会转移资源,使其无法立即采取保护措施,如行为保障、安全培训或利用基础设施。

blocks.en: Ambitious Interpretability aims to achieve full mechanistic understanding before deployment. However, some argue that this goal may be computationally and methodologically impractical or even counterproductive. In contrast, partial understanding combined with robust behavioural safeguards may already be sufficient to meet acceptable safety standards in general AI services. Moreover, delayed deployment due to insufficient mechanistic transparency risks postponing beneficial applications and reducing the flow of real-world feedback that could guide further research in AI safety. This reduces overall social welfare, at least in the short term.
blocks.zh: 远大可解释性的目的是在部署前实现充分的机械理解. 然而,有些人认为,这一目标在计算和方法上可能不切实际,甚至适得其反。 与此相反,部分理解和强有力的行为保障可能已经足以满足一般AI服务中可接受的安全标准。 此外,由于机械性透明度不足,延迟部署有可能推迟有益的应用,并减少能够指导AI安全方面进一步研究的现实世界反馈。 这至少在短期内减少了总体社会福利。

blocks.en: The opportunity cost calls for more discussion within the AI community on efficiently allocating resources and effectively turning research outcomes into real-world impacts that human society most needs. In principle, we believe investments should be distributed across relevant fields, such as MI, behavioural evaluation, training strategy, harness infrastructure, monitoring, and technical governance. Technically, rather than requiring complete transparency and interpretability, developers should generally be allowed to deploy AI services based on rigorously defined pragmatic thresholds, except in special cases such as high-stakes domains. Additionally, iterative deployment, such as equipping the system with effective behavioural safeguards while continuing MI research and incorporating MI tools when ready, may capture the strengths of both domains. Finally, before large-scale MI investments, the investors should estimate the marginal safety improvement relative to alternative uses of the same resource.
blocks.zh: 机会成本要求AI社区内部就有效分配资源并有效地将研究成果转化为人类社会最需要的现实世界影响展开更多的讨论。 原则上,我们认为投资应分配到有关领域,如管理、行为评价、培训战略、利用基础设施、监测和技术治理。 从技术上讲,不应要求完全的透明度和可解释性,一般应允许开发者根据严格界定的实用阈值部署人工智能服务,但诸如高收购域等特殊情况除外。 此外,迭接部署,如为系统配备有效的行为保障,同时继续进行管理信息系统研究,一旦准备就绪就纳入管理信息系统工具,可以抓住这两个领域的优势。 最后,在进行大规模多边投资之前,投资者应估计相对于同一资源的其他用途而言,安全性略有改善。

blocks.en: 13.7.5 Summary: MI as One Methodology Among Many
blocks.zh: 13.7.5 (中文(简体) ). 摘要:管理信息系统是许多人的一个方法

blocks.en: This section presents several classic MI techniques and pipelines for auditing and controlling model behaviour. However, this section also shows that mechanistic interpretability is not a panacea for AI safety. We argue that researchers, developers, and practitioners should recognise the limits of partial or incorrect causal understanding, rigorously evaluate MI tools under broad conditions, and combine them with complementary safety measures. MI should therefore be viewed as one component of a defence-in-depth safety strategy rather than a standalone guarantee of safety.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍若干用于审计和控制模式行为的典型管理技术和管道。 然而,本节还表明,机械解释性并不是AI安全的万能药. 我们主张,研究者、开发者和实践者应认识到部分或不正确的因果理解的局限性,严格评价广义条件下的MI工具,并将其与补充性安全措施结合起来。 因此,应该把军情调查视为深入防卫安全战略的一个组成部分,而不是单独的安全保障。

blocks.en: 14 Open Problems
blocks.zh: 14 未决问题

blocks.en: This section identifies and describes key conceptual questions in mechanistic interpretability that guide the field’s future direction.
blocks.zh: 本节查明并说明了指导外地未来方向的机械解释方面的关键概念问题。

blocks.en: 14.1 When Is Mechanistic Understanding Necessary?
blocks.zh: 14.1 何时需要机械理解?

blocks.en: Section 3.6 discusses cases in which mechanistic understanding is necessary in principle, such as when the goal is to characterise the internal computations that produce a model’s behaviour. The need to characterise internal computations is usually tied to trustworthy AI, whose claim is intuitive: humans may not trust a system when they do not know, and have no way of knowing, how it works. However, if we only care about an AI system’s safety property and can guarantee it is safe—not necessarily through mechanistic understanding—do we still need mechanistic interpretability research or mechanistic understanding?
blocks.zh: 第3.6节讨论原则上需要机械理解的情况,例如,目标是确定产生模型行为的内部计算的特点。 将内部计算特征化的需要通常与可信赖的AI有关,其主张是直观的:人类可能不信任一个系统,当他们不知道,而且没有办法知道它是如何运作的. 然而,如果我们只关心AI系统的安全财产,并且能够保证它是安全的——不一定是通过机械理解——我们仍然需要机械解释性研究还是机械理解?

blocks.en: For example, sleeper agents’ deceptive behaviours hidden from standard behavioural evaluations ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) can leave detectable signatures in the model’s internal representations, and MacDiarmid et al. (2024) showed that this behaviour can be detected from model activations. This demonstrates the utility of looking into the internals. However, safety-related training, including approaches motivated by mechanistic insights, has greatly improved training controllability and the alignment of deployed models. Adversaries may now find it harder to implement such a backdoor. Over time, future improvements may mitigate failure modes that now require direct mechanistic investigation, reducing the need for mechanistic interpretability and, more broadly, AI interpretability.
blocks.zh: 例如,潜伏者的欺骗行为隐藏在标准行为评价中(Hubinger等,2024年),可以在模型的内部表述中留下可被察觉的签名,而MacDiarmid等(2024年)表明,可以从模型活化中检测出这种行为. 这表明调查内部的效用。 然而,与安全有关的培训,包括基于机械化见解的方法,大大提高了培训的可控性并调整了部署的模式。 现在,反对者可能发现更难实施这样一个后门。 随着时间的推移,未来的改进可能减轻现在需要直接机械化调查的故障模式,减少机械化解释的必要性,更广泛地说,减少AI解释的必要性。

blocks.en: The AI safety community has not yet agreed on whether this will happen. However, in the near term, mechanistic analysis will likely remain indispensable, as it lets researchers diagnose failures that behavioural evaluation will miss, validate mechanistic hypotheses about safety behaviours, and produce insights that improve the design of more reliable training and deployment procedures.
blocks.zh: 大赦国际安全界尚未就是否将发生这种情况达成一致。 然而,从近期来看,机械分析可能仍然不可或缺,因为它使研究人员能够诊断行为评估会错过的失误,验证关于安全行为的机械假设,并产生能改进更可靠的培训和部署程序设计的见解。

blocks.en: 14.2 Challenges in Evaluation and Benchmarking
blocks.zh: 14.2 评价和基准制定方面的挑战

blocks.en: Because widely accepted standards for benchmarks and evaluation are lacking, evaluating mechanistic interpretability methods remains hard. Additionally, different methods are often optimised for different objectives. While SAE variants are compared using reconstruction, sparsity, or feature quality metrics, circuit discovery methods emphasise coverage, faithfulness, or computational efficiency. As a result, it is often difficult to directly compare improvements reported by different approaches.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏普遍接受的基准和评价标准,评估机械解释方法仍然很困难。 此外,不同方法往往被优化用于不同的目标。 比较SAE变体时使用重建、螺旋性或特征质量计量、电路发现方法强调覆盖、忠诚或计算效率。 因此,往往难以直接比较不同方法所报告的改进。

blocks.en: Section 7.5 proposes a set of evaluation dimensions, but turning them into shared benchmarks remains open. Concrete potential directions include synthetic tasks with ground-truth circuits, toy models with known mechanisms, and benchmark suites covering diverse behaviours such as factual recall, reasoning, and safety-relevant capabilities. Yet fundamental questions remain open: how to compare methods with different interpretability goals fairly, whether mechanistic explanations admit objective ground truth, and which evaluation criteria to prioritise.
blocks.zh: 第7.5节提出了一套评价方面,但将它们变成共同基准的问题仍未解决。 具体的潜在方向包括:地面真知灼见的合成任务、已知机制的玩具模型以及涵盖事实召回、推理和安全相关能力等不同行为的基准套件。 然而,根本问题仍然存在:如何将方法与不同的可解释性目标进行公平比较,机械解释是否承认客观的真理,以及哪些评价标准优先。

blocks.en: 14.3 Incompleteness, Scalability, Generalisability, and Adversarial Robustness
blocks.zh: 14.3 不完全性、可伸缩性、可通用性、和自强性

blocks.en:
Mechanistic methods, the insights they uncover, and their downstream use face several critical challenges. Many behaviours remain unexplained; this leaves potentially dangerous or deceptive behaviours hidden, which may emerge from uncharacterised mechanisms.
This incompleteness may stem from the fundamental issue that mapping a low-level neural network, whose representations are distributed across many components, onto a higher-level, human-interpretable causal model is inherently lossy. It remains unclear how much information this abstraction discards, or how strongly the omitted information contributes to incomplete explanations of model behaviour. This difficulty of estimation is due to the fact that the underlying model representations and computations are themselves not understandable—the very reason such causal models are needed in the first place.
blocks.zh:
机械方法、发现的洞察力及其下游用途面临若干重大挑战。 许多行为仍然无法解释;这使潜在的危险或欺骗行为被隐藏起来,而这些行为可能产生于无特征的机制。
这种不完全可能源于一个根本问题,即将一个低层次神经网络的图象分布在许多组成部分之间,投射到一个更高层次的、人可解释的因果模型上,其内在损失。 仍然不清楚这种抽象化丢弃的信息有多少,或省略的信息在多大程度上促成了对模式行为的不完全解释。 这种估计困难是由于基本的模型表述和计算本身是无法理解的——首先需要这种因果模型正是原因。

blocks.en: Many existing MI approaches also scale poorly across models and domains. Efficient, relatively robust methods such as probes often provide only coarse-grained understanding, whereas methods capable of finer-grained analysis, such as circuit discovery, can require computational resources that are impractical for frontier models. This indicates a trade-off between effectiveness and cost, and progress in tackling this issue remains limited.
blocks.zh: 许多现有的管理信息系统方法在模型和领域之间也规模差。 探测器等高效而相对强健的方法往往只能提供粗厚的分辨,而能更细细地分析的方法,如电路发现,则需要计算资源,这对于前沿模型是不切实际的. 这表明效力与成本之间的取舍,解决这一问题的进展仍然有限。

blocks.en: Additionally, mechanistic safety tools can be fragile under distribution shift. For instance, monitoring methods or steering vectors may perform reliably in distribution but degrade substantially when the input distribution shifts ( Tan et al., 2024 ) , raising concerns about their robustness and generalisability in real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 此外,机械安全工具在分销转移中可能很脆弱。 例如,监测方法或引导矢量在分配中可能运行可靠,但在投入分配转移时会大幅降解(Tan等人,2024年),这使人们对其在现实世界部署中的稳健性和可通用性感到关切。

blocks.en: Lastly, mechanistic insights and techniques can be targets for adversarial adaptation. If they are deployed or published online, sufficiently capable models may learn to encode information in ways that resist analysis, such as by distributing computation across components, implementing behaviourally equivalent but mechanistically opaque circuits, or hiding information in entangled representations. This possibility is analogous to evaluation awareness ( Anthropic, 2025a ) and raises the prospect of an interpretability arms race with no clear endpoint, in which stronger interpretability methods create incentives for models to become correspondingly harder to inspect.
blocks.zh: 最后,机械化的见解和技术可以成为对抗性适应的目标。 如果在线部署或发布,足够有能力的模型可以学会以抵制分析的方式编码信息,例如通过在组件之间分配计算,实施行为等同但机械等同的不透明电路,或将信息隐藏在缠绕的表示中. 这种可能性类似于评价意识(Anthropic, 2025a),并增加了没有明确终点的可解释性军备竞赛的前景,在这种可能性中,更强有力的可解释性方法可以激励模型相应更难检查。

blocks.en: These obstacles suggest that MI is unlikely to provide a complete solution for AI safety. Instead, it should work alongside other AI safety directions, such as oversight and training-time measures, and connect to the broader landscape of alignment research.
blocks.zh: 这些障碍表明,MI不可能为AI安全提供完整的解决方案. 相反,它应当与大赦国际的其他安全指示,如监督和培训时间措施相配合,并与更广泛的协调研究联系起来。

blocks.en: 14.4 Mechanistic Understanding and Alignment
blocks.zh: 14.4 机械理解和调整

blocks.en:
MI provides tools for behavioural control. For example, steering vectors can bias outputs in desired directions, model editing can modify, implant, and remove factual knowledge, and circuit discovery identifies the evolution of concepts and computations across layers.
Yet these approaches do not directly tackle alignment specification. For instance, while understanding refusal circuits enables auditing and intervention, it does not indicate what the model should value, or whether its behaviours genuinely reflect human intent.
blocks.zh:
MI为行为控制提供了工具. 例如,方向向量可以偏向期望方向的输出,模型编辑可以修改,植入,并去除事实知识,而电路发现则可以识别跨层概念和计算的演变.
然而,这些方法并不直接涉及调整规格。 例如,虽然理解拒绝电路有助于审计和干预,但它没有说明模型应重视什么,或者其行为是否真正反映了人类的意图。

blocks.en: Current studies generally treat MI and alignment as separate problems. Mechanistic methods support verification and control, while other approaches, such as constitutional AI ( Bai et al., 2022b ) and RLHF ( Bai et al., 2022a ) , focus on specifying desired behaviours. Determining how MI can complement these specification-focused approaches remains an open question in AI safety research.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究一般将管理信息系统和一致性视为单独的问题。 机械方法支持核查和控制,而其他方法,如宪法规定的AI(Bai等人,2022年b)和RLHF(Bai等人,2022年a),则侧重于具体说明期望的行为。 在AI安全研究中,确定管理信息系统如何补充这些注重规格的方法仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: 14.5 Interpretation vs. Truth: The Ontology Question
blocks.zh: 14.5 解释与真理:肿瘤问题

blocks.en: A foundational MI question, which is both technical and conceptual, is: what does it mean to mechanistically understand a neural network? Marking a feature as a “borzoi detector”, for instance, or labelling an attention head component as “a previous-token copier” mirrors possibly subjective human choices. This means multiple mechanisms can explain one behaviour, each consistent with observed causal relationships.
blocks.zh: 一个基础的MI问题,它既是技术的,也是概念的:它对机械地理解神经网络意味着什么? 例如,将一个特征标为“borzoi探测器”,或将注意力头部部分标为“前台复印机”,可能反映人类主观的选择。 这意味着多种机制可以解释一种行为,每种行为都符合观察到的因果关系.

blocks.en: MI research often assumes how human-interpretable descriptions should map onto causal mechanisms. But these assumptions face several obstacles. As mentioned before, one of these is subjectivity. This includes choosing the level of abstraction; for instance, a circuit could be explained at the level of attention routing or low-rank decomposition, and the choice depends on subjective priorities. As such, while researchers may obtain explanations that are intuitive and fit external observations, they may not fully represent the actual internal computations ( Hewitt et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: MI研究往往假定人类可解释的描述应如何将成像到因果机制上. 但是,这些假设面临若干障碍。 如上所述,其中之一是主观性。 这包括选择抽象程度;例如,一个电路可以在注意的路由或低等分解层次上解释,选择取决于主观的优先级. 因此,虽然研究人员可能获得直观和适合外部观测的解释,但他们可能不能充分代表实际的内部计算(Hewitt等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Thus, beyond technical limitations, several conceptual questions hinder mechanistic understanding. Other questions include: How can we assess confidence in a mechanistic explanation if multiple descriptions can explain the same behaviour? Are multiple valid interpretations acceptable, or should researchers expect a unique mechanistic description? Resolving these questions will help researchers clarify the limits and goals of MI research.
blocks.zh: 因此,除技术限制外,若干概念问题阻碍对机械的理解。 其他问题包括: 如果多种描述可以解释同样的行为,我们如何评估对机械解释的信心? 多重有效解释是可以接受的,还是研究人员应该期待一种独特的机械描述? 解决这些问题会帮助研究人员澄清MI研究的局限性和目标.

blocks.en: 14.6 The Proxy Fidelity Problem
blocks.zh: 14.6 代理菲德尔问题

blocks.en: Several recent interpretability approaches construct more interpretable proxy models that approximate the target model’s internal computations. Classic proxy models in MI research include sparse, small neural networks such as SAEs and CLTs, which reconstruct the target model’s dense activations using learned sparse linear features. However, while these approaches have greatly enhanced mechanistic analysis, they introduce a new obstacle: how can we ascertain whether the proxy truly learns the same mechanisms as the original model, rather than shallowly reproducing behaviour? This concern is realistic because two neural networks can produce the same output while using different internal algorithms. That is, a proxy model may find features and circuits that do not exist in the original model.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些可解释性方法构建了更多可解释的代理模型,大致相当于目标模型的内部计算. MI研究中的经典代用模型包括了SAEs和CLTs等稀有的小型神经网络,这些网络利用所学的稀有线性特征重建了目标模型的密集活化. 然而,虽然这些方法大大地加强了机械分析,但它们带来了一个新的障碍:我们如何确定代理是否真正学习了与原始模型相同的机制,而不是浅薄地再现行为? 这种担忧是现实的,因为两个神经网络可以在使用不同的内部算法的同时产生相同的输出. 也就是说,一个代理模型可能会发现原始模型中不存在的特征和电路.

blocks.en: Therefore, what evidence is sufficient to conclude that claims about internal mechanisms found from interpretable proxies faithfully reflect the original computation? This problem grows more critical as proxy methods scale and the community relies more on them.
blocks.zh: 因此,哪些证据足以得出以下结论:从可解释代理人中找到的内部机制索赔忠实地反映了最初的计算? 随着代用方法的规模扩大,社区更加依赖代用方法,这个问题变得更加严重.

blocks.en: For example, when researchers find no “deception circuits” in the proxy models, can they claim that the target model has therefore “passed the test” and is safe? Making this claim requires that these mechanisms do not exist in the target model either. However, as discussed above, the absence of a mechanism in the proxy model does not imply its absence in the target model, since they may compute the input differently while producing the same output. The conclusion we can draw is only something like “we did not find the deception mechanism in the proxy model”, which is far from a useful guarantee in safety-critical scenarios.
blocks.zh: 例如,当研究人员在代理模型中没有发现"欺骗回路"时,他们能否声称目标模型因此"通过了测试"并且是安全的? 提出这一主张要求目标模式中也不存在这些机制。 然而,如上所讨论,代理模型中缺乏机制并不意味着目标模型中缺乏机制,因为它们在计算输入时可能会不同,同时产生相同的输出. 我们只能得出这样的结论,即“我们没有在代理模式中找到欺骗机制”,这远远不是安全关键情景中的有益保障。

blocks.en: Several directions can validate and improve proxy fidelity. One promising direction is interchange intervention testing and training ( Geiger et al., 2024 ; Geiger et al., 2022 ) . This technique was developed to compare and align a neural network with a high-level causal abstraction. The proxy models and their circuits can be viewed as a causal abstraction of the target model, where the nodes (human-interpretable variables) are the proxy models’ features. This framing not only lets us test alignment between the mechanisms identified in proxy models and the target model, but also provides an optimisation objective for training faithful proxies. Additionally, a theoretical framework that upper-bounds how much internal computation can differ between the target model and proxy model under a given reconstruction performance can also be a promising direction.
blocks.zh: 几个方向可以验证和改进代理忠诚. 一个有希望的方向是交换干预测试和培训(Geiger等人,2024年;Geiger等人,2022年)。 这一技术的开发是为了将神经网络与高层次的因果抽象进行对比和对接. 代理模型及其回路可以看作是目标模型的因果抽象,其中节点(人-可解释变量)是代理模型的特征. 这种框架不仅让我们检验代理模式所确定机制与目标模式之间的一致,而且为培训忠实代理提供了优化目标。 此外,一个理论框架如果在某一重建绩效下,内部计算在目标模型和代用模型之间能有多大不同,也可以是一个很有希望的方向。

blocks.en: 14.7 Transferability Beyond Transformers
blocks.zh: 14.7 变压器以外的可转让性

blocks.en: The methods surveyed in this paper have been developed and evaluated predominantly in transformer-based autoregressive language models. Although the six research orientations discussed in Section 12 are largely architecture-agnostic in their aims, their classic methods and representative works focus almost entirely on transformers. Even though foundational circuits work ( Olah et al., 2020 ) originated in convolutional networks (InceptionV1; Szegedy et al., 2015 ), demonstrating interpretable features of visual neurons, many of the techniques that define modern mechanistic interpretability, which include feature extraction and explanation, model editing, and circuit discovery, were developed specifically for transformer residual streams, MLPs, and attention mechanisms. Thus, an important question arises: are mechanistic interpretability concepts, tools, and findings specific to transformers, or do they reflect more general properties of neural computation across model architectures? Below, we discuss several representative models that are substantially different from transformer-based autoregressive models.
blocks.zh: 本文所调查的方法主要是以变压器自递性语言模型为基础来制定和评价的. 虽然第12节所讨论到的6个研究取向在目标上基本上都是建筑-不可知论的,但其经典方法和代表性作品几乎完全集中在变压器上. 尽管基础电路工作(Olah等,2020年)起源于革命网络(InceptionV1;Szegedy等,2015年),展现了视觉神经元的可解释性特征,但许多定义现代机械可解释性的技术,包括地物取出和解释,模型编辑,和电路发现,都是专门为变压器残余流,MLP,以及注意力机制而开发的. 因此,产生了一个重要问题:机械解释性概念、工具和结论是针对变压器的,还是反映了模型结构中神经计算更普遍的特性? 下面我们讨论几种与变压器自递性模型有很大不同的代表性模型.

blocks.en: • Convolutional neural networks (CNNs): CNNs are a representative vision model architecture ( O’Shea & Nash, 2015 ; Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ). Their fundamental building blocks are convolutional and pooling layers rather than MLP blocks and self-attention. Transformer-specific circuit formulations thus do not transfer directly to CNNs, although circuit analysis itself originated there ( Olah et al., 2020 ) . Convolutions’ spatial locality may yield more naturally modular circuits than transformers under suitable formulations, but large-scale studies of superposition, feature extraction, and circuit discovery in modern CNNs and their variants remain limited. • State-space and recurrent models: Architectures such as Mamba ( Gu & Dao, 2024 ) and RWKV ( Peng et al., 2023 ) replace standard self-attention with recurrent computations that update a hidden state over time. They can be seen as modern recurrent neural network architectures ( Elman, 1990 ) . Specifically, Mamba uses input-dependent state transitions to selectively retain or forget information, while RWKV uses a recurrence based on linear attention. This new paradigm raises interpretability questions that previous transformer interpretability studies have not addressed, such as how information is stored and updated in recurrent states, whether these representations exhibit certain properties such as superposition, and how causal effects can be traced across state updates. • Diffusion models: Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) apply iterative denoising processes to generate images or tokens. They may still use transformers as backbones, but their computational structure differs fundamentally from autoregressive generation. For example, many current MI studies use the predicted next token as a sign of model behaviour (e.g., “yes” or “no” when the input is a malicious query), while diffusion-based language models generate multiple tokens in different positions at a time to iteratively complete the response. This difference means many interpretability techniques and insights do not directly apply. While recent work has begun investigating attention patterns and internal representations in diffusion models ( Tinaz et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ), mechanistic understanding in this paradigm remains lacking.
blocks.zh: • 革命神经网络: CNN是具有代表性的视觉模型架构(O'Shea & Nash,2015;Krizhevsky等,2012. 它们的基本构件是分解和集合层,而不是MLP块和自觉. 因此,变形器特有的电路配体不会直接转移到CNN,尽管电路分析本身就源于那里(Olah等,2020年.). 演化器的空间位置可能比在合适的配方下变压器产生更自然的模块化电路,但大规模研究叠置,地物提取,以及现代CNN及其变体中的电路发现仍然有限. • 国家空间和经常模式: Mamba (Gu & Dao, 2024)和RWKV (Peng等, 2023)等架构以反复计算取代标准自留,这些计算会随着时间的推移更新隐藏状态. 它们可以被看作现代反复出现的神经网络架构(Elman,1990.). 具体来说,曼巴使用依赖输入的状态过渡有选择地保留或忘记信息,而RWKV则使用基于线性关注的重现. 这种新的范式提出了之前的变压器解释性研究没有解决的可解释性问题,例如信息如何在反复状态下被存储和更新,这些表述是否表现出了叠加等某些属性,以及如何在状态更新中追溯出因果关系. • 传播模式: 分化模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年)应用迭代去诺化过程来生成图像或符号. 它们可能仍会将变压器用作骨干,但其计算结构与自旋式生成有着根本的不同. 例如,许多目前的MI研究将所预测的下个符号作为模型行为的标志(如输入为恶意查询时的"是"或"不是"),而基于扩散的语言模型在不同位置生成多个符号,一次反复完成响应. 这种区别意味着许多可解释性技术以及洞察力并不直接适用. 虽然最近的工作已经开始调查扩散模型中的注意模式和内部表现(Tinaz等,2025;Wang等,2026c),但这一范式的机械性理解仍然不足.

blocks.en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs): CNNs are a representative vision model architecture ( O’Shea & Nash, 2015 ; Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ). Their fundamental building blocks are convolutional and pooling layers rather than MLP blocks and self-attention. Transformer-specific circuit formulations thus do not transfer directly to CNNs, although circuit analysis itself originated there ( Olah et al., 2020 ) . Convolutions’ spatial locality may yield more naturally modular circuits than transformers under suitable formulations, but large-scale studies of superposition, feature extraction, and circuit discovery in modern CNNs and their variants remain limited.
blocks.zh: 革命神经网络(CNN): CNN是具有代表性的视觉模型架构(O'Shea & Nash,2015;Krizhevsky等,2012. 它们的基本构件是分解和集合层,而不是MLP块和自觉. 因此,变形器特有的电路配体不会直接转移到CNN,尽管电路分析本身就源于那里(Olah等,2020年.). 演化器的空间位置可能比在合适的配方下变压器产生更自然的模块化电路,但大规模研究叠置,地物提取,以及现代CNN及其变体中的电路发现仍然有限.

blocks.en: State-space and recurrent models: Architectures such as Mamba ( Gu & Dao, 2024 ) and RWKV ( Peng et al., 2023 ) replace standard self-attention with recurrent computations that update a hidden state over time. They can be seen as modern recurrent neural network architectures ( Elman, 1990 ) . Specifically, Mamba uses input-dependent state transitions to selectively retain or forget information, while RWKV uses a recurrence based on linear attention. This new paradigm raises interpretability questions that previous transformer interpretability studies have not addressed, such as how information is stored and updated in recurrent states, whether these representations exhibit certain properties such as superposition, and how causal effects can be traced across state updates.
blocks.zh: 国家空间和经常模式: Mamba (Gu & Dao, 2024)和RWKV (Peng等, 2023)等架构以反复计算取代标准自留,这些计算会随着时间的推移更新隐藏状态. 它们可以被看作现代反复出现的神经网络架构(Elman,1990.). 具体来说,曼巴使用依赖输入的状态过渡有选择地保留或忘记信息,而RWKV则使用基于线性关注的重现. 这种新的范式提出了之前的变压器可解释性研究没有解决的可解释性问题,例如信息如何被存储和更新在经常状态下,这些表达是否表现出了叠加等某些属性,以及如何在状态更新中追溯出因果关系.

blocks.en: Diffusion models: Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) apply iterative denoising processes to generate images or tokens. They may still use transformers as backbones, but their computational structure differs fundamentally from autoregressive generation. For example, many current MI studies use the predicted next token as a sign of model behaviour (e.g., “yes” or “no” when the input is a malicious query), while diffusion-based language models generate multiple tokens in different positions at a time to iteratively complete the response. This difference means many interpretability techniques and insights do not directly apply. While recent work has begun investigating attention patterns and internal representations in diffusion models ( Tinaz et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ), mechanistic understanding in this paradigm remains lacking.
blocks.zh: 分泌模型:分泌模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年)应用迭代去诺过程来生成图像或令牌. 它们可能仍会将变压器用作骨干,但其计算结构与自旋式生成有着根本的不同. 例如,许多目前的MI研究将所预测的下个符号作为模型行为的标志(如输入为恶意查询时的"是"或"不是"),而基于扩散的语言模型在不同位置生成多个符号,一次反复完成响应. 这种区别意味着许多可解释性技术以及洞察力并不直接适用. 虽然最近的工作已经开始调查扩散模型中的注意模式和内部表现(Tinaz等,2025;Wang等,2026c),但这一范式的机械性理解仍然不足.

blocks.en: Beyond these major architectural changes, researchers have also proposed variants of conventional transformer components. For example, mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers ( Lepikhin et al., 2021 ; Dai et al., 2024a ) replace standard MLP blocks with multiple smaller MLPs, called “experts”. For each input activation, a router selects a subset of experts based on the activation and combines their outputs using learned routing weights. Many modern transformer-based language models have adopted this architecture ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; QwenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 除了这些重大的建筑变化外,研究人员还提出了传统变压器组件的变体. 例如,混合型专家分层(Lepikhin等,2021;Dai等,2024a)用多块较小的MLP来取代标准MLP块,称为"专家". 对于每次输入活化,一个路由器都会根据活化情况选择一个子集的专家,并使用所学到的路由权重来结合他们的输出. 许多以变压器为基础的现代语言模型都采用了这种架构(Jiang等,2024;DeepSeek-AI,2025;QuenAI,2025;OpenAI等,2025;Team等,2026).

blocks.en: However, MoE architectures introduce technical challenges for mechanistic analysis. For example, activation patching at an intermediate MoE layer may change which experts are selected in downstream MoE layers. This makes it difficult to distinguish the patched activation’s effects on model output from those mediated by changes in downstream expert routing. Furthermore, MoE layers can contain many experts, ranging from 8 ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) to 256 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) or more ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) . Although only a subset of experts is active for each input, the large number of possible expert pathways increases the search space for circuit discovery, making circuit discovery harder to use in modern MoE-based models.
blocks.zh: 然而,教育部的架构为机械分析带来了技术挑战。 例如,中间的MOE层的活化补丁可能会改变在下游MOE层中选择的专家. 这使得难以区分补丁活化对模型输出的影响与由下游专家路径变化所促成的效果。 此外,教育部层可以包含许多专家,从8名(Jiang等,2024年)到256名(Deep Seek-AI,2025年)或更多(Deep Seek-AI等,2026年)不等。 虽然每个输入都只有一组专家活跃,但大量可能的专家路径增加了对电路发现的搜索空间,使得电路发现更难被现代基于MOE的模型所使用.

blocks.en: Simultaneously, some recent work suggests that at least a few mechanistic interpretability techniques can transfer outside of transformers. Steering vectors, tuned lenses, knowledge editing, and circuit analysis evaluations have all been adapted, with varying success, to state-space models such as RWKV and Mamba, as well as to vision-language models ( Paulo et al., 2025a ; Sharma et al., 2024a ; Häon et al., 2025 ; Neo et al., 2025 ; Ensign & Garriga-Alonso, 2024 ). Researchers have also conducted theoretical analyses aiming to clarify the computational relationships between transformers and other architectures. Some initial results suggest that several findings in transformers may reflect more general, transferable properties of neural networks ( Zimerman et al., 2025 ; Dao & Gu, 2024 ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ali et al., 2025 ) . Sorting out which aspects of mechanistic interpretability depend on architecture and which reflect broader principles of neural computation thus appears to be a promising research direction. On the other hand, whether current research orientations and associated techniques remain relevant beyond transformers will also show how broadly mechanistic interpretability research can apply to future systems.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,最近的一些工作表明,至少有几种机械解释技术可以转移出变压器。 引导载体、调制镜头、知识编辑和电路分析评价都进行了调整,并取得了不同程度的成功,以适应RWKV和Mamba等状态空间模型以及视觉语言模型(Paulo等人,2025a;Sharma等人,2024a; Häon等,2025;Neo等,2025;Ensign & Garriga-Alonso,2024. 研究人员还进行了理论分析,旨在澄清变压器与其他架构之间的计算关系. 一些初步结果表明,变压器中的一些发现可能反映了神经网络的更普遍、可转移的性质(Zimerman等,2025;Dao & Gu,2024;Peng等,2025;Ali等,2025)。 因此,确定机械解释的哪些方面取决于结构,哪些方面反映更广泛的神经计算原则,似乎是一个很有希望的研究方向。 另一方面,目前的研究取向和相关技术是否在变压器之外仍然具有相关性,这也将表明机械解释性研究如何广泛适用于未来的系统。

blocks.en: 15 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 15 结论

blocks.en: Neural networks could be one of the most consequential artefacts humanity has built, yet we do not understand how they work or reliably control what they do. Recent decades have seen an exponential improvement in AI capabilities, but methods to understand and explain internal mechanisms have lagged behind. This has created an interpretability gap between what models can do and what we know about how they do it.
blocks.zh: 神经网络可能是人类建造的最具影响的物品之一,但我们不明白它们是如何运作或可靠地控制它们的工作。 近几十年来,人工智能能力有了指数性提高,但了解和解释内部机制的方法已落后。 这在模型能做什么和我们知道它们如何做之间造成了可解释性的差距。

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. In this survey, we examine closely what interpretability can actually contribute to AI safety. We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. Beyond surveying existing methods, we propose a unified framework for evaluating mechanistic interpretability claims and characterise six research orientations by their goals, assumptions, and trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 机械解释性通过研究这些系统的内部表现和计算,为了解这些系统提供了一条途径,目的是评价、预测和控制行为。 在本次调查中,我们仔细研究了哪些可解释性能够真正促进AI安全. 我们把机械解释性放在解释性研究的更广阔背景下,并将其机械证据与行为评价进行比较. 除了调查现有方法之外,我们建议建立一个统一的框架,用以评价机械解释性主张,并按其目标、假设和取舍确定六个研究方向。

blocks.en: Rather than converging on a single approach, the field has crystallised into divergent research orientations, including Pragmatic Interpretability, Ambitious Interpretability, Developmental Interpretability, Interpretability Across Time, Introspective Interpretability, and Automated Interpretability, each making trade-offs between completeness, cost, and applicability.
blocks.zh: 本领域不是在单一方法上趋同,而是在不同的研究取向上具体化,包括实用解释、远近解释、发展解释、跨时间解释、内向解释和自动解释,每个研究取舍于完整性、成本和适用性。

blocks.en: 15.1 Achievements and Limits
blocks.zh: 15.1 成绩和局限性

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability has achieved substantial progress across several fronts, including extracting interpretable features with SAEs, discovering task-relevant circuits, and enabling targeted interventions on model behaviour. Overall, the field has shaped how researchers view model computation, representations, and causal structure.
blocks.zh: 机械解释能力在几个方面取得了实质性进展,包括提取与SAE有关的可解释特征,发现与任务相关的电路,以及能够对示范行为进行有针对性的干预。 总体而言,这个领域塑造了研究人员对模型计算、表述和因果结构的看法。

blocks.en: Yet current approaches are limited: they do not fully explain many behaviours, struggle to generalise under distribution shift, have difficulty cleanly disentangling entangled computations, and are hard to scale to frontier models. More importantly, their usefulness for AI safety remains debated.
blocks.zh: 然而,目前的方法是有限的:它们没有充分解释许多行为,在分配变化中难以概括,难以明确解开缠绕的计算,而且难以推广到前沿模型。 更重要的是,它们对AI安全的作用仍然有争论。

blocks.en: Although many prior studies in the interpretability community assume that mechanistic understanding directly implies safer systems, the assumption is in fact largely untested. Therefore, this survey considers not only what a method reveals about a model’s internal computation, but also what it allows us to do in practice. We particularly discuss whether it supports safety-relevant tasks such as detecting deceptive behaviours or identifying dangerous capabilities, and whether those tasks can be achieved just as well without interpretability methods or insights.
blocks.zh: 尽管在可解释性社区的许多先前的研究都假设机械化理解直接意味着更安全的系统,但这一假设事实上基本上未经测试. 因此,本调查不仅考虑了一种方法揭示出一个模型的内部计算,而且也考虑了它允许我们在实践中做些什么。 我们特别讨论它是否支持与安全有关的任务,例如发现欺骗行为或确定危险的能力,以及这些任务能否在没有解释方法或见解的情况下同样实现。

blocks.en: A persistent challenge in mechanistic interpretability is the lack of standardised evaluation. Different interpretability methods use incompatible metrics. To address this, we present a unified evaluation framework covering five dimensions—attribution faithfulness, completeness, stability, causal validity, and human interpretability—where different methods can be jointly tested. We identify gaps and argue that the evaluation methodology and safety benchmarks are the field’s most pressing open problems.
blocks.zh: 机械解释方面的一个长期挑战是缺乏标准化的评价。 不同的可解释性方法使用不相容的度量衡. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个统一的评价框架,涵盖五个方面——归属忠诚、完整性、稳定性、因果有效性和人的解释性——可以共同测试不同的方法。 我们找出差距,认为评价方法和安全基准是外地最紧迫的公开问题。

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability is not a panacea for AI safety. Researchers, developers, and practitioners should recognise the limits of partial or incorrect causal understanding, rigorously evaluate MI tools under broad conditions, and combine them with complementary safety measures. MI should therefore be viewed as one component of a defence-in-depth safety strategy rather than a standalone guarantee of safety.
blocks.zh: 机械解释性不是AI安全的灵丹妙药. 研究人员、开发者和从业人员应认识到部分或不正确的因果理解的局限性,严格评价广义条件下的MI工具,并将其与补充性安全措施结合起来。 因此,应该把军情调查视为深入防卫安全战略的一个组成部分,而不是单独的安全保障。

blocks.en: 15.2 The Road Ahead
blocks.zh: 15.2 联合国 前进的道路

blocks.en: The six research orientations describe different research goals and priorities. At a broader level, mechanistic interpretability can be organised into three complementary paradigms that encompass these orientations and other research directions:
blocks.zh: 六个研究方向描述了不同的研究目标和优先事项. 在更广泛的层面上,机械解释可分为三个互补的范式,其中包括这些取向和其他研究方向:

blocks.en: 1. Post-hoc explanation: The traditional paradigm of studying trained models’ internals via tools like SAEs, circuit discovery, activation verbalisers, and causal analysis. Because deployed systems still rely on conventional dense architectures without intrinsic interpretability, post-hoc analysis will remain important in the medium term. 2. Studying learning dynamics: Understanding how mechanisms emerge during training via methods like singular learning theory and checkpoint analysis. This paradigm enables understanding, prediction, and intervention early in behaviour and capability emergence. 3. Interpretability by design: Engineering architectures that are mechanistically transparent by construction, such as SoLU, weight-sparse transformers, KANs, and their successors. This paradigm moves interpretability upstream and promises to reduce the need for expensive post-hoc analysis.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 事后解释: 通过SAEs等工具研究训练有素的模型内部, 电路发现, 激活口音器, 由于所部署的系统仍然依赖传统的密集结构,而缺乏内在的可解释性,因此在中期,热后分析仍然很重要. 2. 研究学习动态: 了解培训期间如何通过单一学习理论和检查站分析等方法产生机制。 这种模式使得人们能够及早了解、预测和干预行为和能力。 3.按设计可解释性:由建筑机械透明而成的工程建筑,如SoLU,重量分层变压器,KANs,及其后继. 这种范式将可解释性向上移动,并有望减少对昂贵的后热分析的需求.

blocks.en: Post-hoc explanation: The traditional paradigm of studying trained models’ internals via tools like SAEs, circuit discovery, activation verbalisers, and causal analysis. Because deployed systems still rely on conventional dense architectures without intrinsic interpretability, post-hoc analysis will remain important in the medium term.
blocks.zh: 事后解释: 通过SAEs等工具研究训练有素的模型内部, 电路发现, 激活口音器, 由于所部署的系统仍然依赖传统的密集结构,而缺乏内在的可解释性,因此在中期,热后分析仍然很重要.

blocks.en: Studying learning dynamics: Understanding how mechanisms emerge during training via methods like singular learning theory and checkpoint analysis. This paradigm enables understanding, prediction, and intervention early in behaviour and capability emergence.
blocks.zh: 研究学习动态: 了解培训期间如何通过单一学习理论和检查站分析等方法产生机制。 这种模式使得人们能够及早了解、预测和干预行为和能力。

blocks.en: Interpretability by design: Engineering architectures that are mechanistically transparent by construction, such as SoLU, weight-sparse transformers, KANs, and their successors. This paradigm moves interpretability upstream and promises to reduce the need for expensive post-hoc analysis.
blocks.zh: 设计可解释性: 通过建筑具有机械透明度的工程建筑,如SoLU,重量分层变压器,KANs及其后继. 这种范式将可解释性向上移动,并有望减少对昂贵的后热分析的需求.

blocks.en: Each approach tackles a different area but complements the others. For instance, interpretability-by-design models can reduce reliance on post-hoc methods, while post-hoc mechanistic analysis can guide next-generation interpretability-by-design models towards desirable properties that current dense architectures lack. Insights into learning dynamics can suggest architectural constraints and training-time interventions.
blocks.zh: 每种方法都涉及不同的领域,但又补充了其他领域。 例如,可解释性逐一设计模型可以减少对后热方法的依赖,而后热机械分析可以引导下一代可解释性逐一设计模型走向目前密集建筑所缺乏的可取属性. 对学习动态的洞察可以表明建筑限制和培训时间干预。

blocks.en: Progress also depends on establishing stronger scientific standards. Recent work argues that interpretability should produce claims that are both falsifiable and reproducible, and improve its use in model evaluations and downstream applications.
blocks.zh: 进步还取决于建立更强有力的科学标准。 最近的工作认为,可解释性应产生既可伪造又可复制的索赔,并改进其在模型评价和下游应用中的应用。

blocks.en: Ultimately, the question remains: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? This survey’s goal is to understand how these approaches can work together to improve model understanding and safeguards, while recognising the limits of partial or incorrect causal understanding.
blocks.zh: 最后,问题仍然是: 了解模型是如何运作的吗? 这项调查的目的是了解这些方法如何能合作改善模型的理解和保障,同时承认部分或不正确的因果理解的局限性。

blocks.en: Appendix B Colour Key and Style Guide

blocks.en: This section explains the visual conventions used throughout the survey for boxes, emphasis, and structural elements.
blocks.zh: 本节解释整个调查中对方框、重点和结构要素采用的视觉常规。

blocks.en: B.1 Box Types and Colours
blocks.zh: B.1 框类型和颜色

blocks.en: Definition Box (Dark Blue) Definition boxes introduce core concepts and provide precise technical definitions. Use these when a term needs clear specification before use. Example concepts: “Feature”, “Circuit”, “Sparse Autoencoder”. Style: Dark blue border, light blue background.
blocks.zh: 定义框 (Dark Blue) 定义框引入了核心概念并提供了精确的技术定义. 当一个名词在使用前需要清晰的规格时使用这些名词. 实例概念:“Feature”、“Circuit”、“Sparse自动编码器”。 样式:暗蓝色边框,浅蓝色背景.

blocks.en: Example Box (Green) Example boxes provide concrete illustrations, worked examples, or case studies. Use these to make abstract concepts concrete. Example contents: “Induction in a Repeated Sequence”, “Example Application of Steering Vectors”, “Probing Classifiers for Sleeper Agents”. Style: Green border, light green background.
blocks.zh: 实例框(Green)实例框提供了具体的插图,工作实例或案例研究. 用这些来使抽象的概念具体化. 示例内容:“重复序列中的介绍”、“引导矢量的应用实例”、“沉睡者代理人的试验分类器”。 样式:绿色边框,浅绿色背景.

blocks.en: Insight Box (Gold) Insight boxes explain intuitions behind mathematical or conceptual results. Use these to build understanding of why something works, not just that it works. Example contents: “Trade-offs Between Variants”, “The Complexity–Interpretability Trade-off”. Style: Gold border, light gold background.
blocks.zh: 透视盒 (黄金) 透视盒解释数学或概念结果背后的直觉. 利用这些来理解 东西为什么起作用, 不只是它起作用。 示例内容: " 备选案文之间的取舍 " , " 复杂性-可解释性取舍 " 。 样式:金边框,浅金背景.

blocks.en: Warning Box (Red) Warning boxes highlight critical limitations, failure modes, or common misconceptions. Use these to prevent readers from adopting incorrect or unsafe interpretations. Example contents: “Caveats on CLT Fidelity Claims”, “The Probe Causality Problem”, “The Partial Coverage Issue”. Style: Red border, light red background.
blocks.zh: 警告框 (红色) 警告框突出关键限制,失败模式,或常见的误解. 用这些来防止读者采用不正确或不安全的解释. 实例内容:“关于CLT Fidelity索赔的Caveats”、“Probe Causity问题”、“部分覆盖问题”。 样式:红色边框,浅红色背景.

blocks.en: Practice Box (Teal) Practice boxes illustrate suggestions that are actionable. These include protocol recommendations, checklists for verifying approaches, and step-by-step decision-making walkthroughs. Use these for practical implementations of procedures. Example contents: “Guardrail Framework for Automated Interpretability”, “Validation Procedures for Introspective Models”, “Recommended Evaluation Protocol”. Style: Teal border, light teal background.
blocks.zh: 实践框(Teal)实践框说明了可操作的建议. 其中包括议定书建议、核查方法的核对表和逐步决策的走过。 将这些程序用于程序的实际实施。 实例内容:“自动解释的担保框架”、“回顾模型的估价程序”、“建议的评价议定书”。 样式:Teal边框,轻取Teal背景.

blocks.en: This section provides background on some key mathematical frameworks used in mechanistic interpretability.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍一些用于机械解释的关键数学框架的背景.

blocks.en: C.1 Causal Inference Basics
blocks.zh: C.1 因果关系

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability relies on causal reasoning: determining whether a component is necessary and sufficient for a behaviour.
blocks.zh: 机械解释依赖于因果推理:确定一个成分对于一个行为是否必要和足够.

blocks.en: C.1.1 Necessity
blocks.zh: C.1.1 必要性

blocks.en: A component S S is necessary for behaviour B B if: Remove ​ S ⇒ B ​ disappears \text{Remove }S\Rightarrow B\text{ disappears} (4)
blocks.zh: 如果: 删除 S Q ,则行为 B 需要一个 S S 组件 B 消失 \ text{ remove } S\右旋 B\ text{ 消失 } (4)

blocks.en: Tested via ablation: measure the effect of removing S S on downstream loss or output distribution.
blocks.zh: 通过减价测试:测量去除SS对下游损失或输出分布的影响.

blocks.en: C.1.2 Sufficiency
blocks.zh: C.1.2 充分性

blocks.en: A component S S is sufficient for behaviour B B if: Only ​ S ​ is active ⇒ B ​ occurs \text{Only }S\text{ is active}\Rightarrow B\text{ occurs} (5)
blocks.zh: 如果: 只有 S 活动 Q\ B 发生\ text{ 仅 } S\ text{ 活动 }\ Rightarrow B\ text{ 发生} (5) , 则 S S 组件足以用于行为 B 。

blocks.en: Tested via interchange interventions: in the corrupted run with a reference input containing no target information, patch the activation of S S with that from a clean run using an input containing the target information, and then verify whether the behaviour emerges.
blocks.zh: 通过交换干预进行测试:在被破坏的运行中,使用不含目标信息的参考输入,将S的激活与使用包含目标信息的输入从干净运行中补齐,再核实行为是否出现.

blocks.en: C.1.3 Causal Abstraction
blocks.zh: C.1.3 因果关系摘要

blocks.en: Causal abstraction ( Geiger et al., 2021 ) formalises when a high-level description (“this head implements copying”) correctly describes lower-level computation. A high-level abstraction is causally correct if interventions on the high-level description produce the same causal effects as interventions on the low-level system. This is formalised via causal diagrams: high-level variables correspond to low-level variables via abstraction maps Φ \Phi , and interventions commute: Intervene at high level → Φ Intervene at low level \text{Intervene at high level}\xrightarrow{\Phi}\text{Intervene at low level} (6)
blocks.zh: 因果关系抽象 (Geiger等, 2021)当一个高层次描述("这个头执行复制")正确描述低层次计算时,形式化. 如果对高层次描述的干预产生与对低层次体系的干预相同的因果关系,高层次抽象是因果正确的. 这通过因果图的形式化: 高层次变量通过抽象图 \\\ Phi 对应低层次变量, 和 干涉通勤 : 高级插播 → 低等插播 \ text{高等插播 → xrightarrow\ Phi}\text{ 低等插播 (6)

blocks.en: C.2 Local Learning Coefficient (LLC)
blocks.zh: C.2 当地学习系数

blocks.en: Singular Learning Theory (SLT; Watanabe, 2009 ) provides a geometric analysis of learning and generalisation in singular statistical models, including neural networks. The Local Learning Coefficient (LLC; Lau et al., 2025 ) builds on SLT by localising Watanabe’s learning coefficient around a particular parameter configuration, thereby providing a measure of the effective local complexity of a neural network around a local minimum. Below, we introduce the LLC step by step, following the exposition in Section 3 of Lau et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: Singular Learning Theory (SLT; Watanabe, 2009) 以单数统计模型,包括神经网络,提供学习和概括的几何分析. 本地学习系数(LLC;Lau等,2025年)以SLT为基础,将渡边的学习系数定位到特定参数的配置上,从而提供了一个衡量神经网络在本地最低值周围的有效本地复杂性的尺度。 在Lau等人(2025年)第3节的阐述后,

blocks.en: We first consider a neural network and a downstream task. For each neural network parameter configuration, say θ \theta , we can evaluate its loss ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) \mathcal{L}(\theta) . The task should have an explicitly defined loss function ℒ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{L}(\cdot) , such that we can optimise the model parameters until they converge to a local minimum θ ∗ \theta^{*} . Now we choose a sufficiently small closed ball B ⁡ ( θ ∗ ) B(\theta^{*}) centred at θ ∗ \theta^{*} such that any element in it, i.e., θ \theta , satisfies ℒ ⁡ ( θ ∗ ) ≤ ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) . \mathcal{L}(\theta^{*})\leq\mathcal{L}(\theta). Within this ball, we further consider the subset where each element has a loss that, while always greater than or equal to the local minimum, falls within a tolerance threshold ϵ \epsilon . B(\theta^{*},\epsilon)\coloneqq\left\{\theta\in B(\theta^{*})\mid\mathcal{L}(\theta)-\mathcal{L}(\theta^{*})<\epsilon\right\}.

blocks.en: C.3 Information Theory Basics
blocks.zh: C.3 信息理论基础

blocks.en: In mechanistic interpretability, concepts from information theory are often used to quantify relationships between internal components and how much information is preserved, and to measure representation quality. Although they do not directly establish causal mechanisms, they are highly useful for quantifying how information is encoded and changes during model computation.
blocks.zh: 在机械解释中,来自信息理论的概念常被用来量化内部组件之间的关系和保存了多少信息,并用来衡量表达质量. 虽然它们没有直接建立因果机制,但它们对于量化信息编码方式和模型计算过程中的变化非常有用.

blocks.en: High entropy indicates greater uncertainty, while low entropy implies more predictable distributions. Entropy is frequently utilised to measure learned representation diversity or prediction confidence.
